dpo/sprang 65nga/7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas bstsal ba'i ched brjod/gleng brjod/ 5sa bcad dang po/le tshan dang po/ nga'i skyes yul bod byang shar mdo smad tsong kha'i yul gyi lo rgyus rags tsam gleng ba/ 11le tshan gnyis pa/ nga'i pha mes kyi rigs rgyud dang / nga rang byis pa'i dus kyi dran tshor/ 35le tshan gsum pa/ 7gong sa mchog gi skya'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma nged gnyis 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi gnyen du 'brel ba/ 51le tshan bzhi pa/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du ji ltar bltams tshul/ 55le tshan lnga pa/ 7gong sa mchog gi 'khrungs gzhis stag 'tshor gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ 85le tshan drug pa/ so nam pa phal pa'i bu phrug glo bur mi drag gi sras su gyur pa/ 95

sa bcad gnyis pa/le tshan bdun pa/ lha sa'i jo bos mtshon bla lha che khag mjal ba'i skal bzang thob pa/ 111le tshan brgyad pa/ sku drag gzim shag che khag gi gsol ston du bcar ba 131le tshan dgu pa/ bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi srid 'dzin gyi rtsa 'dzugs skor/ 1276sku tshan bcu pa/ yab gzhis stag 'tshor gyi gnas stangs dang / kho bo pha yul la bu lon bsdu bskyod skor/ 153le tshan bcu gcig pa/ sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang / phran gnyis srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i mjal khar bcar ba 185le tshan bcu gnyis pa/ sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang phran gnyis rgya gar brgyud rgya nag la slob sbyong du bskyed pa/ 195rngan bcad garwas34 pa/le tshan bcu gsum pa/ rwa sgreng bla brang la byus nyes byung ba'i skor/ 249le tshan bcu bzhi pa/ rwa stag srid skyong rnam gnyis dbar gyi don rkyen/ 357le tshan bco lnga pa/ bod gzhung gi gang ci'i legs bcos mdzad phyogs la 'gal rkyen 'phrad pa/ 293le tshan bcu drug pa/ phran dang / 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gnyis ngo shes byung stangs dang / khong gi dmar lugs las 'gul/ 311

zur 'dzar /1 sku par khag gcig bzhugs/3 stag 'cher 'khrungs khang gi sa khra bod shing phag 1935 lor rgyal ba sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po sku 'khrungs skabs kyi bkod dbyibs dran lam rab rib tsam bkod pa/3 1939 lor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog mdo smad tsong kha'i 'khrungs yul nas lha ldan rgyal sar gdan zhu chibs bsgyur bskyangs skabs phebs lam 'khel yul gyi sa khra/4 gdan sa chen po sku 'bum byams pa gling gi 'dra ris/

mod rtogono lho d+ngha ngh+ru/ waX ram̐ tsu 156 0'ji ji lo ra༅༅/ deng dus bod kyi spyi tshogs gsar rnying 'pho 'gyur shin tu chen po 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs 'dir/ bod mi rgan rabs rnams nas rang gi mi che'i nang bde sdug myong tshor ji byung sgro skur spangs pa'i lo rgyus gang mang rtsom bris dgos pa'i 'bod skul ji ltar bgyis pa bzhin/ stag lha phun tshogs bkris nas rang gi mi che'i lo rgyus dang chabs cig de'i che de'i dus spyi tshogs kyi gnas stangs rags rim 'khod pa'i dpe deb gsar rtsom bgyis pa legs/ dpe deb 'di la brten nas ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs gsar pa tshos spyi tshogs rnying pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa la phan cha nges can zhig 'byung nges yin/kun la dge zhing shis pa'i smon 'dun bcas/tu la'i bla mas/rab byang bcu bdun pa'i chu bya zu 1 ches 35zung la ra —5phya khab 1993 rla 2 zunga'ag 17

gleng brjod/dmo༅/ /rnam mang lam lugs 'gran pa'i 'jig rten 'dir//rnam dpyod lugs zung phan bde'i grags snyan can//rnam dag sde bzhi'i dpal la mnga' brnyes pa'i//rnam dkar gangs ri'i mgon po phyag gis bstod//brtse chen nyi ma gsar pa'i 'od snang gis//yangs pa'i sa chen zhi bde'i dro skyid spel//bod 'bangs dga' bde'i pad dkar 'dzum byed pa'i//mgon gcig srid pa'i mig gis shis pa stsol//shes bya'i gnas la 'dres pa chung bas tshig sbyor khug ta'i glu min kyang //brjod bya'i don la zol sbyor spangs pa'i ting ting 'jol mo'i gsung snyan bzhin//lo rgyus smra la gdeng dang spobs pa'i rgod po'i gshog rtsal mi ldan yang //rang gi byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa bya pho tsha lus 'di skad sgrog/ces skyabs yul dam pa la mchod cing shis pa brjod pa dang / brtsams par dam bca' bas ngag gi lam cung zad yangs por phye ste/ skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni/ 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i gdul zhing bod chos ldan gyi zhi bde'i rgyal khab 'di bzhin mi lo nyis stong lhag tsam gyi sngon nas rang btsan bston med du gnas dang gnas bzhin par phyi lo 1950 lor rgya dmar gyis bod du btsan 'dzul byas 5

pa nas bzung bod mi dmangs rnams nas kyang 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i dbu khrid 'og mthun sgril rdog rtsa gcig sgril dang / rang srog blos btang gi snying stobs bzung ste btsan 'dzul par rgol lan bstud mar sprad mthar phyi lo 1959 lo bod rgyal yongs su rang btsan sger langs kyi las 'gul spel bar rgya dmar dbang 'dzin pa chos gdug rtsub can gyi drag gnon byas te chags 'jig 'gag rtsa'i gnas su gyar skabs 'phags mchog 'jig rten mgon po gang de thugs bskyed g.yo ba med pa'i sgo nas bod bstan srid kyi rang dbang slar gso'i ched re zhig rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du chibs zhal bsgyur dgos pa'i yo langs che ba'i las mtha' 'di lta bu byung rjes rgya phyogs nas spyir bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus hril por 'khyog bshad rdzun bzo'i yig cha mang dag spel nas bod rgya khongs su bsgrub thabs byed pa dang / bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa kla klo lta bu yin tshul/ lhag par bod kyi nye rabs kyi lo rgyus dngos yod gnas tshul shes bzhin khyad bsad dkar nag phyin ci baglogs pa'i rtsom yig 'dra min spel dang spel bzhin pa de dag la rang phyogs nas drang zhing nan pa'i rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyi ther 'don dang / dgag sgrub byed pa'i khungs ldan lo rgyus rtsom sgrig byed rgyu gal 'gangs shin tu che khar/ phyi lo 1959 lor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi phebs rjes su 'brangs nas nged rang rgya gar du btsan byol du 'byor rjes sku'i gcen po stag 'tshor rin po che mchog nas kyang /khyed rang gi da bar gyi myong tshor dngos dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus shig bris na bod don dngos yod kyi dril bsgrags las don thog phan slebs che nges yong rgyu zhes thog mar skul lcag mdzad kyang las brel dang shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis re zhig btang snyoms su lus/de rjes 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po ma/chog nas bod mi spyi yongs la/6

rang rang so so'i myong tshor dang sbrags nas bod kyi lo rgyus 'bri dgos pa'i bka' slob bzang po snga phyi spyi phebs kyi bka' dgongs sgrub ched dang / lhag par sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma de nyid 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas kyang nged tsho'i lo rgyus shig 'bri dgos yod lugs dran skul yang yang gnang zhing / dus da lta yang khong gi byams brtse'i zhal dkyil dran lam du lhang lhang 'char bzhin du dam pa de nyid dran gso'i ched du lo rgyus 'di nges par 'bri dgos 'dug bsam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bskyed/bar lam phran gyi bza' rla skal bzang lags nas kyang lo rgyus 'di rtsom 'bri bya rgyur skul ma yang yang gnang pa bcas dang / de sngon bka' blon shan kha ba dang / dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ nyag rong a brtan sogs nas rang rang so so'i myong tshor ngo ma'i lo rgyus 'bri gnang mdzad pa rnams skabs de rang du do snang che ba rang ma byung rung / rjes su rgan rabs de tsho 'jig rten phyi mar gshegs rjes khong tsho'i lo rgyus de tshor zhib lta byed dus dpyad gzhi'i rin thang chen po ldan pa shes tshor gting zab yong gi 'dug pa bcas kyis rang nyid shes bya'i gnas la sbyangs pa dman zhing da cha na rgas rdzi rdib kyis rkyen pas lo rgyus ring po 'di lta bu zhig 'bri ba'i spobs pa dang bral na yang / skul ma'i bka' bzang rim phebs rnams bsgo ba rnar gzon du gtong blos ma bzod par bgrang bya bdun cur brgal pa'i nad gcong rgas po'i lus gog sems shugs kyis bskul te rang nyid kyi mi che'i byung ba brjod pa zhes pa'i lo rgyus dran tho 'bri bar mngon du phyogs pa 'di'i nang / 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul mdo smad tsong kha yul du ji ltar sku bltams pa dang / dbus phyogs su gdan zhu'i thad skya ngal du mang 'phrad tshul dang / rang gi skye yul bod yul gyi mtha' mtshams su yin pas yul der 'tshar longs byung ba'i myong tshor ngo ma dang 'brel nas bod dbus phyogs dang / chos dang rwar

rig gzhung chab srid bcas kyi 'brel ba'i gnas stangs dang / yul der lo rgyus thog rgya nag chen po'i mi rigs ring lugs kyis lo ngo brgya phrag gi sngon nas byus ngan lag len bstar te rgya mi gnas spo byas nas rang cag bod mi rnams rgya mir bsgyur thabs dang / yul gru kha bral btang ba byed pa/ lhag par nye ba'i dus su rgya dmar nas de snga'i rgya mi'i dbang sgyur ba gang zhig las kyang gdug rtsub che ba'i sgo nas yul lung kha bral gtong thabs dang / rgya bod dbar gros mthun don tshan 17 zer ba btsan 'jog byed bcug rjes bod sdod dbang sgyur ba tsho'i bya spyod/ rgya phyogs nas bod shar phyogs su drag po'i bcos bsgyur btang rkyen bod mi rnams sdug khur ma thub par rgya rgol gyi gyen langs rim byas skor/ mthar phyi lo 1959 lo bod rgyal yongs su btsan rgol gyi gyen langs byung nas 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du phebs rjes btsan byol bod gzhung 'dzugs gnang gis byes 'byor bod mi dmangs kyi sdug bsngal sel thabs mdzad skor/ phyi lo 1979 lo nas bod rgya zhi mol skya tshab dang /gzigs skor sku tshab snga rjes bod du gtong gnang mdzad skor bcas gnas tshul ji ma ji bzhin drang pos gzhung bsrangs na sgong ngas rta 'khyogs pa'i dpe ltar phyogs ris dang / sgro skur/ 'dzem zon bcas yongs su spangs nas rang gi mthong thos myong tshor ngo ma'i thog skabs de'i lo rgyus dpyad gzhi khungs btsan la gzhi bcol nas lo tshigs dang / nang don sogs 'thus sgo tshang du btang ste zhib cha gang che bkod pa 'di'i thog nas mi sger gyi lo rgyus tsam ma yin par skabs de dang de'i dus su byung ba'i bod kyi srid don gyo 'gangs che'i 'gyur ldog byung rim rnams rang rigs mi rabs rjes ma rnams nas phra zhing zhib pa rtogs thub pa zhig 'bri ba'i ngal ba khur du blangs pa 'di'i thad sku sger drung che rta ra ba bstan 'dzin chos nyid mchog nas 'gangs che'i slob ston gnang ba dang / bka' zur zhe bo blo bzang dar rgyas mchog 8

nas mchod brjod 'bri rogs/ de bzhin bka' yig drung gzhon shel gling che dbang rnam rgyal lags nas yig 'bri'i rkang 'gan bzhes pa/ bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi rgan drung thon zur blo bzang bstan 'dzin lags nas zhus dag gtong rogs gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu /de mtshungs 'jar man du bzhugs pa'i rdzong sar mnga' ris chos rje sprul sku mchog nas mthun rkyen zhal 'debs hin sgor chig stong lnga brgya dang 'jar man gyi sgor lnga brgya tham pa bcas gnang bar thugs rje che zhu rgyu/lhag par tu bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi dbu 'dzin sku zhabs rgya mtsho che ring lags nas gang ci'i thog skul ma dang rogs ram gnang ba dang / bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi rig gzhung nyams zhib pa skya zhabs bkra shis che ring nas zhus dag dang phyogs bsgrigs rgyus ston gyi thugs 'gan legs mdzad gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang sbrags/ lo rgyus 'dir da dung skyon dang nor 'khrul nges can zhig yong nges pas/gzur gnas mkhyen ldan rnam pas yo bsrang mdzub ston yong ba'i re ba zhu rgyu dang /phyogs ris yongs su spangs pa'i lo rgyus shig 'bri dgos na/ lo rgyus mi sna 'ga' zhig la phran bu phog thug 'gro rgyur g.yol thabs med pas 'dir yang bsam bzhin du min rung / phyogs 'ga' shas la phog thug gi rang bzhin yod srid na snying nas bzod gsol zhu rgyu bcas so//

thog 24(5sprad 2snokhyidro 21/khaye skurdon dang po/ nga'i skye yul/ bod shar phyogs mdo smad tsong kha'i yul gyi lo rgyus rags tsam gleng ba/ ༄༅༅/ /nga'i skye yul ni bod chol kha gsum gyi ya gyal mdo smad rta yi chol kha'i bye brag tsong kha yul chen bco brgyad du grags pa'i chi kyā tsho ba'i khongs kyi cong rtsi grong sde yin/ cong rtsi sde pa ni stag 'cher gyi shar me le bcu gsum tsam zhig gi sar yod cing / de'i nub nyer shar tsong ri khrod gnas yod/ shar tsong ri khrod ni dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dkyil la chos rje kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rjes phyag btab ste yun ring bzhugs nas mthar ri khrod de rang du dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/rig gnas gsar brje ma byung bar khong gi gdung rten de ri khrod de'i rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs/ ri khrod de'i bdag po ni stag 'tshor bla brang yin/ de'i nye 'gram grong sde khag 'ga' shas stag 'tshor bla brang gi chos gzhis su gtogs/chi kyā tsho pa zhes pa de rje sku 'a bum gyi chos gzhis tsho drug gi gras shig yin zhing / de'i gas su zhing skyong tsho pa dang / phyogs pa tsho pa/ chi kyā tsho pa/ klu 'bum tsho pa/ mi nyag tsho pa/ zi na tsho pa bcas tsho khag drug sku 'bum gyi cho sa

gzhis su gtogs shing / tsho pa so so'i 'go par nang so zhes 'bod/ nang so zhes pa de snga mo'i chos rgyal gyi dus rabs su gtsugs pa'i sa mtshams so lta ba'i 'go ming yin par grags/gser tog tshang gi sku 'bum gdan rabs las/ a mdo zhes pa ni a chen gangs ri'i rgyab kyi ri dang / mdo la ring mo gnyis kyi ming bsdoms pas a mdo zhes grags/ de'i ngos kyi chu rnams phyogs 'grel te rma g.yang phyug mo'i gzhung du 'bab par rma chu zhes grags/ de mtsho skya rengs kyi gzhung rgyud lho phyogs su kha gtad de 'bab pa'i khug so nyin lam du ma'i bar 'khyog pa'i chu mtshams phan chad mdo stod dang bar khams tshun chad la a mdo zhes zer/ a chen gangs kyi nub ngos pā yan ha ra zhes pa'i ri bo de rma chu'i 'go yin par gsal/a mdo dkyil dbus nas gzhal ba'i lho ngos su snyan grags can gyi gangs ri chen po der rma chen spom ra zer/ nub byang du phyogs las rnam rgyal du grags pa'i gangs ri chen po zhig kyang gnas yod/ tsong la ring mo'i rgyud tsong kha'i skyes ri ni rma chen spom ra'i sras yin zhes pa dang / ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yin zhes yul mi'i ngag rgyun du grags so/tsong la ri bo'i nub ngos dang / tsong chu'i lho ngos phyogs kyi ri klung thang gsum ra shar tsong kha'i yul zhes su grags pa de ni rje nges don nyi ma'i gsung las//tsong chu zhes byar grags pa'i klu chen gyis//gdags dang srib tu bgos pa'i 'dzin ma'i khyon//tsong kha zhes grags skyid pa'i ljongs shig mchis//de yi lho phyogs tsong la'i rdza chu ni/12

/gser ldan pha mtha' 'tshol la bzhugs 'dra'i 'dabs//blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa sku bltams pa//gnas mchog lum pa'i dga' tshal gnyis pa yod/ces gsungs so/dus snga rabs nas mdo smad yul chen du 'tsho zhing gnas pa rnams ni bod mi sha stag yin zhing / yul de yang mdo smad yul gyi khongs la dus bzhi'i grang dro dang / thang gshongs snyom pa/ sa dang chu bzang zhing / 'bru rigs sna tshogs smin pa/ mi rnams rang bzhin gyis rgyud 'jam zhing drang ba/ las 'bras kyi blangs dor ma mthar yang phyogs re tsam shes pa/ gcan gzan dang / 'bu srin gdug can sogs nyung ba/ phyugs rigs dkar nag gis khengs pa'i ri klung thams cad thang gshongs dang / ljon shing gis mjes pa/ dri zhim me tog tshon mdangs sna tshogs bkra ba/ shing 'bras sna tshogs kyi sdong po yongs su 'dzoms yod/mdo smad chos 'byung las/ mtsho sngon gser rten 'di ni zol bstod lta bu min par dngos don dus bzhir grang dro kha char snyom pa dang / nyer 'che rnams nyung zhing / chos dang longs spyod 'dzoms nas 'chi med gnas ltar bde skyed la rol ba'i yul bzang po yin zhes gsal/dus rabs bdun pa nas chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos bod yongs la gcig gyur thog mdo smad sa khul gyi tsho pa khag mnga' 'og tu gcig gyur mdzad/de nas bzung yul der snga rabs nas gnas pa'i yul mi'i thog dbus gtsang sa khul khag nas dmag mi mang po btang / 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad rnam las/ nga tsho'i yul phyogs la bod dbus 'phan po'i nang gi dmag mi bzhag tshod 'dug nga'i gci

pha mes shig dmag mi de'i gras byung bar brten nang mi'i yul skad nang la yang bod dbus 'phan po'i yul skad 'ga' shas 'dres yod pa dper na/ thur mar khyim bu dang/ phor par can ne zhes zer gyi yod gsungs pa ltar ro/de bzhin mdo smad deb ther rgya tsho las/ mdo smad lho byang gi mi rgyud phal cher chos rgyal gyis bod dang rgya'i sa mtshams su rgyal srung dmag mi'i rigs las mched pa sha stag yin/ skad rigs nang brda rnying pa yang 'ga' shas yod zer/dmu dge bsam gtan gyis 1981 lo'i sbrang char dus deb gnyis pa'i nang srong btsan sgam po sogs bod rgyal rnams kyis mtha' bzhi dbang du bsdus skabs bod rgya dbar gyi sa mtshams srung ched dmag mi'i nang gzhis chags nas sdod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ mdo smad lho rgyud sa mtshams su kong po nas yong ba'i dmag mi rnams chu dkar phyogs su gnas chags/ phen lha'i dwags po dang /lan pheng gi khon po yin/ dwags po ni brda cung zad kyang mi 'gyur bar deng sang yang dwags po zer/ kong po rnams ni brda cung zad 'gyur nas deng sang khon po zer/stod shar nas 'ong ba'i dmag rnams a mdo zung chu brgyud la bzhag pa deng sang gi zung chu rdzong gi bod rigs rnams red/ rgyal mo jil chu'i 'go la yod pa'i 'brog sde bzang dkar khag gsum yang stod kyi bzang dkar nas 'ong ba yin pas/ ming yang ma 'gyur bar gnas yod/ yang khong gis de ni a mdo the'u dang / phing ༷'i sa cha'i dwags po nas bzung ste khams kyi lcags la'i bar gyi mi rigs de dag srong btsan gyi dus su dbus nas 'ong / khri srong gi dus dang khri ral gyi dus su'ang skor gcig kha snon brgyab ces gsal/de bzhin rma chu chu rgyud kyi bod mi 'bor chen zhig srong btsan gyi dus su 'ong 14

bas ldong rigs kyi dmag mi yin par bshad 'dug mdo smad byang rgyud dpa' ris zhes pa'i sa khul du bka' ma log ces pa'i bod mi tsho pa khag gcig yod pa de rnams ngag rgyun las khri ral yab sras kyi dus su bod dbus nas 'di khul gtong skabs btsan po'i bka' ma 'byor bar ma log ces bka' phab ltar de rnams kyi spyi ming la bka' ma log ces da lta bar gnas yod/ gong gsal gnas tshul rnams la zhib dpyad byas na/ mdo smad lho byang du gnas pa'i bod mi mang che ba dbus phyogs nas yong ba sha stag yin par snyam/ dper na/ 1987 lor mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi sbrang char dus deb 'don theng gnyis pa'i nang blo gros rgya mtsho nas tshotshomakhas dbang gsung rabs rgya mtsho'i rnam thar mdor bsdus tsho zhes pa'i brtsoms yig las/ dam pa 'di'i tsong kha lho rgyud nye 'dabs ba yang stag tshang sde grong dmu tsha sga zhes grags pa'i rus rgyud kyi khyim tshang du 'khrungs shing / khyim tshang 'di ni sngar bod chos rgyal khri ral pa can gyis dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing gi gtsang rong gi (da lta'i gtsang gzhis ka rtse'i nye 'dabs ) phyogs su gnas pa'i sga chen dmag dpon dang gtsang stod na yod pa'i g.yu tsha'i dmag dpon bya ba gnyis gas btsan po'i bka' lung ltar dmag mi khri phrag mang po khrid nas mdo smad shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul gyi nye 'dabs su bod chen po'i mtha' mtshams srung bar phebs/ sga chen dmag dpon gyis bod byang shar phyogs kyi mtha' mtshams dang / g.yu tsha'i dmag dpon gyis bod shar lho'i phyogs kyi mtha' mtshams kyi srung ma byas/ bod rgyal po'i bka' lung ma thon na phyir dbus gtsang du 'ong mi chog pa'i tha tshig yod stabs phyis rang yul dbus gtsang su 'gro ma thub par mdo smad dan tig gi nye 'khor ba yang stag tshang grong du gzhis chags/ de nas mi rabs 'ga' zhig 'des pa'i rjes su 45

bod kyi chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud mdo khams tsong la ring mo'i yul du mched pa'i tsong kha'i rgyal po rgyal sras khri nam lde'u btsan gyi dus su sga chen dmag dpon gyi gdung rgyud sga g.yag ri'i bya bas dmag dpon byas/ bod chos rgyal chen po'i chab srid kyi la rgya bskyang / zhes pa ltar dus snga rabs dbus gtsang dang / stod mnga' ris la dwags sogs nas mdo smad byang shar mtha' mtshams srung dmag snga rjes khri phrag mang po btang ste rim bzhin chags pa yin zhes gsal lo//dus rabs bcu pa nas bcu gsum bar mdo smad sa khul de bod dbus dang chab srid kyi 'brel ba chad pa lta bu byung yang / dus rabs bcu gsum gyi dkyil la hor rgyal pos sa paṇa gdan zhus kyis mchod yon gyi 'brel ba byung ba nas bzung / mdo smad de bod dbus gzhung dang 'brel ba slar yang 'brel ba mthud thub pa byung / dus rabs de nas bzung hor rgyal khab kyi shugs rkyen la brten nas mdo smad sa khul du hor rigs kyang gzhis chags byed 'go tshugs/ yin na'ang / chab srid kyi dbang 'dzin khri dpon dang / tsho pa khag gi nang so bcas go ming rang 'jags gnas yod/dus rabs bcu drug pa'i dkyil du jing gir gyi gdung rgyud zhol than han yab sras kyis mdo smad khul du rgyal mchog bsod nams rgya mtsho gdan drangs rjes sku 'bum dgon par 7zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod/ skabs der mdo smad yongs rdzogs mnga' 'og tu bcug nas chab srid kyi bdag po hor rgyal po de nyid kyis byas/de'i rjes su tsong chu'i g.yas g.yon gyi sa rgyu gshin po'i khul la rgya nag nas rgya mi gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis gnas spos kyis sa bgos gsar spol byas shing /mdo smad shar byang mtha' mtshams su rgya mi dang 'dres sdod bod mi rnams la rim 46

bzhin rgya'i goms gshis kyi shan zhugs te rim bzhin rgya mir 'gyur ba mang po byung /rgya'i mkhas pa 'ga' shas kyis rgya nag sung gi dus rabs rjes nas man ju'i dus mjug bar rgya bod sa mtshams su gnas pa'i bod mi rnams rgya mir 'gyur ba'i grangs 'bor de da yod bod mi yongs rdzogs las mang pa yod ces zer ba de bden par mngon/ sung rgyal rabs deb ther ( rgya nag sung rgyal rabs /thu'u phrin yin ) bod kyi rgyal rabs ) las/ phyi lo 851 lo nas bzung mdo smad byang shar rgyud kyis yul gru rnams gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis rgya 'og tu shor ba'i sa khul de ni yi kro'u dang / khri/ cing / hu'i/ ching / chen kro'u/ lan/shā/ yus kro'u bcas /yi kro'u dang / khyen kro'u sogs rgya nag kun su'u zhing chen dang /nying sha sa khul bcas su gnas yod ces krung go snga rabs dang / deng rabs kyi sa ming tshig mdzod chen mo dang / h+phang khrin lan nas brtsams pa'i krung go thun hring mdo bsdus deb ther gnyis pa bcas su gsal / yin zhing / bod mi tsho khag de rnams la 'go pa re yod/rgya nag la 'brel ba yod pa rnams la smin pa'i bod ces ming btags/ rgya nag dang 'brel ba med pa'i bod mi rnams ma smin pa'i bod mir 'bod/ gnas tshul de dag la gzhigs na bod rgyal khab chen po'i sa mtshams de bod kyi yig rnying las rgya'i mchod rten dkar po yan mdo smad rta yi chol kha zhes gsal ba las kyang rgya che ba yod par mngon/de bzhin mdo smad shar byang mtha' mtshams su rgya mi dang 'dres sdod bod mi rnams rim bzhin rgya'i goms gshis su gyur te rang gi goms gshis de brlag 'gro gi yod pa red/ dper na/ chi kyā tsho pa'i grong sde mang po rgya mir bsgyur ba'i rtags mtshan ni rgya'i dud tshang mang po'i nang srung ma lha mo dang mgon po phyag drug 17

bsten pa ma zad/ gsung rab brgyad stong dang / mdo sde bskal bzang / yum bcas gtan du mchod 'bul byed kyi yod/ de bzhin rje skya 'bum dang / de'i nye 'dabs ri khrod khag la'ang bu phrug grwa par 'jug pa dang / pha ma rgan gras che 'das rjes dge 'dun pa gdan 'dren zhu gi yod/gong smros ltar dus rabs dgu pa'i smad tsam la bod dbus gzhung gi srid dbang rtsa 'thor song / mdo smad sa khul du bca' bzhugs dpon khag rnams dang /bod rgya'i sa mtshams su sdod pa'i sa srung 'go dmag rnams kyang gcig 'og gcig la ma 'dus pas phan tshun dmag 'khrug gi las kho na brtsams te gcig gyur gyi rnam pa dor bar brten bod sa mang po rgya lag tu shor ba ma zad/ bod mi'i sngar yod mi 'bor de yang je nyung du gyur yod/lhag par du man ju'i dus rabs stod tsam mdo smad kyi lho rgyud sa khul rgyal rong dang / rnga pa/ co ne sa khul bcas la kun su'u dang / zi khron zhing chen khongs su dbye yod pa dang / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i shing sprul phyi lo 1735lor man ju gzhung gi zi ling du am ban gsar 'dzugs byas/ phyi lo 1938lor mtsho sngon zhing chen gsar 'dzugs byas pa'i thog bla brang bkris 'khyil gyi mnga' khongs sog sde phud/ de min tshang ma kun su'u zhing chen khongs su phye/ phyi lo 1949 lor rgya nag yongs su gsar brje'am bcings 'grol zer ba btang rjes kun su'u zhing chen khongs gtogs kun lho bod rigs rang skyong khul dang / kun nub dpa' ris zhes pa'i bod mi'i sa khul cha shas shig la than kru bod rigs rang skyong rdzong zhes pa gsar 'dzugs byas/ de mtshungs mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi mnga' khongs lho byang gnyis su gna' rabs nas gnas pa'i bod mi 'dus 18

sdod sa khul der bod rigs rang skyong khul zhes pa khag lngar dbye ste gsar 'dzugs byas/rgya nag pas dus snga rabs nas da lta bar thog mar bod mi rnams kha phye nas bde blag tu dbang bsgyur byed pa'i srid byus ngan pa lag len bstar bzhin yod pa'i rkyen gyis nam zhig rang cag bod mi rnams rgya mir gyur nyen chen po yod pa des dpyod ldan rnams la yid gdung tshad med skye bzhin yod//mdo smad khul de bod kyi chol kha gzhan dang 'dra bar gdod ma'i dus rabs kyi chos ni bon chos yin zhing / khri srong dus su bod chol kha gzhan dang mtshungs par mdo smad khul du phal cher la nang chos dar khyab chen po byung bar mngon/ 'on kyang / bon chos la dad gus byed mkhan mang po zhig sngar mus su gnas nas deng sang yang a mdo shar pa sa khul phal mo che bon chos la dad gas byed mkhan yin 'dug dus rabs bcu pa'i smad du dbus gtsang yongs su sangs rgyas kyi chos nyams rgud du gyur pa'i skabs der mdo smad khul la de tsam gnod skyon byung med par mngon/bod kyi yig rnying kun las/ btsan po glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa'i dus su dmar shakyu 'od dang / g.yo dge 'byung / gtsang rab gsal gsum bod kyi stod phyogs nas li yul brgyud mdo smad tsong kha'i bde khams su byon te rgyun ring sgrub pa nyams len mdzad pa dang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal la dge slong gi sdom pa bstsal te bod dbus phyogs su bstan pa'i me ro smad nas gsos zhes grags/ dus de nas dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya paṇa chen hor rgyal khab tu ma phebs par mdo smad khul sngags rnying ma'i chos lugs dar khyab chen 19

po byung zhing / sa skya dang hor rgyal rgyud rnams mchod yon gyi 'brel ba shugs chen byung bar brten sa skya'i chos lugs kyang dar khyab byung / dus skabs de'i nang tsong kha'i yul du chos rje kum pa rol pa'i rdo rje yun ring bzhu gas par brten bka' rgyud kyi chos lugs kyang dar zhing rgyas pa byung yod tshod/dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dkyil la 7rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa tsong kha'i yul du skya bltams pa'i rjes su zhwa ser gyi bstan pa mdo smad khul la dar zhing rgyas pa byung 'dug tsong kha pa skya bltams pa dang dus mtshungs sa steng du tsan dan gyi ljon shing zhig 'khrungs te lo ma re re'i steng la rgyal ba seng ge nga ro'i sku brnyan lha bzo mkhas pas bris pa las brgya 'gyur gyis byon legs pa'i ri mo'i bkod pa mngon sum du mjal rgyu yod par brten sku 'bum zhes bya ba'i mtshan de thogs/ skabs der sku 'khrungs sa'i sa steng tu pad+ma spungs pa'i mchod rten zhig bzhengs shing / lo ngo brgya phrag gcig lhag gi rjes su tsong kha'i yul chen gyi rgyal rgyud dang / nang so/zhing 'brog gnyis kyi skye bo bcas kyis mchod rten de dag bzhugs yul gyi lha khang zhig bzhengs pa dang / de'i phyir lcags ris bskor zhing / 'khrungs gnas de'i lho smad du gnas shig bzung nas sgrub sde btab par dge 'dun bdun grwa gcig bzhugs/de nas rim bzhin 'phel te bcu phrag lnga tsam la gyur nas sgrub pa nyams len la gzhol/ zhes sku 'bum gdan rabs su gsal/phyi lo 1583 lo tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dzing gir rgyal rgyud al than han gyis gdan drangs pa bzhin 7rgyal ba tsong kha pa skya bltams sa sku 'bum byams pa gling 'dir zhabs kyi pad+mo rnam par bkod nas 7rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin gzim khang chung ba gsar skrun byas pa'i nang du nyin shas bcad 20

rgyar bzhugs/ de nas 7rgyal dbang mchog la tsong kha'i nang so rna mas kyis zhus don bzhin/ tsong kha'i lte ba'i gnas der dgon sde chen po gsar bzhengs zhu rgyu'i (sku 'bum gdan rabs su gsal / bka' lung bzang po thob don ltar skye bo rnams kyis mos gus spro gsum gyi ngang nas dgon pa gsar bzhings zhus/ dus de nas bzung nye ba'i phyi lo 1959 bar lo ngo sum brgya lnga bcu nga dgu'i ring skya 'bum byams pa gling 'di 'phags yul na len ḍa dang mtshungs pa'i 'chad nyan sgom gsum dar zhing rgyas par byung /dus rabs bcu drug pa'i rjes nas bzung mdo smad yongs su zhwa ser gyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar dar bzhin rgyas pa byung ba ma zad/ mdo smad khul nas dbus phyogs gdan sa bzhi la gzhung chen ka pod lnga slob gnyer gnang bar rgyun mi chad pa phebs nas chol kha gsum la mtshan snyan chen po grags pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma dge bshes mang du byung ste sku 'bum nas dga' ldan khri pa'ang khri thog bcu gcig tsam byung ba de ni a mdo'i gtam dper/ byung na dga' ldan khri dang /ma byung gtsang po'i chu/ zhes pa de las mdo smad pa rnams kyi slob gnyer dang / snying stobs gsal por mtshon/ 7gong sa lnga pa'e skabs nas bzung mdo smad khul la hor sog rgyal rgyud rnams kyi dbu blar dbus phyogs kyi bla ma mang po gdan drangs/deb ther rgya mtsho las/ 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mtsho sngon dpon khag rnams la bkris bā thur 'di gu shī rang gi sras ngo ma khyed tsho'i a khu yin pas spyi dpon du bskos zhes gsal/ dus rabs der mdo smad khul gyi sog po dpon khag dang / jun gar/ sog yul phyi nang yongs kyi rgyal rgyud dang / bla chen khag phan tshun mi mthun pa byung mtshams phan tshun gnyis kyis 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma 2

mchog la bde sdug gtugs gsher zhus te/ 7rgyal dbang mchog gis skya tshab ched rdzong slob ston gyi bar 'dum mdzad yod pa dper na/ 7rgyal dbang lnga pas hal ha 'u lod dang / rgya sog gzhung 'grigs thabs su dga' ldan khri thog zhe bzhi pa blo gros rgya mtsho sog yul du ched brdzong mdzad/ de bzhin khri thog zhe lnga pa 'jam dbyangs tshul khrims dar rgyas hal ha cher chen rgyal po dang / jun gar dga' ldan hung tha'i ji gnyis ma 'chams pa'i chings 'grigs su ched brdzong gnang /sog po mkhas dbang se chen 'jag 'jid kyi rtsom yig nang tu la'i bla ma skya phreng lnga pas gu shī han dang / jun gar dga' ldan tha'i ji bcas la mtshan gnas bstsal ba de skabs der tā la'i bla ma ni chab srid thog dus rabs dkyil ma'i ro man bla chen dang / yu rob rgyal khab khag gi dbar byung ba'i 'brel ba de dang mtshungs pa zhig yin/ gal srid skabs der sog po'i rgyal rgyud khag la khong gi rgyab bskyor ma byung che de rnams kyi sog po'i spyi tshogs nang du rang nyid kyi 'go khrid byed thub pa'i nus stobs de tsam med pa'i gnas tshul yong gi yod ces gsal//1539 lo rgyal ba lnga pas gu shri han la bstan 'dzin rgyal po zhes mtshan gyis gzeng bstod gnang / dus phyis mdo smad byang shar sa khul bod mi rnams kyi rig gzhung dang / yul srol/ goms gshis bcas ha lam rgya mi dang mtshungs par gyur yod pa ma zad/ tsong chu'i yas mas kyi bod mi rnams bod skad tshig zur tsam smra mi shes kyang / yul gyi ming dang / mi'i ming bcas bod skad sha stag bed spyod byed kyi yod/ sa mtha' lung khug tu gnas pa'i dpa' ris khul dang / de min tsong kha'i khul gyi lung khug re zung gi grong sde dmar gtsang dang / gro tshang / mtha' grong sogs kyi bod mi tsho'i bod skad nang du rgya skad cung zad bsres te brjod kyi yod pa 22

dang / rgan rabs 'das grong song ba yin na grong sde'i thag nye sa'i chos sde nas dge 'dun pa mang nyung la ma ltos par gdan 'dren zhus nas zhabs 'jug byed pa dang / 'byor pa che ba'i mi tshang gis chos rje sku 'bum khri pa dang / de'i lhan du chog grwa dge 'dun bdun grwa gnyis gsum gdan 'dren zhus te zhabs 'jug zhu ba dang / de bzhin grong sde'i nye 'khor gyi chos sde'i dge 'dun yongs rdzogs gdan zhus kyis nyin gsum ring bsngo smon zhabs 'jug byed cing / 'byor pa 'bring pa chos nye 'khor sgrub sde'i dge 'dun bdun grwa re gnyis gdan 'dren zhu ba dang /'byor pa zhan pa tshos dge 'dun gnyis gsum nas ma chag pa gdan zhu byed/dper na/ chi kyā tsho pa'i bod mi 'byor ldan tshos gong zhus ltar sku 'bum khri pa gdan zhu byed pa dang / de 'og 'byor 'bring tshos khul de'i dge lugs ri khrod khag bzhi'i dge 'dun pa yongs rdzogs gdan zhu byed/ de ni shar tsong ri khrod dang /an ja ri khrod/ ra rgan ri khrod/ sa mkhar ri khrod bcas yin/ ri khrod de bzhi la dge ser bzhi po 'bod/ rnam kun ri khrod bzhi po der dge 'dun pa mang na bdun brgyad dang / nyung na gnyis gsum nas ma chag pa yod/ dge 'dun pa rnams nas nyin gsum ring sku phung dur 'jug ma byas gong bsngo smon zhabs 'jug gnang ba dang / 'das po'i rjes shul dang / khyim mches pho mo rgan gzhon bcas res mos kyis sku phung gi mdun du nyin gsum ring ma ṇi 'dren srol yod/ de nas sku phung gdan 'dren zhu skabs phung po shom tsam gyi shing sgam gru bzhi phyi dbyibs kun dga' ra ba dang 'dra ba'i nang skyil dkrung gis lag gnyis thal mo sbyar nas 'khog par byed/ sgam de'i rtser nyi rla skar gsum gyi tog rgyag ba dang / skya phung de mi rabs gong ma'i sku phung sbed sa'i 'khris su dur 'jug byed/ rgan pa tsho'i shod 23

srol la mi thog bdun dgu'i sngon la sku phung zhugs 'bul zhu gi yod kyang / deng skabs skya phung gdan zhu'i mdun la mi zhig gis dung dkar 'bud nas sngon du bskyod/phung po sa sbad gtong skabs dge 'dun pa 'ga' shas kyis smon lam gsung / phung po sa zes zin rjes sku phung skyel mi rnams mi tshang de'i sgo 'gram du tshang mas lag pa bkrus te me phung chen po zhig gi steng du 'gam nas rgyal sgo'i nang du 'dzul gyi yod/sngar gyi shod srol la 'das po de'i rnam shes me phung la 'jigs nas nang du ma 'dzul bar phyir log byed kyi yod ces zer/chi kyā tsho pa'i bod mi rnams lo gcig gi nang du chos kyi dus chen gtso che shos de sa ga zu ba yin zhing / zla ba de'i ches 1 nas ches 15 bar phomo rgan gzhon mang che bas lha khang nang du smyung gnas gtong ba dang / snga dgong ma ṇi 'dren pa/ dgun dus ring dge 'dun pa 'ga' shas gdan 'dren zhus nas bstan srung mgon po dang lha mo'i bskangs gso dang / yul lha gsol ba bcas nyin gnyis gsum ring zhabs brtan sgrub kyi yod cing / de min rla ba re re bzhin rgan byis rnams kyis gu ru pad+ma sam r+bha lnga'i skya thang zhig gdan 'dren zhus nas mi tshang 'khor res kyis ma ṇi 'dren gyi 'dug sku thang mi tshang der ma phebs gong mi tshang de'i thog kha nas bsangs gtong ba dang / dung dkar 'bud nas phebs bsu zhu ba/ skya thang gdan zhu byed mkhan rnams kyis ma ṇi bgrang rjes mi tshang des gsol ston bshams nas mi rer bag leb re 'gyed lta bur sprod kyi 'dug mi tshang gcig gis rla ba gcig gi ring skya thang la mchod 'bul gyis bzhugs su gsol rjes rla ba rjes ma'i 'khor res mi tshang gzhan der sngon brda sprod srol 'dug dbyar dus zu ba drug pa bdun pa gang rung zhig la yul lha gsol ba'i nyin mo grong sde de'i skye bo rgan 24

gzhon tshang ma yul lha gnas sa'i rten mkhar mdun 'dzoms te mi mang nyung la gzhigs pa'i lug gnyis gsum re bsad pa'i khrag gis yul lha gnas sar dmar mchod phul rjes de nas tshang mas lug sha btsos te mi tshang mar bgo bsha' byed pa/yul srol de phal cher gdod ma'i dus rabs kyi bon chos kyi shul lus yin par mngon/ ston bsdu'i rjes su lo gsar ma ran bar yul mi tshang ma spun dang dga' nye thug 'phrad du skyod pa dang / de min khyim mches dga' nye phan tshun gsol ston gyi chang rag la ci dgar rol bar byed/rla ba 1 po'i lo gsar ches 1 nas ches 3 bar rang khyim du lo gsar gtong ba dang / ches gcig nyin zhogs pa yar langs rjes thog mar dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul/ de nas gzhon skyes tshos rgan rabs tshor phyag 'tshal ba dang / rgan rabs rnams nas gzhon skyes tshor dngul gyi gsol ras sprod pa dang chabs cig lo gsar bzang zhes phan tshun bkris pa'i tshig ci dang ci yang brjod par byed/ ches nya nas 15 bar dgong ltar grong sde'i nang yod pa'i rgan gzhon tshang ma g.yul thang du 'dzoms te rkang bro glu gzhas kyi dgyes rgur rol/ pho mo khag bgos kyis glu blangs nas tshig rgyag rgyag res byed pa/ ches 15 dgong mo me skong bdun thad drangs kyis spar te rgan gzhon tshang myo4 me'i sgang du mchongs pa de ni lo 'di'i nang bkris pa dang / gegs bar sel ba'i gto bcos byas pa zhig yin 'dug byed sgo de zin 'phral tshang mas mgrin pa gzengs su gtod nas lha rgyal lo/ zhes 'bod pa de nas bzung lo gsar mdzad sgo grub pa'i rtags mtshan yin/ de'i sang nyin nas bzung thag ring du yod pa'i spyan nye'i sar lo gsar gyi 'tshams 'dri zhu bar bskyod/ gong gsal yul srol de dag snga rabs bod mi'i mes 25

po rnams kyi shul rgyun bzang po zhig yin par snyam//tsong kha'i bod mi rnams kyi 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi gnyen 'brel goms srol ni/ dus snga rabs su mi tshang drag gras rnams kyi gnyen sgrigs byed skabs gnyen dpang gtong res byed cing / gnyen sgrigs kyi goms srol de ni bu'i khyim tshang nas so so'i gnyen 'brel zhig gnyen dpang du gdan zhus kyis a rag rdza dam zhig gi steng du shog bu dmar po g.yogs pa dang / rdza dam gyi rked par kha btags dkris te a rag de bu mo'i nang du khyer nas bu mo'i pha ma gnyis la bu mo slong bar yong lugs skor gnas tshul gsal po gleng rjes a rag rdza dam de pha ma gnyis kyi lag tu 'bul sprod byas par bu mo'i pha ma gnyis kyi 'dod mos byung che rdza dam kyi kha btags dkrol nas a rag de gtsang dag 'thung gi yod pa de ni bu mo mna' mar sprod rgyu'i khas len byas pa'i mtshon rtags yin/ gal srid mos mthun med na kha btags ma shig par rdza dam phyir slog byed/ mna' ma bsu len gyi byed sgo de sngags pas /sngags kyi gzungs 'dzin mkhan nam/ gsang sngags nyams su len mkhan )gza' ches bltas te dus tshod gtan 'bebs byed/ mna' ma bsu len gyi byed sgo rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sna tshogs shig yod pa las/ rgyas pa de bu mo'i nang nas gza' skar 'byung 'phrod dge ba'i ches cha gtan 'khel mtshams bu mo'i pha mar lan sprod pa dang / mna' ma skyel bar yong skabs mna' ma'i pha dang spyan mched/de min gnyen 'brel khyim mches mi mang po rta rags bsgrigs te mna' ma skyel bar yong srol yod/ lam 'khel grong sder bu dang mna' ma'i mi tshang gnyis kyi gnyen 'brel ja ston zhes ja chang gi bsu ma byed/ mna' ma nang du ma slebs tsam gyi le dbar gsum bzhi'i sar bu'i dga' nye khyim mches rnams kyis thab bsu zhu sar rta 26

rags bsgrigs te bskyod cing / dga' bsu zhu sar rta rags phan tshun gnyis thug skabs gnam sa g.yo ba ltar ki sgra dang sbrags phan tshun gnyis kus rta rgyugs 'gran nas zhwa mo 'phrog res byed/ zhwa mo shor mkhan des thob mkhan der kha btags g.yogs pa dang / thob mkhan des shor mkhan der chang rag 'dren/ de nas dga' bsu'i rten 'brel gyi byed sgo grub rjes mna' ma de bu'i khyim tshang gi sgo 'gram bar skyel ba dang / sgo 'gram du me skong chen po zhig spar nas mi tshang mas kha btags 'khyer nas dga' bsu zhu skabs mna' ma skyel mkhan gyi gtso bo'i gras kyi rgan rabs gcig gis khyod tsho'i mar dang ja/ gos chen/ dngul sogs dngos po gya nom pa la brten nas 'bab stegs zhes rta bab chibs stegs rtsigs shig ces skad sangs mthon pos brjod skabs mna' ma skyel mkhan gzhan dag tshang mas kyang rgyab skyor mgrin gcig tu brjod/ de mtshams bu'i khyim tshang nas gzhon skyes shig gi kha btags 'khyer nas skyel mi gtso bo de'i mdun la mjal dar re bton snye/stod dbus gtsang gi snam phrug yin mod/ smad rgya nag gi gos gru yin mod/ sa go ca'i ras yin mod/ kha na 'jal na kha na yod gi 'dom na 'jal na 'dom la yod gi kha 'dom 'dom pa bco brgyad yod gi zhes sogs kyi tshig brjod nas kha btags de dag skyel mi tshor 'bul/ da dung des 'dod blo ma tshims na gzhon pa gzhan zhig gis dngul thum re khyer nas / stod dbus gtsang gi gser yin mod/dma' rgya nag gi dngul yin mod/ sa go ca'i nor yin mod/ sogs zer nas dngul thum zhig skyel mi gtso bo de'i phyag tu kha btags gcig dang sbrags 'bul gyi 'dug da dung des kyang ma 'grigs na/ dngos po gzhan zhig khyer nas yang bskyar gong bzhin bstod tshig brjod nas 'bul/ skyel mi tsho 'dod blo khengs na 27

gzhi nas rta thog nas babs te mi tshang de'i mna' ma dang lo rta mthun pa'i bu mo gang rung zhig gi lag nang 'o ma dkar yol dkar sangs gang khyer te skyel mi gtso bo dang / bu mo dang bu mo'i pha bcas kyis lag g.yas pa'i srin mdzub kyis phud gtor zhu ba dang / me skong chen po zhig gi sgang la 'gom nas rim bzhin rgyal sgo'i nang 'dzul/ de nas skyel mi tshang mar ston mo gzab rgyas bshams pa dang /mna' ma dang mnyam du yong mkhan bag rogs gcig gam gnyis de sngon nas gra sgrig byas pa'i khang pa zhig tu khe gtsang bzhugs su 'jug sku mgron tshang ma bzhugs gral la 'khod ma thag mi re'i mdun du phye mar byur bur bkang pa'i rtsam phor re'i steng du rtsi bcud mar gyi lteb pa gnyis sbyar nas 'bul/ de nas rten 'brel gyi rdzas gro ma 'bras sil dang / gsol ja btegs 'bul rjes mna' ma'i pha dang skyel mi gtso bo der lug sha khog sgang tshang dang / de 'og la sha khog gi smad cha mjug ma rang sbyar re/ de byings la lug sha dang / phag sha bzhi ling re phul rjes chang rag gi btung ba bskud mar 'dren/ 'ga' shas nas mar spags za ba dang / 'ga' shas nas sha za ba sogs rang rang gis gang 'dod pa'i bza' btung la ci dgar rol/gsol ston bshams rjes mna' ma skyel mkhan rnams dang / bu'i nang gi sne len zhu mi tsho phan tshun blu gzhas kyis 'gran bsdur sogs rtsed 'jo'i rnam grangs la nam phyed tsa / bar dgyes rgur rol bzhin byed sgo de mjug 'gril/ de nas sku mgron rnams bu'i nang du ma bzhugs par grong sde'i khyim mches tshos skya mgron rnams khag bgos nas gdan drangs te mi tshang so so'i nang du yang bskyar gsol ston gzab rgyas 'bul bshams byed/ de'i sang nyin sku mgron rnams bu'i nang du snga dgong dgung gsum gyi gsol ston bshams nas gsol ston thog sngar bzhin sha sogs kyi thob 28

skal gya nom pa bstar 'bul byed/ dgong dro gsol ston bshams rjes sku mgron dang / bu'i nang gi sne len pa tsho phan tshun chig rgyag gi glu gzhas 'gran zhing /pham mkhan rnams kyis rgyal kha thob mkhan der mjal dar 'bul ba dang / thob mkhan des pham mkhan der chang chad dkar yol gsum re 'dren/ mtha' ma skya mgron dang / sne len mkhan tshang ma chang rag gi btung bas rab tu myos nas rkang pa'i 'degs 'jog kyang cha mi snyoms par rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir log byed/nyin gsum par yang bskyar gsol ston rgyas pa zhig 'bul gshom byed cing /dgong dro gsol ston 'bul skabs mna' ma skyel mi gtso bo dang / mna' ma'i pha ma gnyis la dar gos chen sogs 'bul rten gzab rgyas thog sngar bzhin lug sha khog sbug tshang sogs bstar 'bul byed/ skya mgron byings rnams la yang go babs la gzhigs pa'i 'bul tshan mi nyung ba dang / mjal dar re 'bul/ de nas bu dang mna' ma'i pha yis gnyen dpang drung du bcar te 'bul tshan gya nom pa lcog rtse'i steng du bzhag nas gzhon nu pho mo gnyis gsum zhig nas da lam gnyen dpang gi bkrin la brten nas nged cag mi tshang gnyis gnyen 'brel byung ba der thugs rje che zhu ba'i bkros pa'i blu gzhas mang po gtong ba dang / khungs so sor chang rag gi btung ba dkar yol re 'dren/ gal srid gnyen dpang gi 'dod blo ma khengs pa byung che phyogs gnyis kyi pha mas phul ba'i mjal dar de mi len pa'i thog la/ da cha khyed gnyis gnyen 'grogs pa de ngas dka' ngal khyad du bsad pa'i 'bras bu yin/khyed mi tshang gnyis kyis nga'i bkrin la bsam shes med par 'bul tshan 'di tsam gyi nga'i 'dod blo khengs ma song zhes thengs mang brjod pa sogs gnyen dpang gis tshang mar rgod bro'i gtam gleng yang du ma byed/ slar yang gzhon nu pho mo tshos mjal 29

dar khyer nas gnyen dpang la bstod bsngags mang po zhus mthar chang sa'i dga' ston rten 'byung gi byed sgo de legs grub byung ba'i rtags mtshan du tshang mas lag nang rtsam pa khyer nas lha rgyal 'then/nyin gsum ring mna' ma'i bag rogs kyis nyin mtshan drug tu mna' ma dang mnyam du sdod pas bu dang mna' ma gnyis mnyam 'dzoms kyi go skabs yong gi med/ gal srid bu des mna' mar skad cha shod 'dod dang / lta 'dod yod na bag rogs der ngo bstod mang po byed dgos/ de ltar byas na gzhi nas skad cha shod pa'i go skabs yong gi yod/ gal srid ngo ma shes pa'i mi gzhan zhig gis mna' ma'i khang pa'i nang du 'dzul na mna' mas ngo gdong rtsig zur la bltas nas sdod kyi yod la phar skad cha bshad rung lan 'debs bag rogs kyis byed kyi yod/nyin gsum ring bu'i nang du bsdad rjes mna' ma de rang nyid kyi pha dang mnyam du rang khyim du phyir log byas nas zla gcig lhag tsam song rjes gza' skar 'byung 'phrod dge ba'i nyin zhig bu'i nang du slar yang mna' ma skyel bar yong gi 'dug de nas bzung na gzhon khyo shug gnyis 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi dga' bde'i dpal la longs su spyod 'go tshugs te mna' mas bu'i nang du rla ba re gnyis bsdad rjes gza' ches dang bstun nas khyo shug gnyis mna' ma'i pha ma thug par gnyen log tu 'gro skabs mna' ma'i pha ma dang / spyan mched tshor che chung la ma ltos pa'i 'bul tshan re khyer dgos/ de nas bu dang mna' ma gnyis mna' ma'i nang du bdun phrag re gnyis bsdad rjes phyir log byed pa dang / re zung gis bu de sngon la rang khyim du log nas mna' ma dus yun ring tsam rang nyid kyi pha ma dang mnyam du bsdad rjes bu des mna' ma bsu bar 'gro srol yod/30

gong du rob tsam zhus pa ltar/ tsong kha'i khul gyi sngar srol bod mi mang che bas bu dang bu mo gnyis mos mthun byung che bu'i nang nas gnyen dpang gdan zhus kyis bu mo'i pha ma gnyis sar btang nas bu slong bar yong gi yod pa dang / slong chang skabs 'bul tshan mang po dgos skor gnyen dpang dang gros gleng byed/ gal srid bu mo mna' mar ma ster ba byung che bu mo 'phrog rgyu'i grabs gshom byas nas zla dus ches grangs nyin bu mo'i nang du bu mo 'phrog par yong rgyu yin zhes sngon brda sprad de/ de nyin bu'i rogs par na gzhon dar ma gang mang khrid de bu mo'i nang du bskyod/de bzhin bu mo'i pha ma gnyis la lan 'byor ma thag khyim mches gnyen 'brel rnams gdan zhus kyis gnas tshul gsal brjod dang sbrags pha rol por kha gtad gcog rgyu'i grabs gshom ang bsar spi len gyis sgug bsdad de gdong thug skabs bu'i phyogs nas skad cha shod mkhas pa zhig gis skad cha snyan po bshad nas mna' ma lon thabs dang / gal srid don dag ma 'grub che mgo bskor g.yo byus la brten nas mna' ma len thabs byed/ de yang don son ma byung na drag po'i g.yul 'thab la brten nas bu mo 'phrog thabs byed/ bu mo 'phrog thub pa byung na yul de'i mi mang tshang mas bu der dpa' zhing brtul phod pa zhig yin par bsngags brjod byed/ bu mo'i pha ma gnyis kyang bu mor dpa' mdzangs ldan pa'i khyo ga zhig byung bar dga' tshor skye ba dang / blo bde po'i thog nas khas len dang / dga' bsu zhu gi yod/gal te mna' ma 'phrog ma thub pa byung na yul mi tshang mas bu der dmod cing 'phya bar byed/ mna' ma 'phrog dus skabs re mi gsod kyang yong ba dang / de ltar byung che yul mi phan tshun zhi mthun thog thag gcod yong thabs byed pa dang / re zung gis don gnad de'i thog lung tshan phan tshun gyi 'khrug pa yang yong gi yod pa red/cig

nga'i dran thog la nga tsho'i grong sder gong gsal gnas tshul de rigs thengs gnyis tsam byung yang / mi gsod kyi gnas tshul ma byung bar phan tshun brdung res byas pa'i gnas tshul tsam byung rung mtha' ma zhi ba'i thog nas thag gcod byung song /phyis su bu dang bu mo gnyis kyi gnyen sgrig de phan tshun gyi pha ma rnams kyis thag gcod byed kyi yod/ mdo smad khul 'dir chol kha gzhan gnyis dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos ni khyo ga gcig gis chung ma gcig bsten pa las/ chung ma gcig la khyo ga 'ga' shas bsten pa'i lugs srol med/ 'on kyang khyo ga gcig la chung ma gnyis yod pa re zung yod pa de ni phal cher 'byor pa chen po yod pa'am/ yang na chung ma dang po der phru gu ma skyes par gnyis pa len pa'i srol yod/ mdo smad pa tshos chol kha gzhan dang 'dra bar bu dang bu mo gang la yang nye ring med pa brtsi mthong 'jog gi yod/ 'ga' shas kyis bu gcig dang bu mo gcig las med che bu de grwa pa bzo ba dang / bu mo der mag pa len srol yod//tsong kha'i yul gyi bud med rnams kyi chas gos che sar 'dra yang chung sar khyad par chen po yod/ skyes pa rnams kyi gyon chas ni bod chol kha gsum spyi dang mthun pa zhig yin/ chi kyā tsho pa'i bud med rnams kyi rgyan cha de bud med kyi rgyab tu bum pa khyer ba lta bu zhig yod/ bum pa'i steng du gser las bzos pa'i rgyan cha bkris rtags brgyad dang / g.yu byur sogs rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs rgyag gi yod/ de ni mang che ba mi drag gi bud med tsho'i rgyan cha yin/ de 'og rnams kyis dngul las bzos pa'i rgyan cha 'dogs pa dang / 'byor pa zhan pa rnams kyi rgyan cha'i steng du dung dkar las bzos pa'i bzo dbyibs sna tshogs rgyag srol 'dugabum pa'i gsham du bud med rang nyid kyis phar phyin brgyab pa'i me tog sna tshogs 32

las grub pa'i rgyan cha 'dogs pa'i skor/ rgan rabs kyi ngag rgyun las/ bum pa lta bu'i rgyan cha de rje tsong kha pa'i yum 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas dar ba zhig yin zer/gang ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos mdo smad du dar nas gong gsal rgyan cha'i bzo dbyibs rim bzhin dar ba zhig yin par snyam/ bu mo mna' mar ma 'gro gong bu mo'i skra lhas ma gnyis sla gi yod cing / chang sa rgyag skabs lan bu phra mo mang po sla gi yod pa dang / chang sa rgyab rjes lhas ma gsum sla gi 'dug de ltar lan bu phra mo mang po sla ba de ni bod snga rabs kyi goms gshis shul rgyun zhig yin/snga rabs mdo smad khul pho mo tshang mas rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i phying zhu ring po gyon srol yod kyang / phyis su goms gshis de nyams yod/ skyes pa tsho'i phyu pa'i mtha' rgyan la 'byor pa drag pa tshos sram lpags dang / stag lpags/ gzig lpags gtong ba dang / 'byor pa zhan pa tshos snam bu thig ma gtong ba/ phyu pa'i ske rag dmar po 'ching ba las tshos gzhi gzhan mi 'ching / ske rag kyi sne dzar rgyab tu glod kyi yod cing / rgyab sul rub bsdu byed pa las dbus gtsang ltar rgyab sul gral 'grigs po de 'dra bsdu srol med pa bcas so 33

bsku tshan gnyis pa/nga'i pha mes kyi rigs rgyud dang nga rang byis pa'i dus kyi gnas tshul skor/dbe༅/ /nga'i skye yul cong rtsi grong sde ni rje sku 'bum gyi lho shar du me le nyi shu tsam gyi sar yod pa dang / grong sde der dud tshang nyi shu tsam las med/ cong rtsi sde grong gi tha snyad ni/ grong gi nub ngos nye 'dabs su de'u 'bur zhig yod pa'i steng du chu mig cig yod pa de'i chu rgyun gar rgyugs kyi shul du cong zhi'i rtsi dkar po lta bu chags par brten grong gi tha snyad la cong rtsi sde pa zhes su grags/ cong zhi'i chu des nad 'pho ba dang / mkhal ma/ sha dug rus chag gso ba/ bad kun smug po sogs la phan gyi yod stabs lo res dpyid dkar ston gsum gyi dus su phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas chu'i 'phrod bsten sman bcos la yong mkhan mang po yod/cong rtsi grong sde dang stag 'cher grong sde'i bar bod mi dang rgya rigs kyi grong sde lnga tsam yod/ de'i mi rgyud ni snga rabs su bod mi yin zhing / dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i rjes su hor mis dbang sgyur byas/ rjes su hor rigs mi rgyud de rim bzhin rgya rigs su gyur 'dug7gong sa 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po pe cing nas bod du phyir phebs skabs 35

chi kyā nang sos chibs zhabs su bcar te zhabs rtog legs par zhus par brten khong la gzengs bstod gnang char yang 7rgyal dbang mchog gi shangs khrag las bris pa'i lha mo gsung byon ma'i sku thang zhig dang gser bris bka' bstan bcos du ma bstsal yod par grags/nga'i pha yi ming la cong rtsi skal bzang zer/ khong gi khyim du bu spyan bzhi dang /bu mo spyan gsum yod/ khong ni bu spyan gsum pa de yin/ khong gi gcen po rgan shos de chung dus nas rje sku 'bum dgon pa'i grwa par zhugs te chos kyi slob gnyer legs par thon nas sku 'bum gyi dge bshes lha ram pa'i mtshan thogs te rjes su sku 'bum gyi rgyud pa'i mkhan po sogs mdzad de cong rtsi zhabs drung zhes su grags/gcung po chung shos de yang rje skya 'bum gyi grwa pa yin pa phud/ de min spyan mched tshang ma zhing pa yin/ nga'i ma yi ming la don grub mtsho mo zer/ khong gi 'khrungs yul ni cong rtsi grong sde'i shar ngos tsong chu'i pha rol dmar gtsang sde nas yin/ khong gi mes po dmar tshang nang so blo bzang chos 'dzin bya ba yin zhing / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu yos 1733 lor mdo smad khul gyi sog po rgyal po ching wang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis man ju gzhung la ngo rgol byed skabs mdo smad kyi zi yon bcu gsum gyi nang so 'ga' zhig sog rgyal gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i khongs su dmar tshang nang so yang zhugs rkyen khrims mun du bcug ste lcang skya ye shes bstan pa'i sgron mes man ju gong ma yung ṭing la snyan sgron skyabs 'jug zhus mthar nang so'i go ming phab nas btson ra las thar te khyim bdag gir byed chog byung lugs skor kho bo chung dus sgrung gtam lta bur yang yang gsung gi yod/dmar gtsang zhes pa de snga rabs bod kyi rgyal po glang dar skabs bod dbus 36

phyogs su nang chos bsnubs pa'i dus der dmar shakyu 'od dang / gtsang rab gsal/g.yo dge 'byung bcas dbus kyi mkhas pa mi gsum bros phebs nas sa khul de'i brag gi steng du sgrub gnas chags te sgrub pa nyams len mdzad pas sa der dmar gtsang zhes grags/cong rtsi sde grong gi shar ngos nye 'gram dang / dmar gtsang gi mdun phyogs su snga rabs kyi shul bzhag mkhar rdzong gi gyang ro zhig yod pa de ni dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i stod tsam la bod kyi chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud khri bkris brtsegs pa dpal gyi sras gnyis pa khri lde'u btsan nam/ jo sras sam/ rgyal sras/ rgya'i tha snyad du mchog zhi lu zhes pa mnga' ris phyogs nas li yul brgyud mdo smad tsong kha yul du byon te mdo smad sa khul phal mo cher dbang sgyur mdzad nas rgyal thog gsum tsam bzhugs pa'i rgyal sa tsong kha mkhar zhes grags shing / de rjes tsong kha mkhar zhes pa'i tha snyad de rgya'i tha snyad du rim bsgyur gyis deng sang phen grin shan zhes 'bod/nged kyi mes po mi thog bzhi tsam sngon la tsong kha mkhar nas cong rtsi grong du gnas spos byas pa red ces rgan rabs rnams kyi bshad rgyun yod pa ltar/ nged kyi nang mi tshos lo ltar lo gsar ches gsum nyin sa phyogs der kha bltas nas yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la gsol mchod bya srol yod/pha ma gnyis kyi gsung gsal la/ phyi lo 1923 lo nga rang btsas ma thag pa nas bzung gzugs gzhi nad mnar 'chi la nye ba'i byis pa zhig yin pas/ lo gcig tsam lon rjes pha ma gnyis kyis lha bla mar thugs dam rim zhus phyir phebs su/ byis pa 'di lo gcig gnyis tsam gyi ring che la bar chad ha cang chen po yod/de las zlog ched pha ma gnyis lto skor gnas skor du phyin na bar chad sel rgyu'i re ba 37

yod ces gsungs par brten khong gnyis nas lo gnyis ring nga rang sga'/ par bsnams nas mdo smad sa khul gyi gnas phal cher bskor ba yin zhes gsungs myong /skabs re nga'i gzugs po ha cang zhan po byung ste ha lam 'chi 'gro ba lta bu thengs 'ga' shas byung skabs khong gnyis kyis nga lam kha'i pha bong steng du bzhag ste 'chi rgyur sgrag sdod skabs bya rog dang / khyi spyang sogs kyis phung po za rgyu'i re sgrag byed par brten ma shi gong nas bya rog gis mig 'don rdugs kyis dbugs ma phyin par du nga'i g.yas g.yon du srung nas bsdad/ dus tshod gang 'tshams song rjes rkang lag 'gul skyod btang ba dang / skad rgyag pa sogs byung bar brten khong gnyis dga' tshor chen pos slar yang nga sgal par bsnams nas gnas skor du mu mthud bskyod/lo gnyis ring dka' sdug mang po myong nas nad gcong byis pa nga'i gzugs po phran bu drag skyes byung bar brten khong gnyis dga' spro'i ngang nas rang khyim du phyir log gnang 'dugang tsho nang du phyir log ma byas gong nang mi tshang mas phru gu nad gcong de 'das grong song med dam snyam nas pha ma gnyis yong rgyur sgug nas bsdad/ lo gnyis kyi rjes la nga rang pha ma gnyis mnyam du phyir log yong thub pa byung skabs nang mi tshang ma brjod kyis mi lang ba'i dga' spro 'phel/ gong du zhus don ltar/ nga rang chung dus lus po nad gcong yin stabs lha bla ma mang po nas ming snga rjes zhus par/ byang chub skyabs dang / lha mo che brtan/ chi kyā skyabs/ rdo rje nyi ma bcas rim pas gnang /skabs der nga rang lo gnyis gsum tsam son dus sku 'bum dgon gyi stag 'cher rin po che sku gong ma'i yang srid sprul sku brtsad gcod zhu rgyu'i 'os sprul gyi 38

khongs su nga rang yang tshud de stag 'cher bla brang nas 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum par thugs dam zhus nas da lta'i stag 'cher rin po che thub bstan 'jigs med nor bur yang srid 'khrul bral yin pa'i thugs gtan 'khel/nga rang lo lnga drug tsam gyi dus su chi kyā nang so cong rtsi grong sde'i mdun gyi rgya lam nas zi ling bar phar tshur 'gro 'ong skabs nga'i a khus lam mdun du gur zhig phubs nas phebs bsu zhu gi 'dug chi kyā nang so shing rta 'khor lo'i nang phebs kyi yod pa dang / skabs re phebs bsu zhu sa der shing rta 'khor lo las babs te phebs bsu zhu mkhan la bka' mol tshig re zung gsungs/ skabs re shing rta 'khor lo nas ma babs par phebs bsu ba rnams la 'tshams 'dri'i bka' mol 'ga' shas gnang gi 'dug nga'i a khus chung dus nang so'i sku srung lo 'ga' shas gnang yod par brten khong dga' bsu phebs skyel zhu rgyu ni a khu'i las 'gan yin par snyam/dus skabs der chi kyā nang so la chi kyā tsho pa'i yul der khrims 'go rang btsan gyis dbang bsgyur byed pa'i dbang cha yod/ phyi lo 1928 lor mdo smad khul la rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab go min tang gzhung gis mtsho sngon zhing chen zhes pa'i ming btags rjes nang so rnams kyi dbang cha de phyir len byas nas mtsho sngon zhing chen srid 'dzin las khungs nas gcig bsdus kyi dbang sgyur byas/ 'on kyang nang so sger gyi rgyu nor thams cad rang 'jags bzhagarang lo bdun brgyad du son skabs nga rang la nad gzhi drag po zhig byung ba lam rob dran gsos kyi 'dug rang lo bcu gsum gyi rjes su bar chad zlog pa ltar rim pas lus khams dwangs skyes su gyur/ nga'i pha ma gnyis dang lhag 39

par nga'i rme bo lags kyis chung dus ha cang byams po gnang ba dran gsos kyi 'dugarang nyid chung dus nad gcong yin par brten khyim mches kyi phru gu tshos nga la brnyas bcos mang po byas pa yang dran lam du 'char/ 'on kyang nga'i a khu'i bu lha mo don grub ces pa des nga la srung skyob yag po byed kyi yod/ khong nga las lo gsum gyis rgan pa yod cing / nga rang lo lnga tsam nas bzung gcen po lha mo don grub dang mnyam du rgya yig slob 'go tshugs/ skabs der smad phyogs rgya nag la mu ge chen po byung nas rgya mi mang po mdo smad sa khul la bros byol yong ba'i gas rang lo 50 tsam la slebs pa'i rgya mi zhig nga'i nang du 'tsho gos kyi rogs skyob zhu bar yong ste snga dgong gnyis kur nga la rgya yig slob sbyong sprod pa dang / nyin mo lug 'tsho bar 'gro gi yod/tsong kha'i khul du bod mi'i grong sde'i nang bod phrug tsho bod yig slob pa phud/ rgya yig kyang slob sbyong byed/yul de'i goms gshes la grwa pa byas nas bod yig dang dpe cha slob pa ma gtogs khyim pa tshos bod yig slob srol med/ de ni bod mi rang nyid kyi skad yig dang rig gzhung nyams rgyad du gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig yin par snyam/gcen po lha mo don grub dang / nga gnyis kyi dge rgan rgya rgan zhig thob pa nas bzung snga dgong gnyis rgya yig slob 'go btsugs/ khong ni rgya yig gi shes tshad mtho po yin par mngon/ slob sbyong gi zhor du rgya nag gi rgyal rabs dang / pha ma rgan rabs la brtsi bkur zhu lugs skor gyi sgrung gtam sna tshogs shod kyi yod/skabs der nga tsho'i grong sde'i g.yas g.yon la deng rabs can gyi slob grwa med pa ma zad/ slob deb kyang thob khag po yin/ khong ni sngar srol gyi rgya yig slob stangs thog nas slob sbyong sprod pa de ni snga dgong slob khrid byas pa'i tshig don de dag sang nyin 40

snga dro ngag thog nas rgyugs sprod byed dgos/ mtshan mo phyi po'i bar snum zhu'i 'og tu blo 'dzin byed dgos shing / skabs re rang nyid lo na chung ba'i rkyen gyis dgong dro slob sbyong skabs gnyid cog rgyag dus dge rgan gyis gang zag ring po zhig de nga'i mgo la gzhu ba des na tsha gtong ba dang/ zhed snang chabs sbrags kyis gnyid sad kyi yod pa dang / mgo bo 'phur tsam byas nas yang bskyar slob sbyong byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang slob sbyong byas rjes dge rgan gyis nga la ha cang byams po byed cing / de'i sang nyin nga gnyis mnyam du 'khrid nas lug 'tsho bar bskyod/ skabs der dga' dga' skyed skyed ngang nas dus tshod 'khyol 'gro gi yod/ lug gu rnams dga' mchongs rgyag bzhin rgyugs 'gro skabs nga rang mnyam du rgyugs rgyur ha cang dga' po yod cing / lug rnams sa thag ring po nas tshur bskong rgyu'i las 'gan de dang bas kun blangs kyis byed kyi yod/ rtsa chu bzang po'i ne'u gseng g.yu yi maṇaḍal lta bu'i khrod du mu tig gi tshom bu bkod 'dra'i lug khyu rnams kha khu sem por rtsa bzang la longs su spyod skabs nga tsho dge slob slob sbyong gi 'dzin grwa tshugs kyi yod/skabs re dge rgan gyis nga gnyis la rgya nag snga rabs kyi rgyal khab gsum gyi sgrung dang /dpa' bo brgya dang brgyad kyi chu ngogs gtam rgyud ces pa'i sgrung yang shod skabs de tsho ni shin tu 'khrugs nyams ldan pa sha stag yin pas nga tsho gsum mgo 'khor thag chod nas lug brlag pa'i gnas tshul yang byung myong pa'i skabs der brel 'tshab ngang lug skong bar 'gro gi yod/ de 'dra'i ngang lo bco lnga song rjes dge rgan gyi byams brtse'i thog nas slob khrid byas pa'i sngar srol rgya yig gang tsam rgyugs phrod pa dang / slob sbyong gi go skabs bzang po zhig thob 'byung /de nas dus mi ring bar dge rgan de'i nang mis nga tsho'i yul phyogs su khong 4ga

rang 'tshol du yong nas nang mi dang mnyam du rgya nag la phyir log byas/ skabs der dge rgan thon khar dge slob phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i yid gdung zad mi shes pa byung yang / dge rgan gyis lo rjes mar nga rang nges par du khyed tsho thug 'phrad du yong gi yin zhes gsungs pa des phran bu'i blo bder gyur/ gong gsal gnas tshul de rnams dus da lta yang yid la lhang lhang dran bzhin 'dug dge rgan bzang po de rang yul du phyir log byas rjes lo gcig ring slob sbyong gi go skabs chad par brten de sngon bslabs zin pa'i slob tshan nas mang po zhig rang bzhin gyi brjed song /de nas lo gcig gi rjes su phyi lo 1933 nas 1934 bar tsam la cong rtsi grong sde'i shar ngos rgya mi mang po yod pa'i grong sde der deng rabs can gyi slob grwa chung ba zhig gsar 'dzugs byas te nga tsho'i grong sde nas bu phrug bcu lhag tsam slob grwa der slob sbyong byed par bskyod/slob grwa gsar pa de'i nang slob phrug brgya lhag tsam yod kyang / dge rgan gcig las med/ slob grwa de ni rgya lha khang zhig gi nang du tshugs shing / slob phrug mang che ba rgya phrug yin/ nga tsho'i grong sde dang / grong sde gzhan dag nas yong ba'i bod phrug bco lnga tsam yod/ slob tshan rgya yig dang / rgya nag gi rgyal rabs/ rgya yig gi rtsom rig rgyun mkho'i shes bya/ sa khams/ rang byung tshan rig ang rtsis bcas yod/de sngon slob tshan de gas bslabs ma myong stabs ha cang dga' snang chen po byung la shes e yong bsams pa'i 'jigs snang yang byung / slob tshan rgya yig gi rtsom rig dang / rgyal rabs bcas las sla po byung yang / dka' las khag po ang rtsis slob rgyu de byung / dang thog ang rtsis kyi ang ki yang yag po 'bri shes kyi 42

med/ dge rgan gyis slob phrug tshang ma'i yig rgyugs blangs rjes nga dang rgya phrug gcig 'dzin gra bzhi pa'i nang bzhag thog 'dzin gra dang po dang gnyis pa'i nang rgya yig dang rgyal rabs kyi dge rgan gcig lcogs bya rgyu'i las 'gan sprad nas ngas ang rtsis slob dus dka' ngal 'phrad de thengs kha shas rgyugs ma 'phrod par brten nyes rdung yang 'ga' shas bzed dgos byung /nga tsho'i dge rgan de lo de tsam chen po min la shes tshad kyang nga tsho las cung drag tsam zhig 'dug skabs der rgya nag gzhung gis mdo smad khul gyi zhing 'brog sa khul gyi mi tshang mang ba'i grong sde khag la slob grwa gsar pa btsugs pa'i khyab bsgrags byas/ 'on kyang / rgya mi'i dud tshang mang che ba'i grong sder ma gtogs bod mi khe gtsang sdod sar slob gru ha lam btsugs med/ mdor na rgya mi'i slob grur bod phrug ma btang ba'i gnas tshul mang po byung yod/ slob grwar lo gnyis slob sbyong byas kyang de tsam gyi shes tshad mtho ru phyin ma song ba de ni slob phrug brgya lhag tsam yod pa rnams la dge rgan gcig las med pa dang / dge rgan gyi shes tshad kyang mtho po med pa'i rkyen gyis yin par snyam/de bzhin slob grwa'i byed sgo mang che ba rtsed mo rtse rgyu dang / slob phrug rgan pa tsho dge rgan gyi g.yog rgyugs su 'jug pa bcas kyi gnas tshul de 'dra'i 'og slob phrug gi pha ma mang che bas slob phrug dgongs pa yang yang zhu ru 'jug cing / slob phrug slob grwar ma btang na dge rgan gyis rgyu mtshan dres te srid gzhung la snyan seng zhus nas nyes chad 'gel gyi yod/lo gnyis song ba'i lo mjug der mtsho sngon khongs gtogs bod sog slob grwa zhes pa zhig gsar 'dzugs byas pa de ni sngar paṇa chen sku gong ma'i zhabs phyi zhu 43

myong mkhan skya 'bum gyi grwa pa zhig yod pa des sngon chad mtsho sngon khul nas bu phrug bcu grangs shig rgya nag tu slob sbyong byed par khrid de lo shas rjes phyir log byas khongs chi kyā tsho pa'i mtha' grong sde'i slob phrug blo bzang byang chub ces pa de zi ling du 'byor nas slob grwa de gsar 'dzugs kyis 'gro song dang / gang ci'i mthun rkyen rnams paṇa chen tshang brgyud nas rgya nag dbus gzhung gis sprod kyi yod/ bod sog slob grwa'i slob phrug skong rgyu'i thad mtsho sngon zhing chen srid gzhung nas bod sog zhing 'grog sa khul gyi lo bcu nas bco lnga bar yin pa'i mi tshang drag gras kyi bu phrug tshang ma yong dgos pa'i bka' btang / skabs der nga tsho'i grong sder bka' de 'byor skabs nga rang dang / nga dang lo mnyam yin pa dkon mchog che ring dang /byang chub che ring bcas nga tsho gsum slob grwar 'gro rgyu'i ming tho bkod/ rang nyid zi ling slob grwar 'gro rgyu byung ba der ha cang dga' snang chen po skyes byung / 'o na kyang /nga'i mo'o lags dang / a ma gnyis kyis nga sa thag ring por 'gro rgyur 'dod pa ma byas par phran bu'i dka' ngal 'phrad kyang / mthar khong gnyis nas nga rang slo ba grwar 'gro rgyur mos mthun byas/ slob grwa der slob phrug grangs tshad sum brgya nas lnga brgya'i bar skong rgyu gtan 'khel pa ltar/ skabs der bod mi'i grong sde'i sa khul nas slob grwa ba gang 'tsha34sa slebs yod kyang 'brog sde'i sa khul nas mi drag gi bu phrug slob grwar btang med cing / nyung shas btang ba rnams kyang dbul phongs tshor gla cha sprad nas btang ba zhig red/ de ni rang nyid kyi bu phrug rtsa chen du brtsis pa de mtha' ma drin chung du song /bod sog slob grwa'i slob tshan ni slob grwa gzhan dang gcig mtshungs yin pa'i 44

thog bod sog skad yig gi slob tshan yang yod/ bod phrug rnams kyis bod yig slob sbyong dang / sog rigs rnams kyis sog yig slob sbyong byed kyi yod/ yin na'ang des phan thogs gang yang byung med pa de ni bdun phrag gcig la slob tshan de thengs gcig las slob kyi med la/ bod yig dge rgan shes tshad drag pa zhig gtan nas thob kyi med/ slob grwa de zi ling grong khyer nang gi slob grwa'i mthun rkyen legs shos su gnas par brten mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi spyi khyab kru'u zhi rma phu'u pang gis zhe sdang phrag dog skyes te rnyog dra sna tshogs bzos nas slob grwa der dka' ngal mang po sprad/phyi lo 1938 lo gzhi rim slob grwa'i 'dzin gra gnyis pa'i skabs mtsho sngon sa khul gyi na gzhon rang lo 15 nas rang lo 20 slebs pa rnams dang /da dung gzhi rim slob grwa khag gi slob phrug tshad lon rim bzhin der slebs pa rnams la gra sgrig dmag gi sbyong brdar sprod dgos zhes bkod khyab byas pa ltar bod sog slob grwa'i lo tshad lon pa'i slob phrug la gra sgrig dmag gi sbyong brdar sprod rgyu'i ming tho blangs khongs nga rang yang tshud par brten lo de'i rla 10 tsam la slob grwa'i gung seng gi dus skabs slebs nye'i dus su rang khyim du phyir log 'gro ba'i go skabs ma byung bar gra sgrig dmag gi sbyong brdar du rang dbang med par 'gro dgos byung /dus skabs der nyi hong pas rgya nag nang btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrugs bslangs yod stabs rgya nag rgyal yongs su gra sgrig dmag gi slob sbyong tshugs pa yin tshod 'dug dmag sbyong byed ring gi 'tsho ba ni ha cang dka' tshogs che ba zhig red/skabs der rang lo 15 tsam la slebs yod kyang / lus stobs zhan pas me mda' 'khyer nas chu tshod gnyis gsum 'gro dgos skabs ngal ba chen po 'phrad kyi yod/ mtshan mo so lta byas nas langs sdod skabs gnyid shor ba dang / grang ngar 45

gyis rkyen pas srung cha legs par byed ma thub skabs nyes rdung yang thengs mang bzed myong / gra sgrig dmag gi sbyong brdar ring sdod sa gur sha stag yin stabs grang ngar gyi dka' sdug mang po myong dgos byung yang / dmag sbyong byed skabs rkang lag chag skyon shor ba sogs gang yang ma byung / dmag rtsed dge rgan mang che ba yi ge na gcig mi shes pa'i kha che hu'i rigs zhe cig yin stabs mi de tsho ni ya nga snying rje spu tsam med/slob phrug tshor nyes rdung tshod med gtong gi yod kyang rjes su rang khyim nas dngul dang rngan pa bskur ba rnams las gdug rtsub can gyi dge rgan de tshor phran bu re sprad rjes mi de tsho'i gshis kur 'gyur ldog byung song / dmag sbyong lo gcig dang rla ba brgyad tsam byas rjes lus stobs legs pa rnams dmag sgar khag la btang ba dang /shes yon yod pa tshor dma' rim gyi go gnas dang drung yig sogs kyi las gnas sprad nas btang / lus stobs zhan pa'i slob phrug rnams slob grwar rang 'jags phyir bslogs btang khongs su nga rang yang tshud stabs slob grwar log pa'i go skabs byung yang / ring por mi thogs par mo'o lags kyis nga'i pā lags slob gru'i spyi khyab blo bzang byang chub sar btang nas rtsa dgongs zhus/skabs der nga'i bsam par slob sbyong mu mthud bya rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam (5/nga / rang nyid kyi lus stobs zhan po yin stabs khong tsho'i bka' la ma nyan mthu med byung nas nang du phyir log byas/ nga'i mo'o lags kyi bsam tshul la/khong rang gi che yi 'du byed ma stong gong nga rang gnyen sgrig bya rgyu'i re ba gnang gi yod /nga'i a ma'i gshis ka ha cang 'jam po yin pas dus rtag tu nang mi tshos thub tshod btang zhing / gyong sha stag 'khel gyi yod/ khong la dka' ngal chen po phrad skabs dgong dro snum zhun gyi 'og tu chu tshod gnyis gsum bshams nas bzhugs kyi 'dug46

ngas khong thugs sems skyo ba'i skabs der sems gso zhu skabs khong la sku ngal phrad pa'i rgyu rkyen yong sa de nam yang gsung gi med/ rjes su rang nyid lo na son skabs mi gzhan gyi sa nas go thos la/ don dag mang che ba ni pā lags kyis gcen mo dang gcung mo'i kha la gsan nas nga'i a ma lags la dka' ngal 'phrad pa red zer/rjes sor nga'i mo'o lags gshegs rjes a ma lags nang gi dbang cha thob ste phran bu'i bde ba thob kyang ngas khong rang la zhabs phyi phan thogs zhu ma thub pa der da lta yang blo 'gyod 'dugang skyes pa'i rjes la nga'i a ma lags la bu gcig dang / bu mo gcig skyes kyang bu de lo gcig tsam rjes la 'das grong song ba dang / bu mo de da lta yang bsdad yod/ nga tsho'i yul srol la yang dge 'dun la dad gus chen po zhu gi yod cing / lhag par dbus phyogs nas lha sa smon lam chen mor zhugs myong ba'i dge 'dun yin che de bas dad gus che ba zhu gi yod/ skabs der nga rang grwa pa byed rgyu'i bsam blo yang 'khor myong yang / pha ma gnyis la bu gcig las med stabs grwa pa byed pa'i go skabs ma byung / mo'o lags kyis nga la mna' ma len rgyur thugs khur chen po gnang yang / ngas thengs mang nyan 'jog ma zhus pa da lta yang lhang nger dran bzhin 'dug/ thengs gcig don de'i thog ngas nang nas phyir thon 'gro dgos byung yang / nyin shas rjes mo'o lags dang a ma bcas dran nas nang du yang bskyar phyir log byed dgos byung / rjes su gnas tshul de bsam blo 'khor skabs rang dbang med par gad mo shor nas de ni byis blo rgod bro ba zhig yin par snyam/nga rang lo na chung dus sku 'bum dgon par 'gro rgyur ha cang dga' po yod/lo gcig la thengs gsum 'gro ba'i go skabs yod pa de ni rla ba dang por smon lam 47

dus chen dang / rla ba bzhi par sa che'i dus chen/ rla ba drug par drug pa ches bzhi bcas yin/ skabs der dus chen la 'gro mkhan mang po yod/ mang che ba rnams kyis dgon par mchod 'bul zhu ba dang / phyag 'tshal bskor sbyong byed pa bcas dang / nad gcong 'ga' shas kyang dgon par mchod mjal dang / bskor ba rgyab na nad gzhi drag skyes yong res phyag 'tshal bskor sbyong byed mkhan yod/ so nam pa 'ga' shas kyis mar dang 'bru rigs sna tshogs khyer nas tshong bar yong ba dang / mi mang che ba rla ba dang po'i smon lam dus chen la 'dzoms kyi yod/sku 'bum gyi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du gnas pa'i bod mi dang /sog rigs rgan gzhon pho mo tshang ma gnas bskor du yong ba dang / thag ring du gnas pa'i bod pa'i 'brog sde khag nas kyang mchod mjal du yong mkhan yod/dgon gsham du rgya mi dang / hu'i rigs kyis tshong las dang / za khang zin mkhan yang mang po yong ba de tshos bod skad chu rgyugs rgyugs rgyag gi yod pa dang / bod mi 'brog pa tshor mgo bskor btang nas khe bzang chen po za gi yod stabs 'brog pa tshos tshong pa de tshor a khu mkhas pa khyod mkhyen zhes zer srol yod pa de tshor nga rang yang phru gu'i dus yin pas ltad mo chen po mthong gi yod/ skabs re mi rgan pa tsho dang mnyam du mchod mjal du khrid skabs don gnad ji yin mi shes kyang dad pa'i snang ba bcos min zhig yong gi yod/ ya mtshan pa zhig la/ sku 'bum dgon par nyin phyed yol mtshams su dge 'dun pa tshos rtags gsal rtsod sa der ltad mo chen po yong gi yod/ thog mar nga'i bsam par dge 'dun pa de tsho don gang gi ched du rtsod kyi yod dam snyam yang / rjes su rgan rabs tshos/ de ni chos kyi slob gnyer sbyong brdar gyi rigs shig yin lugs gsung myong //48
smras pa//skyes shing mtshar ba'i dga' ba'i pha yul du//gces shing rtag tu sdod pa'i skabs phra yang //phun tshogs lta na sdug pa'i mdzes ljongs dang //yid la gcags pa'i bya ba lhang nger dran//49

le tshan gsum pa/7gong sa mchog gi sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma nged gnyis 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi gnyen du 'brel ba/da༄༄9/ /ngas bod sog slob grwa nas dgongs pa rtsa zhus kyis nang du phyir log byas te rmyo sko lags dang nang mi tshang mas nga la mna' ma len rgyu'i brel zing byung ba dang /rang nyid lo na chung ba'i rkyen gyis ngo tsha thag chod nas gnyen sgrig gi skor gleng gros byed par yang dka' ngal yong gi yod/nga tsho'i lung pa'i srol la bu rang lo 15 dang / bu mo rang lo 17 la gnyen sgrig byed kyi yod stabs skabs der nga rang lo 15 tsam slebs pas nang mi tshos ngo shes dga' nye tshor mna' ma su 'gab zhib dpyad dgos pa'i mngags cha byas mthar stag mcher grong sde'i a ne bza' tsho gnyis kyis stag 'cher rin poche mchog gi gcen mo che ring sgrol ma nga'i mna' mar len rgyu'i lan gsal 'byor par nang mi tshang ma dga' spro chen po byung nas gnyen 'brel yong thabs kyi las 'gan de a ne dang / a ne'i bza' rla che ring don grub gnyis la skyabs 'jug zhus/ ring por ma thogs par gnyen sgrig lam tsam gtan 'khel kyi bkris pa'i lan de 'byor pa ltar sngar srol slong chang gi byed sgo gzab rgyas byas te chang rag dang /bya

dngos po sna tshogs pa'i 'bul tshan khyer nas a ne'i sku zla stag 'tshor la slong chang du bskyod/skabs der skya'i gcen mo dgung grangs bcu bdun tsam phebs yod/ khong ni sras sros tsho'i nang gi bgres shos de yin/ khong gi 'og la stag 'cher rin po che yin/ khong ni rje sku 'bum gyi bla ma che khag cig yin pa ma zad/ nga tsho chi kyā tsho pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yang yin/ de 'og sras rgya lo don grub dang / blo bzang bsam gtan/ sras lha mo don grub da lta'i 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po bcas yod/nga tsho mi tshang phan tshun gnyis mi thog gong ma'i dus nas dga' nye'i 'brel ba yod pa dang / lhag par du sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma'i yab nga tsho'i nang du yang yang phebs kyi yod/ mi tshang phan tshun gnyis rogs res byed myong yod stabs gnyen 'brel de las sla por byed thub pa byung /ngas gnyen sgrig gi gnas tshul de thos skabs sems khral dang ngo tsha bsdoms nas gang byed 'di byed med pa lta bu byung / mi tshos de'i skor gleng skabs rang dbang med par byad bzhin dmar por gyur nangag gab thabs dang / bros thabs ci 'dra byed dgos snyam pa yong gi yod/ de bzhin lam bar ngo shes thug dus kyang gnyen sgrig skor gleng mi yong ngam snyam nas 'tshor snang yong gi yod/ de sngon ngas stag 'cher grong sder a ne thug par yang yang 'gro skabs khong gi sras mo blo gsal dang / sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma lhan du sku rtsed yang yang gnang gi 'dug khong nga las dgung lo gnyis kyi bgres pa yin stabs ngas khong la a lcag zhu gi yod/gnyen sgrig gtan 'khel ba nas bzungs nga rang stag 'cher grong sder 'gro rgyur ha cang 'cher snang chen po yong gi yod/ gal te a ne'i nang du mi 'gro ka med byung che 52

g.yol thabs sna tshogs byed cing / a ne dang a ne'i bza' zlas nga la/ che ring sgrol ma lags thug dgos zer rung / ngas u tshugs kyis g.yol thabs byed kyi yod/ de bzhin che ring sgrol ma lags nga'i a ne'i nang du phebs skabs ha cang 'cher snang chen po gnang gi 'dug nga'i a ne'i gzim khang dang / sku'i gcen mo'i gzim khang bar lcags ri gcig las med/ zer skad la mi thog gnyis kyi sngon du mi tshang gcig nas kha gyes pa zhig yin zer / mi tshang de nyid kyi ming la stag 'cher khyim phyi nang gnyis zer/ phyi nang khyim gnyis ha cang mthun po yod/stag 'tshor grong sder dud tshang bcu lhag tsam yod pa mang che ba bod mi sha stag yin/ nga rang lo bcu drug dang / sku'i gcen mo dgung grangs 18 tsam phebs skabs phyi lo 1937 lo'i dgun dus su chang sa'i dga' ston mdzad sgo gra sgrigs byed skabs rang nyid kyi bsam blor dga' snang dang / 'tshor snang gnyis ka byung / g.yol thabs ni ga la yod/ rjes su bsam blo 'khor skabs rang nyid ci bya gtol bral kyis khong tshos bkod sgrig gang byas las rang nyid la dbang cha gang yang med pa zhig red 'dug gnyen sgrig dga' ston gyi nyin mo mgyogs po slebs yong bsam pa'i dngangs skrag kyang byung / dga' ston mdzad sgo'i skabs gna' srol ltar mdzad sgo tshugs nas phyogs gnyis kyi sku mgron mang po phebs/ dus skabs der grong sde de'i dpal 'byor gnas stangs la dpag pa'i chang sa'i mdzad sgo gzab rgyas byung song /dang thog bka' mol gnang skabs phar mag par 'gro rgyu'i dka' mol byung yang nga'i pha ma gnyis la bu gcig las med stabs sku'i gcen mo tshur mna' mar bsu len bya rgyu'i thag gcod byas/ goms gshis ltar mna' ma nyin gsum 53

bzhugs ring ngas thengs gnyis tsam ngo mjal zhu bar bcar yang phan tshun bka' mol zhu rgyu phar bzhag zhal ras la lta yang nus ma byung / rang nyid nas mna' ma thug sar 'gro ba'i spobs pa dang bral yang / mi gzhan gyi skul ma'i 'og mi 'gro ka med byung ba zhig yin/ skabs der ngo tsha thag chod nas mgo bo yang 'degs mi nus pa byung pa'i gnas tshul de da lta yang lhang lhang dran bzhin 'dug stabs legs pa zhig la bag rogs de nga tsho'i gnyen tshan du 'gro mkhan gzhon nu ma zhig yin pas de snga phan tshun ngo shes yin stabs dka' ngal de tsam rang ma byung / sku'i gcen mo skabs der sku gzugs nga las che ba yod stabs mi tshos nga la bzhad gad kyang byed kyi yod/ nyin gsum gyi chang sa'i mdzad sgo grub skabs nga'i dngangs skrag gi bsam pa de rang yal du song nas da dung mdzad sgo nyin shas yod na ci ma rung snyam pa byung /chang sa'i mdzad sgor phebs mkhan tshang ma phyir phebs skabs rang nyid kyi bsam pa yang khong tsho dang mnyam du thon phyin pa lta bu'i 'char snang byung /de nas bzung skya'i gcen mo slar yang ga dus phyir phebs gnang yong bsam nas re sgrag zhus/ de rjes gong gsal gnyen sgrig gi lam srol ltar sku'i gcen mo phyir phebs kyis nged gnyis 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi 'tsho ba mnyam skyel byed 'go tshugs/de rjes ring por mi thogs par khong gi sku mched chung shos lha mo don grub sku 'bum dgon pa'i bla ma chen po zhig gi yang srid yin zhes pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis dbus phyogs kyi bla ma zhig gi yang srid yin par gtam gleng 'dra min sna tshogs byung / mthar 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yang srid 'os sprul yin zhes pa'i gtam bzang de dbyar rnga ltar mdo smad khul du khyab pa red//54

le tshan bzhi pa/ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul mdo smad tsong kha'i yul du ji ltar sku bltams tshul/༄༅༅/ /rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu bya phyi lo 1933 bod zla 10 ches 30nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog dgung grangs lnga bcu nga brgyad la phebs pa'i gong rla'i nang mgul cham lta bus sku khams cung zad rnyog tshul bzhes nas yun de tsam ma song bar gong ches kyi phyi dro'i chu tshod drug pa'i thog spyan gleng pho brang ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil gyi 'dabs 'brel gzim chung 'chi med mchog 'khyil du ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i mdzad pa ltar seng ge nyal stabs tshul gyis sku mya ngan las 'das rjes re zhig bod rgyal khab kyi chos srid 'dzin skyong gi dbu khrid mdzad po rgyal tshab bsko gzhag thad bod gzhung srid blon dang / bka' shag bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms bcas bka' gros snga phyi rim nan gnang ba'i mthar rgyal tshab kyi 'os gzhi'i nang du dga' ldan khri pa las thog mi nyag a mi ye shes dbang ldan dang / rwa sgreng ho thog thu thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ phur lcog 55

sprul sku thub bstan byams pa tshul khrims gsum gyi mtshan shog bris nas rtse pho brang po tā la'i rten gtso 'phags mchog lo ke shu ra'i spyan sngar mchod 'bul rgyas gshom dang 'brel srid blon dang / bka' blon rnam pa/ bod ljongs tshogs 'thus/gnad yod dpon rigs khag bcas lhan 'dzoms pa'i dbus su dga' ldan khri zur tre hor byams pa chos grags mchog nas thugs smon bden tshig gis mtshams sbyar te zan brtag bsgril bar rwa sgreng ho thog thu'i mtshan thon pa ltar bod rgyal khab kyi rgyal tshab tu bsko gzhag gis sngon yod srid blon yab gzhis glang mdun pa kun dga' dbang phyug (khong ni 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku'i tsha bo yin / mchog nas 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i phyag rogs mdzad de srid 'gan lhan du bskyangs/de nas lo gnyis song rjes bod shing phag 1935 lor 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che mchog gis 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yang srid bod ljongs stod smad bar gsum gang du sku bltams yod med skor brtag dpyad gnang bar lha sa'i shar ngos rta thog nyin zhag drug gi sa gnas chos 'khor rgyal dgon pa'i nye 'dabs dpal ldan lha mo'i bla mtsho yod sar phebs te nyin shas ring dpal ldan lha mo'i thugs rje 'phrin las bskul ched bskangs tshogs 'bum ther 'bul gnang dang 'brel thugs smon gsol 'debs nan tan mdzad de mtsho gzigs gnang skabs bla mtsho'i nang nas bod yig dbu can gyi yig 'bru chen po/ a/ ku ma/ zhes dang / de'i rjes tsam la dgon pa thog sa gsum brtsegs yod pa'i bar thog g.yu rtsi can gyi yangs steng gsar dz+ra ngas kyi rgya phebs yod pa/ dgon pa'i shar phyogs nas 'gro lam skya thal ler ri chung zhig gi rtsa bar thug pa/ de'i thad kyi khang pa thog gcig ma thog sngon po byas pa gcig bcas rwa sgreng 7rgyal tshab rin po che dang /56
