ke'u tshang mtshan zhabs rin po che rnam gnyis lhan bzhugs kyis gzigs tshul gcig mthun gsal por gzigs pa rnams skabs de rang du rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan nas bsnyel tho bkod pa gnang zhing/ da dung de bas gsal ba'i mtsho mjal yong ba'i thugs smon gnang skabs la da lta'i 7gong sa yid bzhin nor bu sku bltams sa'i gzim khang de'i khra ma'am sge'u khung nas 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos gzigs nas bzhugs pa zhig rwa sgreng rin po che dang / ke'u tshang rin po che rnam gnyis kyis gzigs pa dang / ke'u tshang rin po che de sngon sku 'bum khul la phebs myong yod stabs khang pa'i rnam dbyibs/ de dag a mdo khul la yin pa ma zad/ a ka ma'i yig 'bru'i don yang sku 'bum nye khul yin pa thugs su rtogs pa byung 'dugarwa sgreng rin po che ston 'khor rnams chos 'khor rgyal nar lha sar phyir phebs rjes bod kyi bla chen khag dang / gzhung bsten dgra lha'i gtso bo gnas chung /dga' gdong / bsam yas tsi'u dmar po sogs bstan srung dam can rnams la 7rgyal ba'i yang srid gang du 'khrungs pa'i lung zhu gnang ba'i phyir phebs tshang mar 7rgyal ba'i yang srid bod shar phyogs su sku bltams yod lugs bka' lung dang /brda rtags gcig mthun du phebs pa ltar yang srid brtsad gcod 'tshol zhib byed po shar phyogs yul gru khag gsum la tshogs chung khag gsum bsko brdzong gnang gtan 'khel te gdan sa 'bras spungs dang / se ra/ dga' ldan bcas kyi bla ma dang /mkhan po drag gras can 'dems bskos kyis shar lho'i phyogs dwags po dang / kong po khul du ser byes phur lcog byams pa rin po dang / shar phyogs mdo stod khams phyogs yas mas yul gru khag la ser byes khang ser rin po che/ mdo smad a mdo 57

khul du mtshan zhabs ser byes ke'u tshang rin po che ngag dbang smon lam bcas gsum la phyag rogs gzhung zhabs ser skya drag gras khag so sor bsko gzhag gis sa gnas khag so sor ched brdzong gnang ste ke'u tshang rin po che'i phyag rogs su zhol gnyer khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dud / phyi lo 1959 lor 7gong sa mchog rgya gar du btsan byol du phebs pa'i rjes tsam du rgya gar du phebs nas btsan byol gzhung gi shes rig bka' blon las rogs dang / rtsom sgrig 'gan 'dzin las rogs bcas kyi 'gan 'khur lo mang gnang ste/ phyi lo 1972 lor sku gshegs / dang / nag chu mkhan po rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin (7rgyal ba'i chung srid 'khrungs yul nas lha ldan rgyal khab tu gdan zhus rjes 7rgyal ba'i sku bcar gzim dpon mkhan po'i 'gan 'khur lo mang gnang ba dang / de rjes sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po'i thugs 'gan lo shas ring gnang ste/ phyi lo 1949 lor sku gshegs / las bya rtse drung blo bzang che dbang bcas ngo las rnams phyi lo 1935lo bod me byi lo rla 9 ches 5 nyin lha sa nas mdo stod skye rgu mdo brgyud mdo smad khul du phebs thon gnang zhing /khong rnams skye rgu mdor ma phebs sngon la kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma mchog skye rgu mdor zhabs 'khod zin par brten khong rnams chab mdo'i mnga' khongs ri bo che sa gnas su nyin shas ngal gso gnang ba'i thog nas paṇa chen rin po che mchog la 7snyan zhu phul rjes skye rgu mdor phebs te phyi lo 1937 lo bod me glang bla 1 ches 1 nyin kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i sku mdun du mjal khar bcar nas 7rgyal tshab rin po che'i snyan rgya dang / rten chas rnams phul/ de'i rjes ke'u tshang rin po ches paṇa chen rin po che'i gzims chung mjal kha'i thog kun gzigs rin po che mchog gi bka'i phebs sgor/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang / / paṇa chen rin po ches 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu 58

gsum pa chen po'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus pa'i mkhan por gyur pa dang / sngags kyi chos skor zhus pa'i rdo rje 'chang zhes mtshan brjod bstod tshig ) gi yang srid mchog sprul rin po che 'khrul bral nges pa rnyed pa zhig ma byung mthu med la brten ngos rang sku 'bum du sdod skabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi sgo nas brtsad gcod zhus par khye'u mtshan ltas bzang ba gsum byung lugs kyi bka' mngags dang 'brel mtshan tho shog lte zhig ke'u tshang rin po che la gnang ba'i thog khong rnams la grogs 'gyur zhu mi che mchog gling sprul sku dang / dngul chu sprul sku rnam gnyis dang lam rgyus su sne shan pa ched brdzong bcas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur yag po gnang yod pa red/ ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las rnams skye rgu mdo nas lam bar rla gsum lhag tsam 'gor te sku 'bum byams pa gling gi nye 'dabs chu nag spang khar phebs 'byor skabs sku 'bum dgon chen gyi bla spyis thab bsu gzab rgyas zhus 'dugaphyi lo 1937 lo bod me glang zla 4 ches 10 nyin sku 'bum byams pa gling dgon chen du phebs 'byor gnang ba'i nyin sprin dpyad legs shing / char sem phran bu babs pa sogs rtags mtshan shin tu bzang po byung ba ma zad/ skya 'bum dgon pa'i bzo dbyibs de bzhin lha mo'i bla mtshor mtsho gzigs la gsal ba ji bzhin dgon pa 'di rang yin pa 'dra dgongs pa ke'u tshang rin po che'i thugs la lhang nger 'char ba dang sbrags spro snang chen po byung nas yang srid mchog sprul rin po che myur du nges rnyed yong rgyu'i thugs re chen po byung 'dug de nyin gong gsal char sprin sogs kyi rtags mtshan shin tu bzang po byung ba'i thog sku 'bum dgon gyi bkod pa rnams 'dren byed kyi yul du mjal ma thag 'di snyam du bsam te/ srid gsum bdag mo'i bla mtshor gsal ba'i dgon pa de phal cher 'di rang yin pa gor 59

ma chag snyam pa'i dga' ba dang / yang srid mchog gi sprul sku myur rnyed ngal ba don ldan gyi skal bzang zhig yong re chen po byung 'dugaskabs der sku 'bum bla spyis ke'u tshang rin po che'i bzhugs yul che shos sgar pa dang / khe smad sras bsod nam sa dbang 'dud a kur sgar pa/ rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin dang / rtse drung blo bzang che dbang gnyis a kyā si sgar pa bcas la go sgrig zhus 'dugade sngon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa zhi dbyings su ma gshegs sngon gyi nyin zhig mtshan zhabs ke'u tshang rin po cher khyed rang rjes ma sku 'bum la phebs skabs che shos sgar par bzhugs na spro po yod/ ngos rang de sngon rgya sog yul du phar phyir bskyo da skabs der bsdad pa yin/ der ha cang skyid po yod ces bka' phebs pa'i skabs der ke'u tshang rin po che'i thugs la/ nga de khul 'gro 'char gang yang med par 7rgyal dbang rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ji yin snyam yang / dgongs skor bka' 'dre gang yang zhu ma nus pa'i ngang dus yun gang tsam song nas de skor thugs brjed gyur 'dug kyang / skabs der sku 'bum du phebs 'byor gyi bzhugs yul che shos sgar par bkod sgrig zhus 'dug par brten de sngon 7rgyal dbang sku gong mas bka' slob ji bstsal skor skabs 'phral thugs la lhang lhang dran te ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi ngo mtshar ha las pa byung lugs thugs 'brel yod rigar la gsung mol byung 'dugake'u tshang rin po che ngo las rnams lam bar sku ngal shin tu chen po byung bar brten nyin shas ring sku ngal gsol ba dang sbrags sku 'bum gyi rten gtso gser sdong rin po che dang / gzhan khag bcas la mchod 'bul dang / de bzhin bla 60

chen khag dang / bla spyi/ las sne gnad yod khag bcas mjal 'phrad kyis bod gzhung nas da lam mtshan zhabs rin po che ngo las rnams sku 'bum yas mas khul 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po mchog gi yang srid brtsad gcod du ched brdzong gnang don ltar de nas gzhogs 'degs dgos rgyu'i bka' rgya dang / gnang cha bcas khungs so sor phul/ — de bzhin skabs der zi ling khul sa gnas dbang 'dzin byed mkhan rma phu'u phang la mthun lam ched du mjal 'phrad la phebs te bod gzhung gi bka' yig dang /rten chas bcas 'bul gnang thog khong rnams 'di khul yong don skor 'grel bshad dang sbra gas mthun 3gyur rogs ram yong ba'i re bskul gnang nas sku 'bum du phyir phebs/re zhig sku 'bum la bzhugs te khul de'i yas mas kyi gnas stangs dang /paṇa chen rin po ches bstsal ba'i 'os sprul khye'u gsum gyi mtshan shog la mngon gsal med pa'i nyams zhib gnang ched ngo las rnams sa phyogs khag bgos kyis ke'u tshang rin po che bya khyung dang / ra khog sku 'bum tsho drug bcas dang / mkhe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud sku 'bum nub brgyud mtsho kha g.yas g.yon 'brog sde mda' bzhi/ 'khyam ru/ rkang tsha khul sogs dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin dang / blo bzang che dbang gnyis sku 'bum byang rgyud dpa' ris/ mchod rten thang dgon dang / zhwa dmar / rta lung / rab rgyas khul bcas la 7rgyal ba'i yang srid rtsad gcod du phebs nas rla gnyis lhag tsam 'gor gshis/ paṇa chen rin po ches bstsal ba'i khye'u gsum gyi mtshan shog nang du gtso bo ni chi kyā tsho pa stag 'cher du sku bltams pa gcig dang / gnyis pa ni paṇa chen rin po che sku 6

'bum du bzhugs ring dus 'khor dbang chen bstsal rjes skya ser mi mang rnams la mjal kha bstsal skabs phyag phreng nas 'jus 'then mdzad mkhan khye'u de dang /gsum pa ni rdi tsha nang so'i bu bcas red/khong rnams skya 'bum du ma phebs sngon tsam la rdi tsha nang so'i bu gshegs tshar bar brten ngo bzhugs gnyis la mngon gsal med pa'i thog nas rtogs zhib ched ke'u tshang rin po ches g.yog po'i gyon chas bzhes pa'i thog 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tā la'i bla ma skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen po mchog gi phyag phreng zhig mgul du bzhes shing / rtse drung blo bzang che dbang dpon po 'am/ 'go gtso yin khul gyis gyon chas gzab spros thog 'khor g.yog 'khrid de glo bur shar tsong ri khrod du gnas mjal du phebs pa yin tshul gyis chi kyā stag 'tshor 'khrungs khang du gnas tshang g.yar te rtse drung blo bzang che dbang gzim chung spug dang/ ke'u tshang rin po che zhabs gras gnyis dang mnyam du thab tshang nang du bzhugs skabs chung srid rin po che mchog nas ke'u tshang rin po che'i sar phebs nas zhal 'dzum dmyal dmul gyis dgyes nyams kyi thog nas sku 'gram du bzhugs pa'i thog ke'u tshang rin po che'i mgul la bzhes pa'i 7rgyal dbang sku gong ma'i phyag phreng la phyag 'chang nas 'di nga la dgos zhes gsungs par/ ke'u tshang rin po ches nga su yin ngo shes na phul chog gsungs pa'i lan du/ se ra'i a ka red ces gsungs pa dang 'brel ma ṇi ma ṇi gsungs/ se ra a ka zhes pa tsong kha'i yul skad du dge 'dun par a ka zhes 'bod/ ke'u tshang rin po ches slar yang sbug tu yod pa de su red zhus par/ rtse drung blo bzang red/ de min g.yog gnyis po de su red ces zhus par/ se ra'i a ka (khong gnyis nas gcig ni/ se ra byes grwa tshang bsam blo khang tshan gyi grwa pa skal bzang 62

dang / cig shos de ke'u tshang dge slong tshul khrims rgyal mtshan / red ces ngo nor phra mo tsam med pa'i bka' lan bstsal gnang la brten ke'u tshang rin po che thugs spro snang dpag med kyi dad gus chen pos thugs yid tshoms pa'i ngang do nub de gar bzhugs zhag gnang ste mdzad spyod gang sar zhib brtag gnang skabs chung srid rin po ches ke'u tshang rin po che'i sku mdun du yang yang phebs bzhugs dgyes nyams dang sku gong ma'i phyag phreng la yang yang gzigs zhib 'ju bzung gnang ba sogs ngo mtshar yid ches chen po byung ba dang / de'i sang zhog khong rnams phebs thon gnang skabs chung srid rin po ches gzim mal nas bzhengs te lhan phebs gnang rtsis kyis bshum pa sogs 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i rnam 'gyur ston pa gnang byung zhes mkhye smad bsod nams dbang 'dud kyis brtsams pa'i 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog thog mar brtsad gcod ngos 'dzin gdan zhus skor rang myong ma bcos bden gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsir gsal/de mtshungs sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mas skabs de'i lo rgyus gsungs rigs su/ de dus 'grul pa ngo ma shes pa 'ga' shas nga tsho'i nang du slebs nas gnas tshang g.yar rogs zhes gsungs te yab yum rnam gnyis kyis gzim chung gtso bo der bzhugs bcug pa red/ skabs der gcung po lha mo don grub (7gongs chen po / dgung lo gnyis tsam yin/ khong gis 'grul pa de rnams la dgyes mnyes chen po'i ngang nas yang yang phebs te ngo shes lta bu gnang zhing / de'i sang nyin snga thog khong rnam phyir thon skabs gcung pos khong rnam lhan du phebs kyi yin zhes nga tshos glags ma 'khel ba lta bu byung / skabs der yab yum rnam gnyis kyis 'grul pa de rnams sku 'bum bla ma che shos rin po che'i yang srid brtsad gcod byed 63

mkhan nam/ yang na bla ma che khag gzhan zhig gi yang srid brtsad gcod byed mkhan zhig yin pa min nam dgongs pa las 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid brtsad gcod zhu mkhan yin pa su zhig gi blo yul la ma byung ba red ces gsungs byung /ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las phyi bya stag 'tshor du phebs pa'i dus mtshungs mkhye smad bsod nams dbang 'dud dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin rnam gnyis kyang 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i phyag phreng gcig bsnams nas de sngon paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag phreng 'ju mkhan rlon pa lo yer gyi tsha bo'i khyim der phebs te gnas g.yar gyis lhod bzhugs thog khyim 'dir khye'u mtshan ltas bzang ba byung yod med bka' 'dre gnang bas de sngon paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag phreng nas 'ju mkhan khye'u ngo mtshar che ba zhig yod lugs bshad de khye'u der na bza' gzab spros kyis khong gnyis sar gdan 'dren zhus byung bar khong gnyis kyis sku gong ma'i phyag phreng bton nas khye'u der 'dir phebs zhes zhus par 'cher snang kho na ma gtogs phyag phreng la do snang gzigs zhib dgyes nyams sogs ngo mtshar yid ches kyi rnam pa gang yang ma byung zhes gong 'khod ltar mkhye smad bsod nams dbang 'dud kyis rang myong ma bcos bden gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsir gsal/de nas khong rnams kyis paṇa chen rin po ches gnang ba'i mtshan shog tu gar la ba'i khye'u gnyis dang / de min sa gnas gzhan khag nas btsal rnyed byung ba khye'u bcu gnyis kyi pha ma sogs kyi ming dang / brjod bab rtags mtshan ji byung gi lo rgyus rnams lha ldan rgyal khab tu gsang tar phul te bdun phrag bzhi'i mtshams bka' lan phyir stsal du chi kyā stag 'cher gyi khye'u yi mdzad tshul ngo mtshar che bar brten nga dung 7rgyal dbang sku phreng gong ma'i sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra'i brtag dpyad zhib 64

nan dgos rgyu'i bka' tar phebs par brten/ ke'u tshang rin po ches gtsos ngo las tshang ma sngar bzhin sku 'bum dgon pa nas glo bur gsang stabs kyis chi kyu stag 'tshor 'khrungs khang du phebs thon skabs dgon pa'i tshogs dung btang ba dang dus 'grigs shing / lam bar zho dang / 'o ma chu snod chab kyis bkang ste 'khyer yong ba bcas rim par thug 'phrad sogs lam bkra shin tu legs pa ma sgrig lhun 'grub tu byung zhes gong bzhin mkhye smad bsod nams dbang 'dud rtsom bris su gsal/khong rnams kyis de sngon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po rgya sog yul gru khag nas bod rgyal khab tu phyir phebs skabs/ phyi lo 1909 bod zla 4 ches 3nyin sku 'bum nas shar tsong ri khrod dang / bya khyung dgon bcas la gnas gzigs la chibs bsgyur skabs stag 'cher 'khrungs khang mdun gyi gzhung lam du phebs te chibs bshol gyis sku ngal gso gnang mdzad thog 'khrungs khyim la zhib gzigs gnang nas de snying rje po 'dug ces bka' gnang ba'i lo rgyus yod pa'i sa gnas su phebs skabs bya khu byug gis skad brgyab pa dang dus mnyam byung zhes de sngon rem bzhi blo bzang che dbang lags dang / phran bza' tsho gnyis bcas rgyal rtse khul 'brong rtse gzhis su rla shas sdod pa'i ring khong gis gsungs byung zhing / mkhe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud kyi brtsams yig tu'ang 'khrungs khyim kyi mdun thang de sngon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po shar tsong ri khrod du gnas gzigs su chibs bsgyur skabs chibs bshol sku ngal gso gnang mdzad de/ 'khrungs khyim la gzigs nas 'di snying rje po 'dug ces bka' gnang ba red zer sa'i yul der slebs skabs lo der dpyid kyis dpal yon mgron du 'gugs pa'i khu byug gi mgrin glu thog ma de rna bar sem zhes gsal /65

7gong sa skya phreng bcu gsum pa'i mdzad rnam las/ sa bya 1909 zla 4 ches 3 nyin ston 'khor hrag bsdus kyis sku 'bum nas bya khyung thub bstan dag ther gling du zhal bsgyur zhing / shar tsong ri khrod du bzhugs zhag thog chos rje kun pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i gdung rten gyis gtsos rten gsum gang bzhugs la mchod 'bul gnas gzigs dang ri khrod pa rnams la mang 'gyed bstsal sogs gsal/stag 'cher khul gyi rgan rabs khag gi ngag rgyun las/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po sku 'bum nas shar tsong ri khrod du gnas gzigs la chibs bsgyur skabs stag 'cher grong gi mdun gyi phebs lam du phebs te chibs pa nas bshol gnang thog phebs lam gyi zur la cung zad sku ngal gso gnang gis shar tsong ri khrod du chibs bsgyur gnang rjes stag 'cher sku gong mas 7rgyal dbang mchog gis skya ngal gnang sa der mchod rten zhig bzhengs pa red ces zer zhing / mchod rten de dus phyis rgya dmar gyi rig gnas gsar brje'i las 'gul skabs rtsa gtor btang 'dug skabs der 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po shar tsong ri khrod nas bya khyung dgon du chibs thon mdzad par zhabs bcag 'ja' chen cha gcig stag 'cher sku gong mar ri khrod de'i rten skal du stsal 'dug pa de dag la gzhigs na rjes su 7rgyal ba'i yang srid stag 'tshor 'khrungs khyim du phebs rgyu'i brda ston mdzad pa zhig yin pa gor ma chagake'u tshang ngo las rnams stag 'tshor 'khrungs khyim du phebs 'byor skabs yab chen phyir phebs kyis bzhugs med kyang / yum gyi khong rnams la sne len gzab rgyas gnang zhing / skabs der chung srid rin po ches khong rnams slar yang phebs 'byor la gzigs te thugs dgyes nyams mdzad cing / khong rnams kyi yum 66

nas gnang ba'i ja dang / skor ril (a mdo bag leb ) bcas bzhes grub mtshams chung srid rin po cher brtag dpyad zhus chog pa zhes yum la bka' 'khrol zhus te gzim chung dkyil la cog tse'i stong du 7gong sa skya gong ma'i sku'i nyer chas ngo ma dang / 'dra ya re re bcas bstar bsgrigs kyi bzhag nas ke'u tshang rin po ches dbus ngo las rnams g.yas g.yon du bzhugs gral la 'khod nas chung srid rin po che gdan zhus kyis 7gong sa sku gong ma'i phyag phreng nag po ngo 'dra gnyis ke'u tshang rin po che'i phyag tu bzhes te gang dgos bka' 'dre zhus gnang bar the tshom med par ngo ma de bzhes nas mgul du bzhes/ de rjes phyag phreng ser po ngo 'dra gnyis spyan bstar zhus par yang gong bzhin ngo ma de bsnams nas mgul du bzhes/ de nas sba'i phyag 'khar ngo 'dra gnyis spyan bstar zhu skabs 'dra de yar tsam 'then gnang song bar khong rnams nas phyag 'khar thugs nor gyur song snyams pa'i dngangs 'tshab kyis lta ba'i ngang phyag 'khar ngo ma ngo 'dra gnyis ma'i rtsa rtser zhib gzigs gnang nas 'dra de rang 'jags gnang thog ngo ma de bzhes nas phyag g.yon gyis bzung ste sar 'dzugs gnang mdzad 'dugaphyag 'khar 'dra de yang de sngon 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos phyag bzhes kyis sgrub khang sku gong mar bstsal ba dang / sgrub khang sku gong mas ke'u tshang rin po cher gnang ba zhig yin 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan mkhyen pa'i brda ston gnang ba yin 'dug ces dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud 'tsho bzhugs skabs kho bor gsungs myong zhing / gong gsal sku'i nyer chas sne kha gsum ngo nor med par ngos 'dzin gnang rjes da dung gsung brda gnang byed ba so'i cang te'u rnga chung gcig dang / de'i 'dra ba so'i ḍa ma ru bcas khong rnams kyis chung srid rin po cher spyan 67

bstar zhu skabs the tshom ka kor med par cang te'u ngo ma de bzhes nas phyag g.yas pas dkrol bar mdzad bzhin par dgyes nyams bzhad mo bzhad de khong rnams la gzigs zhib gnang ba bcas kyi mdzad bzang ngo mtshar smad du byung ba'i thog nas 7rgyal dbang sku gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral yin pa'i khong rnams la yid ches nged rnyed kyis dga' dad spro gsum 'phel te tshang ma'i spyan nas spyan chab nyil nyil dbang med du babs shing / phan tshun gcig gis gcig la smra brjod ma thub par chung srid rin po che'i sku phyur bar chad nyes skyon mi 'byung ba'i gsol 'debs smon lam btabs te ngang tsam bzhugs pa'i ngang nas yab chen yang phyir phebs byung ba tshang mas ngo mjal gyis de nub khong rnams 'khrungs khyim du lhod bzhugs thog de sngon mtshan ltas ngo mtshar che ba ji byung skor yab yum gnyis la bka' 'dre zhus par de tsam ma byung gsung 'dug kyang / gal te de skor gsal po gsungs pa yin na khye'ur bgegs dbang bar chad 'byung rdugs kyis gsang rgya gnang ba zhig red 'dugabla ma rtsa che'i rigs 'khrungs ltas su skabs re rkyen ngan rigs yong gi yod tshod ltar/ de bzhin chung srid rin po che ma 'khrungs sngon khyim gyi rta drel dang /mdzo mo/ ra lug bcas mang po 'chi god byung zhing / chung srid rin po che ma 'khrungs pa'i zla shas gong nas yab chen yun ring bsnyun mnar gyis 'chi gson nges med lta bu'i gnas la thug kyang chung srid rin po che 'khrungs ma thag yab chen gyi snyun gzhi lci po de bzhin 'ja' yal ba lta bur seng dwangs byung zhing / yab chen gzim mal nas yar bzhengs te gzim khang gi rten gtso srung ma dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang mdun du phebs nas mchod me zhig phul ba'i thog khye'u mtshan la lha mo don grub 68

ces mtshan gsol bar mdzad/de sngon 7rgyal yum mchog gi mtshan lam du grwa pa zhig gi mdun du khye lta bu'i brjod nyams can gyi gcan gzan zhig yum gyi mdun la mchongs yong ba dang sbrags dngangs skrag gi ngang nas mnal sad pa zhig dang / chung srid rin po che 'khrungs kha'i yum gyi mnal lam du nub kyi nam mkha' la 'brug chen po zhig 'phur bar gzigs bzhin pa'i ngang 'brug de glo bur yum gyi phyogs su 'phur yong nas de'i sder mo gcig yum gyi phrag dpung du 'chang ba lta bu'i dngangs skrag gis mnal sad pa'i skabs snyun zug kyang phran bu yod pa'i snang ba byung / gang 'tshams shig la khye'u 'khrungs pa dang / de min chung srid rin po che ma 'khrungs sngon yab yum gnyis la mtshan ltas ji snyed byung yang thugs snang gang yang ma byung zhes 7rgyal yum mchog gi zhal snga nas thos/de 'brel 7rgyal ba'i yang srid ma 'khrungs gong tsam la stag 'cher sgar pa'i phyag mdzod ngag dbang byang chub (7rgyal yab kyi gcen po / kyi mnal lam du stag 'cher sgar pa'i sgo ra'i nang du gser gyi mchod rten 'od stong phyogs kun la 'phro ba zhig sa nas skyes pa rmis byung bar skabs der khong gi rang khyim la skyes bu dam pa zhig sku 'khrungs mi yong ngam snyam pa thugs su 'khor yang / 7rgyal ba'i yang srid 'khrungs yong snyam pa blo'i yul la'ang ma byung zhes skya nye khag la gsung gleng byung 'dugayang rgyal yab kyi tsha mo a lcag blo gsal nas brjod don/ 7rgyal ba rin po che dgung lo gnyis gsum tsam phebs skabs rgya mi'i bud med gzigs ma thag 'jigs snang gnang ste lam seng bros phebs nas gab yibs gnang ba dang / bod 69

pa'i pho mo rnams la ngo shes lta bu mdzad/ lhag par dge 'dun pa'i rigs la dgyes mnyes chen po gnang gi yod/ yang srid ngos 'dzin ma gnang gong rtsed rogs mang che ba a lcag blo gsal gyi gcung mo dga' ba g.yang sgron yin zhing / sku rtsod gnang skabs zhal nas mi su zhig gis mi shes pa'i chig mang po gsung gi yod par ma zad phyogs su thon tshul gyi sku rtsod gnang ba de la tshang mas ya mtshan tsam las de tsam gyi do snang byas yong pa ma red ces brjod kyi yod//skabs der ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las rnams stag 'cher nas skya 'bum du phyir phebs khar chung srid rin po che yang khong rnams lhan du phebs rtsis kyis rjes 'phreng gnang bar yab yum sogs kyis dbu bskor zhus kyang khong rnams la gzigs bzhin du bshum pa'i ngang phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i gnas tshul byung 'dugakhong rnams sku 'bum du phyir 'khor rjes paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag phreng las 'ju mkhan chung srid de sku 'bum dgon par phebs bzhugs yod stabs slar yang brtag dpyad du sngar bzhin sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams bsnams nas brtag dpyad zhu skabs khye'u der skya'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams spyan bstar thabs shes rnam pa ci drag zhus kyang thugs 'tshor snang gi rnam pa kho nas ngo 'dra gang la'ang phyag 'chang ba tsam yang byung mi 'dug rjes sor chung srid de bzhin sku 'bum khri chen ke kya'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus yod pa red/khong rnams kyis paṇa chen rin po ches bstsal ba'i mtshan shog nang gsal chung srid ngo bzhugs gnyis la brtags dpyad snga rjes zhus lugs skor gsang rgya dam po gnang ba'i thog lha ldan rgyal khab tu gsang tar dang / rta shad gdong snyan zhu zhib cha phul nas bla shas song rjes rgyal khab nas chi kyā star 'cher gyi chung srid rin po 70

che'i snga phyi'i mdzad tshul la ngo mtshar che ba dang / lhag par 'khrungs khang gi bzo dbyibs sogs 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i mtsho gzigs byung ba dang shin tu mthun pa ma zad/ slar yang bla lha khag gi thugs dam bka' lung sogs tshang ma rtse mthun byung bar brten 7rgyal ba'i yang srid ngo ma chi kyā stag 'cher du yab chos skyong che ring dang / yum bsod nams mtsho mo gnyis la shing phag lo'i 1935 bod rla 5 ches 5 phyi 7 ches 5 nyi shar mtshams sku bltams pa'i khye'u lha mo don grub mchog la thugs gtan gtsang 'khel zin pas 'phral du gdan zhu thub thabs dgos rgyu zhes bka' tar phebs kyang / khong rnams kyis 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thugs gtan 'khel ba'i gnas tshul phyi grags byung che yul de'i dbang 'dzin pa rma phu'u phang gis bod gzhung la dka' ngal bzo rgyu'i go skabs 'tshol rgyur gdon mi za ba dang / de min za rngam ka kor ci che byed rgyur brten ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las rnams 7rgyal ba'i yang srid thugs gtan 'khel skor phyi nang su la'ang tshog zur tsam brjod thal mi 'byung ba byed rgyur mna' dam gnang thog lha ldan rgyal khab la'ang yang srid thugs gtan 'khel ba'i gnas lugs phyi grags gnang che rma phu'u phang nas yang srid mchog sprul rin po che rgyal khab tu shar gtong byed re bral bas 'di gar ngo las rnams mna' dam byas zin pas rgyal khab nas kyang gnas skabs gsang rgya gang che mdzad gal che nges dang / 'di khul rdugs gzhi mi 'byung ched sku 'bum gyi nub byang lho gsum la btsal rnyed byung ba khye'u bcu gnyis dang/ paṇa chen rin po ches bstsal ba'i shog blu nang gsal stag 'cher dang / rlon pa gnyis kyi chung srid rnam gnyis bcas sku 'bum du bsdu bskong yong thabs sa gnas dbang 'dzin rma phu'u phang la zhu bskul gyis brtag dpyad zhu tshul byas rjes stag 'cher chung 7ga

srid 'os sprul khongs su bod dbus su gdan zhu bya rgyu'i skor rgyal khab rang nas mtsho sngon dbang 'dzin rma phu'u phang la bka' tar zhig gnang rgyu dang / 'di nas kyang rma phu'u phang la zhu bskul thabs shes byas na ji 'gab dgongs skor gsang tar zhig 'bul ba gnang 'dugade nas ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las rnams nas rma phu'u phang la 'brel gtugs gnang ba'i thog khye'u gzhan dag bcu gnyis bcas mnyam du gdan zhus kyis cog tse ring po'i steng du 7rgyal ba skya gong ma'i sku'i nyer chas ngo 'dra rnams bstar du bsgrigs yod pa rnams chung srid so so'i pha ma spyan mched gang 'os re dang sbrags rim bzhin gdan zhus kyis spyan bstar zhu skabs 'ga' shas nas ngo 'dra phyed khyer dang / de byings phal cher ngo ma gcig dang 'dra re/ 'ga' shas nas 'dra sha stagare zung nas 'jigs 'cher lta bus ngo 'dra gang la yang reg thug ma mdzad pa sogs byung lugs zhes gtam rna ba'i bdud rtsir gsal /khye'u bcu gnyis la brtags dpyad gnang rjes rma phu'u phang dang sku 'bum bla spyi sogs nas da cha mtsho sngon khongs su 7rgyal ba'i yang srid 'tshol zhib brtag dpyad snga rjes zhus zin par brten khye'u gzhan rnams rang khyim du phyir slog zhus 'dugaskabs der rma phu'u phang gis stag 'tshor chung sred rin po che dang /gzhan 'ga' shas gdan zhus kyis shing tog dang / mngar cha bcas phul skabs chung srid gzhan rnams kyi shing tog dang mngar cha sogs la 'dod rngam gyis sbar mo brgyangs nas len pa sogs byas yod kyang / stag 'cher chung srid rin po che lha mo don grub mchog gis sgam brling ldan pa'i ngang nas mngar cha gcig las ma bzhes 72

pa'i mdzad tshul la kho pa blo mos chen po byung 'dugade rjes tsam la bod gzhung gis 7rgyal ba'i yang srid 'os sprul nges gtan 'khel khongs su lha ldan phyogs su re ba yod pa chung srid gnyis dang / der yod stag 'cher chung srid lha mo don grub bcas lha ldan rgyal khab tu gdan 'dzoms thog bla ltar lung brtag rtsis gsum gyi thog nas gtan 'khel gnang rgyu yin lugs sogs bka' tar phebs 'byor ltar rma phu'u phang dang / sku 'bum bla spyi yab yum sogs la gong gsal skor gsal po zhus par rma phu'u phang gis tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid nges gtan med na rang bzhin 'os sprul zhes don med a mdo'i phru gu sa thag ring por khrid rgyu dge mtshan med lugs sogs ka kor gleng rnyog bshad de dus yun gang 'tsham 'gyangs par brten rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po ches go min tang gzhung gi gtso 'dzin cang ce hri la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 'os sprul dbus su gnyis yod pa dang / gcig mtsho sngon khul du yod kyang rma phu'u phang gis bod du gtong gi mi 'dug pa mchog nyid nas rma phu'u phang la 'phral gtong yod pa dang /'os sprul lha sar 'byor mtshams su 'dir yod 'os sprul rnams dang lhan du brtag dpyad byed kyi yin zhes tar 'phrin zhig gtong gnang mdzad par brten cang ce hri nas lam seng rma phu'u phang la bka' rgya btang 'byor rjes rma phu'u phang gis sngar bzhin ka kor gyis rda yang / /rgyadangul / stong phrag sum brgya tham pa dang / sku 'bum dgon du 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i na bza' khri chas cha tshang gcig dang /gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur cha tshang re bcas dgos lugs bshad par ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las 'u thug thabs zad kyis gong gsal dngul 'bor rnams sprod rgyur khas len thog rim 'bul bya rgyu byed dgos byung 'dug73

lha ldan rgyal khab nas khrung ching du bca' bzhugs bod gzhung sku tshab don gcod khang brgyud rgya nag gzhung la zhu bskul sogs thabs shes rim par mdzad rung nges gsal gang yang med par yun ring 'gor/de rjes slar yang rma phu'u phang la zhabs skul rim nan zhus par 7rgyal ba'i yang srid nges gtan med par gdan zhu ma byas mthu med yin che rang bzhin lam rkyang gtong rgyu sku 'bum sogs dgon pa che chung khag dang / bod sog nang pa'i chos la dad can rnams blo pham gleng ba che ba yong dang yong rgyur de dag 'gog ched slar yang rda yang rgya dngul sgor mo stong phrag gsum brgya tham pa sogs dgos lugs bshad pa'i gnas tshul rgyal khab tu dgongs skor zhu gnang bka' 'khrol bstsal ba ltar skabs der zi ling khul nas rgya gar brgyud me ka zhes par gnas mjal du 'gro mkhan rgya kha che hu'e rigs / rma phu'u phang gi gnyen ltos rma kong wu'u can la dngul brjes kyis gnang 'dugacang ce hri yis lam seng gtong dgos zer ba'i tar btang skabs rma kru'u zhis rda yang sgor mo 'bum gsum byung na lam seng gtong gi yin lab par ke'u tshang rin po ches de nas rgya kha che hu'u hu'u rgya gar brgyud gnas skor 'gro mkhan tsho'i lag nas rda yang sgor mo 'bum gsum gyi tshab lha sa nas gnang rgyu'i zhal dan dngul brjes gnang nas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che gdan zhu thub pa'i lam 'gro byung ba ltar gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og nas yang srid mchog sprul rin po che zi ling nas lha sar gdan zhu thub pa red/sku 'bum nas lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu gtan 'khel gtsang zin gyis nyin gcig ches cha bzang ba dang bstun ke'u tshang rin po che bzhugs yul che shos sgar 74

par 7rgyal mchog 7sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i bzhugs khri sngon yod la brten 'os sprul rin po che stag 'tshor sgar pa nas gdan drangs kyis chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo'i thog na bza' sgron 'bul dang 'brel bzhugs khrir zhabs sor bkod de 7rgyal dbang sku gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral nges rnyed kyi ngos 'dzin yongs grags min pa'i nang ma'i rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo bskyangs/'os sprul rin po che bod dbus su gdan zhu thugs gtan 'khel mtshams rma phu'u phang gis ke'u tshang rin po che ngo las rnams la khyed tsho mi gcig zi ling du sdod dgos zhes yang skyar ka kor brjod pa ltar rgyal khab tu bka' dgongs zhus par mi gcig ma bsdad mthu med yod che rtse drung blo bzang che dbang sdod dgos zhes bka' lan phebs don bzhin las bya rtse drung blo bzang che dbang bzhugs rgyu thugs gtan 'khel don ltar zi ling du mi gta' lta bur ma bzhugs thabs med byung zhing /skabs der blo bzong che dbang la rma phu'u phang gis khyod rang rang dgar sdod ma che bas zi ling du bod kyi don gcod khang gi ming 'khur bya dgos brjod 'dug pa'i lan du de skor phran rang gis thag chod min la ji 'gab rgyal khab tu snyan tar phul chog pa zhes brjod thog don gcod khang gsar 'dzugs mdzad che mi 'gro bsko brdzong yong ba zhes lha ldan rgyal khab tu tar snyan phul ba ltar/ don gcod las byed rtse mgron gnyis bsko gzhag gnang rung / de rjes blo bzang che dbang gis bla brang bkris 'khyil du gnas mjal la bskyod 'thus rma phu'u phang nas bka' 'khrol zhus te bkris 'khyil la bskyod bsdad skabs mdo khams su srid don snyog zing byung ba sogs kyi rkyen pas rma phu'u phang gis do snang che ba rang med pa'i go skabs zin te rta dre'u re zung 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i phebs bsu thon mi dang mnyam du btang thog de rjes 75

blo bzang che dbang rang nyid grwa rgyun gnas skor bar brdzus te ḍa ru dang rkang gling khyer te gsang thabs kyis bod dbus su phyir log bya rgyu yin lugs lha sar gsang tar 'byor 'phral nag chu nas rta khal gdong bsu ched bstsal gyis phyi lo 1940 bod zu dgu pa'i nang lha sar bde phebs thub pa byung 'dugabod sa yos phyi lo 1939 lo'i bod rla 5 ches 1 nyin 7rgyal ba'i mchog sprul rin po che dang / yab yum rnam gnyis/ sku'i gcen po rgya lo don 'grub dang / blo bzang bsam gtan sogs skya 'bum dgon nas bod gangs can rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa lha sa'i phyogs su ke'u tshang ngo las rnams kyis gdan zhus ltar chibs kyi kha lo bskyod cing / sku'i gcen po stag 'cher rin po che thub bstan 'jigs med nor bu mchog dang / sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma / kho bo bcas skya 'bum nas nyin gcig gi sa drel khog ces pa'i 'brog khul bar phebs skyel du bcar nas phyir log byas/7rgyal ba'i mchog sprul rin po che ston 'khor rnams sku 'bum nas chibs thon gyis phebs lam du rla gsum lhag tsam phebs skyod kyis ri klung du ma dang /byang thang / chu chen mang po bcas brgal nas 'dzam gling nang snyan grags can gyi 'bri chu'i stod khul mthu stobs chu khar phebs 'byor skabs phebs bsu dang po lha ldan rgyal khab nas bod gzhung rtse phyag las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin mkhan chung thub bstan thar 'dod dang / bla phyag las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin pa gsar byung sras dbang 'dud rin chen gnyis ched bcar gdong thugs mkho sogs dang / chu sgrol ko ba bzhi bcas 'byor ba ltar chu bo bde blag tu brgal nas nyin shas phebs nas mtsho sngon sa mtshams brgal zin pa'i dus skabs der bod gzhung gis ches cha 76

bzang ba stabs bstun gyis rtse pho brang po tā la'i gzim chung bde ldan 'khyil du bod ljongs bkris tshogs 'du rgyas mdzoms zhes pa tshogs nas mdo smad stag 'cher la 'khrungs pa'i chung srid rin po che 7rgyal mchog skya gong ma'i yang srid mchog sprul gi sprul skur ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel mdzad pa'i dril bsgrags bskyangs/phebs bsu dang por bla phyag las khungs kyi 'gan 'dzin pa sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa /de rjes bod gzhung phyi 'brel las khungs kyi do dam dang / bka' tshab/ phyi lo 1959 lor 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma mchog rgya gar du btsan byol du phebs skabs chibs zhabs su bcar nas btsan byol bod gzhung gi phyi srid bka' blon dang / a ri'i ni'u yog sku tshab don gcod bcas kyis mdzad 'khur gnang yod / mchog dang / rim bzhi rin sgang pa ngo las bcas ched mngags gdong 7rgyal ba'i dbu gyur ser po sogs kyi mtshon thugs mkho khag bcas gtong gnang ltar dwangs la'i shar phyogs khra tshang la brgyab ste 'bum chen zhes pa'i sa gnas ri klung kun la me tog ser chen yongs su bzhad pa'i spang gshongs yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su dbu gur ser po bsgron pa'i nang 7rgyal ba'i bzhugs khri gos zab kyis g.yogs pa'i steng 7rgyal dbang mchog gi sprul sku gdan zhu zhus te zhabs 'khod bstun phebs bsur bcar mkhan bla phyag mkhan chung thub bstan thar pas bod gzhung gi sku tshab zhus te maṇ+ḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul dang sbrags phebs bsur bcar mkhan ngo las rnams nas mjal kha zhus/spyir btang 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma mchog nas lha ldan rgyal sar phyir phebs mdzad skabs bod gzhung nas phebs bsu dang po dang gnyis pa/gsum pa bcas rim gtong gnang srol yod pa dang / phebs lam mi med lung stong dang / 'brog sde'i sa khul sogs 'khel che dbu gur ser po bsgron gyi yod cing / 77

de min paṇa chen rin po che phud pa'i bla dpon su zhig la'ang dbu gur ser po bsgron srol med pa red/ gong gsal skabs der bod gzhung gis mdo smad stag 'cher du 'khrungs pa'i khye'u lha mo don grub 7rgyal dbang sku gong ma'i yang srid 'khrul bral yin par gzhung 'brel ngos 'dzin gtsang ma zhus pa'i skor yin/phebs bsu gnyis par/ bka' blon bon shod rdo rje che brtan nas sne khrid kyis sku bcar gsol dpon dang / gzim dpon drung rtsis sogs ser skya dpon rigs khag dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 'thus/ 7rgyal dbang mchog gi phebs ḍi dang / phebs byam pa 'go byings bcas nag chu'i sa gnas dga' bzhi na mo che zhes par phebs bsu gnyis par bcar/phebs bsu gsum par/ bod kyi 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che mchog nas sne khrid gnang ste gzhung zhabs ser skya khag byang 'dam gzhung gi sa gnas dbu ma bkris thang zhes par phebs bsur phebs pa gnang zhing / de nas bod zla 8 ches 35 nyin lha sa'i nye 'dabs shar phyogs ri rgya bsam gtan gling gi brgyud sgang stod 'dod rgu thang du bod gzhung nas de sngon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa 'khrungs yul dwags po nas lha sar gdan zhu gnang skabs kyi mdzad lam ltar 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po ches sne khrid pa'i bod gzhung bka' shag dang / ser skya dpon rigs yongs rdzogs/ gdan sa gsum gyi bla ma dang / mkhan po las zur/ dge 'dun bcas dang / de bzhin bkras lhun dang / sa skya/ smin gling sogs kyi bla chen dang / lha sa'i ser skya mi mang dang/ phyogs mtha' nas 'dus pa bcas kyi mi mang khri phrag mang pos dad gus spro gsum gyi sgo nas phebs bsu gzab rgyas bla na med pa zhus cing / de bzhin go min tang gi sku tshab khu'u krung shing gis sne khrid pa'i 78

dpon rigs 'ga' shas lha sar 'byor te tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po gser khri'i mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel du bcar yod pa dang / de bzhin dbyin ji dang / bal gzhung / 'brug pa/ 'bras gzhung bcas kyi skya tshab gnad yod mi sna bcas kyang gong mtshungs khri phebs mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel du bcar yod pa red/rjes sor go min tang gi brtsams bris yig cha khag tu phyi lo 1939 zla 12 ches 3 nyin go min tang gzhung gi bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab khru'u krung shing rgya gar brgyud bod du tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin ched du gser bum dkrug 'don dang / blta zhib thog khri ston mdzad sgor gtso 'gan 'khur ched lha sar 'byor nas phyi lo 1940 lo'i rla 2 ches 1 nyen kru'u krung shing gis nor bu gling kha'i mtsho dkyil pho brang du mtsho sngon nas gdan zhu byas pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid lha mo don grub la lta zhib byed skabs khye'u de mkhyen spyod rab tu zab cing / mngon shes shin tu gsal bas/zhib bsher byas rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid yin pa shes pas gser bum dkrug 'don byed mi dgos par lha mo don grub kyis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i las 'gan 'dzin rgyu ched mngags kyi chog mchan 'god rgyu'i bka' phab pa yin/ gzigs skyong thun mong ma yin pa zhig gnang ched go min tang spyi khyab khang gis nor srid las khungs su rgya sgor khri phrag bzhi bcu tham pa sprod dgos pa'i bka' brgyud 'bebs byed dgos zhes bka' phab pa yin zhes bris pa'i skor phyi lo 1940 lo'i che 3 ches 5 nyin go min tang gzhung gis gong gsal gsal bsgrags byas pa'i gnas tshul rnams don dngos dang ma mthun pa'i phyogs 'gal gyi 79

rdzun gtam spel ba zhig yin pa dper na/ skabs der kru'u krung shing gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid rin po che la blta zhib ces pa nor gling skal bzang pho brang du bcar 'thus chog pa'i re 'dun bton kyang / bod gzhung gis blta zhib byed dgos don med lugs zhes khas len ma gnang bas lta zhib bya rgyu'i go skabs tsam ma thob pa red/ mtha' don kru'u krung shing gis mgo bde dran 'phrul gyi g.yo thabs su legs skyes 'bul bar bcar chog pa'i re 'dun nan zhus ltar/phyi lo 1940 lo'i zla na ches 1 nyin nor gling mtsho dkyil pho brang du mjal bcar thog rten 'bul rnams 'bul du bcug yod pa red/lhag par du nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med nas phyi lo 1989 laches 31 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs mi mang tshogs chen thog lo rgyus kyi dpang rtags khungs btsan zhig bton pa'i nang / go min tang gi bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang kru'u krung shing bod du tā la'i bla ma skya phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgor btang ba'i gnad don 'di thad go min tang gis 'khyogs bshad byas pa red/ 1985 lor ngas ched mngags nan cin du phyin te cang su'u zhing chen u yon lhan khang dang / zhing chen srid gzhung la go min tang skabs kyi tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 'tshol zhib ngos 'dzin dang tā la'i bla ma skya phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs skor gyi yig cha blta gi yin zhes zhus par mos mthun gnang don zhib 'jug yig cha de'i khongs su srid skyong rwa sgreng gis mtsho gzigs gnang lugs kyi gnas tshul bod yig ngo bshus yig cha zhig 'dug pa de ni 'bri sa bod shog min par rgya shog red/ ngo bshus yig cha 'di'i nang don ni/ srid skyong rwa sgreng gis 80

bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms hrag bsdus thog gnang ba'i yi ge'i 'dra bshus shig yin zhing / yig gzugs la bltas na/ a mdo khul gyi mis 'dra bshus byas pa 'dra po 'dug go min tang gzhung gis 'dra bshus yig cha 'di nor bur brtsis nas yig tshags las khungs la nyar tshags byas 'dug go min tang gis ngo bshus yig cha de bod gzhung gi tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 'tshol zhib byed lugs skor go min tang gzhung la snyan seng zhus pa'i ma yig ngo mar brtsis 'dug 'on kyang ngo bshus yig cha de ni bod shog thog bris med pa ma zad/tham ga yang brgyab med par spyir btang gi 'dra bshus yig cha zhig red/ de min yig cha ngo ma gnyis yod/ de ni 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dang bka' shag ser 'bras dga' gsum bcas kyis dngos su tham ga brgyab nas bod sog las khungs dang /cang ce hri so sor phul ba'i yig cha de gnyis bod shog spus legs thog bris yod pa ma zad/ srid skyong rgyal tshab dang / bka' shag se 'bras dga' gsum bcas kyi tham ga brgyab 'dug yig cha de gnyis kyi nang don ni/ tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid 'os sprul mtsho sngon sa khul du 'khrungs pa dang / nga tshos yang srid 'os sprul bod du gdan 'dren zhu rtsis skabs rma phu'u phang gis 'gog rkyen dang / rnyog dra mang po bzos rkyen go min tang gzhung gis bod rgya mi rigs dbar gyi 'du shes la dmigs nas rogs ram gnang skyong yod pa zhes 'khod 'dug de min yig tshags nang du 'go brjod dmar po yin pa'i tshags par zhig 'dug pa de'i nang / kru'u krung shing gis tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad 8

sgo byas lugs dang / kho pa mdzad sgor zhugs skabs kyi 'dra par gcig bcas bkod 'dug 'dra par de ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i gzims sbyag tu brgyab pa zhig yin pa dang / 'dra par thog kru'u krung shingagis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi par phul ba'i chu tshod cig 'dug tu la'i bla mas chu tshod de phyag nang nyar nas dgyes tshor chen po gnang ba'i ngang tshul der gzhigs nas kru'u krung shing gis tu la'i bla ma ni spyi dang mi 'dra ba'i spyang po 'dug pas/ gser bum dkrug mi dgos par chog mchan gnang na 'grigs pa'i snyan seng 'byor pa ltar chog mchan bkod pa yin zhes tshags par thog bkod pa dang / kru'u krung shingagis tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgo gtso skyong byas pa zer ba ni 'dra par 'di 'dra zhig la brten nas kru'u krung shing gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas lugs kyi gsar 'gyur bkod pa tsam zhig red/ 'on kyang don dngos thog kru'u krung shing gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas pa'i gnas tshul de rigs byung med/bar lam bod rgya blo mthun 'ga' shas kyis kyang kru'u krung shing gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas lugs kyi gnas tshul bres 'dug pa de ni bod kyi lugs srol cha rgyus rtsa ba nas med pa zhig gis ma gtogs 'bri mi srid/ go min tang gis skyag rdzun bshad pa de ltar nga tsho gung khran tang gis de'i rjes su rgyugs nas mu mthud skyag rdzun shod dgos don ga re yod dam/ngas de skor krung dbyang 'thab phyogs gcig gyur pu'u yi blo mthun cang phing /'thab 82

phyogs gcig gyur pu'u krang gzhon pa / la brjod par khong gis phyin chad nga tshos kru'u krung shing gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas pa red zer ba de shod rgyu med ces gsungs song /yang blo mthun rdo rje che brtan la yig cha gcig rnyed 'dug pa de ni/ bod gzhung gis go min tang la thugs rje che zhu ba'i yi ge'i nang don du/ go min tang gzhung gis kru'u krung shing tu la'i bla ma skya phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phabs mdzad sgor rten 'brel zhu bar gtong gnang mdzad pa de la thugs rje che zhus par go min tang gis yi ge de la brten nas kru'u krung shing gis tu la'i bla ma skya phreng bcu bzhi pa'i khri phebs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas pa red ces bshad 'dug pa des gnad don ga re gsal bshad byed thub kyi red dam/ mdzad sgor zhugs pa dang / gtso skyong / gnyis go don gtan nas mi 'dra/ don dngos thog tu la'i bla ma khri phebs mdzad sgo gnang skabs rgya mis shod lugs ltar gtso skyong gi rnam pa gtan nas med bzhin du kru'u krung shing mdzad sgor zhugs pa de tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa khri phebs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong byas pa red ces u tshugs kyis bshad na skabs de'i gnas tshul dang mthun gyi mi 'dug ces nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis phyi lo 1989 zla 7ches 31 nyin bod rang skyong ljongs kyi skabs lnga pa'i mi dmangs 'thus tshogs kyi tshogs 'du thengs gnyis pa'i thog de sngon go min tang gis bod rgya'i dbar gyi 'brel ba'i lo rgyus la 'khyog bshad rdzun gtam spel ba'i yig cha de rigs la da dung gung khran tang gis kyang de'i rjes su rgyugs te 'dzam gling yongs la 5u tshugs kyis 'ud 83

sgrog byed pa de'i rdzun rkub gsal rjen du brtol ba red/gong smros ltar kru'u krung shing lha sar ma 'byor sngon nas bod gzhung gis tā la'i bla ma skya phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid mchog sprul nges rnyed thugs gtan gtsang 'khel zin yod par brten kru'u krung shing gi 'dra chags chags kyis go min tang gzhung la rdzun chas spros pa zhig las/ blta zhib dang gser khrir mnga' gsol gyi mdzad sgo gtso skyong byed pa sogs kyi dbang cha rtsa ba nas byung yod ma red/klog pa po rnams kyis gong gsal bod kyi 'das pa'i gnas tshul ji byung la zhib tu dpyad na rgya nag go min tang srid gzhung dang / rgya dmar dbang 'dzin pa rnams kyis bod mi dmangs rnams la mgo skor thub tshod dang / 'dzam gling mi dmangs rnams la kha bslu'i srid byus ji ltar lag len bstar ba de gsal rtogs thub pa'i re 'dun zhu gi yod///srid las 'das kyang srid gsum 'gro ba'i slad//mchog sprul mchog gi thugs bskyed mi g.yo bar//ngo mtshar mtshar sdug bye bas mdzes pa'i sku//dpal ldan dpal gyi lha sar zhabs sor 'khod//84

le tshan lnga pa/7gong sa mchog gi 'khrungs gzhis stag 'tshor gyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus/ra༅༅/ /7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gi 'khrungs gzhis mdo smad tsong kha khul stag 'cher gyi chags stangs dang / mes po gong ma rnams kyi 'byung khungs mdor bsdus ni/ stag 'tshor zhes bya ba'i tha snyad de dus snga rabs su yul der nags tshal stug po'i khrod du ri dwags gcan gzan dang / 'dab chags kyi rigs sna tshogs gnas shing /rgyun du gcan gzan stag gi skad 'tshor che bar brten yul de'i tha snyad du stag 'cher zhes su grags/thog mar yul der 'brog sde chags pa dang / rjes su yar rgyas kyis zhing 'brog zung sbrel gyi grong sde chags shing / bar skabs shig nas ri klung thams cad zhing las su gyur ba red ces rgan rabs rnams kyi ngag rgyun lo rgyus su grags/stag 'cher grong sde de sku 'bum byams pa gling dgon gyi chos gzhis tsho drug gi ya gyal chi kyā tsho pa'i khongs su gtogs pa red/rgan rabs rnams kyi ngag rgyun lo rgyus su stag 'cher 'khrungs gzhis kyi sku brgyud mes po rnams kyi 'byung khungs thog ma'i gnas yul de stag 'cher grong sde'i 85

shar ngos thag mi ring ba'i sa mthong ri sde grong zhes (mthong ri sde grong zhes par rgya skad du thu'u ring krong zhes 'bod/ thu'u ring zhes pa yul mi dang krong zhes pa grong gi don yin/ yang na thu'u ring zhes pa sog rigs la'ang zer / gnas yod kyang / gcen gcung gsum gyis sa zhing rgya bskyed ched stag 'cher khul du gnas spos kyis spyan gcig stag 'tshor nye 'dabs bar lung rtsar gzhis chags pa dang / spun gcig stag 'tshor lho'i nye 'dabs bstan 'dzin sgang zhes par gzhis chags nas rjes su de'i mi brgyud chad/'on kyang stag 'cher dang / bar lung rtsa khag gnyis kyi mi brgyud rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung ba'i gras su dus rabs bcu bdun gyi lo rabs bcu gnyis la stag 'tshor sprul sku sku phreng dang po blo bzang rdo rje stag 'cher 'khrungs gzhis 'dir 'khrungs shing /de rjes stag 'cher 'khrungs gzhis 'di gong 'og gnyis su gyes te 'khrungs gzhis 'di stag 'cher 'og mar grags/ de rjes stag 'tshor sprul sku sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho dang / sku phreng bdun pa da lta 'tsho bzhugs thub bstan 'jigs med nor bu bcas rim bzhin 'khrungs gzhis 'dir 'khrungs 'dugastag 'tshor sprul sku sku phreng drug pa blo bzang 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i yab sgrol ma skyabs dang / yum skal bzang skyid rnam gnyis la rigs sras gnyis dang /sras mo gcig bcas byung ste sras bgres pa stag 'cher sprul sku de yin pa dang / de 'og sras mo gcig dang / sras gcig yod khongs nas sras mo bgres pa yin stabs yul goms gshis lugs la sras mos khyim gzhis 'dzin skyong bya srol ltar stag 'tshor grong sde de ga'i khongs bkris ba zhes pa'i khyim gyi rigs sras chi kyā skyabs zhes pa mag par bsus/ de rjes ming sring gnyis kyis khyim 'di khag gnyis su bgos te stag 'cher gyi khyim gzhis phyi nang gnyis su grags/ sras mo'i khyim 86

'dir stag 'cher phyi mar 'bod/ khong la sras gnyis dang / sras mo gnyis 'khrungs pa'i sras bgres pa de chung dus nas rab tu byung zhing / stag 'tshor sku gong ma'i zhabs phyi zhus te phyis su stag 'cher sgar pa'i phyag mdzod ngag dbang byang chub ces pa de yin/ rigs sras chung ba de 7gong sa 7rgyal dbang mchog gi yab chos skyong che ring yin/ de min sras mo gnyis 'khrungs yod pa sras mo bgres pa stag 'cher nye 'dabs zur kyā sde grong du mna' mar phebs/ sras mo chung ba de stag 'tshor grong sde khang gsar khyim du mna' mar phebs/gong gsal stag 'cher khyim nang ma'i sras de la rigs sras gsum dang /sras mo gnyis byung 'dug sras bgres pa che ring don grub /yab gzhis a khu lags yin / de 'og sras gnyis chung dus nas rab tu byung / sras mo gnyis gzhan du mna' mar btang / 7rgyal yab chos skyong che ring dgung lo bco brgyad tsam la phebs skabs sku 'bum nye 'dabs chu ru kha'i sde grong gi khyim tshang ya rabs spyod bzang can kyi rigs brgyud yab nyi ma che ring dang / yum sgrol ma mtsho gnyis kyi sras mo bgres pa (7gong sa 7rgyal dbang mchog gi yum / bsod nams mtsho mo mna' mar bsus nas lo gcig tsam gyi rjes su sras mo zhig 'khrungs shing /sras mo de ma 'khrungs sngon la stag 'tshor sprul sku sku phreng drug pa dgongs pa rdzogs par brten 7rgyal yab chos skyong che ring gi yum gyis mna' mar sras shig 'khrungs rgyu'i thugs re chen po yod 'dug kyang / rjes su sras mo zhig 'khrungs pa der thugs pham gnang 'dug sras mo de skya'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma yin/ de nas lo gnyis rjes sras shig 'khrungs pa da lta'i stag 'tshor sprul sku thub bstan 'jigs med nor bu yin/ de nas rim bzhin sras gnyis 'khrungs kyang chung dus nas skya 87

gshegs/ de rjes sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang / blo bzang bsam gtan/de nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon tu la'i bla ma sku bltams pa red/ de mjug sras mo zhig 'khrungs yod kyang sku chung dus nas gshegs/7gong sa chen po mchog sku 'khor dang bcas lha ldan rgyal khab tu zhabs sor 'khod rjes 7rgyal yum mchog la sras mo rje btsun pad+ma 'khrungs / de rjes sras bstan 'dzin chos grags 'khrungs te sku chung dus nas gshegs/ de 'og sras shig 'khrungs pa sku'i gcung po mnga' ris sprul sku bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sras sros nang gi tha chung de yin/7rgyal yab chos skyong che ring lcags byi 1900 lor 'khrungs shing /khong ni thugs bag yang po dang / drang tshugs che la/ snying rje yang che/ stag 'cher sde grong yas mas kyi skye bo rnams dang mthun zhing / skabs re sku rlung drag po bzhengs na'ang dus yun khyag tsam las mi gnas/ rgyun du rta drel la mnyes po yod pa sogs 7gong sa mchog gis nga'i pha dus rgyun du khyim mches rnams dang 'brel mthun chen po yod pa ma zad/ stag 'tsher grong sde khag tu gnas pa'i ngo shes rnams kyis khong la dga' gus zhu gi yod pa dang / byams snying rje legs po yod mkhan zhig yin/ rlung lang po dang grung po zhig kyang red/ lhag par rta la dga' po yod stabs rta drel mang po bzhon gyi red/ de bzhin rta drel 'dems sgrug la mkhas shing / bcos thabs la'ang mkhas po yod ces gsungs pa ltar yin no/rgya mar gyi 'grems spel byas pa'i bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/ 'don thengs dang po'i shog grangs 335 nas 337bcas la khreng zhi krang gis lha sa'i spyi tshogs thog gi go bab mtho shos ni rgyal yab 88

yin zhing / khong la rgya rigs kyi ming zhig yod pa ste dzi'i tsha'i lang zer zhes 'khod 'dug de ni kho pas bod ming gi sgra dag po ma shes pa bzhin du long bas glang chen gyi sna la byil byil byas pa tshod dpag kyis brjod pa'i dpe ltar red/rgyal yab kyi mtshan ni chos skyong che ring yin pa yongs grags yin zhing /mdo smad pa tshos chos skyong che ring gi skyong zhes pa tshig 'bru dor nas chos che rang zhes 'bod srol yod/ yang rgya mis chi chog che ring yang 'bod kyi yod/chi zhes pa'i ming tshig 'di chi kyā nang sos stag 'cher sku gong ma'i yab tshang la dmigs bsal gyi sprad pa'i khong gi rus ming lta bu zhig yin no/da dung khreng zhi krang gis rgyal yab kyis rtag tu nga ni krung dbyang nas yong ba zhig yin gsung gi yod stabs stag brag gis khong la rdugs pa chen po byed kyi yod ces bshad 'dug de ni nam mkhar mi shong ba'i rdzun gtam chen po zhig red/skabs der krung dbyang zer ba'i go min tang dbus gzhung gnas yul ni rgya nag nan cing yin zhing rgyal yab chen po ni mdo smad tsong kha yul nas lha sar phebs pa zhig yin pa las rgya nag nan cing nas phebs pa zhig ma yin no/yang kho pas shog grangs 353 nang hreng tsung le'ang /go min tang lha sar bca' sdod sku tshab / dang yab gzhis nang mi gros byas nas rgya lo don grub nan cing du slob sbyong byed par gtong rgyu byas te yab gzhis bu mo'i mag pa hong go kreng /phun tshogs bkra shis / rgya lo don grub kyi rogs su btang ste gsang ba'i sgo nas sngon la hin rdur phyin te de gar hreng tsung le'ang sgug sdod kyis mnyam du nan cing la 'gro rgyu byas/hreng tsung le'ang gis don de jus 'god byed skabs ha cang gsang ba'i sgo nas byas pa zhig red/ ces rgyus mnga' che mdog gi bshad pa de yang rdzun gtam 'ba' zhig 89

red/ gang yin zer na/ sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang phran gnyis rgya nag tu slob sbyong la bskyod pa'i yong rkyen skor phran nas sba gsang med pa le tshan bcu gnyis pa'i nang gsal po bris yod/ de min kho pas yab gzhis bu mo'i mag pas rgya mi'i ming la hong go kreng / zer zhes ha las pa zhig bshad 'dug de yong rkyen ni dus rabs bcu drug pa nas bzung ming dang / de rjes man ju dus rabs bcas su bod kyi byang shar tsong kha dang / dpa' ris/ co ni/ rgyal rong / rnga ba'i smad phyogs/ dar mdo bcas kyi bod mi yul dpon rnams la rgya'i goms gshis ltar ming gong ma 'am/ man ju gong ma/ rgya dpon bcas kyis rus ming ched mngags btags 'dugadape zhig brjod na co ne dpon gyi rus ming la dbyang zhes btags yod tsang da lta'i dpon gyi ming la'ang dbyang hri ce zhes zer ba sogs byung ba ltar mtha' mtshams bod mi'i khrod du'ang rim bzhin rus ming btags rgyu srol dar ba red/nga'i a khu chung dus nas chi kyā nang so'i sku srung du bzhugs skabs khong la hong tsung kon zhes ming btags/ lhag par go min tang gi dus su bod phrug rnams slob grwar zhugs na dge rgan gyis rgya skad kyi ming zhig nges par 'dogs kyi yod/ de ltar ma byas na slob grwar tshud thabs bral/ ngos kyi rgya skad ming 'di yang gong bzhin dge rgan gyis btags pa zhig yin/ da ni dkyus su 'jug par bya ste/7rgyal yam chen mo bsod nams mtsho mo mchog ni lcags glang phyi lo 1901 lor sku 'bum dgon pa'i nye 'dabs chu ru kha sde pa'i khyim tshang du 'khrungs shing / khong la skya mched sras gnyis dang / sras mo bzhi yod pa'i khongs bgres shos deyin/90

7rgyal yum dam pa de ni/ sku chung dus nas byis pa phal pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba thugs gshis shin tu bzang zhing dul ba/ sgam tshugs dang snying rje che ba/ya rabs spyod bzang gi sgo nas gzhan phan kho na'i thog rang gi yab yum gnyis la gus brtse che ba dang / sku mched rnams la mdza' zhing brtse ba/ de bzhin rgan rabs la gus pa/ rtsod grogs rnams la'ang mdza' zhing mthun pa/ dgung lo bcu bdun la phebs pa na stag 'tshor sde grong du stag 'cher sku gong ma'i tsha bo chos skyong che ring mchog gi nga/jig rten mthun 'jug gi bag mar phebs nas sku che'i yab yum gnyis la gus brtse dang ldan pa'i bsnyen bkur bag yod tshul bzhin du mdzad pa ma zad/ gzim khang gi phyi nang mtha' dag gi phyag las gnang sgor thugs 'gan lhur bzhes tshags tshud legs po yod pa/ lhag par sku rla mchog la mdza' brtse gus gsum gyi sgo nas 'grogs 'dris thugs mthun ha cang legs shing / yul lugs kyi gsol zas g.yos sbyor la shin tu mkhas stabs ro bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i zas rigs kyis stag 'cher sku 'khor tshang mar rgyun gtan 'tsho skyong legs thog khul de'i khyim mches zhib 'dris yod med la ma ltos par mi rigs gzhan su 'dra zhig khyim du slebs kyang rigs rus mchog dman dbyer med kyis kun snyoms thugs brtse'i ngang nas sne len gzab skyong gnang ba sogs mdor na gangs can zhing mgon 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i sgyu 'phrul gang sprul der ston gyis sdom brtson ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i rnam rol bdag cag gzhis byes bod 'bangs rnams kyi srid zhi'i 'jigs skyobs bla na med pa 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang tu la'i bla ma mchog gis dbus skyes 'phags sprul skya gsum gyi yum du gyur ba'i phul byung las smon dang / thugs gshis mdzad bzang gi dpal yon mtha' dag ngang gis bya

tshang ste mchog dman skye bo kun gyis bsngags brjod kyi me tog sna tshogs 'thor ba'i yul du gyur pa zhig yod/7rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po che ma 'khrungs sngon 'khrungs gzhis kyi 'byor pa'i gnas stangs ni stag 'cher sde grong nang drag gras shig yin gshis sa khang gi rgya khyen yang phal cher e kur nyi shu lhag tsam yod/ dus rgyun g.yog re gnyis gtan ltar thog dpyod mos dang/ ston dus zhing las skabs las mi pho mo bcu lhag tsam gla dgos pa dang / de bzhin rgyun du rta drel legs pa lnga drug dang / mdzo dang mdzo mo drug bdun/ ra lug brgya skor bcas yod pa red/stag 'cher sde grong de brag dmar po'i steng du gnas yod/ de'i mdun du nags tshal rgya khyon chen po rang min pa zhig yal 'dab phang phung rgyas pa/ nags tshal gyi thod du lam chen zhig yod pa'i 'dab 'phreng du stag 'cher sde grong la kha phyogs pa'i mchod rten thog brtsegs gnyis tsam zhig yod pa'i brjed nyams ldan par 'gying nger gnas yod/ de'i lho ngos thag mi ring ba'i sar tsong kha skyes ri mthon po rngams nyams su gnas/ ri gsham du nags tshal phun sum tshogs pas mdzes shing / nags tshal de'i dkyil du kurma shar tsong ri khyod rten dang rten pa byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba yod/gong smros ltar stag 'cher sde grong gi 'khor yug ri klung thams cad rang byung spang ba/shongs thog zhing 'brog zung sbrel gyi sa khul zhig red/ 'khrungs khang de stag 'tshor sde grong gi dkyil tsam gyi sa 'bur 'bur gyi stong du chags pa dang /'khrungs khang gi gzhung sgo shar lhor gtad yod pa dang / rgyal sgo'i steng du dar shing thung tsam zhig btsugs pa'i rtser shing brkos kyi nyi rla skar gsum brgyan pa/ dar 92

shing de rigs a mdo'i yul gru kun gyi bod mi drag zhan tshang mas 'dzugs srol yod/ 'khrungs khang gi sgo ra phyi nang gnyis kyi phyi'i dbus dkyil der rdo gcal dang/de'i dbus su yul srol ltar mi tshang drag gas rnams kyis dar shing chen po zhig 'dzugs srol ltar btsugs yod/ 'khrungs khang gi lcags ri'i kha bad g.yu rtsi'i rdza g.yam gyis bkab yod pa'i de ni thog mar 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin pho ches lha mo'i bla mtsho'i nang nas gzigs pa'i khang pa thog gcig ma kha bad kyi rdza g.yam g.yu rtsi btang ba de yin/ 'khrungs khang gi gzhung sgo'i g.yas ngos zur gsol thab dang /byang ngos gzim chung g.yas g.yon gnyis yod/ gzim chung gnyis kyi dbar bar 'khyams chung tsam zhig yod pa dang / nub ngos la gong bzhin gzim chung gnyis yod/ gzhung sgo'i g.yon zur la khyim tshang dang / g.yas su rta ra/ nub tu mdzo ra/ nub kyi sgo ra'i lho ngos su ra lug gi lhas dang / byang ngos su rtsa khang dang /so nam yo chas khag 'jog khang / 'bru khang bcas yod/stag 'cher 'khrungs khang 'di 7rgyal dbang chung srid rin po che lha ldan rgyal khab tu chibs bsgyur mdzad rjes rgyal yab mchog gis phyi lo 1945 lor a khu lags che ring don grub lha sa nas stag 'cher 'khrungs gzhis su ched brdzong gis 'khrungs khang sngon yod de dag rtsa bshig gis 'khrungs khang rgya che spras legs shig gsar bskrun gnang ba red/phyi lo 1954 lor 7gong sa mchog rgya nag tu chibs bsgyur zhor sku 'bum byams pa gling dgon chen dang / shar tsong ri khrod la gnas gzigs su chibs bsgyur skabs stag 'cher 'khrungs gzhis su ched du zhabs sor bkod nas zhag gcig bzhugs zhag mdzad yod/ rjes su rig gnas gsar brje'i dus zing skabs 'khrungs khang de rtsa gtor btang ba dang / phyi lo 1979 lo'i sngon tsam rgya 93

gzhung gis rtsa gtor btang ba'i 'khrungs khang de slar yang sngar bzhin gsar bskrun byas 'dug gsham bkod stag 'cher 'khrungs khang gi sa khra 'di bzhin phyi lo 1945 lo'i gong du yod pa'i 'khrungs khang gi bkod dbyibs rang gi dran lam ltar bkod pa lags so//94

le tshan drug pa/so nam pa phal pa'i bu phrug glo bur mi drag gi sras su gyur ba/dbe༅/ /phyi lo 1939 lo de'i rla ba bcu gcig pa tsam la mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi spyi khyab rma phu'u phang gi yig tshang nas stag 'cher rin po che'i gcen mo dang /khong gi rla bo gnyis ring min bod dbus nas bsu len byed par yong rgyu red 'dug pas phyi lo thon rgyu'i gra sgrig byed dgos zhes dang / gra sgrigs dmag gi sgrig gzhi nas rtsa dgongs sprod rgyur khungs su bka' khyab gnang yod ces yi ge 'byor/ de ni rgyal yab chen mos khong la tar 'phrin zhig gnang yod lugs go thos byung /gnas tshul de dag nga'i pha ma dang / dga' nye tshos thos skabs dga' skyo zung 'brel zhig byung / de nas mi ring bar lha sa nas sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma'i yab yum rnam gnyis kyis gtong gnang ba'i a ne lags kyi sku zla a khu lags dang / 'khor g.yog 'ga' shas bcas nged gnyis bsu len du 'byor/ kho tsho'i mdun la nga gnyis kyi lam bar mkho byed dang / gyon gos bcas mang po bskur gnang mdzad 'dug rang nyid kyi bsam blor dga' snang chen po byung yang / bsam blo zhib tu gtong dus rang nyid kyi pha ma gnyis bzhag nas sa thag ring por 'gro rgyur blo mi bde ba dang / sems khral yang byung / lhag par nga'i pha ma gnyis la bu nga 95

gcig pu las med pas kho gnyis la thugs khral dang sku ngal chen po yong nges yin par snyam/ tha ma khong gnyis kyis nged bza' tsho gnyis mnyam du 'gro rgyur thag gcod gnang /sngar lugs ltar sku 'bum nas lha sa bar phan tshun 'gro 'ong gi nam dus ni dbyar dus dang / dgun dus gnyis yod/ spyir btang tshong pa rnams dbyar dus rla ba drug pa'i nang rta drel mang po ded nas mdo smad khul gyi thon khungs dang /rgya zog bcas khyer te zu ba gsum lhag gi lam 'grul byas te lha sar 'byor ma thag rta drel dang zog rnams phyir tshong gi lha sa nas snam bu dang / rgya gar gyi tshong zog nyos nas dgun dus g.yag thog bskal te lam bar rla ba bzhi lnga tsam 'gor gyi yod/sku 'bum khul du 'byor rjes tshong zog rnams btsong nas lam seng rta drel nyos te gong bzhin dus thog tu phyir log bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ skabs re tshong pa mi grangs nyi shu sum cwa yod stabs rta drel ha lam stong phrag tsam ded 'gro zhing / de bzhin za chas dang mkho byed 'grel khal g.yag dang / lam bar gyi sha za rgyur lug mang po bcas ded nas rim bzhin bed spyod byed/ nag chu khar ma slebs gong nas lug phal cher bsad tshar gyi 'dug tshong 'grul de rnams kyi 'go pa ni lo mang po'i sngon nas bod gzhung gis bskos pa'i zi ling sgar dpon zhes pa de yin/ der gzhung gnas nas las tshan gnas rim drug pa'i go gnas dang / thob thang bstsal yod//phyi lo 1940 lo'i zu ba 5 pa'i nang skya'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma nged gnyis lha sar thon rgyu'i gra sgrig rnams a khu lags kyi bka' bkod 'og go sgrig byas te sku 'bum nas lha sa'i phyogs su thon/ skabs der a khu lags kyis rta 96

drel bsdoms lnga bcu lhag tsam nyos 'dug de rnams la rta rtog byed mkhan lag do zhes mi bcu tsam dang / tshong zog dang bza' chas 'gel khal g.yag lnga bcu tsam sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma nged gnyis ma gtogs tshang mar me mda' ring thung re dang / mde'u brgya lhag tsam sked par dkris nas 'khyer yod pa ni lam bar jag rkun 'phrad nyen gyi 'gog srung yin/ skabs re tshong 'grul 'ga' shas la jag pa 'phrad nas rta drel dang / dngos zog bcas 'phrog pa'i gnas tshul byung myong ba red/ de bzhin rla ba gsum lhag tsam 'grul bzhud byed dgos par brten lam par bza' chas dang gyon chas bcas sngon tshud nas gra sgrig yag po byed dgos/a khu lags kyi 'go 'khrid 'og nga tsho skya 'bum nas rdog thon byed skabs nga'i pha ma dang / 'ga' nye tshang mas skyel mar phebs byung bas phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa'i skyo lhang nge ba zhig byung / de nyin nga tsho chu tshod gsum 'grul bzhud byas te 'brog sde'i sa khul zhig tu 'byor/ de'i sang nyin nga tsho mtsho sngon po'i 'gram lho rgyud nas nub phyogs su thad kur bskyod de nyin bcu tsam 'grul bzhud byas rjes tshwa 'dam sa khul du slebs/ tshu 'dam sa khul de'i klung la sdod mkhan tshang ma sog po dang /g.yas g.yon ri khul du sdod mkhan rnams bod mi yin/ de nas tshong pa rnams kyis sog po'i sa nas lam bar gyi sha za rgyu'i lug mang po nyos nas slar yang nub phyogs su kha gtad nas 'grul bzhud byas/nyin lnga drug tsam 'grul bzhud byas nas rtsa chu legs sar nyin zhag re gnyis bca' zhag byas/ tshwa 'dam nas rla gnyis lhag tsam bskyod de lung chung skyid po zhes pa'i gnas su 'byor nas 'grul pa tshang ma sa cha der nyin shas ngal gso byas/ sa cha de ni rtsa chu bzang po yod pa zhig yin pas de sngon bod gzhung gi so 97

dmag dbur dus der sdod kyi yod 'dug tsha 'dam nas lung chung skyid po bar mtha' yas pa'i mi med lung stong dang / shing nags med pa'i ri sha stag yin kyang /dom dang spyang ki sogs gcan gzan gyi rigs dang / rkyang dang 'brong sogs ri dwags mang po khyu dang khyu byas te ri klung gang sar rang dbang dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gnas bzhin 'dug pa de tshos mi la zhed snang de tsam byed kyi mi 'dug 'on kyang skabs re snying rje med pa'i mis ri dwags gsod mkhan yang nyung shas yod tshod 'dugang tsho lung chung skyid por ma 'byor gong gi zhag sa der slebs nas rta drel rnams rtsa zar btang ba dang / mi rnams kyis gur phub nas ngal gso rgyag skabs nub phyogs sa thag ring po nas rta pa bzhi tsam nga tsho'i phyogs su thad kur rgyugs yong bar mi rnams kyis 'di dag jag pa min nam snyam ste me mda' 'khyer te rang rang so so'i gur gyi nye 'gram na kha spo thor yibs te ma byung sngon 'gog gi thugs zon byas nas bsdad/ rta pa bzhi po thag nyer 'byor mtshams tshur mjal dar dkar po g.yugs pa dang / skad brgyab pa'i tshig don du/ nga tsho ni bod gzhung gi so dmag yin pa dang / bod gzhung gi bka' mngags ltar 7rgyal ba rin po che'i sku'i gcen mo dang sku 'khor rnams kyi phebs bsur bcar ba yin/ khong rnam pa khyed tsho mnyam du phebs yod dam zhes dris byung / tshang mas skad de thos ma thag dga' snang chen po dang / blo bde po byung / 'ga' shas kyi mi de tsho yong sar rgyugs nas 'tshams zhu byas pa dang / re gnyis kyis khong tsho mnyam du 'thams res byas/rang nyid nas de sngon goms gshis de 'dra mthong ma myong stabs ha cang ya mtshan po byung / so dmag bzhi po nga tsho sdod sar ma slebs tsam nas rta las babs te a khu lags kyi bzhugs gur nang du bcar nas yong rkyen zhib phra snyan seng zhus rjes a khu 98

lags dang so dmag bzhi po nga gnyis bza' tsho gnyis kyi gur nang phebs nas 'tshams 'dri gnang / so dmag bzhi yis brjod gsal lha sa nas 7rgyal ba rin po che'i yab gzhis kyi khyed rnams bsu len du tshong dpon rta'u khra san zhes pa dang 'khor g.yog bzhi bcas nyin lam gsum gyi sar phebs sgug zhu gi yod lugs dang /kho rang bzhi po de bod gzhung nag chu rdzong gi sa srung ba yin zhing / gong gsal phebs bsu 'byor ba'i ljags lan 'bul bar rdzong nas gtong gnang bzhin bcar ba yin zhes zer ba ltar nga tsho tshang mas gtam bzang de thos ma thag dga' spro chen po byung ba dang / lhag par sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma ni brjod kyis mi langs pa'i dgyes tshor chen po gnang gi 'dugaskya 'bum nas lha sa bar tshong 'grul nang khul gyi gleng rnyog thag gcod dang /nyen re'i sdod sa'i bkod sgrig bcas zi ling sgar dpon gyis byed dgos shing / zi ling sgar dpon gyi nyin ltar 'khor g.yog re gnyis 'khrid nas dgong dro sgar babs sa der sngon la lta bar 'gro gi yod/ sgar sa gtan 'khel rjes khong rang dkyil du sdod pa dang / khong rang gi gur gyi 'gram du dgra lha'i snang brnyan gyi ri mo bkod pa'i mdung dar zhig btsugs pa dang 'grul pa rnams khong gi mtha' skor du sdod pa las gang byung bsdad mi chogang tsho lung chung skyed por zhag gsum bsdad rjes dngas la phyogs su thon pa'i nyin gnyis par nga tsho bsu len du yong ba'i tshong dpon rta'u khra san ngo g.yog bcas thug 'phrad byung / khong gi mdun la sku'i gcen mo nged gnyis la gos chen gyi na bza' dang / zhal tog sna tshogs/ spags tshag bcas bskur gnang mdzad 'dug99

de nas nga tsho rim bzhin dngas la brgyud nag chu khar thon/ nag chu sa khul la ma slebs tsam gyi nyin phyed kyi sar nag chu rdzong gis phebs bsu'i 'tshams zhu mjal dar 'bul len byas/ tshong dpon rta'u khra san dang mnyam du nag chur sngon nas phebs sgrig zhus pa'i khang pa'i nang nyin shas bsdad/nag chu kha zhes pa'i sa gnas de bod gzhung gi byang shar phyogs kyi rgyal sgo lta bu'i sa cha gnad chen zhig yin/ lha sa nas rta pa'i tshugs zhag brgyad dag tsam las med rung / sa cha de sa mtho'i 'brog sa legs pa zhig yin pas de'i ri klung thams cad la phyugs rigs dkar nag gis khengs nas 'dug nga tsho nag chu khar nyin gsum ngal gso byas nas rta drel dang / lag do rnams tshong rigs gzhan dang mnyam du dal bur yong rgyur mngags nas nga tsho ngo g.yog hrag bsdus lha sar sngon du thon/ lam bar nyin lnga tsam 'gor song yang rnam kun rta bzang po zhig gzhon rgyu yod na nyin gsum bzhi tsam la slebs kyi yod par grags/lha sar ma slebs gong gi nyin sngon mar 'phan po sgo la'i rgyab kyi grong gseb nang du zhag gcig bsdad/ nga tsho grong gseb der ma 'byor gong lha sa nas mi gnyis 'byor te sang nyin la phar nang gi la gsham du sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog phebs bsur phebs kyi yod lugs kyi brda lan 'byor/ de'i sang nyi shar mtshams su nga tsho 'phan po sgo la'i rtse ru slebs nas tshang ma rta las babs te lo mang po'i sngon nas mjal 'dod chen po yod pa'i snyan grags can gyi rgyal sa lha sa dang / rtse po ta la pho brang chen po bcas mdun du gsal lham mer mjal ba dang / tshang ma rang dbang med pa'i dad pa'i spra long g.yo bzhin par phyag gsum btsal nas smon lam brgyabs/400

nga rang chung dus su de sngon lha sar phebs myong ba'i dge 'dun tsho pha yul nas lha sar bskyod skabs dang po 'phan po sgo la'i rtse nas lha sa gtsug lag khang dang /rtse pho brang bcas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas chen de tsho mjal ma thag phyag 'tshal ba dang / smon lam rgyag rgyu byung na ma 'ongs pa'i bya ba thams cad lam 'gro 'ong ba ma zad/ smon lam de yang 'grub kyi yod ces sgrung gtam lta bur gsungs pa de yid la lhang nger dran/nga tsho la gsham dog sde'i phu'i grong sde zhig gi nye 'gram du 'byor skabs lha sa nas sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog gi zhabs phyi lnga drug tsam khrid de nga tsho sgyag nas bzhugs 'dug de nas phan tshun 'tshams 'dre zhus shing mi tshang de'i nang gsol ja bzhes 'bras btegs/〉 de nas yab yum gnyis kyis nged gnyis la gos chen gyi na bza' sogs bskur gnang ba ltar gyon chas tshang ma gsar brje byas/de nas bzung so nam pa phal pa'i bu phrug de glo bur mi drag gi gras su gyur/khong tshos sha shed legs pa'i chibs pa 'ga' shas khrid gnang mdzad 'dug pa de tsho nga tsho'i bzhon rta dang brjes nas rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta mchog lcag gis bskul te nor gling pho brang gi gzim sgo'i 'gag tu 'byor/ chibs pa de rnams ni 7gong sa mchog gi chibs ra nas g.yar po zhus pa red 'dug rnam kun chibs pa de rnams las med du gso gi yod stabs sha shed shin tu legs po 'dug pa de tsho mang che ba mdo smad khul nas bsgrubs pa'i zing rta yin/dbus phyogs su mdo smad kyi rta de legs shos su brtsi gi yod par brten mdo smad rta yi chol khar grags pa de yang rgyu mtshan de rang yin par snyam/ dog sde phu nas nor gling gzhung sgo'i bar me le bdun tsam yod/ lam bar 'phrad pa'i mi 40

tshos snam bu nag po'i phyu pa gyon pa dang / dkar po gyon mkhan yang re zung 'dugade min re 'gas gos chen rgya smug dang / ser po gyon nas rta bzhon te 'gro ba mthong rgyu 'dug pa de rnams bod gzhung gi skya drag red zer/ 'ga' shas kyis phyu pa 'jol 'jol gyon zhing / zhu mo 'bog do zhes pa sder ma ser po lta bu gyon pa'am/sog zhu gyon mkhan yang re zung 'dug pa de tshos rna cog la sog byil btags 'dugade min phyu pa rgyab sul bsdus nas gser gyi a long btags pa yang re zung mthong rgyu 'dug//'di na srid pa'i phun tshogs chu gter cher//dga' bdes dregs pa'i ngang pa khyo shug zung //'dod yon rlung gis bskyod pa'i rkyal rtsed ngang //mi rtag sgyu ma'i ltad mo ci yang mthong //'ga' shas kyis nga tsho 'phrad skabs rta nas babs pa dang / lam zur du langs bsdad nas nga tshor gus zhabs dang / zhwa mo 'bud mkhan yang 'dugaphal cher de rnams kyis sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog zhal tshor pa yin par snyam/ yang na nga tshos bzhon pa'i rta de rnams 7gong sa mchog gi chibs pa sha stag yin pa dang / nga tsho bsu len du yong mkhan gas su 7gong sa mchog gi chibs g.yog mi gsum yod stabs nga tsho 7rgyal ba'i sku nye yin par snyam nas gus zhabs byas pa red 'dug bsam byung /nga tsho nor gling gzhung sgo'i 'gag tu rta las babs nas gzhung sgo 'dzul skabs gzhung sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi skya srungadamag bcu lhag tsam ru bsgrigs te nga tshor gus btud zhu gi 'dug gzhung sgo nas 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis kyi bzhugs shag 102

tu rkang thang mar bskyod/ bzhugs shag de ni gzhung sgo nas gom pa nyis brgya lhag tsam las med pa de ni lo gcig gi sngon nas 7rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po che mdo smad nas gdan zhu thugs gtan 'khel ma thag bod gzhung gis yab yum rnam gnyis gnas skabs kyi bzhugs shag tu gsar bzhengs gnang ba zhig red 'duganor gling pho brang de 7rgyal ba mchog gi dbyar dus bzhugs gnas yin zhing /yab yum gnyis kyi bzhugs sa de bskal bzang pho brang gi shar ngos nye 'gram du 'dug pa der yab yum gnyis kyis nga tsho yong rgyur phebs sgyag gnang nas bzhugs 'dug nga tsho yar bcar nas yab yum gnyis la gus btud dang / 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar phul/ khong rnam gnyis kyis dgyes mnyes chen po'i ngang nas lam bar dka' ngal ma byung ngam zhes thugs brtse chen pos bde sdug gang dang gang yang beka' 'dri dang / skabs der rgyal yum chen mor sras mo zhig 'khrungs 'dug pa de ni sku'i gcung mo rje btsun pad+ma yin/ sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mas yab yum gnyis dang / skya mched rnams lo gcig tsam ma mjal ring phan tshun shin tu dran par brten da res ngo mjal skabs rmi lam yin nam/ mngon sum yin snyam pa lta bu'i dga' spro dpag med gnang gi 'dug nyin shas ngal gso byas rjes 7gong sa mchog gi sku mdun du mjal khar bcar/ nga tsho mjal khar ma bcar gong 7gong sa mchog yab yum gyi gzim khang du thengs 'ga' shas chibs sgyur gnang song /7gong sa mchog sku na phra rung sku'i gzi mdangs rgyas pa dang / lhag par mchog tu gyur pa'i spyan ras zung las snying rje byang sems kyi thugs rgyud gsal bar mngon pa'i 'char snang zhig byung / sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan dang thog mdo smad nas dbus phyogs su chibs sgyur ma gnang gong nas 7gong sa mchog dang lhan bcar 403

sku rtsod zhu rogs gnang gi yod pa dang / dus rgyun 7gong sa mchog gi sku'i gam bcar zhabs zhu gsol gzim mchod gsum dang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas dang /de 'og gzim g.yog dang / mchod g.yog de min gzim 'gag bzhi lnga tsam yod pa de rnams spyir btang mi las sku gzugs ha cang che ba yod pa de rnams rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i mtshon byed 7rgyal ba'i sku srung yin par grags/spyi khyab mkhan po dang / gzim dpon mkhan po gnyis gzhung zhabs ser mo ba'i khongs kyi bgres gras mkhyen yon can la bsko gzhag gnang srol yod pa dang /mchod dpon mkhan po rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi dge 'dun bgres gas shes yon ldan pa'i gras nas bsko bzhag gnang gi 'dug gsol gzim mchod gsum phal cher skabs der dgung lo 40 nas 5༷ phebs par mngon/de skabs kyi gzim dpon mkhan po ni sngon mdo smad du 7rgyal ba'i yang srid rtsad gcod dang gdan zhur phebs mkhan bod gzhung gi sku tshab gas shig yin/ spyi khyab mkhan po ni bod gzhung ser mo ba'i dpon rigs kyi spyi khyab dang / gsol gzim mchod gsum gyi dbu gnas las mtho ba yin/ 7gong sa mchog gi sku sger mdzod sbyag dang / de'i khongs kyi khang khungs dang gling ga sogs la bdag gnyer 'go 'dzin mdzad dgos shing / lhag par du skabs re bod gzhung bka' shag ches mtho'i las khungs su bka' blon tsho dang lhan du chab srid kyi gnad che'i bka' bsdur gnang bar yang phebs srol 'dug gsol dpon mkhan pos 7gong sa mchog gi nyin re'i gsol tshags 'bul phyogs kyi thugs 'gan kho na bzhes pa dang /mchod dpon mkhan po ni 7gong sa mchog gi phyag dpe gsung rab rnams dang /mchod chas rnams la bdag gnyer / de bzhin 7gong sa mchog gi nyin re'i chos 104

phyogs mdzad rim bcas la thugs 'khur bzhes kyi 'dug gzim dpon mkhan po ni 7gong sa mchog gi na bza' skor bcas kyi thugs khur dang / rgyun du sku bcar zhabs phyi zhu mkhan gtso bo zhig red/da dung 7gong sa mchog gi sku bcar gyi gas su rtse mkhan mgron che ba'am/mgron gnyer chen mo zhes pa zhig yod pa de'i nyin re'i phyag las gtso bo ni/7gong sa mchog gi chos srid gnyis kyi mdzad rim go sgrig dang / 7gong sa chen po'i bka' phyir phebs rigs khungs so sor bka' sgyur brgyud bsgrags gnang rgyu/de min bka' shag dang / rtse yig tshang las khungs/ rtsis khang las khungs sogs kyis mtshon gzhung gi las khungs dang rgya khyab rdzong gzhes khag bcas nas chos srid gnyis kyi thog 7gong sa mchog la 7snyan zhu phul 'byor rnams khong brgyud nas 'bul dgos kyi yod/ da dung nyin re 'char can snga dro'i drung ja (bod gzhung gi gzhung zhabs ser mo ba rnams la zhabs rten pha gzhis med stabs nyin re'i zhogs tshogs lta bu 7gong sa mchog gis gsol ja thengs gnyis bstsal lam dar ba yin skad / sogs kyis mtshon mdzad sgo'i gtso 'gan bzhes dgos shing / khong gi 'og la rtse mgron gyi go gnas yod pa brgyad dgu tsam dang / gzim 'gag rnams bcas mgron gnyer chen mo'i bka' bkod 'og nyin re'i sri zhu zhabs 'degs sgrub dgos pa dang / mgron gnyer chen mo dang rtse mgron bcas ser mo ba sha stag yin pa rnams rtse skor gyi spyi khyab las khungs rtse yig tshang nas 'char gzhi phul te bsko bzhag gnang gi 'dug mgron gnyer chen mo gnas rim bzhi pa dang / rtse mgron gnas rim lnga pa red/gzim 'gag bsko phyogs thad ser mo ba'i nang gi gzugs stobs ha cang che ba dang / mi babs legs gras nas 'dems bsko byed srol yod/ skabs 'di'i 05

gzim 'gag mang che ba mdo stod kyi mi khongs yin 'duganor gling pho brang ni 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i skabs byung ba zhig red/ dus skabs der 7rgyal dbang skal bzang rgya mtsho dbyar dus ring nor gling pho brang chags yul du dbu gur sgron nas sku'i 'phrod bsten gyi chab bzhes gnang bar phebs kyi yod cing / de nas rim bzhin pho brang gsar skrun rgya che mdzad/ lhag par sku phreng 13 pa'i sku dus su nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gi nub ngos su spyan gsal pho brang gsar skrun mdzad rjes/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid rgyun du de gar bzhugs kyi yod pa dang / sngar srol ltar na/ dgun dus ring 7gong sa mchog sku 'khor rnams rtse pho brang po ta lar bzhugs shing / dpyid dus su po ta la nas nor gling du chibs sgyur gnang gi yod/ yar mar chibs sgyur skabs chibs sgyur chen mo zhes pa'i dus 7gong sa mchog gser mdog can gyi phebs byam nang du phebs pa dang / sngon rjes sru gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs chibs zhabs su bcar dgos pa dang/ skabs der lha sa'i mi dmangs tshos phebs lam g.yas g.yon du gral bstar sgrig por langs nas mgon po gang de'i mthong grol zhal dkyil mjal bzhin par skya che zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol ba smon lam drag po 'debs par byed/nor gling pho brang la lcags ri phyi nang gnyis yod pa las lcags ri phyi ma de mtshon mdog dkar po dang / nang ma de ser po yin/ lcags ri ser po de'i nang bskal bzang pho brang dang mtsho dkyil pho brang sogs yod pa las spyan gsal pho brang de'i nang tshud med/ lcags ri phyi ma'i shar phyogs su gzhung sgo chen po yod pa dang / lho nub byang bcas su rgyal sgo re yod/ gzhung sgo'i g.yas g.yon du rdo las 06

brkos pa'i ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge gnyis 'gying nger langs shing / sku srung dmag mi gnyis lus po thad 'drongs su langs / de min rgyal sgo khag la yang sku srung dmag mis srung bya zhu gi yod/7gong sa mchog dbyar dus bzhugs rgyun ring pho brang gi shar ngos skya 'khor rnams kyi bzhugs khang dang / bka' shag yig tshang gtsos pa'i las khungs ma lag dang / las shag bcas yod/ bskal bzang pho brang gi byang shar mtshams su zhabs brtan lha khang zhes pa zhig yod pa de'i nang bod gzhung gi zhabs brtan sgrub sa yin pa de'i steng du bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong rin po che'i bzhugs gnas dang /srid skyong rin po cher zhabs zhu sne mgron dang / de 'og shod mgron drug bdun tsam/gzim 'gag gnyis bcas yod pa khong tsho phyag las gnang sa der shod gzims chung 'gag zer gyi yod/nga tsho lha sar 'byor skabs bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che red 'dug pa khong bzhi sde gra tshang gi spro khang du bzhugs pa las nor gling du mdzad sgo'i skabs ma gtogs bzhugs kyi mi 'dug rjes su rwa sgreng srid skyong rin po che dgongs zhu gnang rjes rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin sku bgres stag brag rin po che srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes te bzhugs gnas sngar srol ltar zhabs brtan lha khang dbu rtser bzhugs/nor gling pho brang gi lho nub lcags ri phyir mar ka dang sku srung dmag sgar yod pa dang / skabs de'i bca' sdod sku srung dmag 'bor 500 tsam yod/skya srung dmag sgar nang du 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung yang yod pa de'i nang sngar 7gong sa sku phreng 13 pa chen po mchog gis phyi rgyal mi sna mjal 'phrad gnang gi yod 'dug 07
