dmag sgar de 7gong sa sku phreng 13 pa chen po rgya gar nas phyir phebs rjes nyi hong pa ya 'dzi ma ya su 'ji ro zhes pa der bka' mngags gnang nas nyi hong gi lugs ltar gsar rgyag byas shing / khong la mda' dpon gyi go ming bstsal/spyir btang gzhung zhabs shod skor tsho'i spa lcog tshon rtsi dmar po yin rung khong gis dmigs bsal thog spa lcog gi tshon rtsi ser po rgyag rgyu'i gtan 'bebs gnang / skabs der nyi tong pa des bod kyi gzhon nu ma dang gnyen sbrel nas bu gcig byung zhing / khong bza' mi bod nas nyi hong du phyir log rjes bu de dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs rgya nag tu dmag thog 'das grong song zer/skya srung dmag mi'i dmag chas dbyin lugs ltar rgyu cha snam bu sa mdog gis bzos pa dang / de rnams kyi go mtshon dbyin bzos me mda' kha ring thung snga rjes byung ba de ni 'dzam gling dmag chen dang po'i skabs su bed spyod byas pa'i me mda' legs pa'i gras yin/ dmag chen dang po mtshams bzhag rjes me mda' de gras bod gzhung la btsong par grags/nor gling skal bzang pho brang la tshoms chen zhig yod pa de'i nang nyin ltar snga dro'i ring bod gzhung gi ser mo ba'i dpon rigs drung ja zhes par chu tshod gcig lhag tsam 'tshogs bcar gyis de'i ring rtse gsol thab nas gsol ja snga rjes gnyis phebs pa dang / gzim chung nang ma rnams la phebs res zhes rgyab ra dang thug thung sogs bzhes spro kyang phebs kyi 'dug skabs re gzhung gi mdzad sgo chen mo rnams kyang tshoms chen nang 'tshogs kyi yod/nga tsho lha sar 'byor nas dus yun ring po ma song bar bod rla dgu pa tsam la nor gling pho brang du rme ru spro sang zhes pa'i 'khrab ston nyin gsum tsam gnang song /108

'khrab ston byed mkhan ni lha sa'i byang phyogs rme ru dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa sha stag yin/ 'khrab ston gyi nang don gtso che ba sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad pa dang /de'i srub dbar la gzhas dang zhabs bro sogs 'khrab ston sna tshogs byed pa de'i ring bod gzhung gi dpon rigs che chung dang / lha sa'i mi mang bcas ltad mor bcar gyi yod cing / gzhung zhabs rnams la rtse gsol thab nas gsol ja gsol chig bcas gzab rgyas gsham pa dang / yab gzhes sku 'khor yang gzigs mo dang /gsol tshigs su gdan 'dren zhus song yang / skabs der rang nyid skad brda ma 'phrod pa'i dbang gis ltad mo de tsam chen po ma byung / ltad mo che shos de snga dgong gnyis su dmag mi'i ru sgrig gis 7gong sa mchog la gas btud zhus pa de red 'dug rme ru spro sang gis 'khrab ston de ni 7gong sa mchog gi mdzad sgo dmigs bsal khag la 'khrab ston byed kyi yod skad/ de lo'i 'khrab ston de ni 7rgyal ba'i yang srid rin po che gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus pa'i rten 'brel du dmigs bsal gyi 'khrab ston byas pa yin 'dug/109

sa bcad gnyis pa/le tshan bdun pa/lha sa'i jo bos mtshon bla lha che khag mjal ba'i skal bzang thob pa/༄༅༅/ /nga tsho 'byor nas nyin shas rjes lha sa dang rtse pho ta la'i mchod mjal du bcar ba'i nyin dang po lha sa gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che gtsug lag khang gnyis la mabyedrod mjal du bcar/lha sa'i gtsug lag khang ni grong khyer lha sa'i dkyil du gnas yod/ nor gling nas lha sar phal cher me le gcig lhag tsam yod cing / grong khyer lha sa'i lho phyogs nye 'gram du snyan grags can gyi skyid chu dal bur rgyugs pa dang / bod kyi lo rgyus las/ dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skya dus su dmar po ri'i rtser sku mkhar pho brang dmar po brtsigs/ lha sa'i gtsug lag khang thog mar bzhengs skabs ra la sa bkal nas 'o thang gi mtsho bsub pas ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang zhes su grags pa dang / gtsug lag khang de thog mar bzhengs mkhan ni srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo bal bza' khri btsun yin zhing /

gzhung sgo de nub phyogs bal yul du bstan nas bzhengs 'dug dus skabs der gtsug lag khang gi skya rten gtso bo ni bal yul rgyal pos khong gi sras mo khri btsun la gnang pa'i rten skal jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje yin kyang / khri srong sde btsan gyi sngon tsam nas jo bo mi skyod rdo rje rgya bza' lhan shing kong jos bzhengs pa'i ra mo che gtsug lag khang du gdan zhu byas shing / rgya bza'i rten skal jo bo shakya mu ni lha sa gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/lha sa gtsug lag khang du rten gtso jo bo shakya mu ne dang / thugs rje chen po rang byung lnga ldan/ byams pa chos 'khor ma bcas kyis mtshon grub mtha' ris med kyis mchod pa'i lha sku mang po bzhugs su gsol ba'i lha khang che chung bdun cu brgyad cu tsam yod tshod 'dug nged tsho gtsug lag khang gi lha khang yongs rdzogs la mchod mjal zhus rjes ra mo che gtsug lag khange du mchod mjal du bskyod/ra mo che gtsug lag khang gi chags yul de lha sa'i grong khyer gyi byang phyogs su yod/ gtsug lag khang de yang gong bzhin dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mo rgya bza' kong jos bzhengs par grags/ gtsug lag khang de ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang las gzhi rgya shin tu chung ba yod/ bod kyi lo rgyus lag sngar bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus rgya bza' lhan shing kong jos rgya nag gi lha khang gi bzo bkod dang mthun par gzhung sgo shar phyogs su bstan nas bzhengs pa der jo bo shakya mu ne bzhugs su gsol zhing / rgyas btab ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du grags/ gtsug lag khang de bzhengs nas bar skabs me skyon thengs kha shas byung ba'i rkyen gyis rgya'i lha khang gi dbyibs can de bod khang gi rnam par gyur/ rten gtso bal bza' khri btsun gyi rten skal mi bskyod rdo rje bzhugs su gsol/2

de phyi phyogs su che dpag lha khang yod/ lha sa'i bud med tsho gzugs por mngal chags skabs lha khang der mchod mjal dang sbrags bskor ba gsog mkhan mang po yod pa de ni lha khang der bskor sbyong byas na ma bu bde grol yong gi yod zer/de'i sang nyin nga tshos rtse pho brang du gnas mjal zhus te 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung khag dang / sku rten khag 7rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pa nas bcu gsum pa'i bar sku phreng rim 'byon gyi gser sdong rin po che zhal mjal zhus nas gsol ba smon lam btab/po ta la zer ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing khams gru 'dzin gnyis par grags/bod kyi lo rgyus las/ dang thog lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi skabs su dmar po ri'i rtser pho brang btab cing / srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su rgyal sa der spos zhes dang / shod rgyun 'ga' shas su/ srong btsan sgam pos dmar po ri'i rtser skya mkhar brtsigs zhes gsal/ rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pa chen po bod kyi chos srid gnyis kyi dbang bsgyur mdzad rjes 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang nas rtse pho brang du gnas spo mdzad 'dug nga tshos 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung khag tu mchod mjal legs par zhus rjes rtse pho brang gi rtse thog nas lha sa'i yul ljongs mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar rgyang lta byed skabs yangs shing rgya che ba'i lha sa'i klung thang gi gzhung du snyan grags can gyi skyid chu de dal bu'i ngang nas shar nas nub tu rgyugs bzhin 'dug mtha' 'khor du bkris rtags brgyad rang byung gi mtshan mas bkra ba'i ri bos bskor ba de rnams ni gna' rabs kyi grong khyer lha sa'i srung skyob lcags ri lta bur mngon/lha sa grong khyer gyi nub byang dang / byang shar mtshams su 'dzam gling yongs su snyan grags ldan pa'i dgon pa chen po se ra dang / 'bras spungs gnyis kyi 3

mtha' 'khor du ri khrod mang po nyi zla skar tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bur snang / po ta la dmar po ri'i lho nub nye mtshams su lcags po ri dang ri rgyud sbrel yod pa de ni ri chen gnyis lag gdang sbrel ba lta bu yod/ ri de gnyis kyi mtho dman phal cher mnyam yang / chags stangs thad po ta la ni brjid nyams che zhing lta na sdug pa zhig yin pa dang / lcags po ri la de tsam gyi brjid nyams med kyang / 7rgyal ba lnga pa'i sku dus su lcags po ri'i rtser bod kyi gso rig slob gra dang po 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa de phyi lo 1959 bar ma nyams par gnas yod/ ri gsham du 7gong sa mchog gi ljags smin gyi chab chu len sa'i sman chu'i chu mig yod/rtse po ta la'i stong thog tu rgyal ba'i gzim chung shar nub gnyis dang /tshoms chen bcas yod cing / de 'og rgyal tshab srid skyong gi bzhugs gnas shod gzims chung khag dang / shod 'gag bka' shag lhan rgyas tshogs sa/ de min rtse yig tshang sogs las khungs ma lag tshugs yul dang / las shag bcas yod/rnam rgyal gra tshang de rtse pho brang nang du chags yod cing / bod gzhung gi dus snga rabs nas gsog 'jog gnang ba'i dngos rigs rtsa che'i rigs kyi gan mdzod dang /gsung rab grangs las 'das pa rtse pho brang nang du yod/de nyin nga tsho rtse pho brang du mchod mjal zhu bar nyin hril po 'gor song ba ni/ rtse pho brang gi mchod khang mjal bar 'gro ma myong ba zhig yin na nang logs la slebs nas phyir don mi shes pa lta bu yod zer ba de dngos 'brel red 'du ga nga tsho'i pha yul du sgrung gtam zhig la/ gna' rabs mdo smad khul gyi na gzhon gnyis dbus phyogs su gnas bskor du bskyod de lha sar 'byor nas nyin zhig rtse pho brang gi nang du mchod mjal zhu bar 'gro skabs phyir don ma thub pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad 1 4

stabs re zhig lha sa mthong thub sa'i so khung lta bru'i sge khung chung chung zhig gi 'khris sru ngal gso brgyab/ gcig gi sge khung nas mgo phyir bton nas lha sar ltad mo bltas rjes mgo bo nang du 'jug ma thub par lus skabs/ rogs pa der/ da nga shi sa de yag song / shi lugs de nganasong zhes brjod skabs/ rogs pa des/ thog mar khyod kyis mgo bo ji ltar phyir bton pa yin nam zhes dris par/ thog mar ngas mgo bo 'di ltar bton pa yin zer ba dang dus mtshungs mgo bo nang du 'jug thub pa byung zhes grags/rtse pho brang dmar po de 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i sku che'i smad du gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po ni de'i sngon tsam du bzhings par grags/pho brang de'i nang du khang mig stong phrag tsam yod pa dang / rtse pho brang gi rgyab mdun gnyis sru phebs lam re yod/ rgyab kyi phebs lam der rta lam sgor mo zer ba de brgyud rta bzhon nas thad kur ltag sgo rgyab par 'gro sa yod pa dang / phyis su mo ṭa yang 'gro thub/ mdun gyi phebs lam ni rdo skas yin/po ta la de ri'i steng du sa 'khod snyoms nas brgyab yod pa der khyon bsdoms thog brtsegs bcu gsum yod/ rtse pho brang nang du chang 'khyer mi chog pa dang / dgong dro bud med zhag sdod mi chog pho brang de'i rtsig zheng che chung ni mi ṭar gcig lhag tsam yod pas sge'u khung gi nang du 'bol gdan cha gcig gzhung la rgyag thub pa'i sa cha yod/ nga tsho lha sar slebs nas bdun phrag gnyis gsum gyi rjes su mi drag gi lcam dang / sras mo 'ga' shas sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma mjal 'phrad du phebs shing / bod gzhung gi skya drag dang lcam/ sras mo/ de bzhin tshong dpon 15

bcas mi mang po rgyal yab dang / rgyal yum chen mo'i mjal 'phrad du ha lam nyin ltar yong gi 'dug de rnams kyis 'bul rten du mar ltang dang / 'bras ltang / ja sgam/ rgya gar nas thon pa'i bye ma ka ra do po/ gro zhib yang man do po sogs kyi steng du gos chen nam ldeng re'am/ yang na gru'u tse tshon mdog gang rung 'bul gyi 'dug pa de ni bod kyi spyi tshogs nangamatho rim dang / 'byor ldan pa tsho'i goms srol red 'dug dang thog mjal 'phrad zhu skabs phyag 'bul yin zhes 'bul mtshan 'di lta bu 'bul srol zhig dang / yang na 'ga' shas kyi so so'i bde sdug gi mgo 'dren skyabs 'jug zhu dgos pa'i rkyen gyis 'bul tshan 'bul mkhan yang 'duganyin zhig rgyal yab dang rgyal yum gnyis kyis sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma nged gnyis bod kyi rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i skya mdun du mjal kha zhu ba ra khrid gnang byung bar rwa sgreng rin po che'i bzhugs gnas lha sa grong khyer gyi nub byang mtshams bzhi sde gra tshang gi rgyab la rwa sgreng bla brang gi spro khang nang du 'dug nga tsho ma bcar gong gi nyin gnyis gsum tsam nas mjal khar bcar 'thus kyi snyan seng phul te de nyin snga dro mjal khar bcar chog pa'i bka' khrol byung ba ltar nga tsho rta bzhon nas bskyod/ skabs der rwa sgreng rin po cher 'bul rten du a khu che ring don grub lags kyis skya 'bum nas nyos pa'i rta'i nang gi legs gras spu kha rkyang po 'gros ma zhig dang / bzhon drel cha gcig bcas phul/ nga tsho pha yul du sdod skabs nas rwa sgreng rin po che rta la mnyes po yod lugs thos byung ba de dngos 'brel red 'dugadang thog rwa sgreng bla brang gi rgyal sgo'i phyir 'byor skabs bla brang gi las sne 'ga' shas sne len zhu bar gzhung sgo'i g.yas g.yon du phebs sgug gnang nas bzhugs 'dugargyal ba'i yab yum gnyis kyi chibs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas nga tsho tshang ma gzhung ga bya

sgo'i nang gi rdo'i chibs bkyag thog rta las babs/ de nas gzim chung nang gdan zhus kyis khyug tsam sku ngal gsos ring gsol ja phebs nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar rwa sgreng rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar chog pa'i bka' gsal phebs de nas na bza' gra chas steng du gos chen ser po'i rdu sgo tse bzhes pa'i na gzhon 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa zhig gis nga tsho'i sne khrid gnang byung ba de ni rwa sgreng rin po che'i skya tsha dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan yin 'dug nga tsho rgyal tshab rin po che'i skya mdun du bcar nas thog brtsegs gnyis pa'i gzim chung zhig tu bzhugs sgrom nang bzhugs 'dug skabs der khyug tsam yar bzhengs song ba nga tsho tshang mas phyag 'tshal zhing / 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis la dbu gtugs dang / byings rnams la phyag dbang gnang ste rin po che'i skya mdun gyi gzhogs g.yas ngos su rin po che'i bzhugs gdan las cung zad dma' tsam zhig sgron 'dug pa der 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis bzhugs/ de nas tshang ma bzhugs gral du 'khod 'phral gsol ja gshams/ rin po ches thog mar yab yum gnyis la 'tshams zhu gnang zhing /de nas nged gnyis la yang yar lam khag po ma byung ngam zhes 'tshams 'dre gnang byung / nga tshos gsol ja zhus rjes dgongs pa zhus nas zhal gyes skabs rin po che yar bzhengs nas 7rgyal yab dang lhan du chibs par gzigs par phebs/rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po che ni rwa sgreng sku phreng lnga pa red 'dug pa khong gi mtshan la thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes zhu ba de chu byi phyi lo 1912 lo dwags po rgya tsha rdzong gi sa khul mi tshang dbul po zhig tu 'khrungs shing / dgung lo 33 lor shing khyi 1934 lo bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes nas sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i gser sdong dge legs 'dod 'jo 17

rten dang brten par bcas pa legs par bzhengs shing / 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po ngos 'dzin gdan zhu gnang ba'i mdzad rjes gzhan 'gran ma mchis pa'i rlabs chen zhig red/ skabs der dgung grangs sum cu'i yas mas kyi dar ma zhig red 'dug khong gi sku gzugs de tsam chen po med kyang spyan zung ha cang gzil rngam che zhing / mjal spro ba zhig 'duganyams thag la snying rje che ba/ thugs bag yangs shing sku'i nyer chas sogs thugs mkho khag rgyas spros dang / chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi dgos sar gtong phod che ba'i rwa sgreng bla brang gi stobs 'byor mnga' thang 'gran rla bral ba'i dar rgyas kyi dus su ser skya mang tshogs tshang mas brtsi bkur zhu yul du gyur/ skabs der skyabs rje pha bong khas ser skyu 'dus tshogs su gsung chos gnang dus gsung sgros su srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che hūṃ che brtan pa tsam gyis bod khams yongs kyi phan bde yun gnas yong rgyur dgos pa dge mtshan che lugs bka' yang yang gnang gi yod ces gsungs pa thos/ rwa sgrong rgyal thog ring mtha' mtshams dus bde zhod 'jags dang /'bangs rnams bde bar 'khod cing yul gyi skya nam shin tu rgyas po byung nas skabs shig ring bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod rgyu byung /rwa sgreng rin po che ni rgyal sprul ho thog thu'i gras shig yin/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog srid skyong gnang myong mkhan rgyal sprul ho thog thu/ de mo dang / che smon gling /kun bde gling / rwa sgreng / sde drug bcas byung yod cing / rwa sgreng sku thog dang po khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan ni mdo smad tsong kha'i khul du 'khrungs te sku gzhon nu'i dus su dbus phyogs la phebs nas gdan sa se ra byes grwa tshang du slob gnyer gnang nas mdo sngags gnyis kyi gzhung lugs la sbyang brtson chen po gnang ste/ mkhas ga 8

grags che ba'i thog dga' ldan khri pa gnang bas mtshon chos phyogs kyi mdzad 'phrin rlabs po che byung ba ma zad/ 7rgyal dbang skya phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho'i yongs 'dzin yang mtha' 'khyongs gnang myong ba red/de bzhin sku phreng gnyis pa khri chen bstan pa rab rgyas nas kyang gong ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin bskyangs te dga' ldan khri pa gnang ba sogs dang / sku phreng gsum pa ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgya mtsho de nyid shing sprul phyi lo 1845 lor srod skying gi khrir 'khod de lo ngo bcu gnyis tsam bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong mdzad/ shing yos 1855 lor 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtshos chos sred gi thugs 'gan bzhes kyang rla shas las ma song bar gshegs par brten/slar yang rgyal tshab srid skyong thengs gnyis pa gnang yang chu spre 1873 lo 'bras spungs rigs gra'i gtong sgo bcag pa'i gleng lhags kyis zing cha byung ba'i rkyen gyis byang shar du bros phebs mdzad dgos byung nas lam bar du sku gshegs/sku phreng bzhi pa ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis paṇa chen skya phreng dgu pa'i yongs 'dzin gnang / khong sku na smin nas zhi bar gshegs khar ma 'ongs sngon gzigs kyi rwa sgreng bla brang gi 'dzin dbang thams cad 7rgyal ba skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen por 'bul gnang ba dang 'brel slad phyin rwa sgreng ho thog thu'i skye sprul ngos 'dzin zhu mi dgos pa'i snyan zhu 'bul gnang mdzad kyang 7gong sa mchog nas zhal bzhes ma gnang bar sngar bzhin skye srid sprul sku ngos 'dzin zhu dgos zhes bka' gnang 'dug de ltar 7gong sa mchog nas thugs 'khur che bzhes kyis rwa sgreng skya phreng lnga pa thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rwa sgreng sku gong ma'i yang srid la ngos 'dzin dang / mtshan gsol mdzad 'dug rwa sgreng skya 19

phreng lnga byung ba'i nang sku phreng dang po dang gnyis pa gnyis nas dga' ldan khri pa gnang myong ba dang / sku phreng gsum pa dang lnga pa gnyis kyis bod rgyal khab chen po'i rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes myong ba red 'dugang tsho lha sar 'byor nas re zhig ring bla chen khag dang / dgon pa khag la mchod mjal dang / mjal kha zhu ched brel ba chen po byung yang nyams myong mang po zhig thob byung / rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po ches dbus pa'i bla chen mjal khar bcar ba'i gas su phur lcog byams pa rin po che dang / yongs 'dzin sku gzhon stag brag rin po che/ mtshan zhabs gling rin po che/ khrobyang rin po che/ che smon gling rin po che bcas kyi bzhugs shag tu mjal khar bcar ba yin/ skabs der yongs 'dzin sku gzhon stag brag rin po che dang / gling rin po che rnam gnyis nor gling du bzhugs 'dug nga tsho mjal khar bcar dus gzhan gyi sngon du bcar ba yin/skabs der stag brag rin po che dgung lo lnga bcu tsam yin zhing khong gi thugs gshis ha cang sgam po dang / rgyun du mi rnams la bka' grol mang po mi gnang mkhan zhig yin 'dug khong gis 7rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin sku gzhon ma gnang gong 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i mtshan zhabs kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa dang /skabs der khong nor gling skal bzang pho brang gi nub kyi nye 'gram chibs ra'i gzim chung du bzhugs 'dugarjes su rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes nas zhabs brtan lha khang gi steng thog srid skyong gi bzhugs shag tu gnang ba dang / 7rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin ma gnang gong bla sprul 'bring khag tshogs chen sprul sku'i gas yin pa dang / bla brang gi stobs 'byor de tsam med kyang 7rgyal tshab gnang rjes bod kyi bla chen rgyal sprul gas su gyur/120

khong ni chos phyogs kyi sku yon ha cang mtho po dang / mdo sngags gang thad nas mkhas grub gnyis ldan zhig yin par grags/nga tsho mjal khar bcar skabs 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis la mtshams 'dre gnang ba las/ rwa sgreng rin po che lta bu'i zhal ras 'dzum mdangs mi ston pa de ni rin po che kho rang gi thugs gshis yin par grags/ skabs der nga tsho'i snang ngor bla ma de ni gzil rngam can zhig tu mjal bar brten dus de nas bzung ga dus mjal kyang ngam shugs kyis 'jigs snang phran bu yong gi yod/stag brag rin po che'i gzhis dgon stag lung brag ri khrod ces pa lha sa'i nub phyogs me le 10 tsam gyi sar yod/ bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong ma gnang gong stag brag ri khrod du dge 'dun 'ga' shas las med pas chos kyi sgrub pa nyams len gnang sa'i dben gnas shig yin kyang / 7rgyal tshab gnang rjes stag lung brag ri khrod kyi gra grangs mang du btang ba dang / bla brang 'dzugs skrun gzhi rgya chen po gnang 'dug pa de ni 'jig rten pa'i 'gro lugs dang khyad med pa zhig tu gyur/stag brag rin po che'i mjal kha zhus rjes gleng rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar skabs mjal ma thag rang bzhin gyi dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba zhig byung ba ni/khong gi thugs gshis dul zhing mi su dang su yin rung gsung thos pa tsam gyi sems pa dga' lhang lhang dang / byin rlabs 'jug pa'i 'char snang yong ba zhig yin/ khong gi mthong grol zhal skyin 'dzum mdangs dang ldan pa de mjal skabs sangs rgyas dngos mjal byung snyam pa zhig yong gi 'dug skabs der khong ni 7rgyal ba'i mchog sprul rin po che'i mtshan zhabs khri pa red zer/ dgung grangs phal cher bzhi cu lhag tsam las phebs e yod snyam/12

gling rin po che sku gong mas7rgyal dbang skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin lo mang gnang mthar sku gshegs rjes 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos khong gi yang srid ngos 'dzin dang sbrags mtshan gsol mdzad pa dang /grwa sa chen po 'bras spungs blo gling grwa tshang du chos zhugs kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gsan bsam legs grub kyi 7rgyal ba mchog gi bka' dgongs ltar rgyud stod du bzhugs te mdo sngags gang thad nas mkhas grub gnyis ldan phul du byung ba zhig tu gyur nas rgyud stod mkhan po gnang / de nas 7rgyal ba'i mchog sprul rin po che'i mtshan zhabs bsko gzhag bstsal/ rjes su rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po che mchog gis stag brag rin po che bod kyi rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol skabs khong la 7rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin sku gzhon pa bsko bzhag gnang / gling rin po che mchog gi zhal dbyibs dang / shangs/ snyan cog bcas gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod cing /mi rnams kyis rin po che 'jigs byed sku dngos yin par yid ches dang dad bkur chen po zhu gi 'dug khong gi sku gzugs de tsam chen po ma yin te ha cang thang sha dod pa dang / sku sha phran bu 'byor tsam red 'dug khong ni dus rgyun du thugs bag yangs po zhig red/de rjes nga tsho phur lcog byams pa rin po che dang / che smon gling / kun bde gling / khri byang rin po che bcas kyi sku mdun du rim bzhin mjal khar bcar ba yin/ phur lcog rin po che sku gzugs de tsam thang po med pa'i thog zhabs kyi snyun gzhis rkyen pas phebs bgrod gnang rgyur sku ngal yod pa zhig red 'dug dgung lo de tsam che bar phebs e yod snyam/ rin po che sku gong mas 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin gnang myong ba red/ 22

che smon gling rin po che dang / kun bde gling rin po che rnam gnyis bod kyi bla chen rgyal sprul yin zhing / khong gnyis ka dgung lo phal cher phran las gcig gnyis kyi bgres pa min nam snyam/ che smon gling sku thog dang po nas da lta'i skya thog bar mdo smad co ni'i yul du 'khrungs shing / snga rjes su skya thog gsum gyis bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong gnang myong ba red/ skabs 'di'i sku thog dgung lo bcu gnyis bcu gsum tsam la che smon gling skya gong ma'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin gyis a mdo co ne nas dbus phyogs su gdan 'dren gnang 'dug che smon gling rin po che dang /kun bde gling rin po che rnam gnyis rgyun par mtshan nyid gsan bzhes gnang gi yod kyang skabs re khong gnyis bla brang du khyug tsam re sku ngal dang spro seng du phebs kyi yod/che smon gling bla brang de lha sa byang phyogs rwa sgreng bla brang gi nye 'khris shar ngos su yod/nyin zhig nga tsho kun bde gleng bla brang du rin po che'i mjal khar bcar/kun bde gling bla brang de lha sa dang nor bu gling ga'i bar du yod/ kun bde gling dgon pa ni rab byung bcu gsum pa'i shing stag phyi lo 1794 lor phyag btab par grags/ kun bde gling rin po che'i mtshan gzhan la rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu zhes zhu gi yod pa dang/ sku phreng snga rjes gnyis kyis bod kyi rgyal tshab srid skyong thengs gnyis mdzad yod par brten kun bde gling la rgyal sprul bla chen gyi gas shig yin zhing / bla brang gi stobs 'byor thad rgyal sprul gzhan rnams las che ba yod pa ni rgyal tshab thengs gnyis gnang zhing nyes skyon gang yang ma byung bar grags/ de bzhin bla brang de'i sgrig 'dzugs gzhung srol ltar las byed che chung tshang mas bla brang gi sgrig srol brtsi bkur dang / spyi don la sha zhen che/ bla brang phyi nang gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong 'gan 'khur tshang ma phyag mdzod dza sag bla ma zhig gzhung nas bsko gzhag mdzad srol 123

yod pa'i thog la go gnas kyi gdan thob rim pa gsum pa red 'dug de 'og sde 'chang dang / zhabs sdod pa sogs las byed che chung khag mang po yod/ dza sag bla ma de spyir btang bla brang gzhan dag gi phyag mdzod dang mtshungs pa zhig yin kyang /dza sag bla mas skabs der bla brang gi las 'gan thog bod gzhung gi las 'gan yang byed pa po so so'i 'jon thang la dpag pa'i bkod sgrig gnang gi 'dugabla brang de rnams la chos gzhis mang po yod pa'i thog khrims 'go rang btsan lta bu yin pa de ni ha lam rgyal khab gcig gi 'og gi rgyal phran lta bu gyur/chos gzhis mang po byung stangs ni bla ma'i mdzad pa dang / lhag par du 7rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin gyi thugs 'gan bzhes pa dang / de min rgyal tshab srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i ring bod gzhung gis thugs rje legs 'bul lta bur chos gzhis 'bul srol yod pa dper na/ de snga rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po ches 7rgyal ba'i mchog sprul rin po che gdan zhu'i byas mdzad rjes gzhung nas rwa sgreng bla brang la thugs rje legs 'bul gyi chos gzhis phul skor rnyog gleng mang po byung 'dug pa de skor rjes su 'god rgyu yin//kun bde gling rin po che'i thugs gshis ni chibs pa dang / gzim khye/byi'u bcas la ha cang mnyes po yod pa ma zad/ de bzhin bod kyi zlos gar lha mo dang / zhabs bro bcas la yang mnyes po gnang gi yod zer/nga tshos bla chen rnams kyi skya mdun du mjal khar bcar rjes nga tsho'i byed sgo gnyis pa de ni/ 'dzam gling yongs su mtshan snyan grags khyab pa'i gdan sa chen po gsum la rim bzhin chos mjal du bskyod pa yin/ dang thog 'bras spungs dgon par chos mjal du bcar/ 'bras spyangs dgon pa ni lha sa'i nub phyogs kyi 24

dge 'phel ri'i gsham du yod/ gdan sa chen po gsum gyi nang nas dge 'dun mang shos yin/ spyir btang zer srol la 'bras spungs dgon par rgyun du dge 'dun 7700 yod zer ba de las kyang mang ba yod/ 'bras spungs dgon pa de dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dus 'gor phyi lo 1415 lor 7rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i slob ma chos rje bkris dpal ldan gyis phyag btab pa red/ dus rabs bcu drug pa sa stag lo 1518 lo 7rgyal dbang sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho gtsang bkris lhun po nas chibs sgyur gyi 'bras spungs dgon spyi'i mkhan po mdzad de sne sdong rgyal po bkris grags pas rgyal ba sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho mchog gi bzhugs gnas su 'bras spungs rdo khang sngon po zhes pa de phul rjes rgyal dbang mchog gtan bzhugs thog dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa'i mtshan gsol mdzad cing / de mjug 7rgyal ba sku phreng gsum pa dang / bzhi pa/ lnga pa bcas 'bras spungs dgon par mtshan nyid sogs gsan bsam sgom gsum gyi slob gnyer mdzad/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta phyi lo 1542 lo 7rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa chen pos bod rgyal khab chen po'i chos srid lugs gnyis zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bod spongs yongs rdzogs la dbang bsgyur te bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang zhes pa'i mtshan stan yongs su khyab/gdan sa gsum gyi nang nas 'bras spungs dgon pa thob thang che ba yod/de ni snga rabs 'bras spungs dgon du bod gzhung dbu brnyes pa yin zhing / dgon pa der grwa tshang khag lnga yod pa ni/ sgo mang dang / blo gling / sde yangs/ stod pa/sngags pa dang bcas yod pa las stod pa grwa tshang de ming tsam yod pa las dge 'dun gyi rgyun chad/ dge 'dun mang shos ni blo gsal gling dang / sgo mang gnyis yin/ 25

de gnyis kyi nang nas kyang blo gsal gling grwa tshang la dge 'dun mang ba yod/ dgon pa spyi yongs kyi chos gzhis khag gi 'go 'dzin ni spyi so zhes pa de yin zhing / des dge 'dun dmangs kyi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen skor 'gan 'khur gyi yod/ khrims non byed mkhan tshogs chen dge bskos gnyis yod pa de ni bod gzhung gi lo re gsar bsko gnang srol yod/ de 'og grwa tshang khag dang / khang tshan mi tshan bcas rim pa mtho dman mi 'dra ba yod/ 7rgyal ba'i yab gzhis kyi thob khungs ni 'bras spungs sgo mang dang / khang tshan bsam blo yin kyang / 7rgyal yum chen mo'i thob khungs grwa tshang sgo mang yin kyang/ khang tshan dge zhing yin/7rgyal ba'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che mdo smad nas lha sar phebs rjes 'bras sprangs sgo mang grwa tshang gi khongs bsam blo khang tshan dang / dge zhing khang tshan gnyis kyis 7rgyal yum chen mo'i thob khungs sogs la rtsod rtsog mang po byung ste rtse yig tshang nas khang tshan gnyis kur thob thang yod par thag gcod gnang / nga tsho mchod mjal du 'byor skabs khang tshan de gnyis kur mchod mjal dang / bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas zhus/ bsam blo khang tshan la rgyun du dge 'dun pa lnga brgya nas drug brgya bar yod zer/ dge zhing khang tshan la dge 'dun pa bcu grangs las med/snga rabs gdan sa gsum chags pa nas bzung dgon pa'i grwa tshang dang khang tshan gyi dge 'dun pa'i yong khungs la gzhigs nas khang tshan so sor bgos shing / khang tshan du ma las grwa tshang gcig grub/bod chol kha gsum dang / sog yul bcas kyi sa khul nas grwa rgyun du phebs ba'i dge 'dun rnams kyi thob khungs ha cang gsal po bkod 'dug sngar ser 'bras dga' gsum la cha bzhag na se ra dgon par grwa tshang gsum dang /126

khang tshan sum cu yod/ 'bras spungs dgon par grwa tshang lnga dang / khang tshan brgyad yod/ dga' ldan la grwa tshang gnyis dang khang tshan nyi shu rtsa drug yod/ de snga sgo mang grwa tshang du sog po stod smad yul gru khag nas grwa rgyun mang po yong gi yod kyang /bar skabs phye sog dang / ru su'i khongs gtogs bu rad thu dang / kul mug yul khag gsum bcas la dmar po'i lam lugs su gyur par brten de ga'i grwa rgyun rtsa chad du song ba dang / de bzhin nang sog yul gru khag dang / stod sog bcas nas yong mkhan sngar las phran bu nyung du song / nga tsho de nyin grwa tshang khag dang /dga' ldan pho brang bcas su mchod 'jal lhod po'i ngang nas zhus/nyin shas rjes gnas chung dgon pa'i mchod mjal du bskyod/ gnas chung dgon pa'i mtshan rgyas par gnas chung rdo rje sgra dbyangs gleng zhes zer/dgon pa der gzhung bsten dgra lha'i gtso bo chos skyong rdo rje grags ldan gyi rten mkhar yod/ gnas chung sku rten la bod gzhung gi tā bla ma zhes rim pa gsum pa'i go gnas stsal srol dang / dgon pa der dge 'dun pa brgya lhag tsam yod cing /der zu re bzhin bod gzhung gi gzab gsol zhu ba dang / bod gzhung gi bstan pa chab srid bcas dang / lhag par 7gong sa mchog gi yang srid brtsad gcod bcas kyi skor gnas chung chos skyong la bka' lung zhu gnang mdzad srol/gnas chung dgon pa'i stod phyogs su bstan ma'i gzim khang zhu ba zhig yod pa de ni bod kyi lha srung bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal rdo rje drag rgyal ma'i bsti gnas zhig yin pa de 'bras spungs dgon pa'i srung ma gtso bor bsten gyi yod pa bcas lha gnas mtho po zhig yin par grags/bstan ma bcu gnyis ni bod gna' rabs kyi sred pa'i lha chen dang /127

dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs gu ru pad+ma saṃ lha ba bod du phebs nas lha de rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung bar bka' bsgos dam bcas gnang ba nas bzung rgyal bstan spyi'i srung ma yin pa ma zad/ gzhung bsten srung ma'i gras zhig kyang yin/gnas chung dgon pa'i gsham du dan 'bag ces pa'i grong sde zhig yod pa de sngar sog po gu shī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi dus su sog dmag rnams dgun dus ring lha pa'i nub byang me le re gsum tsam gyi rgyang khad yod pa'i 'dam gzhung zhes pa'i sa gnas la/ dbur dus su sog dmag rnams dmag sgar chags sa yin pa dang / bca' sdod byed kyi yod par grags/de rjes nyin gcig se ra theg chen gling dgon pa'i mchod mjal du bskyod/se ra theg chen gling ni 'bras spungs dgon pa phyag btab nas lo ngo gsum kyi rjes su phyi lo 1419 lo byams chen chos rje shakyu ye shes kyis phyag btab pa zhig yin zhing / khong ni rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i dngos slob yin/ rab byung bdun pa'i sa glang phyi lo 1409 lo rgya nag tā ming rgyal pos rje tsong kha pa gdan 'dren zhus kyang ma phebs par khong gi sku tshab tu byams chen chos rje shakyu ye shes rgya nag tu phebs pa'i lo dus kyi gnas tshul la gzhigs na/ rgya nag nas phyir phebs rjes se ra dgon pa phyag btab par mngon/ se ra theg chen gling dgon pa lha sa'i byang phyogs se ra rtse ri'i gsham du yod/ dgon pa der rgyun du dge 'dun lnga stong lnga brgya yod ces zer yang don dngos de las mang ba yod/ dgon pa der grwa tshang gsum yod pa ni byes gru tshang dang / smad grwa tshang / sngags pa grwa tshang bcas yin/dge 'dun mang shos ni byes grwa tshang yin pa'i khongs nas mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma dge bshes mang po byung myong ba ma zad grwa tshang de 'byor pa yang chen po yin 128

zer/ de 'og smad grwa tshang yin/se ra dgon par 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis kyi thob khungs bsam blo khang tshan gcig pa yin stabs rtsod rnyog gang yang byung myong med/ dgon pa de 'bras spungs las gzhi rgya chung tsam 'dug kyang dgon pa'i mtha' 'khor du ri khrod mang po yod pa ni bsil zer can skar tshogs kyis bskor ba lta bur snang / de skabs bod kyi rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i thob khungs ni se ra byes grwa tshang dang / khang tshan bsam blo yin pa de ni rgyal ba'i yab gzhis dang thob khungs gcig pa red 'dugade'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rwa sgreng sku thog dang po khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan gyi 'khrungs yul mdo smad bya khyung nas yin par brten 7rgyal ba'i 'khrungs yul stag 'cher dang la phar nang tshur nang yin/nga tshos se 'bras gnyis su mchod mjal zhus zin rjes dga' ldan dgon par mchod mjal du bskyod 'char yod kyang / lha sa nas dga' ldan bar me le 35 tsam yod thog nam dus kyang grang du 'gro bzhin pa bcas gang ci'i stabs mi 'grogs pa'i rgyu rkyen 'phrad pas lo rjes ma'i dbyar ku'am/ ston ka gang rung bskyod na legs tshul bsam 'char mang po byung ste phyi lo der skyod 'char byas/nged bza' mi gnyis lha sar 'byor nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mar sbrum ma btsas nye bar brten nor gling pho brang lcags ri phyi ma'i nub byang ngos rgya mtsho smad gzhis grong du re zhig gnas spos gnang te 1941zu 11 ches 7 nyin bu bstan 'dzin ngag dbang btsas pa red//129

6sku tshan brgyad pa/skya drag gzim shag che khag gi gsol ston du bcar ba/༄༅༅/ /nga tsho lha sar slebs pa'i dus tshod de ston mjug 'khel stabs bod gzhung las byed dang / las khungs/ mtho rim skya drag dang / tshong pa che khagami dmangs 'byor ldan che 'bring yod rigs bcas kyis lha sa'i nye 'khor gling ga khag tu spro seng gtong ba'i dus tshod mjug 'gril mtshams shig red 'dugalo ltar dbyar dus nas ston mjug tsam bar lha sa'i mi dmangs gling gar 'gro ba'i goms gshis yod cing / 'ga' shas kyis dus tshod de'i ring gling ga'i nang du gur brgyab nas rla shas ring spro seng gtong ba'i skabs der skya drag 'ga' shas kyis nga tsho yab gzhis sku 'khor rnams gling ga dang / kho tsho'i spro khang gzim shag tu gsol tshigs gdan zhu'i mgron brda btang ba ltar bskyed pa'i gras gzim shag tsha rong dang / yab gzhis glang mdun sogs yin pa dran gyi 'dugagong gsal gzims shag de gnyis gnas sa lha sa skyed chu'i 'gram du chags te phan tshun khyim mches kyang red 'dug khang pa'i bzo dbyibs byings bod lugs yin pa la/ nub phyogs kyi khang dbyibs kyi shugs rkyen phran bu thebs yod par snyam/ cig

lhag par du tsha rong gi gzim shag de jus bkod legs pa dang / ldum ra'i nang gi me tog sna tshogs rnam par bkra ba dang / ljon shing sna tshogs dang / 'bras ldan shing sna mang pos khor yug mdzes par brgyan cing / tshal zhing yang mang po 'debs las byed/ de nyin yab gzhis skya 'khor khe gtsang las gzhan gyi sku mgron su yang mi 'dug nga tsho gzim shag tsha rong gi rgyal sgo'i 'gram du 'byor skabs tsha rong sku ngo dza sag che bzang dgra 'dul mchog dang / lha lcam/ sras sros bcas rgyal sgo'i phyi nang du phebs sgug zhus nas bzhugs 'dug khong tshos 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis la bod lugs kyi phyag 'bul zhus thog phan tshun 'tshams 'dre zhu res gnang / de nas gzim chung du gdan drangs/ nga tsho tsha rong gi gsol tshigs su bskyod pa'i nam dus de zu 9 pa tsam yin pa dang /lha sa'i lugs srol la gsol tshigs nyin dgung dang dgong dro bcas thengs gnyis 'bul ba'i lugs srol zhig yin/ tsha rong gzim shag gi ldum ra'i nang du dbu gur chen po gnyis sgron 'dug pa nyin dgung gsol chigs de dbu gur nang du bshams/ gsol chigs ma phul gong spyir btang gi bka' mol gnang ba dang /ldum ra'i nang du me tog dang / tshal zhing / 'bras ldan shing sogs la gzigs skor du gdan zhu gnang / de nas rgya gar dang / rgya nag nas thon pa'i rol cha sna tshogs kyi skad par ban tse snyan zhing 'dzabs pa btang nas dga' spro'i ngang dus 'da' bar byas/ dgong dro'i gsol tshigs ma phul gong gi chu tshod gcig tsam gyi sngon la gsol ja mngar mo dang zhal tog sna tshogs btegs/ gzim shag tsha rong gi gsol tshigs kyi sne kha ha cang rgyas pa zhig min na yang / shin tu spus dag po dang /132

tsha 'khol thon gsum yod pa der nub phyogs kyi srol phran bu 'dres pa lta bu snang /tsha rong dza sag zla bzang dgra 'dul ni de snga 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po rgya gar dang / sog yul la chibs bsgyur skabs zhi drag gnyis kyi zhabs 'degs gzengs su thon pa zhu gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ chu byi rgya dmag bod nas mthar bskrod gtong skabs kyi mdzad gtso dmag spyi'i mtshan 'khur dang / de rjes bka' blon bcas gnang myong zhing / chu byi rgya dmag mthar bskyod btang ba'i mdzad rjes la 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos gser gyi rtags ma chen po zhig kyang dmigs bsal gyis stsal 'dugatsha rong ni 'jon thang che ba'i mi zhig yin pas sger gyi tshong las la brten nas dpal 'byor thog snyan grags chen po yod pa dang / khong ni gshes rgyud drang zhing /mchog dman kun la bstun gshib mkhas pa/ gzhung zhen che ba/ lhag par gzigs rgya chen po dang / skabs bab don gnad la dbye zhib mkhas pa/ phyi rgyal dbyin ji dang mthun lam zab pa bcas yod par brten mi mang pos kho rang dbyin ji'i phyogs gtogs red zer/ skabs der khong rang dgung lo 50 tsam red 'dug de nas nyin shas rjes yab gzhis sku 'khor gzim shag glang mdun gyis mgron 'bod ltar bcar ba yin/yab gzhis glang mdun gzhim shag ni 7rgyal ba'i skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yab gzhis yin pa dang / skya gong ma'i skya tsha srid zur kun dga' dbang phyug gis 7gong sa mchog zhal bzhugs skabs bod kyi srid blon gyi thugs 'gan bzhes/sku gong ma dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gshegs rjes 7rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ga33

che dang lhan du lo shas tsam bstan srid kyi 'khur 'gan bzhes yod kyang / las don 'ga' shas thog khong gnyis dgongs pa ma mthun pa'i rkyen gyis bod gzhung tshogs 'du nas srid blon las 'khur dgongs zhu dgongs 'char phul ba ltar srid zur du gyur kyang srid blon gyi gdan thob dang gsol phogs rang 'jags phul/skabs der khong dgung lo 40 tsam red 'dug zer skad la/ glang mdun srid zur mi gshis bzang po yin rung 'jon thang de tsam med zer/ yab gzhis glang mdun gyi gzim shag de tsha rong las phran bu che tsam 'dug kyang / de tsam gyi gtsang sbra dod po med pa dang / me tog dang ljon shing la yang do snang de tsam med par mngon/nga tsho yab gzhis glang mdun gyi gzim shag tu 'byor mtshams srid zur dang / lha lcam rnam gnyis kyis skya mgron rnams dbu gur nang gdan 'dren zhus/spyir btang sku mgron la gsol tshigs ma phul gong bod lugs kyi gsol ja dang zhal tog bcas yang yang 'bul srol yod/ nyin dgung gsol tshigs su bzhes tshal / sder ma bzhi dang rgya thug 'bul srol yod/ dgong dro chu chod gsum pa tsam la gsol ja mngar mo 'bul srol yod pa ni dbyin ji'i lugs srol lha sa'i sku drag gi khrod du dar ba zhig yin/ skabs der mang tshogs kyi khrod du ja mngar mo de tsam gyi dar srol mi 'dug gsol ja mngar mo'i mnyam du zhal tog sna tshogs 'bul gshom byed / dgong dro chu tshod lnga pa tsam la gsol tshigs lte ba 'bul gshom byed pa de ni gzab cing rgyas la sna kha 'dzoms pa/ rin thang che ba'i mtsho thon dngos rdzas sogs gsol sgro'o bshams rjes sku mgron tshor mjal dar re 'bul 134

srol yod pa de ni dmigs bsal gyi gsol chigs rgyas gshom skabs ma gtogs dus rgyun spyir btang gi gsol chigs skabs mjal dar 'bul srol med/gong zhus ltar/ dus skabs de ni bod gzhung bka' shag gis gtsos pa'i las khungs che khag dbyar skyed gtong ba'i dus tshod red 'dug de ni rtse drung dbyar skyid/ drung spyi dbyar skyid/ bka' shag thugs spro sogs gtong srol yod pa phyis sor rtse shod dbyar skyid rla sgril byas/ gsol tshigs de tsho gtong skabs lha sa'i gling kha khag tu gur phub nas spro skyid la rol bar byed/skabs der yab gzhis sku 'khor rnams bka' shag thugs spror gdan zhus ltar phebs/ bka' shag thugs spro zhes pa de bka' shag gzhung gis 'gro gron btang ba zhig min par bka' blon sku sger 'khor res kyis gtong srol yod/ skabs de'i gsol tshigs gtong res ni bka' blon bon shod red 'dug gsol ston rgyas spros ha cang che ba dang / dpon rigs mang che ba dang / bka' blon de'i sku nye skya 'khor nang mi dang bcas gdan zhu byed/ skya mgron rnams gyon chas gzab 'chor legs par spras shing / lhag par lcam dang sras mo tshos rgyan gos 'gran ngom byed pa'i dus tshod gtso bo zhig yin 'dug sku drag mtho rim pa tshos shon pha'i zer ba rgya nag zi khron nas dar ba'i rtsed mo 'khrugs nyams ldan pa zhig yod pa der rol zhing /de 'og tshos mā cang dang / sbag chen sogs rgyag pa red/de min bod lugs kyi sho dang / rtsed mo gzhan dag rtse ba/ rol cha sna tshogs 'bud dkrol byed pa dang bskun nas lang tsho'i me tog gsar pa rnam par bzhad pa'i gzhan nu pho mo mang pos gzhas dang zhabs bro'i dgyes rgur rol bzhin pa 135

des mi rnams yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa'i ngang tshul de lta bu ni re zhig mtho ris kyis dpal la co 'dre ba lta bu snang /de ltar nyin bdun tsam gyi ring dga' ston gyi 'du long la spyod ring yab gzhis sku 'khor tsho'i bzhugs sa khe gtsang gra rgyas go sgrig byas 'dug de rjes gsol ston gzhan khag la gdan zhu byas pa bcas khyon zla ba gnyis tsam ring rgyun mthud nas spro skyid rnam g.yeng kho nas dus 'da' bar byas/ 7rgyal dbang skya phreng 13 pa zhal bzhugs skabs de lta bu'i dus yun ring po dang / rgyas spros chen po byed srol med zer ro/ / 36

le tshan dgu pa/bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi srid 'dzin rtsa 'dzugs dang / 7rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim rjes bod gzhung gi srid dbang 'dzin phyogs thad nang khul dan min byung skor/da༄pho2/ /bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi sgrig gzhi lam lugs ni/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta phyi lo 1543 lor 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos bod rgyal khab khyon yongs kyi chos srid kyi sku dbang bdag gir bzhes rjes sngon chad sa skya dang /phag gyu rin spyangs/ gtsang pa sde srid bcas kyi skabs nas byung ba'i lugs gnyis chos srid kyi lam srol khag gi legs cha bsdu len dang / de bas lhag pa'i dus bstun gsar gtod kyang mdzad de chab srid byed sgo mtha' dag gi 'go 'doms mdzad po sde srid ces pa bsko bzhag bstsal/ sde srid kyi thog ma 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel lam/ bsod nams rab brtan yin/ de ni deng dus rgyal khab kyi srid blon dang mtshungs pa zhig yin/ de 'og gzhung zhabs drung rigs skya ser zhes pa skya bo zhabs rten pha gzhis yod pa'i dpon rigs nyis brgya tsam dang / ser mo ba 'ga' shas bcas chab srid kyi sri zhu bar 137

bsko bzhag bstsal/de rjes rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i chu lug phyi lo 1703 lor sog po rgyal po lha bzang ngam/ lha bzang klu dpal gyis bod kyi rgyal po lo bcu bzhi byed ring bod kyi chab srid lam lugs nang sog po'i lam lugs phran bu 'dres yod/ de rjes pho lha bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis sa bya 1729 lo nas me yos 1747 lo bar lo ngo bco brgyad ring bod kyi srid dbang bzung ba'i skabs man ju lam lugs phran bu dar/ khong 'das rjes khong gi sras chung ba 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis me yos 1747 lo nas lcags rta 1750 lo bar lo ngo bzhi ring srid dbang bzung skabs man ju gzhung gis bod gzhung gi srid dbang la the jus byas par ngo rgol byas nas man ju'i zhi drag dpon dmag rnams bod la bsdad mi chog pa sogs kyis ngo rgol shugs chen spel bar brten man ju lha sdod am ban rgan gzhon gnyis kyis 'gyur med rnam rgyal lkog gsod byas rkyen 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyi rjes 'brang mgron gnyer blo bzang bkris sogs nas dpa' stobs che skyed kyis man ju'i am ban rgan gzhon gnyis de 'phral dmar gsod btang bas mtshon man jur drag po'i rgol thabs shugs che byas stabs rgya mi tshos rtse po tu lar bros nas 7rgyal mchog skal bzang rgya mtsho mchog la srog skyabs yong ba'i gsol 'debs zhu dgos byung ba sogs zhib cha 7rgyal ba'i mdzad rnam du gsal ba ltar dang / de'i phyi lo lcags lug 1751lo 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos bod kyi chos srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes nas chab srid kyi rgyun las byed po bka' shag ches mtho lhan khang gsar gtod mdzad de bka' bron ser mo ba gcig dang / skya bo gsum bcas bka' blon bzhi bsko bzhag mdzad cing / bka' blon ser mo bar bka' blon bla ma zhes 'bod pa ma zad/ bka' blon khri pa'i thugs 'gan bzhes srol yod pa dang /bka' shag lhan khang du bka' blon bzhi'i 'og las bya bka' drung gnyis dang /138

bka' mgron bzhi/ gzim 'gag bzhi/ e drung gnyis bcas sgrig 'dzugs gnang bar bka' shag lhan rgyas zhes su grags/de rjes su las bya phar ma bka' shag shod pa zhes shod drung gnyis gsum tsam gsar du bsko bzhag gnang / bka' shag lhan khang gi tshugs yul ni lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi lho sgo'i steng mdo sbug gnyis yod/me glang 1757 lo 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gshegs rjes bod gzhung nas de mo ho thog thu 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshor rgyal tshab tu bsko bzhag mdzad/ khong ni bod kyi bla ma che ba'i gas nas rgyal tshab mdzad mkhan gyi thog ma yin zhing / 7rgyal ba'i yang srid gdan zhu ma gnang bar rgyal tshab ces pa'i mtshan gnas 'bod pa dang / rgyal ba'i yang srid gdan zhus grub nas rim bzhin sku na son rjes chos srid gnyis kyi thugs 'gan ma bzhes par rgyal tshab kyi mtshan gnas de srid skyong zhes pa'i mtshan gnas su bsgyur nas 'bod pa'i gzhung srol chags /chu khyi 1852 lo bshad sgra dbang phyag rgyal pos bod gzhung gi srid dbang skyong skabs khong bla ma min stabs sngar srol ltar sde srid bshad sgra ba zhes pa'i mtshan gnas 'bod pa red/me lug 1907 lor 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po thub bstan rgya mtshos dga' ldan khri zur blo bzang rgyal mtshan la srid skyong bsko bzhag thog khong gi phyag rogs su bshad sgra ba dang / zhol khang / chang khyim pa bcas gsum la blon chen gyi mtshan gnas bsko bzhag mdzad/ de rjes me stag 1925 lor blon chen zhol khang gi phyag rogs su yab gzhis glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug mchog la srid blon gyi mtshan gnas bsko bzhag mdzad pa bcas kyi srid blon zhes pa'i mtshan gnas de gsar gtod gnang ba zhig yin 'dug139

de 'brel rgyal tshab bam srid skyong / sde srid bcas rim byung de dag gi lhan rgyas tshugs yul la shod gzim chung 'gag ces 'bod pa dang / de'i gtso bo'i 'gan khur mkhan sne mgron zhes pa rtse skor gnas rim bzhi pa'i mkhan chung zhig yod pa dang / de 'og las bya ser mo ba gnas rim lnga pa'i shod mgron zhes pa gsum bzhi 'am skabs re drug bdun tsam yang yod/ de min gnas rim de dang mtshungs pa'i shod gzim 'gag gnyis bcas bsko bzhag gnang lam 'dugade bzhin bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi sgrig gzhi rim bzhin 'phel rgyas su phyin te sgrig 'dzugs khag gnyis nas bkod 'doms gnang gi yod pa de ni ser mo ba'i sgrig 'dzugs de rtse skor dang / skya bo'i sgrig 'dzugs de shod skor bcas rang bzhin gyi khag gnyis su byung /rtse skor ser mo ba rnams kyi 'go 'doms las khungs der rtse yig tshang zer/ rtse yig tshang las khungs la mkhan drung bzhi dang / de 'og yig tshang gnyer pa dang / las bya rtse drung 'ga' shas/ yig tshang slob phrug bzhi/ dbu mdzad ri mo ba zhes pa gcig bcas dang / mkhan drung bzhi po des rgyun du 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs ltar bod yongs rdzogs kyi dgon sde khag gi ser mo ba rnams kyi spyi khyab 'go 'doms kyi 'gan 'khur bzhes kyi yod pa ma zad/ bod gzhung chab srid kyi 'gan dbang yang chen po yod pa dper na/ gzhung zhabs ser mo ba'i dpon rigs khag gi las tshan bsko bzhag dang / phyir 'then sogs kyi dbang cha cha tshang yang yod/sngar srol ltar ser mo ba'i dpon rigs kyi 'byung khungs kyang khag gnyis nas yong ba ste/ gcig ni sger pa khag gi bu phrug dang / gzhung zhabs rtse drung gi spyan mched shag tshang rnams yig tshang slob phrug sogs la bzhugs te slob sbyong byas pa brgyud gzhung zhabs rtse drung zhu ba dang / cig shos de grwa sa chen po gsum sogs 140

kyi grwa khongs nas 'dems sgrug gis mi bab spyan zhu dang 'brel rtse slob grar lo shas ring bod yig dang / hor yig lan dza/ war tu/ chag lo'i yig gsar/'gos lo'i yig gsar/ rin spungs yig gsar/ bstan 'dzin yig gsar bcas slob sbyong byas rjes rim bzhin gzhung zhabs rtse drung gi go gnas bstsal ba'i khongs nas 'gro srol yod/ gong gsal yig tshang las khungs drung che bgres pa'i mtshan gnas rim pa gsum pa tā bla ma yin zhing / de byings rim pa bzhi pa mkhan chung yin/ de 'og yig tshang gnyer pa gnas rim lnga pa yin/shod skor gyi 'go 'doms spyi khyab bka' shag gong du phud/ de 'og rtsis khang las khungs yin/ las khungs der rtsis dpon bzhi yod pa tshang ma skya bo yin pa de rnams gnas rim bzhi pa yin/ rnam kun rtsis dpon tshos bka' shag gi bka' dgongs ltar bod yongs kyi rdzong gzhis khag gi yong 'bab rtsis zhib sogs /skya bo'i dpon rigs rnams kyi sgrig lam kun spyod la lta rtogs byed pa'i 'gan 'khur yod/ lhag par chab srid thog rtse mkhan drung dang / rtsis dpon lhan tshogs der drung rtsis lhan rgyas zhes zer/ de ni dbang nus ha cang chen po yod cing /skabs re bka' shag gi mdzad phyogs la'ang shugs rkyen gyi 'gyur ba gtong thub kyi yod kyang / rtsis khang las khungs gcig pur rtse yig tshang ltar gyi dbang cha de 'dra med/ 'on kyang sngar srol ltar rtsis dpon gyi gnas rim thog nas gnad yod las gnas bka' blon dang srid blon sogs bsko gzhag gnang lam yod pa red/rtsis dpon bzhi yi 'og la rtsis pa gsum dang / yig tshags gcig rtsis phrug pa 'ga' shas bcas yod pa rnams gzhung zhabs sger pa khag gi bu phrug zhe cig yin pa de tsho rtsis khang nang dus yun gang tsam yig rtsis sbyong brdar byas rjes shod drung gi go gnas thob kyi yod pa dang / caspyi srol ltar na sger pa'i bu phrug gzhung zhabs gsar zhugs rigs dang thog 4

rtsis khang las khungs su yig rtsis rgyugs 'phrod ming tho dang 'char gzhi bka' shag brgyud 7gong sa mchog gam/ srid skyong bcas la snyan zhur phul nas chog mchan phyag rtags phebs mtshams shod skor gyi gzhung zhabs gras su tshud pa red/ bod gzhung gi las khungs mang che bar gzhung zhabs ser skya sbrel po gnyis bsko gzhag byed pa dper na/ bod ljongs dmag spyi lhan khang / phyi 'brel las khungs/ rtse phyag las khungs/ bla brang phyag mdzod/ gra bzhi dngul khang / bso nams las khungs /ja tsha las khungs sogs las khungs che khag la ser mo ba dang skya bo'i mi sna zung sbrel yod/ 'on kyang snang rtse shag dang / bsher khang sogs khrims gnon gyi bya ba byed dgos par brten skya bo'i dpon rigs rkyang pa yin/de bzhin rdzong gzhis khag gi 'bab yong bsdu gtong gis mtshon pas gzhung rtsis zhu sgo gsar bzos khag gcig do dam byed po 'bab zhib las khungs/ sbrags tar las khungs sogs rim pa yod pa dang / las khungs che khag la gnas rim bzhi pa'i skya ser zung sbrel bsko bzhag gnang srol yod/ de min rdzong gzhis khag la rtse drung dang / shod drung las sbrel thog bsko brdzong gnang zhing / rdzong gzhis che chung la gzhigs pa'i gnas rim lnga pa dang / drug pa/ bdun pa bcas bsko bzhag gnang srol 'dugade mtshungs mdo khams khul rdzong gzhis khag gi spyi 'doms mdo spyi'am /chab mdo bka' shag ces pa bka' blon gcig gam/ rim pa gsum pa dza sag gi go gnas ོ/da pa ser skya gnyis sam/ gcig bcas rim byung bsko bzhag gnang /de min stod smad shar lho phyogs su nyag spyi dang / chab mdo'i nub byang khul du hor spyi bcas yang bsko rdzong gnang /bar skabs shig nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris bcas kyis sa khul khag bgos rdzong gzhis kyi spyi 'doms su dbus spyi dang / lho spyi/ gtsang spyi/ la stod 42

spyi khyab/ mtsho byang spyi khyab/ dwags kong spyi khyab bcas gsar gtod thog gnas rim bzhi pa dang lnga pa yin pa'i ser skya zung sbrel bsko brdzong gnang /bod gzhung dmag sgar khag gi 'go 'doms mda' dpon rim bzhi skya bo re yin pa dang / de'i 'og ru dpon re zung shod drung khongs nas bsko bzhag gnang ba tsam las/ de min ru brgya mang che bas dmag sgar rang khungs so so'i dmag khongs nas bsko bzhag gnang zhing / dmag 'khrugs sogs dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul byung skabs rtse drung khongs nas kyang drag po'i dmag gi nang du 'go 'doms bsko bzhag gnang srol yod pa bcas so/bod chu bya phyi lo 1933 lo'i rla 10 ches 30 nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgung grangs 58 la phebs skabs glo bur dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i gtam ngan de bod chol kha gsum la yongs su khyab ste bod mi tshang ma yid gdung mi bzad pa'i gnas su gyar zhing / skabs de la 7gong sa mchog gi thugs blo 'gel yul sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang / 7rgyal ba'i sku tshab srid blon yab gzhis glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug rtsis dpon lung shar ba rdo rje che rgyal bcas yin pa khong gsum rang rang so so'i phyogs gtogs rnams kyis bod gzhung gi srid 'dzin gsar pa bsko phyogs kyi 'dod tshul tha dad gyur nas thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi phyogs gtogs tshos srid blon yod mus kyi phyag sbrel du kun 'phel lags bsko bzhag gis srid dbang 'dzin tshul dang / de byings kyi 'dod tshul ni bod chos ldan rgyal khab la song bas srid 'dzin sngar lam ltar bla ma zhig bsko bzhag gnang na legs pa'i bsam tshul brjod mthar bod ljongs tshogs chen mang mos kyis 7rgyal tshab srid 143

'dzin bla ma zhig bsko bzhag gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel nas rtse pho brang du 'phags pa lo ke shu ra'i spyan sngar zan rtags bsgril ba'i 'os khongs su dga' ldan khri pa mi nyag a mi ye shes dbang ldan dang / rwa sgreng hu thog thu 'jam dpal ye shes thub bstan rgyal mtshan / phur lcog sprul sku thub bstan byams pa tshul khrims bcas kyi mtshan shog bsgril nas mchod 'bul dang sbrags bod gzhung gi srid blon dang / bka' shag spyi khyab mkhan po/ drung rtsis/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi khag bcas 'dzoms pa'i dbus su dga' ldan khri zur tre hor byams pa chos grags mchog nas thugs smon bden chig gi mtshams sbyar te zan rtags bsgril bar rwa sgreng hu thog thu'i mtshan thon pa ltar bod shing khyi / phyi lo 1934lo'i rla 1 ches 30 nyin bod gzhung rgyal tshab kyi khri gsol zhus pa dang /skabs der tshogs 'du nas srid blon yab gzhis glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug kyang da mus bzhin rwa sgreng rgyal tshab kyi phyag rogs su thugs 'gan bzhes dgos zhus pa ltar de nyin nas bzung rgyal tshab dang / srid blon gnyis kyi srid dbang skyong ba der rgyal srid lhan tshogs zhes grags/dus skabs der bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas 7gong sa mchog sku gshegs pa'i skor skya bcar rnams la gnas tshul ji byas 'dri brtsad gnang / bod che 10ches 30 nyin 7gong sa mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su ma thim pa'i snga rol thog mar bsnyun gzhi bzhes pa'i skabs na/ bka' shag gi mtshon par sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags nas snyan seng zhu rgyu ma byung ba sogs kyi le thogs la brten nas kong po rtse la sgang du rgyang 'bud du btang / thub bstan kun 'phel lags 144

kyi skye yul lha sa'i nub byang snye mo khul yin zhing / khong ma yi mngal du yod skabs bla mar thugs dam zhus don/ phru gu de'i gegs dbang bar chad sel ched de'i ming la bu mo'i ming bde chen chos sgron zhes btags/ khong byis pa'i dus su spyang grung 'dzoms shing / las la brtson pa zhig yod pa dang / dgung lo 13 tsam la son skabs nor gling pho brang du yig 'bri snye phrug zer ba de'i gas su bskong rgyu gtan 'khel stabs me 'brug phyi lo 1915 lo rang khyim pha ma dang bral te lha sa nor gling pho brang du bcar nas lo shas ring bod yig dbu chen slob sbyong byed du bcug khong gis 7gong sa mchog la bcos min gyi dad gus dang / slob sbyong hur thag byas par brten 7gong sa mchog nas phrug gu de grung po zhig 'dug gsungs nas zhabs zhur nyar gnang ste zhabs zhu hur thag zhus stabs bod lcags bya phyi lo 1921 lor 7gong sa mchog gi sku bcar ngo mar gyur pa dang dus mtshungs bka' 'brel ltar ser byes grwa tshang du grwa pa'i sgrig khongs su zhugs su bcug pa dang sbrags thub bstan kun 'phel zhes pa'i ming bstsal/de nas sku bcar zhabs zhu'i ring gang ci'i zhu sgo 'thus tshang byung stabs sngar las gzigs skyong che ru phyin te chab srid kyi las don thad la'ang 'gan 'khur mdzad du bcug pa de nas bzung khong gi mtshan snyan dang dbang shugs je cher phyin/de rjes 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin bka' shag tu las don gal che'i skor bka' bsdur zhu bar gtong gnang mdzad skabs bka' shag mgron drung brgyud snyan seng ma dgos par thad kur bcar te bka' blon lhan rgyas dang bka' bsdur gnang gi yod cing / bka' blon rnams kyang khong la zhed snang dang / gus zhabs kyi 45

rnam pa ston dgos kyi yod/rjes su 7gong sa mchog nas gzhung gi sgrig gzhi lam lugs ltar gnas rim gsum pa sku bcar tā bla ma'i gdan thob kyi mtshan gnas bstsal yod kyang gzhung zhabs byings ltar las zhwa las gos gyon ma dgos par khong gi gyon chas gtso bo gos chen tshos man gyi la shag dang / sgo snam/ snam bu spu phrugs dang shas ma gang rung tshos mdog rgya smug gi phyu chen bzhes pa red/ 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs ltar khong gis rtse pho brang shar rgyud dang / nor gling skal bzang pho brang bcas la nyams gso byed pa dang / nor gling phyi'i lcags ri gsar skrun/ nor gling spyan gsal pho brang dang / gra bzhi glog 'phrul bzo gra gsar skrun bcas kyi 'go 'doms bkod khyab byas shing / de bzhin khong gi bkod sgrig 'og grong drag dmag mi gsar 'dzugs byas te dmag dkyus rnams rdzong gzhis khag gi grong drag gis bu phrug sha stag yin pa ma zad/ dmag mi'i 'go byed brgya dpon yan skya drag sogs kyi bu phrug sha stag bsko bzhag byas pa dang / dmag sgar de gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i go mtshon sogs kyi mthun rkyen yang legs po yod pas spyan gsal kun 'phel lags kyi dmag sgar red ces zer mkhan byung / grong drag dmag sgar gyi mda' dpon g.yu thog bkris don grub dang / de'i phyag rogs phreng ring 'jigs med sum rtsen sogs bsko gzhag bstsal/sku bcar kun 'phel lags kong po rtse sgang khul rgyangs 'bud du btang rjes phyi lo 1935 lo mjug tu kun 'phel lags dang / rogs pa lcang can gung zur bsod nams rgyal po dang mnyam du rtse lha sgang nas gsang thabs 'brug yul brgyud rgya 146

gar du phebs 'byor gyis dbyin ji gzhung la chab srid kyi nyen g.yol mgo btags zhus te bka' sbug khul du tshong las la brten nas re zhig sa gnas der bzhugs/phyi lo 1951 lor 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen pos lugs gnyis chab srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rjes bka' shag gi bka' 'khrol byung nas khong lha sar phyir phebs kyis de sngon 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rma med zhus pa'i skor dang / sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po zhi dbyings su gshegs rjes ma nyes kha g.yogs kyis nyes chad phog pa bcas kyi skor sku'i gcen po skya bcar spyi khyab mkhan tshab blo bzang bsam gtan brgyud 7gong sa mchog la snyan seng zhus pa dang sbrags bod gzhung bka' shag tu bde sdug snyan zhu phul bar don son gyis gzhung gnas nas khong gi bzhugs khang pho brang gsar pa dang / 'tsho rten bod dngul ṭam rdo stong phrag 'ga' shas bcas bstsal zhing / de bzhin gzhung zhabs shod skor rim bzhi'i gdan thob bcas bkrin bla med bskyangs/spyan gsal kun 'phel lags dang / khong gi phyogs gtogs bcas la byus nyes phog rjes dus yun de tsam ma song bar de sngon thub bstan kun 'phel lags kyi kha gtad gtso bo rtsis dpon lung shar ba'i don rkyen zhes pa de byung zhing / lung shar ni de sngon 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs thugs blo 'gel yul zhig yin pa ltar chab srid kyi dbang shugs chen po yod par brten spyan gsal kun 'phel lags dang dbang shugs thog 'gran rtsod byed pa'i dgra rla gtso bor gyur/7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs ma thag kun 'phel lags mgo mjug slog mkhan gtso bo lung shar gyi brgyud bskul shugs rkyen la brten nas byung ba zhig yin 'dug 47

rtsis dpon lung shar ba rdo rje tsho rgyal gyi skyes yul gtsang khul bzhad mthong smon rdzong 'og rta nag gi sger pa'i gas shig yin/ khong gi chung dus bod kyi rig gnas slob sbyong gnang skabs dge rgan mang po bsten nas yig rtsis sogs la sbyang pa phul du phyin pa ma zad/ bod sman gso rigs kyi slob sbyong yang thon/ dgung lo 20 tsam la bod gzhung gi sri zhu'i zhabs sdod zhus te rtsis khang las khungs kyi rtsis pa bsko bzhag bstsal rjes las ma'i 'jon thang chen po yod stabs rtsis pa lung shar zhes snyan grags chen po byung /phyi lo 1913 lor 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng 13 pa chen pos lung shar rdo rje che rgyal la rim bzhi'i gnas rim bstsal te sger pa'i bu phrug na gzhon bzhi 'dems sgrug gis dbyin yul du slob grwar btang ba'i 'go 'doms su gtong gnang mdzad/ skabs der sger pa'i bu phrug btang ba'i khongs su rtse skor smon grong mkhyen rab kun bzang dang / shod skor rin sgang rig 'dzin rdo rje/ skyid sbyag dbang 'dud nor bu/ 'gog mkhar ba bsod nams mgon po bcas red/ khong gis dbyin yul du lo gcig tsam bzhugs ring dbyin ji'i skad yig phran bu slob sbyong gnang ba dang / lhag par skabs de'i chab srid skyong tshul skor sogs la do snang chen po gnang bar dbyin ji gzhung gis rdugs pa byung nas bshad sgra blon chen la lung shar bod gzhung nas btang ba yin nam zhes dris skabs/ bshad sgras bod gzhung nas btang ba ma red ces lan btab rkyen dbyin gzhung gis dang thog khong la sne len yag po zhus kyang de rjes sne len yang sdug tu btang 'dug yin na'ang 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' yig ngo 'phrod lag khyer yod pa des phan thogs chen po byung /gang ltar khong rang gis 'khyer ba'i gser chas dngul chas phran bu yod pa rnams kyang btsong nas 'gro gron gtong dgos byung 'dug khong gi eng lan nas pha ran si dang / 'jar man/ e ṭa li sogs yu rob rgyal khab khag tu chab srid sogs la 148

rtogs zhib tu phebs 'dugaphyi rgyal nas bod du phyir phebs rjes 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng 13 pa chen pos khong la rtsis dpon gi go ming bstsal thog bod dmag gi dmag phogs 'du 'god 'bab zhib las khungs zhes pa gsar 'dzugs kyi do dam par bsko gzhag bstsal/ skabs der khong rang nas 'bab zhib kyi yong khungs sde dpon mi drag dang /sger pa chos gzhis bcas nas 'bab bzo byas par brten sde dpon khag dang /mtho rim mi sna chos lung shar la mi dga' ba'i gleng phyogs mang po byung yang /7gong sa mchog nas lung shar la gzigs pa chen po dang / thugs blo 'gel yul zhig yin stabs khong la sus kyang gnod 'che gtong ma thub/ lung shar dbyin yul sogs su lta skor du phebs skabs rgyal khab de rnams kyi lam lugs kyis khong gi chab srid bsam blor shugs rkyen thebs yod stabs bod rgyal khab chen po'i lam lugs la bsgyur bcos phran bu gtong dgos par dgongs te skyid phyogs kun mthun zhes pa'i sgrig 'dzugs gsar 'dzugs byas te ser skya dpon rigs na gzhon mang che ba sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang zhugs pa dang / de bzhin se 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi yang zhugs yod/ sgrig 'dzugs de'i kha tsha dgos gtugs kyi byed sgo zhig ni bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi bka' blon rnams las rgyun lo 'khor bzhi re'i gtan 'beb bya rgyu dang / de yang mi 'gro su 'os bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas 'dems shog 'phen rgyu sogs kyi bsam tshul yig thog tu bkod de bod gzhung bka' shag brgyud rgyal srid rnam gnyis la 'bul rgyu de yin kyang / stabs mi legs par don der bar chad byung nas sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang ma'i khongs mi ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas gsang ba'i thog bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal sar phyin te gnas tshul yongs rdzogs bshad pa ma zad/ da dung sgrig 'dzugs de'i dmigs yul dang /da yod bka' blon tshang ma gsod kyi yod tshod bshad par brten skabs der bka' 149

blon khri smon zhed snang dang sbrags lam seng 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar nas gong gsal las 'gul gyi gnas tshul de zhib phra snyan seng zhus thog byed gte gtso bo rtsis dpon lung shar ba 'dzin bzung byed dgos zhes zhus kyang /skabs der rwa sgreng rgyal tshab kyis thog mar zhal bzhes ma gnang yang khri smon nas u tshugs mtha' bkag zhus rkyen rgyal tshab rin po ches zhal bzhes gnang dgos byung 'dug pa de ni rwa sgreng 7rgyal tshab rin po che srid skyong gi thugs 'gan bzhes nas zla gnyis tsam las ma song bas thugs rgyus med pa dang / lhag par sku na gzhon rkyen gyis nyams myong med pa bcas la brten bod kyi lo rgyus thog nor 'khrul chen po zhig byung ba dang / rjes su bod mi rnams la yang gyong chen po zhig phog yod/de sngon rwa sgreng rgyal tshab dang lung shar gnyis 'brel ba yag po yod kyang /rgyal kha blon pos sgyur zhes pa ltar khri smon bka' blon gyi kha dbang du song / khri smon gyis gong gsal gnas tshul zhus rjes khri smon rang nyid lam seng 'bras spungs dgon par nyen g.yol lta bur bros/ rtsis dpon lung shar rdo rje che rgyal gyi phyogs gtogs tshos 7rgyal ba sku phreng 13 pa'i gser sdong gsar bzhengs gegs med lhun grub yong ba dang / mchog sprul yang srid rin po che 'khrul bral gdan zhu thub pa sogs kyi mdzad phyogs la zhen skul yin lugs rtse skor las tshan che chung gcig nas gcig rgyud kyis gtam gleng spel stabs rtse skor mi grangs brgya ma zin tsam gong gsal bsam 'dun der mos mthun lta bu byung yang / mthar gong gsal zhen skul zhu ched kyi gan rgya'i thog ming rtags 'god pa'i gleng mol byung skabs rtse skor mang che ba the tshom gyis ming rtags ma bkod/ lung shar gyi phyogs gtogs shod skor 'ga' shas kyis lkog g.yo'i gtam brjod du rang gzhung gi go gnas bsko 'then drang po rtsa ba nas med pa dper na/ rtsa gnyer dang / shing gnyer/ rtsam gnyer bcas gsum gyong gan yod pa'i las 'gan de shod skor pha gzhis yod pa'i kha gtad rtse 50

drung gra rkyang nas gcog dgos kyi yod/ da phyin chab srid kyi dbang cha 'dzin mkhan bka' blon bzhi'i khongs su rtse skor bka' blon gcig las med pa de'i thog bka' blon gcig bsko bzhag gis rtse shod gnyis re byas na 'tshams po yod pa'i skor rtse skor nang bshad rkyen rtse skor mang pos lung shar gyi las 'gul de srid dbang 'phrog byed kyi lkog g.yo ngan byus yin par rdugs pa skyes te sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang 'dzul rgyur phyir 'then byas/skabs der rtse drung blo bzang bkris /phyis su srid tshab bla ma mdzad mkhan / kyis nga tsho rtse skor la bka' blon bla ma 'phar ma gnang rgyu de ni / phyed brgyad yin min mi shes/ 'gro rgyugs byed min mi shes/ zhes zer ba'i dpe ltar/ nga tsho rtse skor nang bka' blon bla ma'i 'jon thang yod mkhan gcig kyang med/ bka' blon bla ma 'phar ma zhu gi min zhes lan btab nas rtse skor rnams tshogs ra nas kha bral/de rjes lung shar phyogs gtogs nas bka' shag tu snyan zhu 'bul rgyu byas te rtsa gnyer lha'u rta ra thub bstan bstan dar gyis las sbrel khri smon sras dbang 'dud 'gyur med sar phyin te gong gsal gnas tshul gyi lo rgyus dang / bka' shag la snyan zhu phul rgyu byas skor zhib phra bshad par/ khri smon sras kyis/ rim bzhi ka shod pas gsang brda gnang byung bas pā lags kha nyin 'bras spungs la phebs tshar song zhes brjod pas lha'u rta ra'i gsang brda rjes lus thebs pa'i zhabs 'dren zhus/de rjes rtsis dpon lung shar shod 'gag la bka' 'gugs kyis las zhwa las gos phud skabs lham ya gcig nang nas lung shar gyis yi ge zhig bton te khong rang gis zos/ lham ya gcig nang du shod gzim 'gag gis bsngog bsher skabs mthu sngags 'khor lo'i steng khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal mnan zhes bkod skad yongs grags su khyab kyang bden pa yin min mi shes/ de nas lung shar 'dzin bzung gi rtse pho brang po tā la'i shar chen lcog tu bcug cing / gsang gros ther 'don byed mkhan gabya

ka shod pa yang btson khang gi 'khris su btson 'jug yin khul byas/lung shar don rkyen gyi zhib dpyod tshogs chung zhig bsko gzhag gis ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang gi gnas tshul tshang ma bshad pa ma zad/tshogs pa'i dmigs yul bcas kyi thog kha snon yang mang po brgyab yod pa red zer/gang ltar skabs der lung shar rdo rje che rgyal gyis bod rgyal khab kyi bka' blon rnams 'dems shog 'phen dgos zhes gnas tshul zhus pa las skabs der bka' blon rnams gsod rgyu'i bsam tshul de 'dra byung e yod snyam/ de nas zhib dpyod tshogs chung der bka' blon khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal gyi byus bkod shugs snon la brten lung shar rdo rje che rgyal gyi mig 'bras gnyis 'don rgyu'i 'char gzhi bka' shag brgyud rgyal srid lhan tshogs la 'bul skabs rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po ches nga dge slong yin pas/ der phyag rtags gnang thabs med lugs gsung par brten bka' blon tshos nang gros kyis lung shar gyis ru su dmar po'i las 'gul spel lugs kyi ming 'dogs de 'dra zhig bzos nas srid blon glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug la snyan seng zhus te phyag rtags phab pa ltar lung shar gyi dbang po'i dang po mig 'bras gnyis ya nga snying rje spu tsam med pa'i thog nas phyir phyungs te btson du bcug skabs der lha sa'i mang tshogs khrod du/ lung shar bla ma yin zer/mda' mo bskyon gyin bzhugs bzhag dri med kun ldan yin zer/ spyan gnyis sbyin par btang song / zhes pa'i glu gzhas grags yod pa red/gzhung zhabs gras nas le thog yod pa rnams gnas dbyung dang / rgyang 'bud btang zhing / rtsis dpon lung shar gyi mi rgyud rnams bod gzhung gi sri zhu'i khongs su zhugs mi chog pa'i nyes chad btang /lung shar btson khang du bzhugs ring khong gis blo stobs ma nyams par lo ngo bzhi'i ring nyin mtshan ltos med kyis bod kha ba can gyi lha skal 'phags pa spyan ras 52

gzigs la snying dbus nas gsol ba btab pa dang / ma ṇi dung phyur bsags pa red ces go thos byung / khong btson khang du bzhugs skabs sras che dbang rdo rje'i rjes la bka' blon gnang mkhan lha klu che dbang rdo rje can la/ rang re'i gnas tshul de lta bu ni che sngon bsags pa'i las 'bras yin mod/ 'on kyang rgyu rkyen gcig ni/ nga'i las don gyi thabs shes zab po dang / dogs zon yag po ma byung ba'i rkyen yin pa las mi su la yang 'khang ra dang sdang 'dzin bya rgyu med/ lhar par du dgra bor sdang sems 'khon 'dzin de bas byed mi rung / de ni phan thogs med pa'i gzhi yin zhes thengs 'ga' shas gsung byung zhes bka' zur lha klu che dbang rdo rjes phran la gsungs pa dran gyi 'dugarjes su lung shar btson khang nas glod bkrol gnang ste lha klur bzhugs skabs rwa sgreng rin po ches zom phud sku srung mda' dpon la khyed rang lung shar sar bskyod nas khong la mtshams 'dri dang sbrags ltos shog snying rje zhes bka' phebs don ltar zom phud pas lha klur lung shar mjal 'phrad byas skor rwa sgreng rin po cher snyan seng zhus gnang mdzad par rwa sgreng rin po che'i bka' phyir phebs su/ de sngon lung shar gyi gnas tshul byung skabs mig 'bras 'don rgyu'i chog mchan ngas bkod med/'on kyang nga rang rgyal tshab kyi las 'khur gsar par song gshis nyams myong med rkyen gyis mig 'bras rtsa ba nas 'don mi dgos pa'i skyob thabs byed thub ma song /lung shar snying rje/ snying rje/ zhes rwa sgreng rin po ches zom phud sku srung mda' dpon la bka' gnang 'dug pa 'di thog nas rwa sgreng rin po cher thugs 'gyod yod pa gsal por mngon/gang ltar lung shar ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog gsar brje'i dgongs pa 'khor nas lag len bstar mkhan sngon skyod pa zhig red/ 'on kyang dus skabs der bod kyi spyi tshogs nang khong gi las 'gul der gdung sems mnyam skyed byed mkhan med pas 453

thog ngo rgol byed mkhan mang po byung yod/ rgyu rkyen gtso bo ni/ bod rgyal khab de phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba med par sgo bkag nas rang srung gi srid byus rgyun skyong byas pa dang / lhag par mi dmangs tshos sangs rgyas bstan par dad shugs chen po yod pa las chab srid kyi go rtogs de tsam med pa/ 'dzam gling gi gnas stangs 'gyur ldog dang / nub phyogs kyi dpal yon bcas ma rtogs pa'i rkyen red/lhag par bod gzhung gi chab srid zhabs zhu mkhan rnams kyang 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag la dus 'gyur ji 'gro'i gnas bab do snang byed mkhan dkon po yin pas/bzang ngan gyi dbye 'byed ma thub pa dang / srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che yang chos phyogs kyi gsan bsam tsam las chab srid gar stegs thog myong cha gtan nas med par brten bka' blon khri smon lo mang ring bod kyi sri zhu'i 'gan 'khur zhu myong ba ma zad/ de sngon srid blon bshad sgra'i 'og tu las bya yun ring byas pa'i nyams myong can zhig yin pas gang ci'i srid don thog g.yo lhad dran 'khrul goms gshis su gyur pa'i mi rgan zhig gis bka' blon gzhan rnams dang nang gros kyis lung shar ni ru su dmar po'i ring lugs pa yin lugs kyi mi dmangs yongs rdzogs sar gtam gleng sna tshogs spel stabs mang tshogs tshos lung shar ni sangs rgyas bstan par gnod bgegs byed mkhan bdud yin tshul yang shod mkhan byung yod/ dus skabs der bka' shag nang bka' blon bgres pa khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal gang ci'i rgyus mnga'i babs kyis dbang shugs chen po yod 'dugagong zhus ltar skabs der nga tsho lha sar 'byor skabs lung shar gyi las 'gul la pham nyes byung nas ne+e pho mi nga mdun gyi zhol btson khang du yod mus yin zhing /lung shar zhes pa'i mi de sangs rgyas bstan par gnod pa byed mkhan yin pa'i rgyu mtshan rgod bro ba zhig bshad srol la/ mang tshogs khrod du lung shar bdud yin pa'i rtags mtshan ni khong gi rkub la mjug ma thung thung zhig skyes yod ces pa de red/ga54

gal srid lung shar gyi las 'gul la rgyal kha thob yod na/ mi chos khong la bsngags brjod kyi me tog ji 'dra zhig 'thor gyi ma red dam/ de ni 'jig rten gyi chos nyid cig yin/ gang ltar lung shar gyis nga rgyal khengs dregs dang / ngang thung 'tshab tshub kyis srid dbang 'dzin phyogs la sgyur bcos gtong thabs byas shing /gtso che shos ni g.yo can drang rdzus dang / srin po mir rdzus kyi sgrig 'dzugs kyi khongs mi nang ma de tshor rdugs zon lhod g.yeng du song bar brten blos bkal nas snying brkus zhes pa'i dpe de mngon sum du byung nas rang gi che stod du 7rgyal dbang skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i thugs blo 'gel yul gyi zhabs 'degs bsgrub pa'i mi de che smad du rang gi gces pa'i mig 'bras kyang gzhan gyis phyungs pa'i gnas su gyur/ 'on kyang lung shar kyi las 'gul de yang snying bzang ngan ji yin dus rabs kyi 'khor lo mdun du bskyod bzhin pa des lan 'debs phyogs ris spangs pa zhig byas dang byed bzhin par brten las 'gul de rim bzhin bzang po zhig tu mngon bzhin yod/khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal gyis lung shar gyi mig 'bras bton rgyus mtshon dgra 'dul gnyen skyong mdzad 'os gang ci lam lhongs byung ba'i thog bka' blon bgres shos yin pa'i babs sogs gang sa nas srid blon bya rgyu'i re ba 'char yod stabs ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas/ khri smon gyi snga phyi'i mdzad rjes zhib bkod kyis dgongs zhu'i snyan zhu zhig rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po cher 'bul gnang mdzad na srid blon bsko bzhag gnang rgyu'i dgongs gzhi yod nges yin lugs khri smon bka' blon la bshad skad 'dug pa gang ltar na yang khri smon gyis dgongs zhu'i snyan 'bul zhu gnang la dus yun de tsam ma 'gor bar khri smon bka' blon dgongs 'khrol gyi 'go mchan thon/ de'i sngon tsam nas khri smon gyi na bza' bzhes stangs dang / khrom gzhung du phebs stangs/ mdzad spyod bcas gang sa ci'i thad nas rnam kun dang mi 'dra ba zhig 155

byung ba ltar/ mang tshogs tshos de ni sngon chad lung shar gyi mig 'bras bton pa'i las 'bras 'khor ba red ces gleng mol byung ba ma zad//lha sa'i khrom skyur gzhas tshig tu/ mtho dus mtho tshod ma zin/ /mi rje sa dbang chen mo/ /sham thab dkar po bzhes nas/ /smyo 'cham brgyab nas gang yong /zhes btang yod//gong gsal lung shar gyi don rkyen mjug 'gril rjes gzhung 'bangs gnyis kus 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gi gser sdong gsar bzhengs dang / mchog sprul yang srid rin po che 'tshol zhib gdan zhu bcas la brel zing chen po'i ngang lo shas song rjes phyi lo 1939 lor 7rgyal ba'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che lha ldan du gdan zhu dang 'brel phyi lo 1940 lo'i bod rla 1 ches 13 nyin gser khri mnga' gsol zhus nas bod mi rnams kyi bsam blo'i nang dus bde zhod 'jags kyi nyi ma shar rgyu red bsam pa'i dus der rnyog dra gzhan zhig rjes mthud du byung ba ste/ tha'i ji khyung ram don grub rgyal por byus nyes phog pa'i gnas tshul skyug bro po zhig byung /gong lo'i nang bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa tshogs te de'i tshogs gtso drung rtsis thun mong gis 'gan 'khur bzhes te bka' shag gi bka' dgongs ltar 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che mdo smad nas 'khrul bral nges rnyed bod kyi rgyal sa lha ldan du gdan zhu legs grub byung bar brten gdan zhur bskyod mkhan rnams la byas rjes gzengs bstod gnang phyogs skor ser byes ke'u tshang sprul sku sogs ngo las so sos zhu mos shog lhi 'bul dgos phebs don bzhin phul bar tshogs 'du nas gros mol skabs byas rjes can dgos 'os nges sha stag yin pa'i mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyi mos mthun byung ba dang / de mtshams tshogs 'du'i nang nas gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan 156

po dang / tshogs 'thus bcas kyi bsam tshul la 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che gdan zhu mdzad mkhan ke'u tshang rin po ches gtsos ngo las tshang mar byas rjes gnang rgyu tshogs 'thus tshang mas mos mthun gnang ba ltar dang / da dung gtso che shos 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che nges rnyed 'khrul bral brtsad gcod ngos 'dzin thub pa de'i lam ston sgron me lta bu 7rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che'i sku ngal 'dzems med kyi bkrin nyag cig la brten nas byung 'dug gshis dang thog skyabs mgon rgyal tshab rin po cher thugs rje legs 'bul zhig nges par 'bul dgos pa'i gros 'go bton par bsam tshul gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis byung thog rwa sgreng bla brang gi chos gzhis su rdzong gzhis lnga drug tsam 'bul dgos zhus pa dang /drung rigs ser skya'i tshogs 'thus 'ga' shas kyi bod gzhung nas rwa sgreng gtsug lag khang nyams gso gnang rgyu legs tshul gyi bsam 'char mang po zhig zhus/yang kha shas kyis rgyal tshab rwa sgreng gis 7rgyal ba'i mchog sprul rin po che'i yongs 'dzin che ba gnang dgos la/ gsan bsam legs grub mtshams sngar lam ltar rdzong gzhis re zung 'bul srol yod/ da lta rdzong gzhis 'bul rgyu stabs bde med lugs/ gal srid phul na gzhis ka re gnyis 'bul rgyu 'am/ yang na rwa sgreng gtsug lag khang nyams gso zhu rgyu legs gnas dang / de min bsam tshul zhig la gdan sa gsum gyis gtsos pa'i drung rigs ser skya yongs rdzogs nas dngul gang mang bsdus te dngul 'bab de srid skyong rin po cher phul na legs tshul brjod mkhan byung /de skabs tha'i ji khyung ram don grub rgyal pos mi gzhan gyi dngul bsdu rgyu'i bsam tshul la rgyab bskyor byas thog gong gsal gdan sa'i mkhan pos gsungs gsal ltar/ gzhung gzhis mang po legs 'bul zhu rgyu 'gab min dang / ri bo zos 157

kyang mi 'grangs pa dang / rgya mtsho btungs kyang mi ngoms pa yin lugs kyi go rgyu'i tshig nan mang po bshad par gdan sa'i tshogs 'thus rnams kyis dgag lan shugs che brgyab pas phan tshun tshig mtshon 'debs res rno ngar can du gyur te gnas tshul de'i thog nas khyung ram don grub rgyal por byus nyes phog pa red/de sngon skya bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang / rtsis dpon lung shar gnyis la byus nyes phog pa dang / da lam khyung ram la byus nyes phog pa'i gnad don de dag ngo bo tha dad cig yin pa ste/ gnas tshul snga ma de gnyis kyi ngo bo ni/ srid dbang 'phrog rtsod byas nas mthar pham nyes kyi 'bras bu byung ba'i byus nyes shig dang /khyung ram gyi gnas tshul gyi ngo bo de rang nyid nas gzhung drang lhag bsam zol med kyi tshog kha thal ba'i rkyen gyis byus nyes phog pa zhig las chab srid thog gi dbang cha'i thob thang dang / rang nyid la khe bzang thob ched min zhes zer yang skabs der mi 'ga' shas kyis tha'i ji khyung ram don grub rgyal pos de 'dra shod dgos pa ni de sngon rwa sgreng rgyal tshab kyis khong la bka' blon gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes byung yang mthar bka' blon gyi go gnas de yab gzhis phun khang gung la gnang ste khong rang la ma byung ba'i khong khro'i rkyen kyis red ces zer mkhan yang yod/ gang ltar khyung ram don grub rgyal por byus nyes phog rgyu'i gnas tshul khong gis thos 'phral nor gling du rgyal yab chen mo'i skya mdun du bcar nas mgon skyabs zhu re byas kyang rgyal yab chen mo sa mtha' mdo smad nas phebs te dus yun de tsam ma song bas gnas tshul gsal po ma ma khyen pa'i ngang rwa sgreng bla brang gis khyung ram rgyal yab kyi sku mdun du bcar ba'i gnas tshul thos ma thag rgyal yab kyi sku mdun du mi sna ched brdzongs kyis da res khyung ram mi ngan de'i kha la ma gsan rogs gnang zhes rgyu rkyen mang po zhus stabs khyung ram la rogs ram gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes rang bzhin gyis med par gyur/ 58

gong gsal bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i tshogs mi gdan sa gsum gyi 'thus mi phud/ 'thus mi gzhan rnams kyis khyung ram gyi bsam tshul la rgyab skyor byas pa ma zad/ phan tshun gyi bsam tshul rtsod gleng rno ngar dza drag tu gyur/ tshogs 'du'i tshogs gtso drung rtsis nang ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma ma gtogs drung rtsis gzhan rnams kyis khyung ram la rgyab skyor gyi bsam tshul ji snyed bton yod par brten tha'i ji khyung ram don grub rgyal po la lam seng bka' nyes gtong ma thub/ rjes su ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas khyung ram don grub rgyal po'i gnas bab la gzhigs te ngan bskul gyis hor tsho pa so dgu'i mi ser spyi mgrin nas rgyal blon mtshan 'khod kyi snyan zhu phul gsal/ tha'i ji khyung ram pas hor spyi'i las 'khur byed skabs hor tsho pa'i mi ser thog brdab gsig sngar na ma grags pa btang lugs bde sdug snyan zhu phul bar brten zhib gcod drung rtsis bzhi sbrel bsko gzhag gis khyung ram 'bod par snga rjes btang yang / zhib sar ma bcar bar brten khyung ram 'dzin bzung gis zhib gcod sar khrid cing las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung gis btson du bcug pa ma zad/mkhar dngos gzhung bzhes kyis sgo thel brgyab nas zhib gcod tshogs chung gis khyung ram shag tu yig rigs 'tshol zhib byas pas khyung ram gyis hor tsho'i snyan zhu phul ba'i zhu lan gyi zin bris nang du rtsis dpon ka shod pas hor tsho'i 'go pa re gnyis lha sar 'byor bsdad yod pa de tshor ngan skul dang ngan bslab kyis snyan zhu de 'bul du bcug pa zhig yin zhing / nga tshos gzhung bsam spyi don gyi ched du bshad pa'i bsam 'char rtsa don du 'khyer nas mi sger la nag med nyes 'gel ched du bzo mkhan kha gtad gtso bo ni rtsis dpon ka shod pa yin cing / zhib gcod tshogs chung gi gras su ka shod pa yod stabs de'i mdun du zhu ba rtsa ba nas 'bul thabs bral gshis nga la bden rgyab rogs mgon yod pa sogs gsal por 'khod yod pa dang / snyan zin de'i nang du yig gzugs mi 'dra ba gnyis kyis bcos brgyab yod pa der tshig 159
