'bru nyi shu tsam yod pa de ni bka' blon bon shod che brtan rdo rje'i phyag bstar ma yin/snyan zhu'i gsham du bcos brgyab pa de dga' byang bstan pa'i yig gzugs red ces shod mkhan byung 'dug gnas tshul des rkyen khyung ram la byus nyes byung rjes bka' blon bon shod che brtan rdo rjes spun nye'i 'brel ba tsam la lta skyong gis snyan zhur bcos brgyab pa zhig yin par brten rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dgongs 'gal du gyur pa'i gnas tshul bka' blon bon shod la rwa sgreng bla brang gi zhabs gas nang ma zhig gis gsang brda btang 'phral bka' blon bon shod kyis lam seng bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs sar bcar te rgyal tshab rwa sgreng mchog la dbu 'dren gyis bka' blon gnas dbyungs mi yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus yod pa dang / phyin chad bka' blon bla ma'i bka' gsung ci sgrub zhu rgyu'i mna' 'jog gi khas len zhus par brten bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po che'i sku mdun du bon shod la nor 'khrul byung yod rung / da lam bka' blon gnas dbyung med pa dang / gal srid bon shod gnas dbyung btang che nga yang las zhabs chabs cig dgongs pa zhu gi yin zhes tha nan zhus par brten bka' blon bon shod la bka' nyes phran bu las gnas dbyungs ma gnang ba sogs kyi skor de snga phran rang rgya gar bka' blon sbug tu rwa sgreng bla brang gi gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan sar sdod ring gong gsal gnas tshul rnams nga la zhib phra gsungs byung /skabs der zhib gcod tshogs chung gi snyan zhu'i zin bris de gtso bor bzung ste de'i tshig gnad dang / lhag par du snyan zin thog bzo bcos rgyag mkhan su yin sogs 'dri zhib nan po rim pa byas par khyung ram nas mu mthud mkhregs bzung byas stabs lus steng du rta lcag snga rjes thengs gsum btang nas rkub sa la 'dzugs ma thub pa chags kyang ngos len ma zhus par zhib gcod tshogs chung gis dpyad mtshams 'char gzhi bka' shag brgyud rgyal tshab rwa sgreng la phul bas phyag rtags 160

dgongs don ltar khyung ram don grub rgyal po'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes thog ru thog rdzong la phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyang 'bud du sngar srol ltar glang la bskyon te btang pa dang /dga' byang bstan pas snyan zin sogs bzo bcos brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis gsang sngags chos rdzong du gong bzhin rgyang 'bud btang /sngar srol ltar bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gis gzhung zhabs gnad yod rim bzhi yan gyi dpon rigs khrims sar thug skabs rta lcag gtong srol med pas skabs der dga' ldan khri pas mtho rim dpon rigs la rta lcag gtong srol med lugs skor rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po cher snyan seng zhus kyang gsan dgongs ma byung bar gang ltar lo mang ring bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag zhus pa ma zad/ lhag par mdo smad phyogs su lo mang ring rgya dmag gis bod sar btsan 'dzul byas par phar rgol gyi g.yul phyogs su zhabs 'degs ji snyed zhus pa'i khyung ram mi rgan der rta lcag snga phyi tsha nan btang ba'i thog sa thag ring por rgyang 'bud du gtong khar thon lcag zhes pa rta lcag sum brgya tsam btang ba red ces go thos byung /gong zhus ltar bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa'i tshogs 'du'i thog khyung ram gyi bsam 'char la rgyab bskyor lta bu'i bsam tshul 'don mkhan gtso bo mkhan drung dom po ba mkhyen rab dbang phyug dang / rtsis dpon las tshab klu khang pa rnam gnyis byung 'dug de nas khyung ram rgyang 'bud du btang nas ring por ma thogs par dom po mkhyen rab dbang phyug mkhan drung nas mkhan chen la gnas spar bsko gzhag byas pa de ni go gnas 'phar yang chab srid kyi dbang nus med par gyur pa zhig red/skabs der lha sa'i mang tshogs khrod kyi gzhas tshig tu/ dom gyi mkhris pa bton song / khyung gi sder mo bcag song / yul lha'i rten mkhar bshig song / cig

klu rgyal gzab gzab gnang shog ces btang ba dang / de mtshungs klu khang par gnas tshul 'di yin med par nyes chad gnang bde ma byung bar brten/ mang tshogs khrod du de snga'i gzhas tshig la phran bu bcos brgyab ste/ khyung gi sder mo bcag song / dom gyi mkhris pa bton song / klu la phog thug btang na/ bud dang shu shar thon yong / zhes btang /de sngon skya bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang / rtsis dpon lung shar la jus nyes phog pa de rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po cher le khag med cing / rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che mchog gi rgyal ba'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che sa mtha' mdo smad nas 'khrul bral gdan zhu gnang ba'i byas rjes su bod gzhung gi rdzong gzhis mang po thugs rje legs 'bul du 'bul dgos zhes bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i thog gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po rnams dang / 'thus mi bcas kyi dgongs 'char bton pa de la khyung ram gyis dgag lan brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis khyung ram la byus nyes byung ba ma zad/ rta lcag gi dka' sdug mang po zhig myong dgos byung / de bzhin khyung ram mi tshang gi mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btang ba bcas skabs der byung ba'i gnas tshul de rnams thos skabs zhib phra'i rgyu rkyen ma rtogs kyang lugs srol de ni yag po ma red snyam pa byung / rjes su 'brel ba yod pa'i mi sna re zung 'brel 'dris skabs gong gsal gnas tshul skor gyi 'byung stangs bka' 'dre zhus par rtsa ba khyung ram la bden pa yod bzhin du mi gzhan gyis rgyal tshab rin po che dgyes mnyes yong thabs su rdzun bzo g.yo zhus kyis rkyen pas nyes chad phog pa des rjes su rwa sgreng bla brang la jus nyes phog pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi sa bon zhig btab nas bzung chab srid gar stegs thog gi gzi brjid nyams dmas su 'gro ba'i 'go tshugs so//162

ru 65na bca pa( 14 ri su /yab gzhis stag 'cher gyi gnas stangs dang /kho bo pha yul la bu lon bsdu bskyod skor/༄༅༅/ /bod gzhung gi sngar srol ltar 7rgyal ba'i yab rje mchog la gzhung sa mchog nas gung gi mtshan gnas phul ba dang / bzhugs gral ni bka' blon rnams kyi gong du bzhugs chog pa red/ de bzhin yab gzhis stag 'cher ba sa thag ring po mdo smad nas phebs par brten gang ci'i thad gzhung gnas nas gzigs skyong gnang dgos stabs 'tsho 'dzin zhes pa drung rtsis gnyis bsko bzhag bstsal te khong gnyis kyis yab gzhis 'tsho skyong gi ched du lta rtogs gnang zhing / skabs der 'tsho 'dzin mkhan drung lcog steng thub bstan nor bzang dang / rtsis dpon 'bre yul ba yin/khong rnam gnyis gza' 'khor re re'i nang yab gzhis su thengs re zung phebs te rgyal ba'i yab yum rnam gnyis la bka' slob dang bka' bsdur gnang nas thugs mkho ji dgos gzhung la snyan seng gis 'brel yod las khungs khag la bka' khyab gnang ba ltar 'bul gyi 'dug pa dang / khong rnam gnyis kyi nang nas rtsis dpon 'bri yul bas thugs 'khur che bzhes gnang ba ma zad/ khong ni mi gshis bzang po dang /7rgyal ba'i yab yum rnam gnyis la brtsi bkur chen po gnang mkhan zhig yin/463

dus yun mi ring bar gzhung gnas nas 7rgyal ba'i yab gzhis la sngar lam ltar 'khyongs thebs su gtsang khul rgyal rtse rdzong 'og 'brong rtse gzhis ka dang /lhun rtse rdzong 'og bya yul gzhis ka/ sbyor ra gzhis ka/ lha sa'i nye 'khor nub byang stod lung khul zas zhim gzhis ku lha sa'i skyed chu'i lho ngos sne'u gzhis/ nor gling pho brang gi byang 'dabs su rgya mtsho smad gzhis chung bcas khyon gzhis ka che chung khag drug gi sa khang sa zhing sogs kha 'dzin gtan 'jags kyi 'go mchan bka' gtan dang bcas gsol stsal byung zhing /phyi lo 1943 lo la sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang lhan du lha sa rwa sgreng bla brang du rgya yig slob sbyong lo ngo gcig ma zin tsam bskyod de rgya yig dge rgan rmā pa'o zhon gzugs po bde min gyis dgongs pa zhus par brten phran gnyis kyang rgya yig slob sbyong byed mtshams 'jog dgos byung / de nas rla gcig tsam gyi rjes skya yi gcen po rgya lo don grub dang blo bzang bsam gtan gnyis lha sa tar khang slob grwar bod yig slob sbyong du sngon tshud nas gra sgrig gnang ste nyin ltar nor gleng nas lha sa tar khang slob grar slob sbyong du phebs kyi yod/ skabs der mdo smad pha yul nas zing tshong mang po 'byor stabs re zhig de rnams la sne len rogs ram bya rgyu dang /7rgyal yab mchog la phyag rogs zhabs phyi rtsag rtsig zhu dgos byung bar brten/ nga rang khong gnyis lhan du slob sbyong du bskyod pa'i go skabs ma byung / de'i rjes tsam la sger zas zhim pa'i lha sa'i shag dang / stod lung zas zhim gzhis bcas gzhung gnas nas yab gzhis stag 'cher la gsol ras gnang ste/ 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis kyis phran bza' 'tsho gnyis la lha sa zas zhim shag de bdag sprod du 'gro dgos zhes bka' phebs pa bzhin phran gnyis lha sa zas zhim shag tu spos/164

de nas bzung sku'i gcen po rnam gnyis nyin ltar lha sa nas nor gling du phebs ma dgos par zas zhim shag tu phran tsho dang mnyam du bzhugs/ phran tsho zas zhim shag tu spos pa nas bzung rgyal yab dam pas dus rtag tu chibs sgyur gnang gi yod pa dang / skabs re nyin shas nga tsho dang mnyam du bzhugs kyi yod/khong bzhugs pa'i ring sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma ma gtogs nga tsho tshang mas khong la gus brtse dang / 'jigs snang gi rnam pa zhig ston gyi yod/ khong ni rgyun du gzhi rtsa'i thugs rgyud bzang po dang byams snying rje chen po yod kyang / skya rlung de khyug tsam las ma bsdad par lam seng zhi 'gro gi yod/ skabs re nga tshos las ku'i nang nor 'khrul chen po byung nas de ring 7rgyal yab mchog nas bka' bkyon gnang rgyu thag chod snyam nas 'jigs snang chen po byung yang / bka' bkyon gtan nas ma gnang ba yang yong gi yod/ sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mar sku rlung gtan nas ma bstan par sras sros gzhan las lhag pa'i byams po gnang gi yod/pha yul nas yong ba'i zing tshong rnams pha yul du phyir log skabs khong la tshong rtsa g.yar rogs zhus par mang nyung la ma ltos pa g.yar po gnang zhing / gal srid yab gzhis rang la phyag dngul med pa'i skabs 'khel na bod gzhung skyed gtong las khungs khag nas g.yar te khong tshor gnang ba dang / gzhung gi las khungs nas kyang skabs 'phral g.yar thabs ma byung na/ rgyud grwa stod smad nas g.yar nas khong tshor gnang gi yod / zing tshong pas dus thog ma sprad stabs de rnams yab gzhis rang gi bu lon du gyur nas bu lon chen po chags pa red/7rgyal yum chen mo skabs re nga tsho'i sar phebs kyi yod pa dang / rgyun du gsol tshigs legs po de 'dra bzos nas phran tshor bskyel bar gtong ba gnang 165

gi yod/ skabs re rgyal yab mchog nas phran tshor bka' bkyon gnang skabs rgyal yum chen mos nga tsho'i phyogs su bzhengs kyi yod/ lhag par du phran la khong gi sras sros las lhag pa'i byams skyong gnang gi yod/ de bzhin yab gzhis zhabs gas rnams la yang thugs brtse ba'i thog nas ma ltar gyi byams skyong gnang ba las/ su gcig la yang sku rlung bzhengs pa dang bka' bkyon gnang ba byung myong med/ gal srid nga tsho dang zhabs gas rnams kyis las ka nor 'khrul zhig byung ba yin na/khong gi thugs brtse che zhing gzi rngam ldan pa'i ngang nas da lam nor 'khrul byung yod kyang / ma 'ongs par gzab gzab tan tan byed dgos zhes bka' gnang gi yod stabs tshang mas khong gi gzi rngam dang / thugs brtse der gus bkur chen po zhu gi yod pa dang / slad khong gi thugs dang 'gal yong snyam pa'i bag zon ha cang chen po zhig ngam ngam shugs kyi yong gi yod pa las/ khong la brtsi bkur mi zhu mkhan gcig kyang med/zas zhim du spos nas bzung phran yang sku'i gcen po rnam gnyis dang lhan du tar khang slob grwar bod yig slob sbyong du 'gro rgyu dang / tar khang slob grwa de nga tsho bzhugs khang zas zhim dang thag nye po yin pas bar thag gom pa 300 lhag tsam las med/ slob grwa de'i dge rgan ni bod gzhung gi ser mo ba'i dpon rigs gnas rim bzhi pa mkhan chung gi go gnas yod gli zhig yin/ khong gi mtshan la chos ldan bstan dar dang / gzhung gi mtshan tho'i nang rong dpal lhun thub bstan bsam 'phel zhu/ khong gis thog mar tar gtong len dang / de rjes lha gnyer/ de rjes bla phyag rjes su bkris lhun po'i dza sag bla ma gnang ba red/ mi tshang mas khong la tar khang chos ldan lags zhes zer/ skabs der bod gzhung bla phyag las khungs 166

kyi do dam pa'i gas shig yin pas nyin ltar las khungs la phebs dgos kyi 'dugakhong rgyun du skya rlung ha cang bzhengs po yod pas slob phrug tshos khong la zhed snang chen po byed/ khong las khungs su phebs ring rgan bdag gcig gis dge rgan chen mo'i tshab byas nas slob phrug rnams kyi kun spyod dang / yi ge 'bre klog bcas la lta rtog byed/ rgan bdag ces pa de slob phrug rgan pa'i nang nas kun spyod legs la yi ge legs pa dang / sdod tshugs pa zhig la bsko srol yod/ slob phrug tshos khong la dge rgan nang bzhin gyi brtsi bkur dang / zhed snang byed kyi red/ skabs re rgan bdag 'ga' shas rgan lags las tsha 'chun che ba yod/ rgan lags ma bzhugs ring slob phrug tshos spyod lam 'tshub po byas na rgan bdag des dbang cha bed spyod byas nas bkod pa shod kyi red/tar khang slob gru zhes pa'i ming thogs stangs ni/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon skya phreng 13 pa chen po zhal bzhugs skabs tar khang dge rgan chos ldan bstan dar sku gzhon nu'i skabs rgya gar bka' sbug khul gyi hom si slob grwar dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong dang sbrags tar gtong stangs slob sbyong du btang ste/ lo ngo gsum tsam slob sbyong byas rjes tar 'phrin gtong stangs legs par thon nas rgyal khab tu phyir bskong gis bod gzhung sbrag tar las khungs kyi do dam par bsko bzhag gnang nas khong gis las 'khur bzhes te khong phyag las gnang yul dang / bzhugs yul chabs gcig tu yin stabs tar khang slob grwa zhes pa'i ming de grags/khong phyag bris yig gzugs ha cang yag po yod stabs las zhor du slob grwa de gnyer zhing / slob grwa de'i nang gi mang che ba gzhung zhabs ser skya'i bu phrug dang /shag tshang che rigs yin/ dus skabs der tar khang slob grwa zhes pa lha sa'i slob grwa 167

khag nang mtshan snyan chen po yod la/ slob phrug kyang slob grwa gzhan las mang ba yod/phran dang thog bod yig slob grwa der slob sbyong du zhugs skabs bod yig slob sbyong gi goms gshis de tsam med pa dang / bod yig gi shes tshad ha cang dman par brten dka' ngal phran bu 'phrad byung / gang yin zer na/ phyogs gcig nas rang nyid slob phrug gzhan las lo na che ba dang / gnyis nas bod yig gi gnas tshad zhan po yin stabs slob phrug chung chung mnyam du sbyang shing thog ka kha skam bris sbyong brdar byed skabs 'cher snang chen po yong gi yod/ rla ba gnyis ring sdug rus byas nas ka kha kho na sbyang ba yin/ de rjes dge rgan gyi tshug ring la phab/ zla shas rjes sheg bu'i thog tu 'bri ru bcug byung / spyir btang byas na slob phrug chung ba rnams ka kha gcig pu lo re gnyis sbyong dgos kyi yod/ skabs re phran gyi yig gzugs dang /klog stangs bcas ha cang zhan po yod kyang / rgan lags kyis nga'i sdug bsngal de mkhyen nas 'phral 'phral shog thog tu phab pa zhig yin par snyam/ tar khang slob gar lo gcig tsam bod yig slob sbyong byed skabs 7rgyal yab mchog gis khyed rang gnas skabs slob grwa bzhag nas pha yul du khyug tsam bskyod dgos/ gang yin zer na de sngon zi ling ngo shes khag la dngul g.yar ba rnams kyi skyin tshab da bar ma 'byor bar brten bu lon de dag len par 'gro dgos gsungs byung /gong zhus ltar bar lam pha yul nas rgyal yab kyis thugs ngo mkhyen pa'i zing tshong rnams lha sa nas mdo smad du phyir log skabs rgyal yab skya mdun nas ma dngul g.yar po zhus ta gang la gang 'tshams g.yar po gnang ba da bar skyen tshab 'bul rgyu ltar bzhag yi ge zhig kyang btang 'byor ma byung bar brten yab gzhis rang la sku ngal chen po 'phrad yod pa red/ gnas tshul de dag gis rkyen pas 168

zing tshong rnams kyi sa nas bu lon rnams ded par 'gro dgos gsungs byung zhing /lha sa nas mdo smad du 'gro dus 'char can dgan thog 'khel gyi yod stabs phyi lo 1943 rla 10 tsam la nga rang lha sa nas zing tshong rnams dang mnyam du nag chu brgyud phyogs thon gyi gra sgrig byas pa bzhin tshong zog snam bu dang / spos/ rgya zog bcas do po brgya lhag tsam brgyab ste ches bzang zhig dang bskun te lha sa nas thon bskyod byas pa dang / phran gyi las rogs su gtsang 'dus byung nas yin pa'i phur bu zhes pa'i tshong dpon zhig btang gnang byung / khong de snga lo ltar zi ling du thengs re zung 'gro myong yod pa'i tshong dpon zhig yin pa dang / 7rgyal yab mchog dang thugs 'dres kyang yod stabs brtan cha'i ched du phran gyi las rogs su gtong gnang ba dang / de min g.yog po bzhi gtong gnang mdzad/lha sa nas thon rjes 7rgyal yab mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs sar mjal zhu chibs drel legs po zhig khrid nas zhogs pa chu tshod dgu pa tsam la skyabs zhur bcar skabs khong rang gzim chung ka phebs 'og tu khrus rgyag bzhin pa'i skabs thugs 'phrad byas byung / phran gyi mjal dar zhig btang nas rgyal yab chen mo'i bka' 'brel ring min mdo smad zi ling du 'gro dgos byung song bas/ lha sa nas rta khal sum bcu tsam dang / nag chu nas gdang la phar rgyab bar so dmag bzhi tsam gtong gnang skyabs 'jug yod pa zhes zhus par/ khong gos rngam zil gyi bzhin ngo nag po bsdus nas sras sku zhabs/ de skor bka' drung brgyud nas zhu dgos/ rgyal yab chen mos chibs drel gnang ba de thugs rje che zhu rogs zhes pa las gzhan gang yang zer ma byung / de nas rang nyid phyir log byas rjes ba/nas tshul rnams rgyal yab chen mor snyan seng zhus/ de rjes 69

yab gzhis phyag mdzod kyis bka' drung brgyud bka' shag la snyan seng zhus par nyin shas rjes don smin son byung / thog mar yab gzhis phyag mdzod nas/ da lam de skor don smin son thabs dka' bas drel phul na 'phro brlag red ces bsam tshul zhu myong ba de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ de'i snga lo nas bzung bka' shag nas yab gzhis la phran bu'i gzigs phyogs yod pa'i rnam 'gyur 'dra min thon skabs khong tshor dogs 'char byung ba zhig red/ de 'brel yab gzhis 'tsho 'dzin mkhan drung lcog steng thub bstan nor bzang sar bar lam nas bka' slob zhu bar btang rung bcar sa ma rag pa dang / bcar sa rag na'ang las brel che tshul gyis 'khur chen po ma bzhes pa'i gnas tshul byung / skabs der khong gi phyag sbrel rtsis dpon 'bri yul gzhung gnas nas gnas dbyung btang ba'i tshab gsar bsko bzhag yong ba zhes bka' shag la zhabs skul yang yang zhus kyang don son ma byung bar brten tshang mar dogs 'char byung ba red/ gong gsal zhu don la don smin bka' bzang phebs rjes tshang ma dga' 'tshor chen po byung /bod rla 10 pa'i nyin zhig gi snga dro phran tsho lha sa nas nag chu bar dngos zog rnams rta khal la bkal te rdog thon gyis nyin bdun bskyod de nag chur 'byor/nag chur ma slebs gong gi nyin gsum ring gsang gzhung sa khul brgyud nas 'gro skabs gnam gshis ha cang grang ngad chen po byung / skabs der nag chu'i gnam gshis kyang de dang 'dra ba zhig red 'dug nag chu rdzong de byang spyi'i ming thog bsgyur nas byang spyi'i bzhugs gnas gtso bo de nag chu yin/ skabs der byang spyi mkhan chung pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan dang / rim bzhi gsum mdo ba rgyal mtshan yon tan gnyis red/ de khul gyi mi rnams kyis byang spyi pha lha bar zhed snang dang / brtsi 170

'jog chen po byed kyi 'dugaphran tsho nag chur 'byor ba'i sang nyin byang spyi pha lha'i skya mdun du bcar te bka' shag gi bka' 'khrol mdzad pa'i nag chu nas gdang la phar rgyab bar so dmag bzhi gtong dgos pa'i skor skyabs 'jug zhus te ka tor de tsam med pa'i ngang nas bka' 'khrol dang / nyin gsum gyi rjes pha lha'i phyag mdzod phran rnams sar so dmag ngo sprod byed par btang byung / nag chur nyin lnga tsam lhod sdod byas rjes ma thon gong zing tshong tshang ma mnyam 'dzoms kyis lam phyogs 'gro phyogs dang / gang ci'i thad gros bsdur byas te thab khag khyon bsdoms 12 la mi 'bor 50 tsam yod/ thab khag re la rta re gnyis las khrid rgyu med/ de bzhin me mda' yang khyon bsdoms bcu tsam las med/ phran gyis bzhon pa'i rta de zing rta yin pa las mang che ba'i bzhon rta hor rta zhe gcig yin pa ni hor rta de dgun dus grang ngar chen po 'khyog thub mkhan zhig yin/ zog tshang ma khal g.yag sha stag la bkal nas dbor 'dren byed/ skabs der nga tshos khal g.yag sum cu tsam dang / rnga mong nyi shu tsam khrid yod/ sbyin bdag tshos rta bzhon pa las de min tshang ma rkang thang mar yin/ gnam gshis grang ngar che bas chu tshod re gnyis ma gtogs rta bzhon mi thub/ skabs der nga tsho tshong 'grul rnams la me mda' de tsam khyer rgyu med stabs da lam so dmag bzhis skyel srung byas pa der tshang ma blo bde po byung / khong tshos dbyar dus las dgun dus jag rkun gyi nyen kha che ba 'dug zer/ de ni dgun dus dbus phyogs nas mdo smad du 'gro mkhan tshong 'grul rnams me mda' 'khyer rgyu nyung ba dang / rgya zog mang po 'khyer rgyu yod stabs jag shog gis bcom rgyu'i nyen kha yod/ga7ga

spyir btang byas na nyin re me le bdun nas bcu'i bar las 'gro thub kyi med/ nag chu nas thon te zi ling du ma 'byor bar rla phyed gsum tsam 'gor gyi yod/ lam thag de'i ring gdang la bar 'brog pa'i sbra gur re gnyis tsam las gzhan gang yang mthong rgyu med cing / gdang la brgal nas tshu 'dam bar zla gnyis tsam ring 'brog sde yang mthong rgyu med/ lag rdo rnams rkang bgrod sha stag byas stabs re zung la dug brgyab nas nad mnar dang / 'das grongs song ba yang re gnyis byung song / gdang la ma brgal gong nyin ltar kha ba lhub lhub tu babs nas yul lung thams cad dngul mdog ltar skya thing nger gyur/ ri skyes srog chags rnams za rgyu rnyed dka' bas khyu bsgrigs nas lung gzhung dro sa phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs kyis bza' chas 'tshol bar byed/ gcan gzan dred mong 'ga' shas phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs kyis ri dwags stobs zhan rnams bzung thabs byed/ kha ba nyin ltar babs pa'i rkyen gyis 'gro lam yang rnyed dka' ba'i gnas tshul mang po byung /skabs re lam nor thebs nas gang 'tsham bskyod thal byung song yang / nga tsho'i nang lam bu der thengs mang bskyod myong mkhan gyis lam rgyus byed mkhan yod pas de tsam gyi dka' ngal chen po 'phrad ma song / 'on kyang zhag sar slebs skabs me shing rnyed ma thub par phar rgyugs tshur rgyugs kyis me shing 'tshol dgos pa des dka' ngal cung zad byung / rnam kun kha ba ma babs pa'i dus su chu mig yod sa dang / rtsa kha bzang sar 'brong dang / rkyang gi lci ba dang / rta sbang rnyed kyi yod/skabs re phran gyis gzhan rnams dang 'dra bar rkang bgrod byas pa'i rkyen gyis la dug brgyab ste lus po mi bde ba byung nas nga tsho mnyam du yod pa'i sog po em rje bla rgan zhig gis rtsa gzigs nas khong gis/ khyed rang gi nad gzhi de la dug red 'dug 172

pas nga la sman yang 'khyer yag med/ khyed rang nyin ma gsum ring zhogs pa snga langs thog rang gi gcin pa dkar yol gang tsam btung na nad gzhi drag gi red gsungs bzhin de'i sang nyin nas snga dro ngas khong gi man ngag ltar 'thung pas nyin gnyis pa'i thog gzugs po phal cher drag pa lta bu byung zhing / nyin gsum rjes seng drag tu phyin song /nag chu kha nas thon te gdang la ma brgal tsam gyi bar lam gzhung g.yas g.yon 'ga' shas dang / de'i nye 'gram gyi sa gshongs 'ga' shas su rgan byis pho mo'i shi ro mang po mthong rgyu 'dug pa nga tsho mnyam du khrid pa'i so dmag gis brjod gsal/ shi ro de rnams mdo smad khul nas bros yong ba'i ha sag mi rigs kyi gras red/ snga lo de rnams nga tsho'i sa khongs su 'byor nas rang re'i 'brog sde khag gi sems can dkar nag mang po 'phrog bcom gyis 'brog sde'i mi dmangs la brdab gsigs ji snyed byung ste rang gzhung bkrin can gyi thugs rjes byang spyi pha lhas dmag brgya phrag btang ste phyi rol pa de rnams 'ga' shas stod mnga' ris phyogs su bros pa dang 'ga' shas za rgyu ma rnyed nas ltogs shi thebs pa byung yod tshod red zer/ khong chos zer stangs de nga rgyal khengs dregs lta bu'i mngon tshul thog nas lo rgyus kyi 'grel bshad byed skabs nga tsho nyan mkhan rnams kyi a kha kha zhes zer mkhan sha stag byung song /nga tshos gdang la brgal nas nyin lnga drug cig 'grul bzhud byas rjes lung chung skyid po zhes pa'i dro sa zhig tu slebs/ dbyar dus de khul rtsa kha ha cang legs po dang / yul ljongs lta na sdug pa'i lung pa zhig yin/ mdo smad tshong dpon tshos rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i sa khul der nyin shas bca' zhag sdod pa'i lugs srol yod/173

lo shas gong nged bza' 'tsho gnyis yar lam de gar nyin shas bsdad pa de yid la lhang lhang dran byung / 'on kyang de skabs kyi yul ljongs de mi sems g.yo zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa zhig yin kyang da cha dgun la song bas skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su gyur 'dug pa de ni 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par skad cig re re bzhin du 'gyur ba'i chos nyid yin par bsam/ phran tsho sa gnas der 'byor nyin gnam gshis cung zad legs su phyin pa ma zad/ de sngon sa gnas de gar kha ba de tsam babs med pa'i thog rta bdun dbang po de yang nga tsho nyin shas rjes slar yang 'phrad par dga' snang gis byams brtse'i 'dzum zhal ston pa'i snang ba zhig byung / nyin shas kyi sngon du dka' ngal 'phrad kyang sa cha der slebs 'phral me shing sogs las sla por thob byung /nga tsho tshang ma ja btungs rjes phran gyi sems nang dga' snang dang sbrags spro seng lta bur 'gro rgyu'i snang ba byung nas rang nyid gcig pur nye 'gram gyi rgyab ri chung chung zhig la 'jegs par chu tshod skar ma bco lnga tsam gyi rjes ri rtser slebs/ lho phyogs kyi lung gshongs der blta skabs sems can 'bri g.yag 500 nas 500tsam gyis lung gshongs de khengs pa lta bur 'dug cing / de rnams khu sem pur rtsa za bzhin 'dug skabs der nga'i bsam par/ nga tsho mnyam du 'gro mkhan zing tshong su 'dra zhig la yang khal g.yag mang po de 'dra khrid rgyu med/ de ni mtsho sngon nar dbus phyogs su yong mkhan 'grul khag gcig yin par snyam/ zhib blta skabs g.yag de rnams dus rgyun gyi khal g.yag las gzugs stobs che ba dang /sha shed legs pa/ de rnams kyi bdag po dang gur sogs gang yang mthong rgyu med stabs de dag 'brong yin nam snyam nas dogs zon gyi thog nas slar yang zhib blta 74

byed skabs tan tan 'brong yin pa ngo thag chod de mnyam rogs tshong 'grul rnams la lung gshongs phar nang la 'brong mang po 'dug ces skad 'bod byas 'phral me mda' yod mkhan tshos me mda' khyer nas phran sar rgyugs slebs byung / skabs der ngas skad brgyab pa de 'brong tshos thos ma thag phran yod pa'i phyogs der yud tsam bltas rjes lung shur de'i nang nas 'brong khyu pa zhig gis skad chen po zhig brgyab 'phral rtsa za bzhin pa dang / nyal nas bsdad pa'i 'brong thams cad 'drogs nas 'brong tshang ma dus cig tu rub rub byas pa'i thog bskor ba 'ga' shas brgyab song ba skabs der nga tsho'i rogs pa tshos mgyogs po gab yib byed dgos zhes skad brgyab byung bar rang nyid 'jigs snang chen pos pha bong chen po zhig gi brgyab tu gab nas bsdad/de nas rogs pa rnams kyi phyogs gnyis nas me mda' kha bsgrigs te brgyab ma thag 'brong rnams kyi tshur blta tsam byas rjes 'brong khyu pa des yang skur skad chen po zhig brgyab nas sne khrid byas te mjug ma gnam la ter nas shar phyogs su bros song ba'i rjes su gzhan rnams kyang de'i mjug mthud nas bros song / nga tsho'i rogs pa tshos me mda' mang po brgyab kyang 'brong gcig ma gtogs gsod ma thub/ 'grong mang por mas skyon byung yod bzo 'dug pa ni 'grong bskyod pa'i shul du khrag thig mang po mthong rgyu 'dug 'brong bsad pa de'i khrid la rogs pa tshang mas mtha' bskor nas blta skabs ha cang chen po zhig 'dug pa de'i snying la me mda' phog 'dug tshur blta tsam byas nas yar langs ma thub par de nas dbugs chad song / mi tshos 'brong khrag dron mo btungs na lus stobs rgyas shing / grang ngar 'gog thub ces zer nas phor pa khyer nas khrag 'thung bar phyin/ la las 'brong la 175

bzhon pa yin na rlung rta 'phar zhing bya ba lam 'gro 'ong zer nas 'brong gi thog tu bzhon pa sogs byas/ de nas tshang mas 'brong sha bgo sha brgyab nas dga' dga' skyid skyid thog dmag sar ca lag 'thob pa ltar rgyal kha thob pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan zhing / 'brong sha gya nom pa bgo bsha' thob/ de'i mtshan mo de rang nyid gnyid ma khug par gnas tshul de dran zhing / zhi bde bag phebs su gnas pa'i 'brong khyu de glo bur char rlung drag pos ded pa ltar skyid pa'i rtsa kha gshin po de bzhag nas bros 'gro dgos byung zhing / lhag par 'brong gcig pu de ni rang gis gces pa'i srog kyang skad cig nyid du 'phrog pa'i bsam tshul de bsam blo 'khor nas yid blong blong po zhig byung / 'on kyang mi gzhan rnams ni/ sha btsos nas zhim mdog gis za bzhin 'dug gnyid ma khug skabs rang gi bsam blor 'brong de rnams de nas bros dgos pa dang / 'brong gcig pu de bsad pa'i nyes dmigs gtso bo de nga rang la yod bsam nas 'gyod sems chen po byung / de gar nyin gnyis bca' zhag bsdad rjes shar phyogs su mu mthud nas thon skyod byas/ der nyin gnyis sdod ring khal g.yag dang / rnga mong sogs la drwa yag po za rgyu byung stabs 'grul bskyod shugs che tsam byed thub pa byung /nga tsho lung chung skyed po nas thon te nyin bcu lhag tsam gyi lam du zhugs skabs grang ngar ha cang chen po 'phrad kyang / kha ba de tsam mang po ma babs par brten lam 'gram du rkyang dang / 'brong / dgo ba sogs ri dwags khya dang khyur byas nas ri klung kun tu zhi bde bag phebs su gnas bzhin 'dug kyang / sdod ma tshugs kyi tshong 'grul 'ga' shas kyis me mda' brgyab nas ri dwags re gnyis bsad song / de nas bstan 'dzin dbu sbog ces pa'i sa gnas su 'byor skabs 76

sa khul de ni zing tshong rnams yar mar 'grul bzhud skabs lha gsol sa'i sa cha de yin/ dbyar dus mdo smad nas yar yong skabs bya ba lam 'gro yong ba dang /jag kun ma 'phrad pa sogs kyi ched du yul lhar skyabs bcol zhu ba dang / dgun dus dbus phyogs nas mar yong mkhan tshos mar lam jag rkun gyi nyen kha las yol zin stabs yul lha der btang rag gi gsol mchod zhu bzhin yod/ yul lha gnas sa de thang de tsam chen po med pa zhig gi dkyil du ri bo chung chung zhig gi rtse mor tshong 'grul rnams kyis dar lcog tshos sna dar shing rub bsdus la bsgar nas de'i g.yas g.yon rdo mang po spungs te bzhag yod pa red/ dbyar dus tshong 'grul rnams kyis bkal ba'i dar lcog rnams mang che ba char rlung gi ded nas g.yas g.yon gyi brag dang / rtsa shing bcas su 'khon nas sdod kyi 'dug pa dang / nyung shas shig dar shing gi thog 'khril nas bsdad de rlung gis yam yom du g.yo bzhin 'dug pa de tsho mdzes sdug ldan pa'i tshos gzhi rnams char rlung gis rkyen pas mdog yongs su shor nas 'phyed ras lta bur gyur 'dug nga tsho'i thab khag rnams kyis lha sa nas khyer yong ba'i dar lcog tshos sna lnga de dbu sbog gi dar phung thog bkal nas bsangs gsol dang / smon lam btab ste tshang mas dus gcig tu ki ki swo swo lha rgyal lo zhes skad gsang mthon pos bsgrags/skabs der nga tsho'i ma byan blo gros zhes pa lam bar nad mnar gyis rnga mong thog bskyon nas de bar slobs thub tsam byung yang de nyin khong gi gzugs po je zhan du gyur te sog po'i em rje bla rgan des brjod gsal/ sman gyi phan pa shin tu dka'/ 'on kyang skya 'bum du slebs thub na drag rgyu'i re ba phran bu yod lugs zer/177

da dung sku 'bum du slebs pas che ba gcig lhag tsam yod pas 'phral 'byor dka' ba dang lhag par lam bar kha ba babs pa'i ri klung mang po 'grim dgos ha cang khag po yod pa red/nga tsho bsangs gsol byas nas yar yong skabs don grub rgyal mtshan gyis do nub ma byan blo gros nas bag tsha mar khu za 'dod 'dug zer ba ltar/ ngas bag tsha mar khu bzos nas sprad rjes gnyid khug nas bsdad yod/ tshang ma bag tsha mar khu mchod rogs zer ba ltar ngas ma byan la lta tsam byas par 'jam thing nger gnyid khug pa lta bur bsdad 'dug pa dang / gdong mdog phran bu'i dmar mdangs lta bu chags 'dug mang che bas blo gros kyi nad gzhi drag tu 'gro gi yod pa zer nas dga' tshor gyis re ba chen po byung yang / sang nyin snga dro ngas ma byan la gzugs po gang 'dra 'dug gam zhes dres skabs lan gang yang byas ma byung / nga'i bsam par/nad gzhi phog pa nas bzung de ring nang bzhin gnyid yag po de 'dra khug thub pa byung ma song bas mdangs nub bag tsha mar khu des phan pa min nam snyam pa byung / khong gi nyal sar yag po zhig bltas nas / yang skyar ma byan lags/ gzugs po gang 'dra 'dug gam zhes 'dres skabs/ mig gnyis btsums shing dbugs kyang gtong yag mi 'dug der brten ngas mi tshang ma skad btang nas blta dus/ ma byan lags dbugs kyi rgu ba chad nas dus yun gang tsam song zin 'dug skabs der sog po em rje bla rgan des ngas dang po nas ma byan lags grongs kyi red bsam pa ma gtogs drag gi red bsam pa ma byung / 'on kyang bag tsha mar khu des nyin gsum gyis khong rang 'chi rgyu mgyogs su btang ba red ces zer byung / de sngon nas em rje des lag rdo rnams la ma byan drag gi ma red/ khong la nad gzhi lci po 178

zhig phog 'dug sman ga tshod yod na'ang phan gyi ma red ces bshad 'dug da cha bsam zhib skabs/ ma byan gyi na tsha de kun ser zer ba'i na tsha 'di min nam snyam/ dus de nas bzung phran rang bod sman thog yid ches cung zad rnyed byung /ma byan de skye yul 'phan po dang grwa sa se ra byes kyi grwa pa zhig yin/ de nyid lha sa nas zi ling bar thengs gsum bzhi tsam bskyod myong ba zhig red 'dugang tshos sa cha der nyin 'phar ma gcig bsdad de 'das po de nyid kyi sku phung de nye 'gram gyi ri rtse zhig tu gdan drangs te thab khag gzhan la yod pa'i dge 'dun pa gsum dang / sog po em rje bcas gdan zhus kyis 'das mchod stabs bde zhig zhus te de'i sang nyin tsha 'dam sa khul phyogs su thon/ nga tsho tshu 'dam du slebs nas nyin shas song mtshams mi rta rnga g.yag sogs ngal gso lhod bsdad kyis rje sku 'bum phyogs su thon te lam bar nyin bco lnga tsam 'gor/sku 'bum la ma slebs tsam gyi nyin zhag gnyis kyi sngon du phran dang tshong dpon phur bu gnyis kyis lag rdo rnams la mngags te nga gnyis sngon du thon gyi yin/nyin gnyis snang tshang lam bgrod byas te sku 'bum du 'byor rgyu byas kyang / lam bar kha ba chen po babs pa'i rkyen gyis bskyod dka' ba byung / 'on kyang mu mthud nas mtshan bskyod byed skabs lam nor gyis brag ri'i sgang du slobs pa ma shes par da dung rta khrid nas mdun du bskyod skabs rta des skad brgyab nas mdun du gtan nas 'gro gi mi 'dug par bya thabs zad nas phran gnyis sa cha de rang la rta sga bshus nas gangs kyi dkyil du bsdad pa yin/ sang nyin nam langs skabs mdun phyogs la lta dus brag ri mthon po'i rtse la slebs 'dug pa/ 'jigs snang chen pos rang dbang med par skad shor/ mdangs nub gal srid rta des skad ma brgyab 179

par mdun du mu mthud bskyod na phran gnyis dang rta bcas chabs cig tu brag g.yang der lhung nas sha 'thor rus 'thor du 'gro rgyur the tshom med/ rta des skad brgyab nas skad gcig tsam gyi 'gal rkyen de sel thub pa de ni dkon mchog gi thugs rje nyag cig yin par yid ches dang / dad pa chen po skyes byung / de nas nga gnyis dga' dga' skyid skyid kyi lam du zhugs nas sku 'bum du bskyod de nyin dgung tsam la sku 'bum du bde 'byor byung skabs stag 'tshor sgar pa'i bla brang gi phyag mdzod ngag dbang byang chub ( rgyal yab mchog gi sku'i gcen po / mchog bcas nga tsho 'byor rgyur sgrag nas bzhugs 'dug phran gnyis nas lam bar 'gro bskyod kyi skor dang / lhag par du mdangs nub 'phrad pa'i 'gal rkyen skor bcas khong rnams la zhus par tshang ma tang sangs shing ya mtshan du gyur thog phran gnyis dkon cog gi thugs rje nyag cig gis skyabs pa zhig yin par mgrin dbyangs gcig gyur gyis gsungs kyi 'dugaskabs der phran gyi khu bo nyin shas sngon nas sku 'bum du bsu bar phebs te de nas nang du phyir log gis de'i sang nyin sku gzugs bde po mi 'dug gsungs pa dang / phran ga dus slebs thub bam/ thug e yong zhes thengs 'ga' shas gsungs nas nyin dgung yol tsam la sku gshegs pa'i gnas tshul thos byung ba de ga'i zhu bya rnams tshong dpon phur bu lags la mngags te sang nyin lam seng brel 'tshab ngang rang gi pha yul gyi phyogs su bskyod/ lam bar du pha ma gnyis lo shas ma mjal bar ga 'dra chags yod dam/ gal srid da lam nyin 'ga' shas sngon la yong thub yod na khu bo yang mjal thub kyi red bsam bzhin bsam bzhin rang gi skye yul cong rtsi sde pa thag nyer slebs skabs dga' skyo gnyis ka byung zhing / dga' ba ni lo shas ring ma mjal ba'i pha ma spyan mched slar yang mjal ba dang / skyo ba ni 180

chung dus nas pha ma ltar brtse ba chen po gnang mkhan khu bo de nyin shas sngon sku gshegs par sems gdung chen po 'di yang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i chos nyid cig yin/ rang nyid khyim gyi sgo rtsar 'byor skabs nang mi tshang ma dga' tshor ngang phran sgug nas bzhugs 'dug pha ma gnyis lo shas ma mjal ring phran bu rgas nyams yod pa dang / a ma'i dbu skra skya phyed sngo phyed du gyur 'dug phran thug ma thag dga' ba'i spyan chab bsil bzhin 'thams 'khyud gnang byung bas rang nyid kyang mig chu dbang med du shor byung / rang nyid 'byor ba'i nyin der khu bo zhing gshegs kyi bdun tshigs dang po'i dge sgrub zhabs rim gnang bzhin 'dug nang du nyin bcu tsam lhod sdod byed ring spyan nye tshang ma nga'i sar thug 'phrad du slebs byung /de nas slar yang sku 'bum du phyir log nas tshong dpon phur bu mnyam du tshong zog rnams phyir tshong byas pa dang / sngon du bod nas dngul g.yar mkhan rnams nas bu lon 'ded len byas/ tshong zog tshong rgyu'i thad phran la nyams myong med stabs tshong dpon phur bu kho rang la 'gan dkri byas/ de nas che gcig min tsam song rjes lha sa nas sku'i gcen mo che ring sgron mar bu mo gcig btsas te ma bu gnyis bde grol byung lugs tar 'phrin 'byor te blo bde zhing dga' spro chen po byung /bu mo de da lta 'dir yod pa'i mkha' 'gro che ring yin/nga tsho lha sa nas thon dus 1943 lo'i bod zla 10 pa'i nang yin/lam bar 'grul bzhud rla gsum dang / nyin 20 tsam 'gor te 1944lo'i bod rla gnyis par sku 'bum du 'byor nas bzung brel zing kho na'i dbang gis dus tshod yud tsam du song / bu lon de tsam lag son ma byung ba de ni mang che bas sprod rgyu med ces zer ba dang / re zung gis rjes su rim pas phul chog ces ka 8

kor zhus stabs bya thabs bral ba zhig byung /lo de'i zla 5 ches shar tsam la sku 'bum nas lha sar thon rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ sku 'bum nas ma thon tsam la rang khyim du khyug tsam bskyod de pha ma gnyis dang / spyan mched rnams thug 'phrad kyis slar yang lha sar 'gro rgyu'i skor zhus par pha ma gnyis 'bral mi phod pa zhig byung / lhag par du a ma lags la/ yang nas yang du mjal bar yong gi yin zhes khas len zhus te thon pa yin/ lo de'i tshong 'grul mi tshang 30 lhag tsam mnyam du phran gnyis kyi zing rta 12 dang /drel 25 bcas nyo sgrub byas te khong tsho mnyam du thon/ bla 'a tsha dkyil tsam la lha sar bde 'byor gyis phran da lam mdo smad pha yul du bskyod skor zhib cha rgyal yab chen mo dang / rgyal yum chen mor snyan seng zhus/phran mdo smad du bskyod ring sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mas lha sa zas zhim shag tu gcen gcung rnam gnyis lhan du bzhugs 'dug de nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar nga tsho tshang ma lcang gseb shar yab gzhis stag 'tshor gzim shag gsar par spo shugs kyis yab yum lhan du bzhugs nas sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang /blo bzang bsam gtan gnyis sngar bzhin tar khang slob grwar phebs bzhin 'dugaskabs de'i zas zhim shag de go min tang lha sar bca' sdod sku tshab las khungs kyis las byed kyi las shag tu khang glar btang 'dug de'i byang ngos shing khang steng shod gnyis su go min tang gi sman khang zhig btsugs kyang / lo gcig ma song tsam em rje rgya nag tu phyir log gis sman khang de sgo rgyag dgos byung song /phran pha yul nas lha sar phyir 'khor rjes gzim shag gi thugs mkho nyo sgrub dang / tsag tsig gi zhu sgo bcas zhu dgos la brten tar khang slob grwar sku'i 182

gcen po gnyis dang lhan du bskyod khom ma byung / skabs der yab gzhis stag 'cher gyi nyin re'i 'gro gron chen po 'gro ba'i thog sngon zhus ltar bu lon sprod chad mang po de dag rnams 'jal ma thub pa'i sku ngal chen po 'phrad kyang phyi'i ltar snang du sku ngal de tsam med pa'i rnam pa ston gyi yod/ dpe zhig zhus na/ phran gyi myong cha'i thog 'phrad pa zhig la/ dgos mkho zhig lha sa'i ngo shes tshong khang nas nyo sgrub skabs rin 'bab rjes su sprod rgyu zhes shod dus rin 'bab kyang ldab gcig tsam che ba len gyi 'dug rjes su dus thog tu sprod ma thub pa byung mtshams tshong khang gi nye 'khor ma slebs tsam la g.yol nas 'gro dgos pa yang yong gi yod/ gal te zog rin len mkhan yong skabs g.yog po tsho da lta sras sku zhabs bzhugs mi 'dug ces shod du bcug nas rdzun shod dgos pa'i gnas tshul yang je snyed byung / gzhis ka khag nas 'bru btsong pa'i rin 'bab dang / tsag tsig yong 'bab thog nas bsdus pa'i dngul phran bu 'byor skabs bu lon sprod yul khag gi skyed 'bab sprod 'jal ma thub pa'i gnas tshul yong gi yod/ lo 'khor gcig ring zla re bzhin skyed dngul sprod dgos pa chags nas bu lon gcig thog nyis brtsegs / g.yas len g.yon 'jal gyis ngal khur je lcir gyur/ lo shas rjes bka' tshab bla ma dom po ba mkhyen rab dbang phyug dang / shan kha 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal gnyis kyi yab gzhis stag 'chir gyi 'tsho 'dzin gnang nas bzung dngul bun sprod 'jal gyi sku ngal sel thub pa'i gnas tshul rjes su zhib phra 'god rgyu yin//483

le tshan bcu gcig pa/sku'i gcen po rgya lo don 'grub mchog dang / phran gnyis srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i mjal khar bcar ba/gsi༅༅/ /phyi lo 1945 lo'i bod rla 8 tsam la 7rgyal ba'i yab yum rnam gnyis kyis sku'i gcen po rgya lo don 'grub mchog dang / phran gnyis byang rwa sgreng du rgyal zur rin po che'i mjal khar bcar dgos pa'i bka' gnang nas phran gnyis lha sa nas g.yog bzhi 'khrid de rwa sgreng du bskyod pa yin/ lha sa nas byang rwa sgreng bar me le re gsum tsam yod tshod 'dug lha sa nas 'gro skabs la mthon po 'phan po sgo la dang chag la gnyis rgyag dgos pa dang de bzhin phod mdor gtsang chu'i lcags zam brgal te 'gro dgos/ phran gnyis dang g.yog rnams kyi bzhon rta yag shos sha stag yin stabs lam bar nyin gsum thog rwa sgreng dgon du 'byor thub pa byung zhing /spyir btang 'grul bzhud byed mkhan tsho dal po'i thog nyin lnga 'gor gyi yod zer/rwa sgreng dgon pa de bzhin chos phyogs thog bod yongs su snyan grags chen po yod pa'i dgon pa rtsa chen zhig tu brtsi zhing / dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dkyil du rgya gar shar phyogs/ bathila'i za hor rgyal po'i sras jo bo rje paṇa〉 ta a ti sha bod du phebs nas rwa sgreng khul du lo shas bzhugs pa dang / de rjes khong gi slob 185

ma'i gtso bo 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur te rab byung dang po'i me sgre phyi lo 1055 lo rwa sgreng dgon pa phyag btarnga//de rjes 7rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po dus yun ring po bzhugs yod pa dang /khong gis lam rim chen po sa gnas der bka' rtsom mdzad/ bar skabs lo mang po'i ring rwa sgreng dgon pa de bzhin bod gzhung gi 'dzin skyong mdzad 'dug7gong sa tā la'i bla ma skya phreng bdun pa mchog gi yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang mchog ldan la gzhung gnas nas rwa sgreng dgon pa de khong la rtsa bdag 'bul gnang mdzad pa nas bzung khong gi skye sprul rim phebs la rwa sgreng bla brang zhes gsar du byung ste/ rwa sgreng dgon pa'i mtshan de bla ma'i mtshan du gsol ba zhig red/rwa sgreng dgon pa'i chags yul gyi rgyab ri dang / g.yas g.yon mtha' skor bcas la nags tshal chen po'i dkyil du dgon pa de chags yod/ shing nags phal che ba shug pa sha stag yin pa ma zad/ shug pa ming chen bzhi la sogs pa stan grags can gyi shug sdong de tsho lo brgya phrag mang po song ba yin zhes zer/dgon pa'i mdun 'gram lho phyogs su rwa sgreng phu chu chen po shar nas nub tu rgyugs kyi 'dug nga tsho 'gro ba'i nam dus ha cang yag po 'khel yod par brten me tog sna tshogs kyi yul lung tshang ma khengs shing / dri zhim phyogs bcur khyab/ yul ljongs lta na sdug pa 'di lta bu ri 'ari med lha gnas mi yul du 'phos pa lta bur snang / rwa sgreng gi sa babs de lha sa las cung mtho tsam 'dugarwa sgreng dgon gyi rten gtso bo jo bo rje paṇ+ḍi ta a ti shas bal yul nas gdan zhu gnang ba'i jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje li sku chung chung zhig dang / snga rabs rgya gar 186

nas gdan 'dren zhus pa'i shing ta la'i lo mar bris pa'i saṃ skri ta'i yi ge'i chos dpe brgya phrag mang po bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis rgya dpe nas bod sgyur gnang ba dang / mkhas pa so sos brtsams pa'i phyag dpe grangs las 'das pa bzhugs 'dugabod zla 4 ches 15 nyin rwa sgreng khu byug mchod pa zhes pa'i dus chen gyi skabs der/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad nas bod mi mang po mchod mjal gnas bskor la yong srol yod/ phran gnyis lam bar nyin gsum bskyod nas de nyin snga dro stag lung dgon pa nas thon te phod mdo lcags zam brgal nas bgrod lam de byang shar dang / shar lho phyogs gnyis su gyes yod/ byang shar gyi lam phyogs de nag chu sa khul gyi lam de yin/ shar lho phyogs bskyod na rwa sgreng du slebs kyi yod/ nga tshos shar lho'i phyogs su bskyod bzhin pa'i skabs rwa sgreng rin po che'i skya tsha dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan rwa sgreng dgon pa nas phran gnyis bsu bar phebs 'dug par nga tsho tshang ma ngo shes grogs po yin tsang ngo mjal skabs gcen gcung 'phrad pa lta bu'i dga' tshor brjod kyi mi lang ba byung / de nas yar bskyod mtshams zhing pa'i mi tshang zhig tu thab bsu sngon tshud nas gra sgrig gnang 'dug par der lhan bcar gyi gsol ja dang / 'bras sil/ zho/ zhal tog sogs gya nom pa gra sgrig gnang 'dug pa dang / de bzhin gsol tshigs kyang rgyas par bshams/gsol ja dang / gsol tshigs lhod zhus rjes nga tsho gsum dang / g.yog bcas rta 'gros ma legs par bzhon yod stabs de nas rwa sgreng dgon pa'i bar dus rgyun rta thog chu tshod gcig tsam 'gro dgos pa de nga tshos rgyug thengs gcig la skar ma bco lnga tsam las ma song bar rwa sgreng rin po che'i bzhugs gnas pho brang spro khang rgyal sgo'i 187

'gram du 'byor/ rgyal sgo'i phyir bsangs bsu gtong ba dang sbrags mi mang po nga tsho'i phebs bsur sgug bzhugs 'dug de'i nang rwa sgreng bla brang gi zhabs gas dang /de'i nye 'khor du gnas pa'i yul mi bcas 'dugaphran tshos rwa sgreng dgon par thag ring nas mjal skabs de'i g.yas g.yon du gra shag dang / de'i nye 'khor mi khyim gyi thog kha nas bsangs kyi dud pa 'phyur bzhin 'dug nyi ma'i 'od zer dgon pa'i gser zangs kyi rgya phebs dang / gañdzi ra bcas su 'phros pa'i gser 'od chem chem du 'phro ba des skye 'gro rnams ma rig mun pa'i smag rum las sgrol ba'i nyams snang shar/ dgon pa'i nye 'gram gyi shar ngos rwa sgreng bla brang rdo brtsigs bkod legs thog brtsegs bzhi can gzi rngam dang ldan pa zhig 'dug de'i thog nas bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bzo rig lag rtsal gyi rig gzhung gi khyad chos shig mngon gyi 'dug bla brang de rwa sgreng sku thog dang po nas lnga pa'i bar skya che hril po'i ring chos kyi nyams bzhes gnang yul gzhug gnas lte ba de yin/ skabs 'di'i sku thog lnga pas bod kyi srid skyong gi thugs 'khur bzhes rjes bod gzhung gi tha'i ji shan kha ba 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyas la rwa sgreng dgon pa nyams gso'i do dam bsko gzhag gis gzhung gnas nas nyams gso gnang yod par grags/ rwa sgreng dgon pa de ni sngar dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i lcags pho byi ba'i lo/phyi lo 1240 lor hor go dan gyi dmag bod du lhags te rwa sgreng dgon pa dang /'phan po rgyal lha khang bcas me bsregs btang ba'i thog skye bo ser skya mang po zhig dmar gsad btang yod par grags/rwa sgreng spro khang de yang bar skabs rgya bskyed legs bcos gnang 'dug pa 188

de'i byus bkod byed mkhan bla phyag phreng ring sras 'jigs med sum rtson dbang po yin zer/ spro khang de rwa sgreng gi lung chu'i 'gram du zhal lho gzigs red 'dug pa dang / thog brtsegs gnyis yin zhing / phyi'i dbyibs bod bzo dang / nang gi bkod pa nub phyogs kyi lugs srol dang / bod kyi sngar srol dang yang mthun pa zhig red 'dug spro khang chen po ma yin kyang ha cang bzo bkod legs po zhig 'dug spro khang gi mdun phyogs su me tog ldum ra che chung 'tshams zhing mdzes pa dang / de'i nye 'gram lho nub dang shar lho bcas su chibs rwa dang / spro khang rgyab tu sku sger yig tshang dang / gsol thab/ las shag sogs pho brang gi mtha' bskor mu khyad kyi brgyan pa 'dugang tsho 'byor nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar srid zur rin po che'i gcung po thub bstan rgyal mtshan lags phran gnyis sar phebs te rin po ches da res sras skya zhabs rnam gnyis phebs lam du sku ngal 'o brgyal byung yod stabs de ring sku lhod lhod byas nas bzhugs rogs gnang / sang nyin snga thog rin po che'i sku mdun du phebs rogs gnang zhes bka' phebs kyi 'dug ces gsungs byung ba ltar phran gnyis nyin gsum ring lam bar 'grul bzhud byas pas cung zad thang chad par brten dgong dro'i gsol tshig zhus rjes snga tsam ngal gso byas/de'i sang nyin chu tshod dgu pa bcu pa tsam la rin po che'i skya mdun bcar 'thus kyis bka' gsal phebs pa ltar/ phran gnyis mjal khar bcar ba dang /dang thog 'bul tshan rnams phul zhing / phyag gsum btsal nas phyag dbang zhus/rin po ches gzim chung gi bzhugs sgrom nang yar sku bzhengs gnang nas sras sku zhabs rnam gnyis phebs lam la 'o brgyal ma byung ngam/ 7rgyal ba thams cad 189

mkhyen pa sku dkyil gsal dwangs yod dam/ yab yum gnyis sku khams bzang bzhugs yod dam zhes bka' brtsad phebs par sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog gis bka' lan re re bzhin phul thog yab yum rnam gnyis nas rin po che'i gser zhal yun ring ma mjal bar brten phran gnyis rin po che'i sku mdun du 'tshams zhu mjal khar ched brdzong gnang ba'i skor snyan seng zhus/ rin po ches thugs mnyes snang chen po'i ngang nas/ khyed gnyis da lam rwa sgreng du zla ba gcig gnyis lhod bzhugs gnang rogs gnang / deng sang gnam gshis kyang yag pa'i skabs yin/ de las snga tsam phebs thub yod na rwa sgreng nye 'khor ri klung thams cad spang gshong legs po dang / me tog che chung sna tshogs shar ba'i dri bsung gis lung pa khengs pa'i dus skabs shig yin/ de bzhin 'dab chags rnams kyis skad snyan sna tshog sgrogs cing / lhag par rwa sgreng 'jol mo'i gsung snyan ni skad grags yod pa zhig yin/ rla gcig tsam gyi rjes su gnam gshes rim bzhin grang du 'gro nges red la/ dgun dus kha ba chen po bab kyi red/ 'on kyang sa khul de skyes bu dam pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs kyis byang gi sa khul gzhan ltar grang ngar med la/ri shur gzhan dag nang bzhin lhag rlung sdang po med/ lhag par du rwa sgreng gi sa chu de yul gzhan las bzang ba yod ces bka' gnang byung /yang khong gi sang nyin rnam pa gnyis dgon par mchod mjal du phebs rgyu'i gra sgrigs byed kyi yod/ rwa sgreng dgon pa de bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi gdan sa gtso bo yin par brten ha cang rtsa ba che ba'i gnas shig yin/ mchod mjal lhod lhod gnang ste de nas nga tsho lhan du rwa sgreng dgon pa'i ri rtsi'i ri khrod du phebs thub na yag po yong gi red/ der bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyi sgrub gnas 190

mjal rgyu yod/ spro gseng gnang sar rwa sgreng dgon pa'i nub phyogs nye 'gram du skad grags yod pa'i pho rong thang dang / de'i nye 'khor bcas su skya cham du gdan 'dren zhu gi yin zhes gsungs te de nas phran gnyis rin po che'i sku mdun nas dgongs pa zhus te rang sar phyir log byas/rin po che bzhugs sa spro khang rtse thog gzim chung zhig nang zhal shar la phyogs pa'i bzhugs sgrom zhig gi nang du bzhugs kyi 'dug phran gnyis la yang gos kha re bting 'dug pa de ni bod kyi mtho rim skya drag rnams kyi che bstod srol zhig yin/rin po che'i bzhugs sgrom steng du gos kha sgron med pa'i thog snam bu dmar tshos can gyi gding ba mdog rgya smug gcig gi steng du bzhugs kyi 'dug gzim chung byang ngos kyi chos gshom der bod lugs kyis bkris pa'i ri mo sna tshogs kyi shing brkos gson nyams ldan pa'i thog rab tu bkra ba'i mtshon rtsi las 'od chem chem 'phro bzhin 'dug mchod gshom nang du li ma dang / gser zangs kyi sku rnying rtsa che sha stag bzhugs su gsol ba dang / rin po che'i gsol lcog steng la gser las bskrun pa'i mchod chas dang / rdzul gyi zhal dkar la gser gyi stegs khebs gcod can zhig nang gsol ja mchod bzhin 'dug pa de tsho'i thog nas rin po che ni rgyas spros chen po gnang mkhan zhig yin par mngon/de nyin nas bzung mdzad seng nam nyin la phran gnyis dang / rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan/ rin po che'i sku'i gcung po thub bstan rgyan mtshan/gsol dpon gzhon pa/ tshong dpon gtsang pa che brtan bcas phran tsho sbag chen brgyab pa yin kyang / rgyan chen po btsugs med/ der phran gnyis ka sbag gsar lta bu yin pas dus tshod yud tsam la 'gro gi 'dug191

nga tsho rwa sgreng du 'byor nas nyin gnyis tsam gyi snga dro rwa sgreng dgon pa'i mchod mjal du bskyod te mchod 'bul dang / dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur zhus/ rwa sgreng du sdod ring rin po che'i lhan du pho rong thang dang de'i nye skor phu chu'i stod smad du dbu gur sgron nas spro gseng btang ba'i thog rta rgyugs kyi 'gran bsdur gnang ba dang / skya rtsed kyi don du me mda' tsha kha yang 'gran bsdur gnang /srid zur rin po che chibs rtsal che ba ma zad/ phyag mda' yang ha cang tsha po 'dug de bzhin sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog sku na phra yang chibs rtsal mkhas la/ phyag mda' ha cang tsha po yod/ skabs der srid zur rin po che spro snang chen po gnang ba mngon pa ma zad/ zhabs gas rnams kyis da res sku ngo rnam pa gnyis phebs nas srid zur rin po che ha cang spro snang chen po gnang gi 'dug ces kyang zer/ dpyod dbyar ston gsum gyi skabs su phu chu'i stod smad dang /dgon pa'i rgyab ri/ pho rong thang bcas su dbu gur sgron nas spro gseng du yang yang phebs nas rta rgyugs dang / phyag mda' tsha gzigs gnang rgyur ha cang mnyes po yod pa dang / dus rgyun gsham 'og las byed tsho 'gran bsdur byed du 'jug gnang gi yod 'dug srid zur rin po ches chibs pa mnyes shos de de sngon rgyal yab chen mos phul ba'i chibs chen g.yu 'brug zer ba de yin/ chibs pa de rta gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i rkang lag ring ba dang / rna chog ring ba/ gzugs po phra la ring ba yod/ spra kha sngon po/ rta de mi sus bzhon kyang rtsal yod med shes thub/ gal srid rta rtsal chen po mi shes mkhan bud med tshos bzhon kyang / dal po'i thog 'gro gi yod/ rta rtsal yod pas bzhon ma thag lam seng khro ngar chen pos rgyugs 'gro gi red/ rnam kun rin po che rang ma gtogs su zhig kyang bzhon chog gi med/ yab 92

gzhis nas chibs pa de srid zur rin po cher phul rjes zhabs rjes kyang bzhag yod par grags/1947 lor rin po che rwa sgreng nas lha sar btsan khrid zhu skabs khong tshos gnas tshul de shes nas chibs pa de chibs su bcug med/ srid zur rin po che'i sku gam du nyin bcu lhag tsam sdod ring phran gcig pu gsang ba'i thog nas gzim chung du thengs gnyis 'bod sgug gnang ste ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi gnas stangs skor dang /rgya nag go min tang gi nus stobs ji yod bka' brtsad ji snyed gnang byung yang /skabs der lo na chung ba'i rkyen gyis chab srid kyi shes tshad dman pa dang / de skabs kyi bod kyi chab srid 'pho 'gyur dang / gnas stangs bcas la blun mongs shig yin stabs khong gis thugs re gnang ba'i gnas tshul gang yang zhu rgyu ma byung /'on kyang dus skabs der nyi hong rgyal khab kyi dmag pham nyes byung ste rgya nag dang a ri bcas mthun phyogs rgyal khab khag la mgo btags zhus pa'i skor snyan sgron zhus pa yin/phran gnyis rwa sgreng du bzhugs rgyun ring sne len gzab rgyas gnang ba ma zad/rin po che'i lhan du gsol tshigs thengs snga rjes zhus pa dang / rwa sgreng nas thon kha'i nyin mtha' mar rin po ches phran gnyis la me mda' pe si tob ang 38yin pa re dang / gra dkar zhes pa'i bod kyi dkar yol rnying ma re la sogs pa'i phyag rtags gsol ras gnang / dkar yol de'i lo rgyus shes kyi med stabs lha sar 'byor rjes snang chung lta bus bed spyod byas te chag skyon byung song / rjes su mi tshos gra dkar zhes pa'i dkar yol de dus rabs brgyad pa'i skabs rgya nag nas dkar yol bzo mkhan skad btang ste bod kyi lho kha sa khul gra nang du bzos pa red 193

ces zer ba ltar dkar yol der gra dkar zhes thogs/ dkar yol de tshos gzhi 'ang gu mdog yin pa dang / nang gi mthil du kham bu'i ri mo zhig dang / de'i phyi'i mthil la sngar srol gyi bod yig yig 'bru gcig yod pa dran gyi 'dug rjes su dkar yol de gas mthong myong ba de tsho tshos gzhi gcig pa yin rung / ri mo dang / che chung / bzo dbyibs bcas cung zad mi 'dra ba 'dug snga rabs bod du bzos pa'i dkar yol de tsho ni shin tu dkon pa'i rtsa che'i dngos po yin pa ma zad/ bod mi'i lag rtsal yang mtho po yin par mngon/sku'i gcen po dang / phran gnyis rwa sgreng du nyin bcu tsam bzhugs nas lha sar phyir log khar rin po che'i sku mdun du thon phyag zhu skabs rang dbang med par skyo snang gi bsam pa zhig byung / khong gis de lta bu'i thugs brtse dang / thugs re gnang bar sems 'gul tshad med thebs shing / rjes su bka' drin 'jal dgos bsam pa dang / snying dbus nas bkrin dran pa zhig byung yang dngos su zhabs phyi gang yang zhu ma thub pa de ni las kyi skal ba med na bsam don bsgrub pa shin tu dka' ba red 'dugarwa sgreng nas lha sar phyir 'khor rjes srid zur rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar ba'i zhib phra'i gnas tshul 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis la snyan seng zhus pa yin//194

le tshan bcu gnyis pa/skya'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang phran gnyis rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu slob sbyong du bskyod pa/༄4༅/ /snga lo nas phran rang rgya nag tu slob sbyong la 'gro rgyur skom pa chu 'dod ltar nyin mtshan khor yug tu bsam kyi yod kyang / re zhig go skabs ma thob par lus/ phran tshos rwa sgreng nas phyir log rjes zla 10 tsam la rgyal yab mchog gis khyod rang blo bzang chos 'phel mnyam du rgya gar du tshong zog sgrub ched du bskyod dgos zhes bka' phebs pa bzhin rgya gar du 'gro rgyu'i gra sgrig byas thog tshong zog sgrub ched kyi ma dngul brjes rgyu'i gra sgrig byas/ skabs der lha sa sa khul la dngul khang med stabs tshong rigs che khag spom mda' dang / rwa sgreng / sa 'du/ lha sdod bal po'i tshong pa che khag bcas la dngul brjes rgyag gi yod cing / dngul brjes kyi 'dza' thang rgya gar sgor mo gcig la bod dngul srang gsum nas bzhi bar yin/dngul brjes de tsho bka' sbug tu yod pa'i khong tsho'i yan lag tshong khang ngam/ tshong phrug nas len rgyu byas te skabs der nga tshos rgya gar sgor mo sum khri lnga stong tsam dngul brjes brgyab/ phran tsho rgya gar du slebs nas rgya zog bsgrubs rjes sku zhabs blo bzang chos 'phel rgya zog rnams dang sbrags lha sar phyir log gtong rtsis dang /195

de nas phran rang rgya nag tu slob sbyong du 'gro ba'i go skabs thob ste chud zos su mi gtong rgyu'i bsam blo 'khor nas lha sdod go min tang don gcod khru'u yi khru'u krang hrin tsun lan sar bskyod de da lam rgyal yab chen mos phran rgya gar du tshong zog bsgrub ched du bskyod dgos zhes bka' phebs byung ba ltar/ gang myur thon rtsis yin zhing /rgya gar du slobs nas tshong sgrub byas zin rjes de rnams rogs pa'i mdun lha sar gtong rtsis yin lugs dang / phran rgya gar nas rgya nag tu slob sbyong du 'gro 'char yod pas khyed nas gang ci'i rogs ram gnang thabs yong ba zhes brjod par khong gis rgya nag tu slob sbyong phebs rgyur dga' bsu yod kyang rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis dang / khyed kyi sku zla bcas kyi bka' 'khrol byung na legs gnas/ slob sbyong gnang phyogs la rogs ram zhu rgyur dka' ngal gang yang med/ nga rang yang gang mgyogs rgya gar brgyud nan cing du phyir log bya rtsis yod/ nga tsho rgya gar du mjal skabs ji 'gab bka' mol zhu rgyu dang / nga rang rgya gar du ma 'byor gong khyed la rogs ram zhu dgos yod na rang re'i ka la ka tar yod pa'i krung go'i gzhung gi ling hre las khungs nas rogs ram zhu gi red/ 'di nas khong tshor tar thog nas gnas tshul ngo sprod bya rgyu/ ka la ka tar don gcod las khungs kyi spyi khyab ling hri khyen kri pheng zhes pa de nga'i grogs po nye shos shig yin/ khyed rang khong sar bcar na khong gis rogs ram legs po zhu gi red ces brjod byung /phran dang sku zhabs blo bzang chos 'phel gnyis lha sa nas rgya gar du thon skabs sku'i gcen po rgya lo don 'grub mchog gis khong yang phran gnyis mnyam du rgya gar du yul skor gnas gzigs su phebs 'dod yod ces zhus te yab yum rnam gnyis kyi bka' 'khrol thob/ de nas phran gsum dang g.yog po bzhi tsam bcas zla 196

11 zla dkyil tsam la lha sa nas rgya gar du thon skabs bod gzhung nas dmag chen gnyis pa'i rgyal kha thob mkhan mthun phyogs rgyal khab a dbyin rgya gsum la g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs zhu ba'i sku tshab dza sag bla ma rong dpal lhun thub bstan bsam 'phel dang dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud bcas las bya dang sbrags gtong rgyu thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar ring min rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu phebs rgyu'i gnas tshul thos byung /phran tsho lha sa nas rgyal rtse bar zhag tshugs lnga dang rgyal rtse nas phag ri bar zhag tshugs bzhi/ phag ri nas gro mo bar zhag tshugs gnyis/ gro mo nas sgang tog bar zhag tshugs gsum bcas khyon bsdoms zhag po bcu bzhi tsam 'gor ste lam bar sa gnas rdzong gzhis khag gi dpon rigs dang / gtso drag rgan po bcas nas phebs bsu dang sne len gzab rgyas byas byung /rgyal rtse nas sgang tog bar de sngon dbyin jis jus bkod byas pa'i mgron khang rnams gtsang zhing / khams dngas ba 'dug pa dang / khang pa'i nang du me gtong sa yag po bzos 'dug pa bcas yid spro bag phebs ngang nas 'grul bzhud byed thub pa byung / nga tsho phag ri nas gro mor 'byor skabs gro mor bca' sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don las khungs kyi skya tshab skye yul gro mo yin pa chung dus rgya gar du slob sbyong byed myong ba rla ba 'ba' pu zhes pa des rgya gar tshong don sku srung dmag nyi shu tsam khrid nas me le gnyis tsam gyi sar phebs bsur phebs byung / khong gis sku'i gcen po mchog dang / phran gnyis la mjal dar re gnang zhing / srung dmag rnams nas dga' bsu'i ched du gus btud kyi rol dbyangs 'bud gtong dkrol gsum byas/ de'i gsham du gro spyi las tshab rdo rje rgyal pos bod kyi sa srung dmag 197

nyi shu tsam khrid nas phebs bsur 'byor/ de nas rla ba 'ba' pu dang rdo rje rgyal po'i sne khrid 'og de'i dgong dro dbyin ji'i tshong don las khungs su bzhugs shag gra sgrig gnang ba ltar de gar bzhugs/gro mor bca' snod dbyin ji'i tshong don las khungs de ni de sngon phyi lo 1904 lor dbyin bod gnyis kyis lha sar bzhag pa'i ching don nang gsal ltar dbyin ji gzhung gis bod sa khul gyi gro mo sna gdong dang / rgyal rtse/ stod sgar thog sogs su tshong don las khungs btsugs pa'i gas yin/ dang thog chings yig nang gsal ltar na/ tshong rwa 'dzugs yul de sna gdong zhes pa de rdza leb la'i ri gsham du yod kyang / rjes su dbyin jis tshong don las khungs dngos su 'dzugs skabs gro mo grong sde'i shar sing ma dang / dga' gling sgang dbar sa stong legs shos shig la btsugs yod 'dug pa dang / sa gnas der ya krung zhes thogs pa ni sna gdong zhes pa'i ming de zur chags pa zhig yin/ der yod dbyin ji'i tshong don las khungs dang ngo las rnams kyi las shag dmag sgar bcas kyi khang dbyibs de bod lugs khang pa dang mi 'dra ba khyad mtshar zhig 'dug pas ya mtshan gyi snang ba gsar pa zhig byung /de'i sang nyin phran tsho de nas me le gnyis gsum tsam du bod gzhung gro mo spyi khyab kyi gnas sa gro spyi khang zhes par bskyod de gro spyi las tshab rdo rje rgyal po dang /srung dmag rnams phebs bsur 'byor/ gro spyi khang du bzhugs shag gra sgrig gnang 'dug pa der nyin der nyin zhag gcig bzhugs/ gro spyi las khungs de de sngon dbyin jis de khul tshong rwa 'dzugs skabs bod gzhung nas kyang gro mo sa khul der gnas rim bzhi pa'i mtshan gnas yod pa'i dpon rigs shig bsko bzhag gnang ste 498

gro spyi las khungs dang / bzhugs shag sa srung dmag sgar bcas 'dzugs gnang mdzad/ de'i las 'gan ni rgyun du dbyin ji'i tshong don las khungs dang las don tsag tsig gi 'brel gtugs dang / sa mtshams srung skyob dang / bod zog dang rgya zog phan tshun 'dren gtong rigs la sho khral bsdu len/ de bzhin gro mo sa khul gyi yul mi rnams la srid 'dzin lta rtog bya rgyu bcas kyi 'gan khur yod/skabs der gro spyi ngo ma rim bzhi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel yin/khong rgyun du bka' sbug khul du bzhugs te bod gzhung gi tshong don mkho sgrub kyi las 'gan yod pa'i thog sger tshong yang rgyag gi yod/ dus rgyun gro mo spyi khyab kyi las tshab tu spom mda' rang khongs nas ngam ring nas yin pa'i rdo rje rgyal po bsko 'dzugs byas yod/ khong ni bod kyi rig gnas thog snyan grags can zhig yin pa ma zad/ mi gshis ngang rgyud 'jam po zhig yin/ de sngon bod kyi gzhung zhabs ser skya rnams mtha' mtshams khag gi rdzong gzhis khag tu rang nyid phebs ma thub pa byung mtshams rang khongs ngo tshab gcig bsko brdzong bya srol yod pa der gzhung gnas nas 'dri brtsad gang yang med/spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel ni mdo stod smar khams spom mda' tshang zhes pa'i mi rgyud yin pa dang / khong ni mi gshis kha ri kha thug cig yin/ khong la bu spyan gnyis dang gcung mo gcig yod pa'i nang khong rang rgan shos de red/ khong gi 'og la rab dga' dang / stobs rgyal gnyis yin/ khong chung dus nas tshong las kho na gnyer mkhan zhig yin stabs tshong las la byang chub pa zhig yin/ de sngon 7gong sa sku phreng 13 pa chen po'i skabs spom mda' yar 'phel gyi khu bo a khu nyi ma zhes pa de gzhung tshong thogs ma lta bu blangs nas lo shas bod ljongs yongs su tshong 199

'khos thabs len shugs che byas nas ha cang stobs 'byor chen por gyur par brten mi tshos sa spom mda' tshang dang / gnam spom mda' tshang zhes zer/ gong smos ltar spom mda' yar 'phel tshong las la mkhas pa ma zad/ bod gzhung dbang 'dzin mtho rim nang du 'brel 'dres chen po yod la srid don thad la'ang thabs byus mkhas po zhig yin/ khong gi thengs zhig phran la gsungs myong bar su la dbang shugs yod na de la 'brel gtugs yag po zhu thub che/ 'bras bu yag po thob rgyu dang / mi phan thogs med pa'i dus su 'brel gtugs byas na rang nyid phung gi red ces gsungs byung / gang ltar kho ni brgya cha brgya yi skabs 'tshol khe gnyer gyi tshong las mkhas pa 'khrul med gcig yin par snyam/ khong gis dgos pa gal che'i rigs la 'gro gron shugs chen gtong phod mkhan zhig yin pa ma zad/ chos sems kyang chen po yod/ rwa sgreng rgyal thog skabs khong gi 'bad thabs byas nas bod gzhung gi las tshan pa'i go gnas shig thob cing / de rjes rgyal tshab stag brag skabs rim bzhi'i go gnas thob pa'i thog gro mo spyi khyab kyi las 'gan yang thob nas rgya gar khul du bod gzhung gi mkho sgrub las 'gan gcig lcog byas yod//nga tsho gro mor ma 'byor sngon tsam la gro mo spyi khyab rim bzhi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel gyis bka' sbug nas khong gi las tshab rdo rje rgyal por nga tsho gro mor 'byor skabs sne len gzab rgyas zhu dgos pa dang / ring min bka' sbug tu phebs bzhugs ring bka' sbug spom mda' tshang gi ko ṭi'i nang du gra sgrig zhu gi yod ces tar 'phrin zhig 'byor byung zer/gro mo spyi khyab kyi bzhugs khang dang / gro mo sa srung dmag rnams kyi dmag sgar chags yul de shar seng ma grong sde dang bye ma grong sde'i dbar la yod/ gro mo spyi 200

khyab bzhugs khang dang btsan 'gag gnyis ni gro mo stod kyi grog rong khag gnyis nas rgyugs yong ba'i chu'i lho byang du gnas yod / phag ri nas rgya gar du 'gro ba'i lam chen de btsan 'gag sa nas 'gro ba ma gtogs lam gzhan nas 'gro sa med/btsan 'gag chags yul ha cang 'os babs can gyi sa char yod/ mtshan mo btsan 'gag gi sgo brgyab rjes phar tshur 'grul pa 'gro lam gzhan gang yang med/phran tsho gro spyi khang du bzhugs zhag gnang ba de'i dgong dro gsol tshogs zhu skabs nga tsho bzhugs sa'i phyir rol du dmag mi'i rol cha gtong ba der phran tsho ya mtshan gyi snang ba byung yang rjes su skad cha 'dres skabs de ni sngar srol ltar mi chen khag la gsol tshigs gtong skabs rol cha gtong srol yod 'dug de'i sang nyin gro spyi khang nas phyir thon gyis lam bar gro spyi'i sa srung dmag bcu grangs kyis sa mtshams bar phebs skyel du bcar/ de nyin me le lnga drug tsam bskyod nas chu 'bi thang zhes pa'i sar zhag gcig bsdad/ de'i sang nyin snga langs kyis sna stod la brgyab nas mtsho sgo zhes par bzhugs zhag gnang /sna stod la ni bod dang 'bras ljongs kyi sa mtshams dbye ba'i la rtse'i shar rgyud ri klung thams cad bod kyi mnga' khul dang de'i nub rgyud tshang ma 'bras ljongs kyi mnga' khongs yin/ skabs de'i sna stod la'i ri rtser rgyal khab phan tshun gnyis kyi sa rtags dang zhib bsher sa tshigs gang yang med/ nga tsho mtsho sgo zhag sar ma 'byor gyi sngon tsam la 'bras ljongs rgyal po nas phran tshor sne len zhu mi sne shan yar pa zhes pa na tshod dar ma zhig ched brdzong mdun gsol chigs kyi mthun rkyen sogs bskur 'dug yar pa zhes pa ni bod kyi sku zhabs zhes pa dang 'dra ba'i ming gnas shig yin/ khong mnyam du ma byan dang zhabs zhu mkhan yang khrid 'dug skabs 201

der sna stod la rtser kha ba chen po babs 'dug kyang nga tsho yong ba'i nyin mo de nam mkha' sngo thing nger dngas 'dug 'on kyang grang ngar chen po yod cing / 'dred brdar shor nas gangs dong nang du ltung ba dang skabs re gangs 'khyags 'dres ma'i steng du bzhon rta 'dred brdar shor nas tshang ma rta las babs nas rta yar slong dgos pa yang yong gi 'dug nga tsho tshang ma na gzhon yin stabs rta las babs te 'khyags shur glod nas rtsed mo'i snang ba'i thog nas la babs skabs grang snang yang ma tshor bar sna stod la brgal rjes gangs 'khyags de tsam med cing / gnam gshis rim bzhin dro ru 'gro gi 'dugasna stod la'i nub ngos su blta skabs gnam gru nas sa la bltas pa bzhin ljang thing nger gnas shing / de'i steng du smug pas khengs 'dug pas sa cha mthon por slebs pa'i snang ba zhig byung / mtsho sgo nas 'bras ljongs rgyal sa sgang tog bar me le nyer gcig lhag tsam las med kyang lam bar brag gtor nas bzos pa'i ha cang g.yang gzar che ba'i lam du bskyod nas de nyin zhag sar ma slobs bar dus tshod mang che ba rkang bgrod bya dgos byung / zhag sa'i mgron khang du 'byor skabs mi 'ga' shas kyis nga tshor dga' bsu sne len zhu rgyur phebs sgug zhus nas bsdad 'dug par de tsho ni 'bras ljongs gzhung rkyang nas khyed tshor sne len du ched brdzong gnang yod pa red ces yar pa lags kyi ngo sprod gnang byung / nga tsho mgron khang du slebs te de rnams kyi nang nas mi rgan pa zhig gis lag tu mjal dar khyer nas sku'i gcen po rgya lo don 'grub mchag dang / phran la dga' bsu rten 'brel gyi ched du phul ba'i thog khong gis 'bras ljongs gzhung rkyang dang / rgyal sras rin po che rnam gnyis nas sku ngo rnam gnyis phebs lam du 'o brgyal ma byung ngam zhes 'tshams 'dre 202

zhu bar btang byung / de ring dgong dro rgyal sras rin po che dang / rgyal po'i sras mo rnam gnyis 'dir rnam pa gnyis kyi sar phebs rgyu yin pas/ do nub dga' bsu'i gsol tshogs zhig 'bul rgyu'i bka' mngags gnang byung zhes dang / de nas sgang tog bar me le bdun tsam las med pas sang nyin sku lhod lhod gnang na 'grigs zer/mgron khang de nas 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i pho brang dang / sgang tog gi yul ljongs bcas gsal por mthong gi 'dug nyi ma ma bzhud tsam la 'bras ljongs rgyal sras dpal ldan don grub rnam rgyal dang / khong gi gcung mo gnyis mgron khang der phebs te nga tsho lhan du mjal 'phrad gnang ba'i thog dgong dro dbyin ji'i lugs kyi gsol chigs gzab rgyas bshams rjes rgyal sras rin po che sgang tog tu zhabs gom bskyon nas phyir phebs gnang / sras mo gnyis nga tsho bzhugs sa'i nye 'gram gyi mgron khang du bzhugs nas sang nyin nga tsho ma langs gong khong gnyis sgang tog tu phebs thon gnang 'dug rjes su sras mo de gnyis nas bgres pa pad+ma che sgron bod gzhung sku drag yab gzhis phun khang gi sras mgon po che ring gi mna' mar phebs pa dang / chung ba pad+ma chos skyed yab gzhis g.yu thog gi sras rig 'dzin che brtan gyi mna' mar gnang / nga tsho sgang tog tu 'byor skabs bka' sbug nas gro spyi spom mda' yar 'phel gyis drung yig pa sangs bstan pa nas phebs bsu'i mo ṭa khrid nas phebs sgug zhus nas bsdad 'dug 'bras ljongs gzhung gis nga tsho bzhugs yul mgron khang zhig gra sgrigs gnang ba der ngal gso lhod lhod byas nas de'i sang nyin 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i pho brang du bcar nas rgyal po dang rgyal sras rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad zhus pa'i thog dgong dro pho brang nang du phran gnyis la dga' bsu'i 203

gsol ston gzab rgyas shig bshams nas gsol tshigs la bcar ba dang / rgyal po yab sras gnyis dang / 'bras ljongs blon chen gdan sa pa ('ba' nyag a thing bkris dgra 'dul )bcas yod/ skabs der 'bras ljongs rgyal po dgung lo bzhi cu nas lnga bcu tsam min nam snyam/ rgyal po des gos chen ser po'i tshal phyu ma dang dbu zhwa mog ril / zhabs phyags 'ja' chen mtshal ka bcas bzhes 'dugakhong ni dus rgyun du yul ljongs kyi ri mo 'bri rgyu sogs la dbyings yod pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ khong gis dbus skad ha cang bde po bskyon gyi 'dugargyal sras rin po che skabs der dgung lo nyi shu lhag tsam yin 'dug pa khong las bgres pa'i rgyal sras shig byung yod kyang gnam dmag nang zhugs nas gnam gru slob sbyong skabs gnam gru brdabs skyon gyis skya gshegs pa red zer/ rgyal sras rin po che zhu dgos don ni khongakhams kyi bla ma'i yang srid cig yin 'dug khong yang dbus skad gtsang ma bskyon zhing mi babs 'dra chags po zhig 'dug skabs der rgyal po dang btsun mo gnyis ma mthun pa byung ste btsun mo bzhugs sa pho brang gzhan zhig tu yod zer/ btsun mo de ni lha sa'i sde dpon mi drag mdo mkhar ba'i sras mo yin/ de sngon 'bras ljongs rgyal po rim byon gyis bod kyi sku drag gi sras mo btsun mor len srol byung 'duga'abras ljongs kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus rob tsam zhu 'os pa zhig yin pas dus ra bas bcu gsum pa'i sngon yul der gnas pa'i mi rigs de bod rigs khongs nas zur du gyes pa'i leb cha zhes pa de yin/ mi rgyud de jo mo lha ri'i lho rgyud lho mon dang mon yul bcas su khyab yod/ yul phan tshun ri mtho chu btsan gyi grog rong dang nags tshal skugs pos bcad par brten tsho khag phan tshun 'grul 204

bzhud kyi 'brel ba de tsam ma byung bar rim bzhin phan tshun gyi goms gshis dang skad cha phran bu mi 'dra bar gyur/dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i skabs bod kyi bla ma sa skya 'gro mgon 'phags pa hor yul nas bod du phyir phebs skabs hor rgyal po gub la'i tan gyis mi nyag pa mchog dman mang po bla ma'i zhabs zhur phul ba'i khongs mi nyag rgyal rgyud yin pa na gzhon zhig khong gi gam bcar zhabs zhur thugs nyar gnang ste bod du khrid phebs pa des bla ma'i zhabs zhu ha cang legs po bsgrubs par brten khong gis sbas yul 'bras ljongs kyi rdzong dpon bsko gzhag gnang nas bzung khong dang mnyam du zhabs zhu'i mi sna mang po mnyam brdzongs te de rnams kyis yul der snga rabs nas gnas pa'i leb cha mi dmangs rnams dbang bsgyur byas nas rim bzhin yul de'i rgyal por gyur cing / rgyal blon gyi dbye ba phye nas mi rgyud du mas yul de bdag gir bzung rjes sbas yul 'bras ljongs der lo brgya phrag mang po'i ring chab srid bskyangs/bod rgyal khab kyi sa skya'i dus rabs nas phag gyu rin spungs/ gtsang pa dang /lhag par dga' ldan pho brang bcas kyi khongs gtogs kyi rgyal phran lta bur gnas pa ma zad/ bod gzhung nas kyang 'bras ljongs sa spyod pa zhes pa'i che bstod go gnas bstsal ba bcas lo rgyus mdor bsdus tsam yin/'bras ljongs rgyal po dang rgyal sras rnam gnyis mjal 'phrad dang 'brel dga' bsu'i gsol tshigs zhus rjes 'bras ljongs khul du dbyin ji gzhung gi gtan sdod chab srid spyi khyab bod mi tshos 'bras spyi blon chen zhes 'bod pa de yang mjal 'phrad zhus shing / des kyang phran tshor dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams gnang mdzad/ skabs der rgya gar rang btsan ma thob sngon gyi dus skabs shig yin pas 205

'bras spyi blon chen de dbyin ji ba zhig red 'dug 'bras spyi blon chen gyi las 'gan ni bod dang / 'brug 'bras ljongs bcas kyi chab srid thog gi 'brel ba byed mkhan yin zer/ lhag par du 'bras ljongs gzhung gi phyi nang gi srid dbang mtha' dag 'bras spyi blon chen gyi bkod sgrig 'og tu gnas yod/'bras spyi blon chen gyi ming gnas de de sngon 7gong sa sku phreng 13 pa chen po mchog gis 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod dbyin ji'i chab srid spyi khyab sar car se spel zhes pa de bod dbyin bar gyi 'brel lam la zhabs 'degs hur skyed zhus pa'i legs skyes su bod gzhung blon chen gyi go gnas bstsal ba nas bzung 'bras spyi blon chen zhes pa'i ming gnas de grags/ de'i bzhugs khang dang las khungs kyi chags yul de 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i pho brang gi nub ngos me le gcig tsam gyi sa bab legs po zhig tu chags 'duga'abras mo ljongs der dbyin ji'i dbang shugs slebs pa nas bzung gor ṣa mi rigs de rim bzhin yul der gzhis chags nas da cha yul de'i mi 'bor las gor ṣa ldab bcu phrag 'ga' shas kyis mang ba khyab ste yul mi ngo ma de grangs nyung mi rigs zhig tu gyur pa ma zad/ shes yon dang gang ci'i thad gor ṣa'i mi rigs de drag pa yod pas rim bzhin yul de'i skad lugs gtso bo yang pā ras skad du gyur 'dugang tsho sgang tog la zhag gsum sdod ring bzhon rta rnams dang / g.yog po byings rnams rgyal rtse khul 'brong rtse gzhis su re zhig phyir slog byas/ sku zhabs blo bzang chos 'phel dang / g.yog gnyis mnyam du khrid de sgang tog nas mo ṭa'i thog bka' sbyag bar chu tshod gnyis lhag tsam la slebs/ bka' sbug tu ma slebs tsam 206

la bkris brag ces pa'i nye 'gram du bka' sbug nas rwa sgreng bla brang gi bka' sbug tu bca' sdod tshong spyi las tshab sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang / sa 'du tshang tshong dpon/ de min bka' sbug du gtan sdod bod mi'i skyid sdug gi ngo tshab bcas nas phebs bsu'i dbu gur sgron nas phebs sgyag zhus 'dug de gar khyug tsam ring phan tshun ngo spyod kyis 'tshams 'dre zhu res byas rjes bka' sbug tu thon/bka' sbyag spom mda' tshang gi ko ṭi'i sgo 'gram du 'byor skabs gro spyi rim bzhi spom mda' yar 'phel nas phran gnyis la dga' bsu'i sne len thog ko ṭi de'i rtse thog gi gzim chung bkod legs yid kyi dang ba 'dren pa zhig tu bzhugs shag gra sgrig gnang 'dug pa der gzim chung mdo sbug gnyis la gsang spyod khrus khang rang 'grigs dang bzo spras legs pa'i 'dzin chas bcas bkod sgrig legs par gnang 'dug skabs der spom mda'i ko ṭi de ni bka' sbug khul gyi khang pa bzo bkod legs shos dang rgya khyon che shos shig yin/ ko ṭi'i mtha' 'khor gyi rgya khyon la ha lam dbyin dzi'i e kur gsum bzhi lhag tsam med dam snyam/phran tsho bka' sbug tu 'byor nas nyin shas ring de khul gyi bod rigs tshong pa drag zhan khag dang bka' sbug du gtan bzhugs 'brug pa rā ja rdo rje dang / shar pa ang spen pa/ lha sdod bal tshong khag gi tshong phrug bcas phran tsho'i sar gcig rjes gnyis mthud du yong nas 'tshams zhu gnang nas nga tsho phan tshun ngo shes mang po chags pa dang / de khul gtan sdod mi rgan tsho'i brjod babs la gzhigs na lo brgya phrag gi sngon la bka' sbug khul gyi bdag po bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang yin zer pa dang / la las 'brug gi mnga' 'og yin zer mkhan 'dug gang ltar dus rabs bcu dgu'i pa'i sngon tsam la dbyin jis bod du 'brel lam gyi lag pa ma 207

brkyang gong sa khul de bdag med lta brur lus pa gor ma chagaphyi lo 1851 lo dbyin jis 'bras ljongs la dbang sgyur byas nas bzung bka' sbyag sa khul de ha cang gal gnad che bar gyur te rim bzhi bod kyi lho nub kyi phyi phyogs tshong rwa'i lte ba lta bur gyur/ sa khul de bod dang / 'brug 'bras ljongs bcas dang sa 'dres yin pa ma zad/ yul phan tshun tshong 'khos 'thab len gyi 'du 'dzoms byed sa gnad 'gag can zhig yin/ bod kyi tshong pa tshos bod zog bal dang / gla rtsi/ sman rtswa bcas de khul du dbor 'dren byas nas 'dzam gling rgyal khab khag tu 'grems spel byed cing / de khul gyi bod kyi tshong pa che khag gtso bo spom mda' tshang dang / rwa sgreng bla brang / sa 'du tshang bcas gsum po de bal tshong rgyag mkhan gtso bo'i gras yin pa de tshos rgya zog dang / rgyal khab gzhan gyi dngos zog rnams dbor 'dren byas nas bod nang khul dang / rgya nag lho nub gyi yul gru khag tu skyel 'dren gyis tshong las 'khrugs po byed kyi yod/phran tsho bka' sbug tu nyin bcu tsam bsdad rjes ri li'i thog ka la ka ta brgyud gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du gnas mjal du thon/ skabs der 'bras spyi blon chen nas 'bras ljongs pa blo bzang 'ba' pu zhes pa rang lo bzhi cu tsam yin pa zhig nga tsho'i sne shan du btang ste/ ri li dang gnas tshang bcas gra sgrig ang bsar byed mkhan yod stabs gnas mjal du bskyod skabs phyogs gang ci'i thad bde blag bag phebs ngang bskyod thub pa byung zhing / phran tsho gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du phebs nas mchog gsum spyan sngar mchod sprin gzab rgyas bshams pa dang / ngan slong rnams la sbyin pa gya nom pa btang /rgya gar ba tshos lho3 ga ya zhes 'bod pa'i rdo rje gdan ni bdag cag gi ston 208

pa shakyu thub pa sogs dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya sa'i gnas mchog bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig yin/ nga tsho bod mi tshos gnas mchog de mjal ba'i go skabs thob pa tsam gyis che 'dir shin tu skal ba bzang ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bsags pa zhig yin par yid ches byed kyi yod/ston pa shakyu thub pa mngon par sangs rgyas sa'i gnas mchog de ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo bzhi brgya'i thog rgya gar lho phyogs khul du sku 'khrungs pa'i 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mchod rten nyams gso rgya bskyed gnang bar grags/mchod rten de sku tshad shin tu mtho la gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig 'dug bar skabs kyi dus su rgya gar khul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nub pa nas bzung mchod rten gyi g.yas g.yon du bye ma spungs nas mchod rten bye mas 'gebs pa'i nyen kha byung yang /rjes su rgya gar dbyin ji'i dbang sgyur skabs mchod rten gyi g.yas g.yon du spungs pa'i bye ma rnams bsal nas mchod rten legs par mjal thub pa byung bar grags/de rjes sing gha la'i dge bsnyen dharma pā las mchod rten la nyams gso chen po gnang / phran tshos gnas mchog de mjal skabs mchod rten gyi nye 'gram du mgron khang thabs chag cig yod pa las de min dgon pa dang mi tshang gang yang med par lung stong zhig red 'dug dgun dus su bod dang / 'brug yul/ bal yul/la dwags bcas nas gnas bskor ba yong skabs mchod rten nye 'khor du ngan slong mang po 'dzoms sar gnas bskor ba tshos sbyin pa rgya gang che gtong srol yod/phran tshos gnas mchog rdo rje gdan mjal rjes skad grags can gyi grong khyer ka la ka tar lta bskor du bskyod de rla gcig lhag tsam ring spom mda' rab 209

dgas de khul glas pa'i mgron khang du bsdad/ grong khyer phyi nang du yod pa'i snyan grags can gyi khrom gzhung dang / yul ljongs/ srog chags spyi gling bcas la gzigs bskor spro 'cham gnang / de bzhin phran gnyis rta rgyugs byed sar thengs 'ga' shas bskyod de rgyan gtsugs nas dngul thob pa'i re ba byas kyang rta rgyugs sa nas phyir log skabs am phrag stong par log dgos byung stabs nyams dma' zhing kha skyengs dgos pa zhig byung /de khul sdod ring nyin zhig ka ta khul du bca' sdod go min tang gi don gcod las khungs su bskyod de ling hri spyi khyab ngo thug gis hreng tsung lan de khul ga dus yong min gyi gnas tshul dris par khong gis/ hreng tsung lan bdun phrag gcig gi rjes su ka la ka tar phebs rgyu red la bod gzhung gi sku tshab tshogs pa mi brgyad dgu zhig kyang ring min khong lhan du ka la ka tar phebs rgyu red/ hreng tsung lan nas khyed rang dang tu la'i bla ma'i sku'i gcen po rgya lo don 'grub rnam gnyis la phyag rogs zhu dgos pa'i yi ge 'byor yang rnam pa gnyis 'di khul phebs yod med dang / bzhugs sa gar yin ma shes par de mur lus/ da ring khyed nga tsho'i sar phebs pa de dga' po byung / khyed rnam gnyis la rogs ram gang zhu dgos kyang gsungs rogs gnang /gal te khyed rnam gnyis la stabs bde yod na nga tsho'i las khungs kyi thag nye sa krung go lu'i shing hri mgron khang chen po min la/ rgyas spros kyang de tsam med pa zhig yod pas der kha khu sem po dang / gtsang sbra dod po yod pas der spo bzhugs gnang na legs gnas/ nga tshos khyed rnam gnyis la rogs ram zhu bde yong ba dang / ring min bod gzhung sku tshab rnam pa ka tar phebs bzhugs skabs nga tshos mgron khang der gra sgrig zhus yod ces zer bar phran gyis hreng tsung lan phebs 'byor mtshams ji 210
