'gab bka' mol zhus nas lan gsal phul 'thus/ da lta gnas skabs ring spom mda' rab dgas gra sgrig byas pa'i bzhugs khang de'i nang bsdad yod pas da lta rogs ram gnang rogs zhu rgyu gang yang med ces brjod nas phyir log byas te gong gsal gnas tshul rnams sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog la snyan seng zhus/nyin shas nas bod gzhung gi sku tshab rnams ka la ka ta brgyud ldi ler phebs pa go thos byung / dus skabs des hreng tsung lan yang ka tar phebs te phran rang khong gi sar phyin nas bar skabs kyi gnas tshul rnams zhib bshad dang 'brel khong dang lhan du nan cing du slob sbyong du 'gro 'dun skor rob tsam gleng mol byung ste phal cher 'gro gtan 'khel yang / slob sbyong du 'gro rgyu'i skor da bar sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog la bka' mol gang yang ma byung ba da cha de skor zhu gal che bar mthong ste nyin zhig khong la phran 'di nas hreng tsung lan dang mnyam du rgya nag tu slob sbyong la 'gro rgyu'i skor zhus par khong yang phran dang mnyam du phebs kyi yin zhes gsungs te skabs der ga byed 'di byed ma shes par phran gnyis hreng tsung lan sar bskyod/ de skor khong la zhib cha'i bsam tshul zhus par khong gis gsan ma thag rnam 'gyur 'dzum mdangs ldan pa'i sgo nas yag po zhe drag red/ 'on kyang khyed rnam gnyis rgya nag du phebs 'thus chog pa'i skor rgyal yab dang rgyal yum rnam gnyis mchog la bka' 'khrol nges par zhu dgos/ lam seng 'di nas tar 'phrin zhig phul thub na legs gnas la nga tsho'i 'di nas btang na 'grigs zhes gsungs byung bar phran gnyis nas de don gtong gnang yong ba zhes zhus rjes bdun phrag gcig tsam gyi rjes su lha sa nas rgyal yab mchog gis phran gnyis la tar lan zhig 'byor gsal du khyed gnyis rgya nag tu bskyod na 'thus rgyu dang slob sbyong hur brtson byed dgos thog 21 1

gzugs por ca ga dag po dgos rgyu bcas bka' slob stsal 'byor byung bar brten phran gnyis blo bde dga' spro brjod kyi mi lang ba zhig byung / 'on kyang phran gnyis ka tar rgyun ring bzhugs shing / rta rgyugs su thengs mang bskyod pas dngul phran bu yod pa rnams 'thor zin pa'i rkyen gyis 'gro song ma ldeng ba'i gnas su gyar stabs phran gyis ka tar bca' sdod spom mda' tshang gi las byed ne pa la mi rigs shig yod pa de'i sa nas dbyin sgor bzhi brgya snga g.yar gyis sgor gsum brgya tham pa sku'i gcen po rgya lo mchog nyin shas bzhugs ring gi gron dngul la phul ba dang / sgor brgya tham pa phra na bka' phrug tu bskyod rgyu'i lam gron du khyer nas bka' sbyag tu dngul phran bu thabs 'tshol byed par bskyod/ bka' sbug tu 'byor skabs blo bzang chos 'phel gyi phyag tu yod pa'i ma dngul rnams kyis tshong zog nyos zin nas khong rang yang 'gro song gtong rgyur lag 'dzangs che bas gnas su gyar 'dug phran gyis spom mda' tshang nas sgor chig khri tham pa snga g.yar gyis ring min lha sa nas skyen tshab 'bul rgyu zhus/ dngul 'bab de nas blo bzang chos 'phel gyi tshong zog bdal gla dang lam gron gtong ched sgor 4000 phul ba dang / de 'phros ka tar sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog la sgor 5000 'bul skur zhus nas ring min rgya nag tu ma thon bar dngul 'bor de nas 'gro gron btang /bar lam ka ta khul du sdod ring spom mda' rab dga' dang 'brel 'dres chen po byung / khong bod yig shes tshad yag po yod pa ma zad/ dbyin ji'i skad yig kyang yag po shes kyi yod cing / lhag par chab srid thog la'ang do snang chen po yod mkhan zhig yin/ phran ka ta nas bka' sbug tu 'byor ba'i nyin zhig khong sar mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar bcar skabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang /212

lcang can gung zur bsod nams rgyal po/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel bcas lhan du bzhugs 'dug de sngon sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang /lcang can gung zur sku zhabs gnyis thengs mang mjal myong yod kyang / mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi mtshan mang po thos myong yang dngos su mjal thengs dang po yin stabs spom mda' rab dgas nga tshor ngo sprod gnang byung / khong gi 'khrungs yul a mdo re kong red 'dug skabs der dgung lo 40 lhag tsam min nam snyam/ khong gi na bza' phyu chen rnying pa tshos mdog rgya smug cig bzhes 'dugabaka' mol de tsam mi gnang la mkhas rlom gyi rnam pa gang yang mi 'dug nga tsho lhan du gsol chigs zhus rjes spom mda' rab dgas da res sras sku zhabs gsol tshigs su gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar phebs thub par dga' bsu zhu rgyu ma zad/ khong rnam pa dang phan tshun ngo sprod zhu thub par ha cang dga' po byung / bar lam sras sku zhabs nga gnyis ka la ka tar nyin mang po'i ring 'brel ba byung nas grogs po chags pa ma zad/ deng skabs 'dzam gling dang / lhag par rgya nag bcas kyi chab srid kyi 'pho 'gyur gnas stangs skor bka' mol ji snyed cig zhus pa'i skor ngas khong rnam par zhus pa dang / da res sras sku zhabs dang khong rnam pa ngo mjal gyi go skabs yag po byung yod/ nga dang khong rnam pa 'brel 'dres dam zab yod/ sang gnangs zhig la 'di gar khyug tsam phebs rogs gnang / khyed la nga tsho'i re 'dun dang bsam tshul phran bu zhu rgyu yod ces gsungs te de nyin nga tsho zhal gyes zhus te nyin gcig gi rjes phran spom mda' rab dga'i bzhugs sar bskyod skabs khong dang a mdo dge 'dun chos 'phel gnyis gzim chung sbug tu bzhugs 'dug par khong gnyis kyi sar 'bod byung bas gzim chung sbug ma der bcar skabs khong gnyis kyi 213

mdun du yi ge mang po bkrams 'dug pa de dag ma bsdus par rang sar bzhag 'dugaspom mda' rab dgas da lta nga gnyis khyed rang skor bka' mol zhu bzhin yod pas khyed phebs pa de ha cang yag po byung / kha nyin ngas khyed rang 'dir gdan zhus kyis khong rnams dang ngo sprod lta bu zhus shing da res khyed 'dir phebs dgos don ni/ nga tsho'i bsam tshul dang dmigs yul bcas khyed la rob tsam zhu 'dod yod/deng sang gi dus skabs 'di ha cang gi gal gnad chen po zhig tu slebs yod pas nga tshos nges par du bsam blo nan tan gtong dgos pa'i 'gag rtsa'i dus skabs shig yin/ rgyal khab gcig yin na'ang 'dra/ mi rigs gcig yin na'ang 'dra gdod ma'i gnas lugs de rgyun du gnas thub thabs med/ gal srid da mus bzhin gnas rgyur 'bad na'ang nyin zhig mi rigs gzhan zhig gi drag gnon 'og tu tshud rgyu'am/ yang na nang khul du mi gsod khrag sbyor gyi nang 'khrugs kyi las ngan zhig yong gi red/ gang yin zhe na/ bod kyi khyim mches rgyal khab chen po rgya dkar nag gnyis kyi bod de sngar mus bzhin bzhag gi ma red/ rang re bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khab chen po de dus rabs bdun pa nas dgu pa bar 'dzam gling nang du snyan grags chen po yod pa'i rgyal khab cig chags te bod snga rabs kyi zer srol la 'dzam gling gsum gnyis tsam bod kyi dbang 'og tu bcug yod par grags/ de rjes bod kyi rgyal rgyud rnams nang khul ma mthun pa'i dbang gis kha gyes nas bzung bod ljongs mtha' dbus tshang ma sil bur gyur zhing / bod rgyal khams yongs rdzogs nyams rgud du gyur te mtha' 'khor rgyal khab gzhan gyis rim zos kyis bod kyi mnga' khul dang / mnga' 'bangs ji nyung du 'gro bzhin yod pa des nam zhig bod ljongs yongs rdzogs 'jig pa'i nyen kha yong gi red bsam gyi 'dug rtsa ba sde pa gzhung gi 214

bla ma dpon po rnams kyis ma mkhyen pa dang ma rtogs pa dpe mi srid kyang gang ci'i mdzad dka' yang mang po 'phrad kyi yod par mngon/ deng rabs kyi dus 'di dmag chen gnyis pa'i dmag 'khrug mjug 'gril nas bzung rgya nag go min tang rgyal khab de 'dzam gling nang shugs cher 'gro gi yod pa dang / de bzhin dbyin jis rgya gar rang btsan myur du mi sprod rang sprod kyi mtshams su slebs kyi yod 'dug gang yin zer na/ cang u yon krang stengs zhal gnyis snga lo 1943 che 1 nang rgya gar mi dmangs kyi 'go khrid pa ma ha ta ma snyan dis gdan zhu ltar/ rgyal sa ldi li gsar par rgya gar mi dmangs rnams la 'tshams 'drer phebs nas rgya gar du bca' bzhugs dbyin ji'i rgyal tshab dang lhan du ring min dmag chen gnyis pa mjug 'gril rjes dbyin ji gzhung la rgya gar mi dmangs rnams kyi rang btsan rtsod len gyi rtsa don dmigs yul 'grub thabs kyi re 'dun gzhir bzung myur du rang btsan sprod dgos lugs re skul nan po zhus par dbyin gzhung gis brtsi mthong chen po byed kyi yod/ da cha nyi hong rgyal khab ldamag pham nas rgya nag dang / a mi ri ka/dbyin ji/ ru su bcas rgyal khab chen po rnams la mgo btags zhus pa'i nyin nas bzung cang u yon krang gi 'go khrid 'og rgya nag rgyal khab de e shi ya'i nang du snyan grags can gyi rgyal khab chen po zhig tu 'gyur rgyur the tshom med/ gong gsal gnas tshul 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i dus skabs 'dir nga tshos bod kyi chab srid gnas stangs de snang med du bzhag na nga tsho'i mi che de go ma chod pa red/ nga tshos nges par du lo rgyus kyi khur po de phrag par 'khur dgos/ rang cag bod kha ba can gyi 'das pa'i lo rgyus der phyi mig gcig bltas na/ sngar 'gyod phyis bsdoms gnang rgyu gal che'i dus su slebs yod/ lo gcig gi sngon la nga tsho 'di khul du 215

gnas pa'i bod mi ngo shes 'ga' shas kyis slad bod ljongs chab srid kyi phan bde yong thabs su yang yang gros mol byung ste nub bod legs bcos tshogs pa zhig ma byung mthu med la brten nga tshos tshogs pa zhig btsugs pa yin/ kha nyin sras sku zhabs khyed 'dir phebs skabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang / lcang lo can gung skya zhabs/ mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel bcas nga tsho'i tshogs pa'i 'gan 'khur ba rnam pas khyed la mjal 'phrad zhus pa red/ nga tsho'i tshogs mi ni 'di khul dang / lha sa khul du khyab yod/ tshogs pa btsugs nas dus yun lo gcig lhag tsam las ma song yang / spyir btang gi tshogs mi brgya ma zin tsam yod/sras sku zhabs khyed rang thugs mos yod na nga tshos dga' bsu zhu gi yin zhes gsungs byung /skabs der phran gyis spom mda' rab dga' ngo shes pa nas bzung /bong gis gshis rgyud 'jam po'i ngang nas deng dus 'dzam gling gi gnas bab dang / 'gyur ba/lhag par chab sred thog mkhas mdzangs ldan pa'i dbye zhib gnang skabs khong ni dngos 'brel gyi shes yon can zhig yin pa shes nas khong gi gang gsungs pa rnams la gus brtse chen po'i ngang dang len gyis tshogs pa de'i nang zhugs rgyu'i 'dod mos yod kyang re zhig bsam blo gtong gi yin zhes zhus/nyin shas rjes khong gi sar bcar skabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags dang / spom mda' rab dga'/ dge 'dun chos 'phel lags bcas lhan du bzhugs 'dug spom mda' rab dgas sku zhabs dge 'dun chos 'phel lags ring min 'brug yul nas mon yul brgyud lha sar phebs rgyu yin pas/sras sku zhabs ring min lha sar phyir phebs rjes khong la 'brel ba gnang rogs /216

gal srid khong la rogs ram gnang dgos byung che nges par du gnang thub na phan thogs chen po yong rgyu zhes bka' mngags gnang byung / skabs der phran rgya nag tu 'gro rtsis yod pa'i bsam tshul de khong tsho su la yang bshad med stabs khong tshos phran ring min lha sar phyir log byed shag gi dgongs tshul byung ba 'dra/ nyin shas rjes 'brong rtse gzhis nas chibs bsu rta drel dang / g.yog bcas bka' sbug tu 'byor rjes blo bzang chos 'phel chibs bsu dang mnyam du lha sar phyir log btang nas phran rang bka' sbug nas ka tar rdog thon byas/rjes su go thos skabs dge 'dun chos 'phel 'brug yul nas mon yul du gsang bskyod kyis de sngon dbyin jis bod kyi mnga' khongs ji zos kyi sa khul rnams kyi rgya khyon la nyams zhib bya ched sa bkra zhib cha zhig bkod rjes dbyin jis bod gzhung la dbyen sbyor dkrug shing zhus te dge 'dun chos 'phel lha sar phebs ma thag 'dzin bzung gis tsha 'dre nan po byas nas snang rtse shag tu btson 'jug byas/ de bzhin dbyin ji'i gzhung gis spom mda' rab dga' dang / thub bstan kun 'phel lags gnyis rgya gar tu bzhugs ma bcug par rgya nag tu phyir 'bud byas te phran tsho nan cing du slar yang thug 'phrad skabs spom mda' rab dga' nas gong gsal gnas tshul byung rim rnams phran la rob tsam gsungs byung / skabs der phran la bsam blo legs nyes gang yang 'khor ma byung / rjes su rim pas gnas tshul gsal rtogs skabs spom mda' rab dga' dang / go min tang dmag don gsang ba'i las khungs dang / bod sog las khungs bcas dang 'brel ba yod pa ma zad/dmag don gsang ba'i las khungs nas khong la 'gro gron slad bod ljongs sa khul du go min tang gi yan lag lta bu'i tshogs pa zhig 'dzugs thabs kyi mngags cha byas don 217

bzhin bod kyi sa khul du 'dzugs thabs bral nas khong bka' sbug tu phebs rjes de sngon byus nyes phog pa'i bod gzhung gi mi sna sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel dang /lcang lo can bsod nams rgyal po dang mnyam du nub bod tshogs pa zhes pa btsugs/de bzhin go min tang gis de sngon dbyin jis zos pa'i mon yul sa khul nang gi sa khyon che chung dang / mi 'bor ji yod/ thon skyed gang yod/ sa bab mtho tshad dang tsha gang / mi dmangs kyi goms gshis dang bsam tshul/ lo rgyus bcas kyi skor zhib phra nyams zhib bya rgyu'i mngags bcol byas 'dug pa ltar dge 'dun chos 'phel gtong dgos don de yin zhes zer/ phran khong tsho'i tshogs khongs su btsug thabs byas pa de ni khong tsho'i tshogs mi dge 'dun chos 'phel lha sar phebs skabs phran gyis 'gabs srung bya rgyu'i thabs byus shig bton pa min nam snyam/ de ni rang nyid lo na chung ba'i rkyen gyis byis pa'i mongs bsam lta bus skabs 'phral ngar sems skyed pa tsam las nyams myong med pa'i skyon cha la brten nas gsal la mi gsal ba'i lam du hol rgyugs byas pa zhig red 'dugabod gzhung gi g.yul rgyal legs 'bul sku tshab rnams rgya gar du phebs 'byor byung ba'i skabs der phran rang bka' sbug nas ka tar phyir 'byor rjes sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang phran gnyis khong rnams kyi bzhugs sa'i mgron khang du gnas spo byas/ bod gzhung gi sku tshab de ni gong du rob tsam zhus don bzhin 'dzam gling dmag chen gnyis pa mjug 'grel rjes bod gzhung nas dus skabs dang bstun nas a ri dang / dbyin ji/ rgya nag bcas mthun phyogs rgyal khab khag la dmag 'khrug gi rgyal kha thob pa der g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs zhu bar sku tshab ched brdzong gnang ba zhig red/248

khong rnams lha sa nas sgang thog tu phebs ma thag dbyin ji'i gzhung gis sne len gzab rgyas zhus pa dang / sku tshab rnams ldi lis phebs nas dbyin ji rgya gar rgyal tshab (2017 775011) lor ṭa we bel la mjal 'phrad zhus thog dbyin ji gzhung la g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs kyi 'bul tshan phul/ de bzhin ldi lir bca' bzhugs a ri'i gzhung tshab mjal 'phrad zhus thog a ri gzhung la'ang g.yul rgyal legs 'bul phus rjes khong rnams ldi li nas ka la ka tar phyir phebs kyis rgya nag tu phebs 'char gyis bdun phrag gsum tsam ring de khul mjes ljongs khag la gzigs bskor spro 'cham dang sbrags de nas phebs thon gyi gra sgrig mdzad skabs phran gnyis khong tsho dang lhan du rgya nag tu slob sbyong byed par 'gro 'char yod lugs skor sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso tar khang dza sag bla ma rong dpal lhun thub bstan bsam 'phel mchog la gnas tshul zhib cha zhu skabs dang thog khong rang hang sangs pa'i thog nas rgya nag tu slob sbyong ga re yod/ ma phebs na yag gi red/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / 7rgyal ba'i yab yum bcas dgongs pa tshom gyi red/ sa thag ring por ma phebs na yag gi red/ de las rgya gar du gzigs mo spro 'cham grub rjes lha sar mgyogs tsam phyir phebs gnang dgos lugs zhes dgag cha nan po gnang bar phran gnyis nas de skor 7rgyal yab mchog la dgongs skor bka' 'khrol gyis bka' tar phebs pa'i skor zhus par khong gis sku'i gcen po nga tsho lhan du rgya nag la phebs rgyu yin lugs skor ngos kyi las sbrel dza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud mchog la bka' bsdur zhus nas gzhung sa mchog la tar thog nas snyan seng ma zhus na blos 'gan bzod min zhes gsungs te khong gis lam seng dza sag khe smad sar phebs te khong gnyis bka' gros thog lha sa 219

bka' shag brgyud 7rgyal ba mchod yon gnyis la snyan tar phul yod pa 'dra/skabs der tar 'phrin nang tshig don ji 'khod ma shes kyang nyin shas rjes tar khang dza sag gis phran gnyis khong gi bzhugs sar 'bod de phran gnyis rgya nag tu ma phebs na legs lugs dang sa thag ring por phebs che 7skyabs mgon rin po che dang / yab yum rnam gnyis kyis thugs khral chen po gnang rgyur nges/ de las tsha ba ma langs gong bod du phyir phebs gnang thub na legs gnas zhes sngar bzhin nan gsung byung yang / skabs der khong gi rnam 'gyur zhi 'jam thog nas gad mo dgod bzhin pa'i ngang nas bslab bya byas byung / de dus phran gnyis skra yang bcad zin nas rgya nag tu slob sbyong du bskyod 'dod chen po yod lugs nan zhu byed skabs khong gis de 'dra yin na byed thabs med/ 'on kyang nga tsho rgya nag tu mnyam du phyin nas mnyam du log na dga' gi red/ ngas khyed gnyis la rogs ram gang thub ci thub ma zhus rang zhus yin/ da dung sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog gi dgongs tshul de phyag sbrel dza sag kha smad mchog la snyan seng zhus nas bka' shag la tar zhig phul dgos shing / hreng tsung lan la'ang gzhi rkang rnam pa gnyis nga tsho lhan du phebs rgyu'i skor bka' mol thag gcod byung yod kyang de'i skor rgya phyogs la bka' mol zhu gi yin zhes gsungs byung /nyin shas rjes hreng tsung lan gyis bod gzhung sku tshab dza sag rnam gnyis dang /sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub rnam gsum la phyag sne hin sgor khri re dang / nga tsho byings rnams la hin sgor lnga stong tham pa re phul ba tshang ma bzhes shing / phran gnyis skabs der gron dngul lag 'dzangs che sgang dang 'khel bas gos gsar bzo rgyu dang / tsag tsig nyo rgyu bcas la phan thogs chen po byung /220

phyi lo 1945 rla 4 ches 4 nyin snga dro ka la ka ta'i gnam gru thang nas bod gzhung sku tshab dza sag ngo las dang / g.yog bcas mi grangs 28 tsam la hreng tsung lan gyis phebs rogs zhus nas go min tang gi gnam gru'i thog thon te chu tshod gnyis tsam 'phur nas 'bar ma sa khul gyi 'ba' mo zhes pa'i grong bseb kyi gnam thang du babs te gnam grur snum blugs ring khyug tsam sku ngal gsos shing nyin dgung gsol chigs stabs bde zhig bzhes nas rgya nag lho nub khul gyi grong khyer khun ming zhes par bca' zhag gnang / de'i dgong dro yun nan zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi lung yun mjal 'phrad du phebs shing / de'i sang nyin snga char gnam gru de rang thog nan cing du 'byor/nan cing gnam gru 'bab thang du bod gzhung don gcod rnying pa rtse mgron thub bstan mtshan legs dang / lo tswa ba thub bstan seng ge go min tang gzhung gi bod sog las khungs kyi dpon rigs 'ga' shas/ go min tang rgyal yongs rgyal dmangs tshogs 'du'i gra sgrig tshogs chung gi dpon rigs khag bcas phebs bsur 'byor 'dug skabs der nan cing gnam gshis grang ngar che bas nga tsho gnam gru nas phyir thon skabs grang rlung gis rus par na zug gtong ba lta bur snang /nga tsho bzhugs sa'i gnam gru de ni dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs dmag mkho skyel 'dren byed ched gnam gru zhig red 'dug pas dma' sar 'phur skabs tsha ba che ba dang / mtho sar 'phur skabs grang ngar shin tu che ba rlung 'khor gyi skad sgra ha cang che bas nga tsho tshang ma'i rna ba srin bal gyis bkag dgos pa byung zhing nyin shas ring rna bar zer zug rgyag pa dang / phan tshun gyi skad cha yang ji bzhin thos ma thub pa'i gnas tshul byung / de nas bsu mi rnams kyi sne khrid 'og nan cing grong 221

khyer gyi byang phyogs ko'u lu'u zhes pa'i nye 'gram du de sngon nyi tong dpon rigs gnad che zhig gi sger shag yin lugs sgo ra khe gtsang byas pa'i thog rtseg gsum can gyi mgron khang gnyis nang bzhugs sgrig zhus 'dug pa der bsdad cing / dza sag rnam gnyis dang / las bya rim bzhi khe smad che dbang don grub/ lo tswa ba ye shes dar rgyas/ las tshan byang dngos rdo rje dngos grub/ nan cing du bca' bzhugs bod gzhung gi don gcod gsar pa mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po/ rtse mgron thub bstan che brtan/ lo tsu ba byams pa ngag dbang / dza sag khe smad kyi lcam bde dbyangs lags/ dbyin ji'i skad bsgyur sa 'du rin chen/ dza sag khe smad kyi sku sger drung yig pha lha dbang phyug sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub/ phran phun tshogs bkris bcas mi 13 dang dza sag rnam gnyis la g.yog gnyis re dang / de min tshang mar g.yog po re khrid rgyu yod pas khyon bsdoms mi grangs 28 yod/nga tsho nan cing du 'byor skabs nyi hong gi dmag mgo btags zhus pa rnams lam zur dang / gnam gru thang bcas su ngal rtsol byed bzhin pa mang po mthong rgyu 'dug pa de rnams kyis dmag chas rtsab ral sha stag gyon nas ya nga ba'i ngal rtsol byed bzhin 'dugadamag chen gnyis pa'i skabs nyi hong rgyal khab chen po'i gong ma'i dmag gi gzil rngam snyan grags 'dzam gling du khyab pa de rnams skad cig du gnya' chag sgyid gug lta bur gyur pa ni/ 'dod rngam can gyi dmag 'khrug la dga' ba'i ngan 'bras shig yin par snang / rjes su de rnams rgya nag nas rim bzhin rang yul nyi tong rgyal khab tu gru gzings thog phyir slog byas 'dugadamag chen gnyis pa mjug 'gril rjes go min tang gzhung gis dmag 222

'khrug rgyal kha thob pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon byed du rgya nag nang khul zhi lhing yong thabs go min tā hud zhes pa'i rgyal yongs rgyal dmangs tshogs chen bskong tshogs bya rgyu der bod gzhung nas 'thus mi nges par gtong dgos zhes re 'dun zhus pa ltar lha sdod go min tang gi don gcod khru'u krang hren tsung lan gyis bod gzhung nas bod don skor go min tang gzhung la da res bka' mol zhu thub na don dag 'grub rgyu'i re ba chen po yod lugs zhes dbu skor g.yo zhu byas pa ltar bod gzhung nas bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pas tshogs gros kyis dza sag gi mtshan gnas yod pa ser skya gnyis dang las bya bcas nan cing du ched brdzong gis bod rang btsan rgyal khab cig tu ngos len yong thabs su chig tho'i nang bod rgya gnyis snga sa nas mchod yon gyi 'brel ba yin pa dang / bod rgya gnyis ni skad dang / yi ge chas gos/goms gshis bcas kyis shan phye yod pas 'bri chu shar rgyud dar rtse mdo yan gyi bod rigs sa khul rnams bod gzhung gi mnga' 'og tu rtsis sprod dgos rgyu dang /slad 7gong sa tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis kyi yang srid ngos 'dzin skabs rgya gzhung nas the byus mi chog pa bcas rang btsan khas len byed dgos zhes pa'i tshig don mngon gsal ma bkod pa tsam las don du rang btsan khas len dgos pa'i rtsa don 'khod pa'i tshig tho zhig dza sag ngo las rnams kyis go min tang gzhung la 'bul rgyu bka' mngags yod lugs go thos byung /nga tsho nan cing du 'byor pa'i skabs der go min tang srid gzhung de khrung ching nas nan cing du spo ba'i sgang red/ de sngon tsam du go min tang gi rgyal srung dmag spyi ha'o ying ching zer ba des nyi hong mgo btags zhu skabs rgya nag gi sku tshab byas te de khul du mgo btags zhu len gyi mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong du phebs nas bzung nyi tong gis 223

de sngon btsan bzung byas pa'i sa khul rtsis len gyi las 'gan 'khur mus su yod pa de'i sar bod gzhung sku tshab rnams mjal 'phrad du phebs/ zla ba gcig tsam gyi rjes su cang ca'e hre khrung ching nas nan cing du phebs 'byor byung zhing / nyin zhig bod gzhung g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs zhu ba'i sku tshab dza sag rnam gnyis dang las bya/ phran tsho bcas khong gi bzhugs yul sar mjal 'phrad du bcar te bod gzhung nas cang ce hre la 'bul rgyu'i rten chas rnams sngon nas sgrig gshom byas thogabod gzhung sku tshab ngo las rnams nas rang rang gi mtshan gnas dang bstun pa'i phyogs chas bzhes shing / sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog dang / phran gnyis la bod gzhung gi mtshan gnas gang yang med pa dang / glo bur du rgya nag tu yong ba zhig yin pas phyogs chas de rigs khyer rgyu med rkyen gos chen gyi tshal phyu ma re gyon nas khong rnams dang lhan du mjal 'phrad du bcar/ skabs der rgya nag mi dmangs rnams kyis cang ca'i hre la cang u yon krang zhes pa'i mtshan gnas bstod kyi yod pa de'i don ni rgya nag dang nyi hong gnyis dmag 'khrug gi dus su khong gis dmag don u yon lhan khang gi spyi khyab kyi mtshan gnas dang / go min tang gi 'go khrid spyo 'doms kyi mtshan gnas shig red 'dug nga tsho cang u yon krang gi bzhugs gnas su 'byor te yud tsam ngal gso byas rjes sne shan pas nga tsho tshang ma tshoms chen zhig tu sne khrid kyis sdings cha'i mdun du gral star bsgrigs nas langs sdod pa'i skabs der cang u yon krang zhi chas tshos gzhis mdog gcig bzhes shing / de'i steng du nub phyogs mi chen rnams kyi gyon chas kha gyon nag po zhig bzhes te gsang sgo nas phebs thog phran tsho'i mdun gyi sdings cha'i steng phebs ma thag nga tsho tshang mas khong la gus btud dang 'brel bod lugs kyi mjal dar re phul ba cang ce gres phyag gnyis 224

kyis bzhes te tshang mar mgo skur tsam thog ha'o ha'o legs so legs so zhes brjod pa las gzhan gang yang ma gsungs/ slar yang gsang sgo nas phyir phebs rjes phran tsho de'i nye 'gram du yod pa'i rli kri hras zhes pa'i mgron khang du cang ci hre steng zhal gnyis kyis nga tsho tshang ma slar yang mjal 'phrad thog ja ston sne len gnang ste khong gi zil nyams kyi ngang nas 7gong sa tu la'i bla ma skya khams bzang po'i thog khyed tsho nan cing du gtong gnang gis lam bar sku khams bde po'i ngang phebs 'byor gyis da res nga tsho tshang ma ngo 'phrad byung bar dga' po byung lugs dang / bar lam nga tsho krung go rgyal khab de lo brgyad ring gzhung 'bangs rnams gcig gyur thog nas nyi hong btsan rgya la pha shi si ring lugs la 'thab rgol byas mthar krung gor rgyal kha thob pa'i skor dang / rgya nag la stobs shugs yod lugs/ slad rgya nag rgyal yongs kyi rgyal dmangs rnams zhi bde bag phebs kyi 'tsho bar longs su spyod rgyur the tshom med/de bzhin rgyal 'bangs dpal 'byor rim bzhin gong 'phel gtong rgyu dang / khyed rnam pas go min ṭī hud tshogs 'dur phebs zhugs gnang na legs lugs/tshogs 'du ma 'tshogs gong hrang tad dang / tang kra'u nan ha'i phu tha'o hran bcas sa gnas su gzigs bskor du phebs thub na de khul nang pa'i dgon pa mang po yod/nga'i a ma yang nang pa'i chos la dad pa chen po yod lugs sogs gleng mol rgyas par mdzad/ de nas khong steng zhal gnyis nas nga tsho tshang mar nub phyogs kyi lugs ltar nyin dgung gsol tshigs gzab rgyas shig bshams thog mnyam du dran rten gyi sku par yang bsgron/de rjes bod gzhung sku tshab ngo las dang / phran gnyis bcas nyin shas ring go min tang gi dpon rigs gnad yod khag mjal 'phrad du phyin/ rgya dpon de 225

rnams nas bod gzhung gis da lam khyed rnam pa ring min 'tshogs rgyu'i go min tu hud su zhugs par gtong gnang mdzad par dga' bsu zhu gi yod lugs tshog don gcig gyur lta bu shod kyi 'dug kyang / bod gzhung gis ngos nas phyi tshul du rgya dbyin a gsum mthun phyogs rgyal khab la g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs zhu ba'i rnam pa tsam las/ nang don slad bod rang btsan gyi rtsa don mngon 'gyur yong thabs kyi dpyad zhib lta bu byed par btang ba zhig red/skabs der go min tang gzhung gis gnas skabs ring sku tshab rnams hrang had grong khyer sogs sa khul khag tu gzigs bskor du gdan 'dren zhus/ nga tsho hrang had du lta bskor byed skabs nga tsho'i pha yul gcig pa yin pa na gzhon zhig sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang phran gnyis rtsad gcod byed par slebs byung ba de ni sku zhabs lha mo che ring yin/ lo shas gong khong gi go min tang gi na gzhon dang blang dmag nang du zhugs nas da cha nyi hong dmag mgo btags zhus pa'i rkyen gyis na gzhon dmag rang sar phyir slog gtong skabs khong yang pha yul du phyir slog gi lam zhor du hrang had du 'byor rjes phran tsho der yod pa shes nas thug 'phrad tu yong ba zhig red 'dugasku tshab ngo las tshang ma che gcig ring gzigs bskor du phebs nas slar yang nan cing du phyir phebs rjes khul de'i gnam gshis tsha ba rim slebs la brten rgya phyogs nas bod gzhung sku tshab rnams kyang pe cing du tsha g.yol lta bur phebs rgyu'i gra sgrig zhus te zla lnga pa'i ches shar la nan cing nas pe cing du rdog thon gnang /phran tsho pe cing du thon khar lha sa nas sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma ring min rgya gar brgyud nan cing du phebs kyi yod lugs kyi bka' tar 'byor bar brten 226

nga rang sku tshab rnams dang lhan du pe cing du 'gro rgyu phyir 'then gyis nan cing du phebs sgug zhus nas bsdad cing / sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog sku tshab lhan du pe cing du phebar / khong rnams pe cing du phebs nas nyin bcu tsam gyi rjes su sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog nas phran la tar 'phrin gnang 'byor du nga pe cing du bde 'byor yod pa dang / gcen mo de gar nam 'byor tar lan gtong rogs/ 'di khul dkar yol rnying ma nyo sa 'dug stabs rogs pa rnams nas nyo sgrub gnang gi 'dug pas khyed mas dngul phran bu thabs shes byas nas gtong rogs zhes gsal 'dug pa ltar gyis hren tsung lan nas rgya sgor khri 30 tsam snga g.yar gyis ring min lha sa nas khyed tsho'i don gcod khru'u la skyin tshab 'bul 'thus zhes zhus te khong gis thabs shes rogs ram gnang nas rgya sgor khri 30 snga g.yar gyis pe cing du sku'i gcen po rgyal don mchog la dngul brjes phul ba ltar khong gis dkar yol rnying ma che chung brgya ma zin tsam thugs zhib gnang ste rjes su phran rgya nag nas bod la phyir slog skabs khyer yong ba yin/ skabs der a sgor rer rgya mi'i sgor brgya lhag tsam gnas kyi yod pa'i thog nyin re bzhin rgya sgor gyi 'dza' thang chag pa dper na/ dus yun de tsam ma song ba'i rjes su so sman dang / so phag yi tse bcas rtsag rtsig nyo skabs sgor stong dang khri zer ba sprod dgos pa byung yod/ tshong pa mang che ba'ang ha log nas ma rtsa brdibs pa'i gnas tshul mang po rgyung skad thos/ 'byor ldan rnams kyis a sgor dang / gser bsdu gsog kho na byed kyi yod stabs dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs je sdug je zhan du song / phan tshun tshong rgyag skabs gser srang ga tshod sprod dang sprod min gyi tshong thag gcod kyi yod/ go min tang gzhung gis gnas tshul de dag 'gog thabs kyi byus gzhi mang po lag bstar byas pa ma zad/227

nag tshong de gras rgyag mkhan re zung 'dzin bzung gi dmar gsod btang ba'i gnas tshul byung na yang gong gsal gnas tshul de tsho je sdug tu 'gro ba las legs su phyin mi 'dug pa de'i rgyu rkyen ni nag tshong rgyag mkhan mang che ba go min tang gi gnad yod dpon rigs dang 'brel ba yod pa sha stag yin/ dpal 'byor gyi gnas stangs ji sdug tu 'gro skabs go min tang gzhung gis nyam nyen de las skyob ched rgya sgor khri lor dang lnga khri / khri bcu bcas kyis shog lor mang po par brgyab nas 'grems spel byas kyang gnas stangs de bas zhan du song /sku tshab rnams pe cing du phebs nas bzung sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma rgya gar nas nan cing du ma phebs bar phran gcig pu nan cing du sdod skabs nyi ma ma 'khyol bar ha cang yul po zhig byung ba ma zad/ nam dus nyin re bzhin tsha ba che ru song thog rlung 'khor dang / grang glog sogs kyi mthun rkyen med pas ha cang dka' ngal chen po byung /rla 7 ches 30 nyin sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma / ka ta nas hrang had du gnam gru'i thog nas phebs kyi yod lugs tar 'phrin 'byor ma thag phran dang bod sog las khungs kyi las byed gcig hrang had du phebs bsur bcar/ nga gnyis hrang tad du 'byor nas nyin gcig gi rjes su sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma dang/ g.yog byams pa bstan dar bcas hrang had du phebs te nga tsho de khul nyin gnyis tsam bzhugs nas nan cing du phebs/ de nas dus yun de tsam ma song bar sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog dang skya tshab rnams pe cing nas nan cing du phyir phebs gnang ste re zhig sku'i gcen mo dang sku'i gcen po mchog sku mched lhan 'dzoms kyis nga tsho tshang ma dgyes rgu'i dpal la rol/228

skabs der rgya phyogs nas sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang phran gnyis la nan cing grong khyer gyi lho ngos su bzhugs khang khe gtsang zhig dang / mo ṭa 'jib 'khor bcas gra sgrig gnang ba der phran tsho spo shug byas/nyin zhig bod sog las khungs kyi mi sna zhig phran tsho'i sar slebs nas sang nyin dgong dro cang u yon krang steng zhal gyis khyed rnam pa gsum la gsol ston zhig gnang rgyu yin pas dus thog tu nga tsho gdan zhur bcar rgyu yin/ de skor bod gzhung sku tshab rnams la ma gsungs rogs zhes nan po mngags byung / de'i sang nyin dgong dro nga tsho gsum dang bod sog las khungs kyi spyi khyab lhan du bcar te cang steng zha'/ rnam gnyis dang / dmag dpon khreng khyen zhes pa lhan du bzhugs 'dugagasol ston skabs khong steng zhal gnyis nas phran tshor byams brtse chen po gnang ba'i thog slob sbyong yag po byed dgos lugs dang / slad phyin phran gnyis la gang ci'i thad la lta rtog rogs ram gnang ched du khong gi gam bcar drung yig tsha'o hreng phun la bka' mngags gnang zhing / de nas nyin shas rjes phran gnyis slob sbyong bya yul krung dbyang chab srid slob grwa chen mor gtan 'khel yod ces lan gsal 'byor/rgyal ba'i yab yum rnam gnyis kyis sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma lags su bka' mngags gnang don bzhin phran gnyis thug 'phrad rjes 'khrungs yul sku 'bum du sku mched rnams la 'tshams 'drer phebs rgyur phran yang khong gi phyag rogs su lhan bcar gyis rla 10 tsam la nan cing nas gnam thog lan kra'u brgyud sku 'bum du thon nas phran gyi pha ma gnyis slar yang mjal ba'i go skabs bzang po zhig thob/phran bza' tsho gnyis lan kra'u gnam thang du 'byor skabs kun su'u zhing 229

chen gyi kru'u zhi ko ci cha'o yis phebs bsu btang 'byor gyis lan kra'u nub byang rta zhu zhes pa'i mgron khang chen po zhig tu bzhugs zhag gra sgrig gis de'i dgong dro ko ci cha'o yis dga' bsu'i gsol ston du mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar bcar/ khong ni cang ce hre'i thugs blo 'gel yul dmag dpon zhig red zer/nub byang sa khul du lan kra'u zhing chen de gnad 'gag chen po zhig tu brtsi gi yod pa ma zad/ gung khran tang gi 'go khrid ma'o tse tung gis gtsos pa'i gnad yod rnams sdod sa yan grin zhes pa'i sa gnas de thag nye po yod zer/dmag dpon ko chi cha'o yis sa gnas der zhi drag gnyis thad nas sa cha der dbang sgyur byed kyi 'dug khong ni lo na lnga bcu tsam slebs shing gzugs stobs che ba/ bka' mol kha ri kha thug gnang mkhan zhig las zhi ba'i dpon rigs nang bzhin dpon nyams med pa/ mi gshis 'jam po zhig 'dug pa de dmag don thad mig dper 'os pa'i mi sna zhig yi na par grags/de'i sang nyin lan kra'u grong khyer nas mo ṭa'i thog zi ling du thon te mo ṭa'i 'gro lam ha cang zhan pas lan kra'u nas zi ling bar gyi lam phyed la zhag cig sdod dgos byung / don dngos thog lan kra'u nas zi ling bar me le 53 tsam las med kyang 'gro lam mi bde bas chu tshod rer me le 7 lhag tsam las 'gro thub kyi med cing / mo ṭa'i 'khor lo bskyod pa'i shul du ha cang thal 'tshub chen po langs kyi yod stabs mi tshang ma'i gzugs po thal bas khengs kyi 'dug lam bar der mgron khang med stabs zhing pa'i khyim tshang zhig tu gnas tshang g.yar/ skabs der nam dus grang ngar che rung mi tshang de'i nyal khang zhes pa 'og tu me gtong sa yod stabs de'i dgong mo dngos 'brel dro skyid ldan pa zhig byung /230

mi tshang de'i pha rgan gyi brjod gsal la/ lung pa de'i g.yas g.yon ri rgyud lung khug tu bod kyi sde grong mang po gnas yod pa dang / snga rabs su de khul lung gzhung rnams la bod mi sha stag gnas yod/ da cha rgya mi dang kha che hu'i rigs gnas yod zer/ de'i sang nyin de nas thon te kun su'u zhing chen dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen gyis sa mtshams shang thang zhes pa'i sa gnas su 'grul pa phan tshul 'gro mkhan rnams kyi dngos po zhib bsher byed sa zhig tu 'byor/ nan cing bod sog las khungs kyi bka' 'byor yod stabs phran gza' mi gnyis la gus zhabs byed pa las 'grul pa gzhan rnams ltar dngos por zhib bsher gang yang byas ma song / zhib bsher byed mkhan tshos phan tshun gyi 'grul pa rnams la gdug rtsub can gyi rnam 'gyur bstan nas dbang shed kyi dka' ngal chen po bzo ba'i gnas tshul mthong skabs rgyal khab gnyis kyi sa mtshams su slebs pa lta bu'i snang ba byung /phran gnyis sa gnas der nyin dgung gsol tshig stabs bde zhig zhus nas zi ling du thon/ dgong dro sa srib tsam du zi ling grong khyer du 'byor te hong krung tā shā zhes pa'i mgron khang du gra sgrig byas 'dug skabs der zi ling grong khyer nang mgron khang de skad grags yod pa zhig tu brtsi gi 'dugade'i sang nyin zi ling kru'u zhi rmā phu'u phang gis sku srung zhig btang nas phran bza' mi gnyis khong gi mjal 'phrad du 'bod pa ltar dus thog tu bcar te bod sog las khungs nas khong la sprod rgyu'i yi ge nge phul/ khong gis da lam bod sog las khungs nas khyed rnam pa gnyis rang gi 'khrungs yul du phebs kyi yod pa'i gnas tshul gyi tar 'phrin 'byor ba ltar khyed gnyis kyi bzhugs sa tong krung ta sha mgron khang la gra sgrig zhus yod/ de bzhin lan kra'u nas kha par zhig 'byor byung /231

lam bar sku ngal ma byung ngam/ deng sang tu la'i bla ma dang / yab yum rnam gnyis sku khams bde po yod shag ces 'tshams 'dre gnang byung / yang khong gis pha yul la dus yun ga tshod bzhugs rtsis yod dam/ nga tshos rogs ram zhu dgos 'dug na gsung rogs gnang / thugs 'dzems ma gnang zhes gsungs byung /de'i sang nyin zi ling nas rta sga ril thog sku 'bum du bskyod nas chu tshod gnyis tsam la 'byor/ skabs der zi ling brgyud du rmā phu'u phang la mo ṭa re gnyis yod pa las de min gzhan su la yang med/ mi drag rnams kyis rta sga ril dang /rta bzhon nas phan tshun 'grul bzhud byed kyi 'dugaphran gnyis stag 'cher bla brang du 'byor skabs sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma'i khu bos phran gnyis yong gi yod pa'i gnas tshul nyin shas sngon nas go thos byung ste de gar phebs sgrag gnang nas bzhugs 'dug skya 'bum dgon par nyin shas bzhugs nas stag 'cher grong sde dang phran gyi skyes khyim bcas su bskyod de phran gyi pha ma gnyis dang spyan mched rnams bcas slar yang lhan 'dzoms kyis dga' bde'i dpal la longs su spyad/ lhag par du phran gyi skyes mas phran bza' tsho gnyis mnyam du yong thub par shin tu dgyes tshor chen po'i ngang nas nga ma shi gong khyed gnyis thug 'phrad byung bar blo bde po byung zhes yang nas yang du gsungs nas spyan chab kyang bsil gyi 'dug par phran gyis khong la thugs gsos lta bur slad lo ltar mjal bar yong gi yin zhes zhus kyang khong gis da slar yang thug rgyu khag po red/da res nga tsho mnyam du 'dzoms pa shin tu legs/ 'di mtha' ma yin zhes thengs kha shas gsungs byung ba de ni dngos 'brel zhal chems lta bu gnang byung /phran pha yul la rla gcig tsam bsdad rjes nan cing du phyir log 'gro don ni 232

sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub sku rkyang du bzhugs yod pa khong la phyag rogs zhu mkhan med stabs mgyogs myur phyir log 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig dang / de mtshungs slob grwa 'go tshugs kyi dus skabs slebs la nye ba bcas phran bza' 'tsho gnyis gros bsdur byas nas phran sngon du 'gro rgyu dang / sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma re zhig 'khrungs yul du lhod zhugs kyis ston dus su nan cing du phebs nas rgya gar brgyud bod du phyir phebs gnang rgyu'i 'char gzhi btings/phran zi ling nas lan kra'u brgyud nan cing du gnam gru'i thog bskyod skabs nan cing dang / hrang had khul gyi gnam gshis ha cang sdug po yin par brten gnam gru babs ma thub pa'i rkyen gyis de nyin u han du phyir log gis u han gnam thang du babs nas u han grong khyer du gnam gru'i las khungs nas gra sgrig byas pa'i mgron khang du zhag sdod byas/ skabs der sa khul der gung khran tang gi so nyul mi snar rdugs zon chen po byed kyi yod pas/ mgron khang de nas sang nyin ma thon bar bde 'jags dmag mi yang nas yang du yong nas 'grul pa rnams kyi dngos chas bsngogs bsher byed pa dang / yong khungs dang 'gro yul bcas 'dri brtsad bsun brtser byas stabs de'i dgong mo gnyid kyang nyal ma bcug pa'i gnas tshul byung /de'i sang nyin nan cing du 'byor nas de'i skor rgya mi'i sne len pa chor shod skabs khong tshos deng sang rgya nag gnad yod grong khyer khag tu gung khran jag tshogs kyi so nyul mang po 'jab 'dzul byed bzhin yod pas slob grwa che khag gi slob phrug rnams dang / bzo gra khag gi bzo pa bcas la mgo bskor g.yo khrid kyis gzhung la ngo rgol gyi las 'gul chen po zhig byed rtsis yod pa'i 'chal gtam yod lugs zer stabs gzhung nas de dag 'gog thabs kyi rdugs zon byed kyi yod pa 'dra zhes zer byung /233

skabs der bod gzhung sku tshab rnams go min hwa hud tshogs 'dur phebs rgyu gtan 'khel 'dug pa ltar khong rnams nyin ltar tshogs 'dur phebs kyi 'dugadza sag khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dud kyi rgyal khams nyul ba'i lo rgyus las /de skabs nan cing du go min tā hud tshogs 'du 'tshog rgyu'i gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i thog phran tsho yang tshogs 'dur yong dgos zer ba rgyal khab nas tshogs 'dur bskyod min dmigs bsal bka' slob med rung tshogs 'dur ma bskyod che bod dang bod chen po'i mi rigs yul gyar mang po zhig rgya nag tu 'byor bsdad yod gshigaskya tshab rdzun ma bzos te don rkyen thal cha 'byung gzhir brten ngo las rnams tshogs 'dur phebs rgyu byas zhes gsal/de bzhin byang ngos pa rdo rje dngos grub kyis bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs kyi rtsom yig nang gsal/ nga tsho ngo las bcu po bka' shag gi mdzub ston ltar gros 'cham byed skabs mos mthun yod med kyi rnam 'gyur gang yang ma bstan par bsdad/ nyin shas song rjes tshogs chung khag bgos kyis gros sdur byed 'go tshugs / nga tsho bod dang / sog po/ shin cang bcas tshogs chung gcig nang yin pa de'i 'go 'khrid ni dmag dpon sbas krung sho zhes pa de yin/ rtsa khrims nang du bod sog gnyis la rang skyong lag len bstar rgyu zhes bris 'dug par skabs de rang du ngo rgol byed ma thub rung / bod gzhung skya tshab rnams phre krung shi'i shag tu bskyod nas rtsa khrims nang du bod skor 'god mi dgos pa'i gnas lugs zhib phra dang 'brel ngo rgol gnang yod ces gsal 'dugaskabs der dza sag rnam gnyis nas bka' bka' shag tu go min tā hus tshogs 'dur zhugs na dge skyon rnams zhib phra'i bka' slob yong ba zhes tar 'phrin 234

phul ba'i bka' lan du khyod tshos tshogs 'dur zhugs pa tsam las gros chod khag la yod med brda rtags ston pa'i lag pa rkyang ba dang / thal mo brdebs pa sogs mi chog pa dang / lhag par bod don skor gros chod sogs kyi nang du tshig zur tsam yang mi 'khod pa'i thabs shes nges par byed zhes gsal yod pa red/gong gsal gnas tshul de'i 'og dza sag rnam gnyis kyis tshogs 'du ma grol ba'i sngon tsam la rtsa khrims gros chod nang du ming rtags 'god dgos yong dogs kyis ngo rgol lta bus nyin bcu lhag ring hrang tad grong khyer du ched g.yol du phebs/ rjes su de'i skor gnas tshul gang yang byung med pa 'dra/ go min tu hus tshogs 'du mjug 'gril skabs tshogs 'du'i rtsa khrims gzhir bzung ltar cang ca'i hri la tsung thung srid 'dzin ngo ma dang dmag dpon rlis tsung ren la tsong thung gzhon pa bsko bzhag byas/dus yun de tsam ma song ba'i rjes cang tsung thung rang lo drug cu zin pa'i rten 'brel dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo'i dus slebs pa'i mtshams der bod sog las khungs nas bod gzhung sku tshab la cang gi 'khrungs skar rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i nyin bod gzhung sku tshab tsho'i khyed tsho'i nang nas rtsed sna'i gas su ston 'os pa yod dam dris byung bar/ phran gnyis kyis g.yog pad lags zhes pa de sngon lha sa'i smon lam rta pa'i rgyugs rtsal la byang chub pa zhig yin stabs rta rgyugs rtsed 'gran 'os min zhus par gang legs yong lugs zer ba bzhin bod lugs kyi rta rgyugs bzhin du rta thog nas me mda' dang / mda' mdung bcas 'phen pa'i rim pa gsum gyi rtsal 'gran skabs gsum gar phog pa dang / rta rgyugs bzhin par kha btags sa steng nas sgrug pa sogs byed pa de ni bod snga rabs kyi dpa' rtsal snying stobs khyad 235

chos ngo mtshar che ba byung ste rgya mi rnams hang sang nas khong la gzengs bstod rtags ma zhig thob pa ma zad/ gsar shog rnams la'ang kho pa'i rta rgyugs rtsed 'gran gyi 'dra par dang lo rgyus mdor bsdus bcas bton 'dugaphyi lo 1945 lor sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang / phran gnyis nan cing krung dbyang chab srid mtho slob du zhugs 'go tshugs pa de ni phran gyi nyin mtshan khor yug tu bsam pa'i re 'dun de dngos su grub pa zhig yin/ phran gnyis kyi shes tshad rgya mi'i slob phrug las dma' ba yod stabs slob gru'i 'dzin gra'i nang du 'gro ma dgos par mtho rim slob grwa de'i nang du dbyin si lu'u zhes pa'i mdzes sdug can gyi khang bzang du dge rgan phebs nas phran gnyis la slob tshan khrid gnang gi yod/ slob tshan gyi gras su rgya yig rtsom rigs dang / dbyin ji'i skad yig rgya nag gi rgyal rabs/ 'dzam gling gi lo rgyus/ sa khams/ ang rtsis/rgyun mkho'i shes rig bcas slob tshan khag bdun tsam slob kyi yod/ dge rgan de rnams kyis phran gnyis kyi shes tshad la dpag pa'i slob tshan go bde po slob 'khrid byed kyi yod kyang slob tshan de dag nang nas ang rtsis slob skabs rgyugs ma 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal 'phrad/slob sbyong gi gung seng dus tshod mang che ba nan cing grong khyer gyi phyi rol du mo ṭa 'jib btang nas spro 'cham du bskyod pa las slob sbyong la nang sbyong de tsam byed thub kyi med/ de'i slob tshan gyi dus skabs su 'tsho ba rgyas spros can la longs su spyod pa'i rkyen gyis slob sbyong la rang bzhin gyis lhod g.yeng 'thus shor song nas blo rtse gcig sgrim ma byas par dus tshod chud zos su btang ba de ni na gzhon dus skabs kyi bag g.yengs skyon cha zhig yin/ da cha skabs de'i gnas tshul la phyi mig zhig blta 236

skabs 'gyod sems drag po skyes kyang phyis dras pa yin pas gzhan gyi bya thabs bral/lo de'i zla ba drug pa tsam la lha sa nas mi snyan pa'i tar 'phrin zhig 'byor gsal/ 7rgyal yab chen mo glo bur dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul thos skabs yid gdung zad mi shes pa'i mya ngan gyi khur po lci pos mnan nas gang byed 'di byed med pa zhig byung zhing / phran gnyis nas a mdo khul du skya'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mar gong gsal gnas tshul dang de khul dgon khag la zhabs mjug mchod 'bul gang thub zhus te 'phral du nan cing la phyir phebs gnang rogs zhes pa'i tar 'phrin zhig phul/bar lam go min tang gi lha sdod don gcod las tshab khreng shi krang gis bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/ 'don thengs gsum pa'i nang bod kyi srid kyi las ka byed ring gi gnas tshul gleng ba zhes pa'i shog grangs 357 nang / 1945 lor rgyal yab glo bur bsnyun te grong pa nga dang li go ling mnyam du mya ngan zhu ba 'gro skabs rgyal yum mjal nas nang gnas dzi yin dres par rgyal yum nas glo bur bsnyun gzhi dza drag cig phog nas bcos thabs ma byung bar grongs song zhes gsung pa las/ de min gang yang ma gsung ba dang / yab gzhis mag pa (khobo ) kyang rgyal yab grongs rkyen gsal po ma rtogs zhes zer ba bcas bkod 'dug skabs de'i dngos byung gi gnas tshul ni rgyal yab mchog nyin gcig lha sa'i nye 'khor yab gzhis kyi 'khyongs gzhis sne'u gzhis su phebs te gsol krum phag sha zhig mchod nas bsnyun gzhi phog ste zla gcig tsam ring bod sman sogs kyi sman bcos gang gzab gnang yang phan bskyed ma byung bar sku gshegs pa zhig red/ lhag par skabs der kho bo dang / sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub gnyis rgya nag tu bskyod 237

nas bod la bsdad med/ gong gsal khreng shi krang gi skad cha de ni ched mngags 'khyog bshad dang / gzugs med grib bzo byas pa zhig red/ de yang glo bur du byung ba zhig ma yin par de snga'i rgya nag gi srid dbang rim byung gi rgya mi'i dpon rigs tshos bod kyi gnad don thad rgyun du rdzun bzo byas pa'i nad ngan kho par gos pa zhig red ces zhor 'phros dang /de rjes 7gong sa mchog nas sku gcen rgyal don la bod gzhung sku tshab lhan du phyir phebs dgos lugs kyi bka' yig phebs par khong gis sku yon gsan bzhes mjug skyong gnang rgyu'i dgongs zhu phul/ bod gzhung sku tshab kyis go min tang gzhung la sngon phul tshog tho'i skor gyi lan gsal yong ched lcag skul yang yang zhus kyang rla shas ring lan gsal ma gnang bar lus/bod gzhung gi tshig tho'i re 'dun don tshan gal gnad chen po yin par brten go min tang nas lan gsal thag gcod bya rgyur dka' ngal yod pa'i gnas tshul 'og bod gzhung nas thag gcod thub pa'i sku tshab cig btang byung na bka' mol gnang rgyu'i gra sgrig ang bsar yod ces lan gsal sprad pa ltar bod gzhung sku tshab dza sag rnam gnyis nas 'di skor rang thag gcod thub pa'i bka' blon ngo ma lta bu zhig byung na ma gtogs ngos gnyis kyis yong gi ma red ces lan 'debs dang 'brel lha sa bka' shag tu tar btang ste de'i skor mjug skyong 'phros mol bya rgyu lha sa rang la byas na rang sa mi sa'i khyad par yod tshul zhus/ bka' shag nas kyang de don mos mthun byas stabs go min tang gzhung nas tshig tho der 'byor lan lta bu'i yi ge zhig sprad pa las/ de lhag don 'bras gang yang ma byung ba red 'dug de dus go min tang gzhung gi bod gzhung la rang thag gcod thub pa'i sku tshab nges par gtong rogs 238

zhes pa'i re 'dun bton pa de ni dus 'gyangs yong thabs 'dra gang chags kho na yin pa snyam/skabs der mdo smad spyi khyab pas las bya sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dud nan cing du ched brdzongs gnang mdun sku tshab dza sag rnam gnyis la yi ge zhig 'bul skur gnang ba ltar sde sras nas phul rjes khong gi sku mched smar khams ma nang a pho thug 'phrad du phyin te bdun phrag gsum rjes khong dang ma nang a pho mnyam du nan cing du phebs nas sku tshab rnams dang lhan du re zhig bzhugs/smar khams mar nang a pho zhes pa ni/ dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs ka la ka tar tshong don du sdod ring nyi hong gzhung gi gsang nyul zhig dang 'phrad de ma nang a pos tshong las bzhag nas nyi hong pa de dang mnyam du nyi hong du bskyod de nyi hong rgyal khab nang lta bskor dang 'brel nyi hong gzhung gi nang srid skyong stangs dang / e she ya'i rgyal khab khag tu phyi 'brel gyi srid byus 'dzin stangs skor slob sbyong rob tsam byas pa dang / lhag par du khong gis nyi hong gzhung gis bod la rgyab skyor rogs ram yong thabs kyi re 'dun zhus nas nyi hong gzhung gis khong rgya nag pe cing brgyud bod du 'brel lam bzo bar gas/nga stabs kyis gtong 'char gyi skabs der nyi hong gzhung dmag pham nas dgra ya khag la mgo btags zhus stabs smar khams ma nang a po bdag sprod byed mkhan ma byung bar rang bzhin gyis pe cing du lus te dka' ngal 'phrad pa'i skor bcas khong gis phran la gsungs byung / khong chab srid la thugs snang chen po yod pa ma zad bod kyi rgyal rabs thugs su chud yod/ khong ni dus dang rnam pa kun tu bod rgyal khab chen po 'di gna' rabs chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi dus rabs nang bzhin zhig byung na ci ma rung dgongs mkhan zhig yin/239

phran tsho mnyam du rla gcig tsam bzhugs rjes sde dge sras skal bzang dbang 'dus mnyam du nan cing nas zi khron brgyud khams phyogs su phebs/gong smros ltar skabs der rgya gar nas spom mda' rab dga' dang / thub bstan kun 'phel rnam gnyis kyang dbyin jis glo bur rgya gar du bzhugs ma bcug par nan cing du phebs te nga tsho slar yang mjal 'dzoms kyi dus skabs byung / nyin zhig spom mda' rab dgas ja khang zhig nang 'dzoms sar bar lam gyi yong rkyen skor phran la rob tsam gsungs byung / khong gis khyed tsho rgya gar nas rgya nag tu phebs rjes rgya gar gsang ba'i mi snas khong la gar 'gro'i sar rdugs pa byas shing /nyin zhig glo bur khong gi nang du yong nas bsngogs bsher byas kyang yig cha gang yang ma thon pa ni gnas tshul de ma byung sngon tsam la ka la ka tar yod pa'i go min tang tshong don las khungs nas khong la gsang yig shig 'byor 'phral yig cha yod rigs rnams bka' sbug tu gtan sdod par rgyag mkhan rgya mi gcig gi tshong khang du bcol zin 'dug de rjes slar yang bsngogs bsher thengs gcig byas nas phan mi thogs pa'i yig cha dang / deb bcas khyer/ rjes su yig cha gzhan rnams rgya mi de'i sa nas blangs te ka la ka tar go min tang tshong don las khungs su skyel thub pa byung yang gang ltar rgya gar gzhung gis thub bstan kun 'phel dang / lcang lo can bsod nams rgyal po/ spom mda' rab dga' bcas rgya gar du bsdad mi chog pa'i bka' btang ste lcang can gung zur sku zhabs 'brug pa ra dza sab kyis zhu bskul thabs shes byas nas ka sbug tu rang 'jags bsdad bcug pa tsam las/ khong gnyis bdun phrag gnyis kyi thog rgya gar nas rgya nag tu yong dgos byung ba dang / nan cing du rla shas ring bsdad nas dar rtse mdor 'gro rtsis yin lugs bcas gsungs byung /240

skabs der nan cing khul du slob sbyong byed mkhan bod mi mang po yod pa mang che ba mdo stod smad khongs nas yong ba las dbus gtsang nas yong ba phran gnyis las med/ mdo stod nas yong ba rnams ni 'ba' khul dang / dar rtse mdo khul nas yong ba zhe cig yin/ mdo smad nas bla brang bkris 'khyil gyi a pha a blo'i sras a mgon dang / mdzod dge dpon/ co ne dpon bcas nan cing du slob sbyong du slebs 'dug de min sog po dang / shar tur ki si than bcas kyi slob phrug rnams mtho slob de'i khongs gtogs bod sog slob grwa zhes par slob sbyong byed kyi 'dugaskabs der bod sog slob grwa tshugs yul nan cing dang / hrang tad kyi bar u zhi zhes pa'i grong khyer du yod/ slob grwa de'i mthun rkyen ha cang zhan po yin lugs go thos byung / slob phrug rnams der sdod 'dod med pa'i thog rim bzhin tshur nan cing du yong nas krung dbyang chab srid mtho rim slob grwa 'am/ de min slob grwa gzhan dag tu tshud rgyu'i thabs shes bya dgos byung 'dug bod sog slob grwa'i nang du shar tur ki si than nas yong ba'i slob phrug mang po yod stabs de tshos bod sog slob grwa zhes pa'i ming de 'grogs kyi mi 'dug ces bsam tshul nan po zhus nas rjes su bod sog slob grwa de mtha' mtshams slob grwa zhes par ming bsgyur byas 'dug kyang slob grwa de dus yun de tsam ma song bar rgya nag nang 'khrug rlung rlabs kyi khrod du 'thor zhig phyin pa go thos byung /bod gzhung gi g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs zhu mkhan sku tshab dza sag ngo las rnams kyis rgya nag go min tang gzhung la/ g.yul rgyal bkris bde legs zhus pa dang / go min tā hus tshogs 'dur zhugs pa/ pe cing dang / hrang had bcas grong khyer che khag la gzigs skor grub zin nas phyi lo 1947 dpyid dus tsam la 241

nan cing nas rgya gar brgyud bod du phyir phebs gnang gtan 'khel bas khong rnams dang lhan du bod gzhung gi nan cing du bca' sdod don gcod sku tshab rnying pa rtsa mgron thub bstan mtshan legs dang / lo tswa ba thub bstan seng ge rnam gnyis kyang rgya nag nas rgya gar brgyud bod du phyir phebs gnang / khong gnyis kyi tshab tu de sngon dza sag ngo las rnams dang lhan du phebs pa mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po dang / rtse mgron thub bstan che brtan/ lo tswa ba byams pa ngag dbang bcas gsum nan cing du lo shas ring bzhugs rgyu gnang 'dug phran tsho ma thon gong bod gzhung gi rgya nag don gcod gsar rnying brje len rtsis sprod byas te nyin gcig phran tsho tshang ma mdzad sgor gdan zhus ltar gsol ston du bcar/ don gcod las khungs de la mkhan mgron lo gsum zhes yang 'bod/ khong gsum gyi 'og tu las khungs de nang rgya drung gnyis dang / bod drung gcig gar dgos las byed gnyis bcas yod/ rgyun du bod sog las khungs brgyud 'brel gtugs gnang gi yod 'dugamakhan mgron lo gsum zhes pa'i 'byung khungs ni de sngon man ju'i dus rabs rgyal po khri thog gsum pa g.yung kring gis khong gi bzhugs yul pho brang g.yung ho dgon zhes pa de khong gi yum kha 'don dge sbyor bya yul dgon par bsgyur/ de nas bod kyi gdan sa gsum res mos kyis g.yung ho dgon du mkhan po gcig dang de'i phyag rogs gnas rim lnga pa rtse mgron gyi go ming yod pa gcig gdan sa gsum la mdo stod smad nas grwa rgyun slob gnyer gnang mkhan rgya skad legs po shes mkhan zhig la lo rtswa ba zhes pa'i gnas rim drug pa zhig bsko bzhag gnang ba bcas nas g.yung ho dgon pa'i bdag gnyer byed kyi yod pas de gsum la mkhan mgron lo gsum zhes grags/ de dag dus yun lo gsum mam bzhi'i mtsham sa su brje len byed/242

de rjes rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab la bsgyur nas bzung bod gzhung gi sngar bzhin mkhan mgron lo gsum bsko brdzong gis ser smad grwa tshang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dkon cog 'byung gnas mkhan por bsko brdzong gnang ba de chab srid thog thugs snang chen po yod pas skabs de'i rgya nag khul gyi gnas tshul ji 'gyur skor rang gzhung mchog la snyan seng zhus par 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng 13 mchog gis khong la gzigs skyong chen po gnang ste dza sag gi go gnas stsal ba'i thog sngar bzhin pe cing g.yung ho dgon 'dzin skyong dang bod gzhung gi rgya nag tu bca' bzhugs don gcod kyi las 'gan gcig lcogs gnang /rgya nag go min tang gzhung gi rgyal sa nan cing de nyi hong gi dmag 'khrug dza drag skabs khrung ching du gnas spos byed dus bod gzhung gi skya tshab don gcod mkhan mgron lo gsum yang khrung ching du gnas spos gnang / nyi tong gi dmag thag chod rjes go min tang gi khrung ching nas nan cing du phyir spo byed skabs bod gzhung gi sku tshab don gcod kyang slar yang nan cing du spos/7rgyal yab chen mo dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i dus skabs der sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub mchog dang / sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma/ phran rang bcas mi yul thag ring du 'khyams pa'i gnas tshul 'og 7rgyal yum chen po sku ngal dang thugs khral chen po gnang gi yod pa'i skor phran la gnon du med pa'i sems khral chen po zhig rgyun mar yod par brten phran gyis sku gcen rgyal don mchog dza sag ngo las lhan du sngon la bod du phyir phebs gnang thub na legs gnas dang / phran re zhig 'di gar bsdad de sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma 'khrungs yul nas nan cing du phyir phebs rjes phran bza' 'tsho gnyis kyang gang mgyogs bod du phyir log zhu rgyu yin 243

lugs skor thengs 'ga' shas re 'dun zhus kyang khong lo shas ring rgya nag tu skya yon gsan bzhes mjug skyel gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel ba der 'gyur ba med pa'i dgongs bzhes gnang thog khong gis de las khyed rang khong rnams dang lhan du bod la phyir log gis 7rgyal yum mchog la phyag rogs zhabs phyi zhu rgyu byung na legs tshul gyi bka' nan ldog tu med pa gnang stabs phran gyis de sngon nas nyin mtshan khor yug tu bod nas rgya nag tu slob sbyong du yong rgyu'i re 'dun byas pa'i go skabs bzang po de chud zos su 'gro rgyur ha cang yid skyo ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ gal srid phran gnyis ka da mus bzhin rgya nag khul du bsdad pa yin na rgyal yum chen mor sku ngal chen po 'phrad pa'i dus su zhabs 'degs phra mo tsam yang zhu ma thub par snang med du mi yul du 'khyams na rang khe rang phan lta bus 7rgyal ba'i yab yum gnyis kyi bkrin gsab rgyu dang rgyab 'gal du 'gro rgyu nyag cig red/ gal srid sku gcen rgyal don mchog mi yul du gcig pur bzhag na de yang blos 'gan mi bzod pa yong rgyur nges snyam nas ga byed 'di byed ma shes par sku'i gcen mo 'khrungs yul nas nan cing du phyir phebs mtshams ji 'gab bka' sdur gnang na legs gnas kyi bsam tshul zhus kyang sku gcen rgyal don mchog nas dgongs bzhes 'gyur med kyis khyed rang da lam sku tshab lhan du sngon la phebs thub na legs gnas/ nga la sems khral gnang mi dgos/ ring min gcen mo 'di khul phebs skabs khong la rogs ram gang thub zhu gi yin pas de'i skor sems khral gnang mi dgos zhes yang nas yang du gsungs stabs phran nyin shas ring zas bcud gnyid bral gyis bsam blo thag gcod ma thub pa'i 'gal ba gcig thog nyis brtsegs byung ste sems kyi dka' ngal tshad las 'das pa byung / mtha' ma phran gyis sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma lags su tar 244

'phrin dang yi ge phul ba'i nang gal srid phran skya tshab lhan du phyir log byas pa yin na khyed rang gis de khul nas sku gcen rgya lo don grub la phyag rogs zhabs 'degs zhu mkhan blos 'grel thub pa dang / babs brling brtan gsum/ shes yon yod pa/nag ga tshang lha mo che ring 'os shing 'tshams par brten kho rang blo mos byung che khyed dang lhan cig nan cing du 'khrid thub pa gnang rogs zhes re 'dun kyi bsam tshul zhus/ dus thog bka' lan ma 'byor ba'i mur dza sag ngo las rnams phyir thon gyi dus la gtugs par brten sku gcen rgya don mchog gi bka' bzhin phran gyi sger don bsgrub re yal bar dor te 'os 'gan bsgrub ched dka' bsngal dang du blangs nas khong rnams dang lhan du rgya gar brgyud bod du phyir thon bya rgyu gtan 'khel gyis thon pa'i nyin mo der sku gcen rgyal don mchog dang 'bral mi phod pa'i sdug bsngal gyis yid rab tu gdung nas rang dbang med par mig chu nyil nyil du 'bab bzhin par khong gi phyag nas bzung ste slad yab yum rnam gnyis kyis thugs re gnang don ltar slob gnyer la thugs khur che bzhes dang 'brel sku gzugs la thugs lcag gzab nan gnang gal thog blo bde'i phyag bris yang gnang skyong yod pa dang / phran ring min rgyal yum chen mo ngo mjal skabs 'di khul gyi gnas stangs gang legs skor thugs bde yong ched zhib phra zhus chog pa dang lhag par phran gyis rgyal yum chen mo mchog gi zhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag zhu rgyu ma zad/ yang sgos gzim shag yab gzhis stag 'cher gyi phyi nang las don rnams 'thus shor med pa zhu rgyu yin zhes ngu skad shub shub gyi ngang nas sems nang gi dam bca' lta bur khong la zhus shing / ma 'dod bzhin du sku gcen rgyal don mchog mi yul sa mthar bzhag nas rang nyid gcig pur phyir log bya dgos byung ba de'i rgyu rkyen ni phran rang rgya nag tu slob sbyong la 245

bskyod 'dod byung ba ltar 'bad thabs kyis 'bras bu byung rjes khong yang phran mnyam du phebs pa'i nyes 'gan de nga la thug yod/ da cha phran rang gcig pur phyir log byas nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon rin po che mchog dang / 7rgyal yum mchog la ji ltar zhu/ de bzhin mi gzhan dag rnams la yang 'grel bshad ji ltar byed snyam ste bsam bzhin du sdug bsngal dang dngangs skrag snon ma zhig byung / thon pa'i skabs der gnam thang du skya gcen rgyal don mchog dang 'bral mi phod pa'i dka' ngal chen po byung / gnam gru'i nang du 'dzul skabs sdug bsngal gyi khur pos non pa'i ngal dub can gyi gom bgrod spo bzhin par phyi mig yang nas yang du bltas shing / gnam gru'i nang du 'dzul rjes sge'u khung nas gnam gru ma 'phur bar khong gi zhal skyin la phyi mig lta bzhin par mig chu dbang med du shor/de nas gnam gru rim bzhin yar 'phur skabs dpa' nyams ldan pa'i sku gcen rgyal don mchog gi bzhin ras mig lam las yol yang phran gyi yid ngor da dung khong gi byams brtse'i zhal skyin yang yang lham mer 'char te mig chu'i rgyun ma chad par 'bab/ de ni phran gyi mi che'i nang 'di las yid skyo ba zhig byung ma myong /de nyin nan cing nas khun ming du slebs te zhag sdod byas/ de'i sang nyin ka la ka ta gnam thang du 'byor skabs ka tar bca' bzhugs go min tang gi sku tshab las khungs kyi mi sna phebs bsur 'byor te nga tsho'i bzhugs yul gha ren ṭi e si kri ho skyel du gra sgrig zhus 'dugasku tshab ngo las rnams kyis hrang had nas tshong zog chu thog btang ba rnams nyin shas ma 'byor bar ka ta khul du sgug nas bsdad/ de nas bka' sbyag tu thon 246
pas rwa sgreng bla brang gi gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan gyis phran yong rgyur phebs sgug gnang ste gra sgrig gang legs gnang 'dug pas bod nas bsu len ma slebs bar khong sar bsdad// 247

rngag bcad gaXs34 pa/le tshan bcu gsum pa/rwa sgreng bla brang la byus nyes byung ba'i skor/༄༅༅/ /nga tsho bka' sbyag tu 'byor nas nyin shas rjes phran sgang thog tu khyug tsam bskyed de lha sar bca' sdod rgya gar gzhung gi tshong don las khungs bde skyed gling kha brgyud yab gzhis stag 'cher gzim shag tu skud med kha par btang bar yab gzhis phyag mdzod bde skyed gling khar kha par nyan par slebs te phran gyi rgyal yum chen mo sku dkyil gsal dngas skor 'tshams 'dre zhus pa dang / da lam phran rang rgya nag nas rang gzhung sku tshab lhan du bka' sbug tu 'byor yod lugs dang / sku'i gcen po rgyal don mchog sku khams bde thang ngang slob sbyong gnang bzhin yod stabs rgyal yum chen mo mchog thugs khral ma gnang rogs zhes snyan seng zhu dgos pa dang /phran bka' sbug nas gang myur lha sar bcar rtsis la rta drel bsu len gang mgyogs gtong gnang yong ba bcas zhus te de nyin sgang thog nas bka' sbug tu phyir log byas/skabs der rgya gar kong ras si tshogs pas rgyal sa ni'u ldi ler bskong tshogs byed pa'i e sha ya'i tshogs 'du der bod gzhung gi sku tshab mgron 'bod ltar 249

e sha ya'i rgyal khab gzhan rnams dang lhan du bod kyi skya tshab kyang tshang 'dzoms kyi go skabs shig byung / tshogs 'du der bod kyi sku tshab phebs mkhan dbu khrid tha'i ji bsam pho che dbang rig 'dzin dang / phyag rogs mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal/las bya bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub/ rtse drung kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ skad sgyur ka shod sras che brtan don grub/ las bya skyed sbug dbang 'dus nor bu/ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi bcas tshogs 'dur phebs zhugs gnang /khong rnams rgya gar rgyal sa ldi lir phebs skabs rgya gar gzhung dang / kong ras si tshogs pa bcas kyis dga' bsu sne len gzab rgyas zhus 'dug skabs der bod gzhung sku tshab rnams kyis e sha ya'i tshogs 'dur zhugs pa'i zhib phra'i gnas tshul rnams nye lam bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub kyis rtsom gnang mdzad pa'i mi che'i rba rlabs 'khrug po zhes pa'i phyag deb nang du gsal por 'khod 'duganyin shas rjes ldi lir e sha ya'i tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan sku tshab ngo las rnams bka' sbug tu phyir phebs gnang ste nyin zhig gro spyi rim bzhi spom mda' blo bzang yar 'phel nas de skabs rgya nag tu phebs pa'i bod gzhung sku tshab ngo las dang / e sha ya'i tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan sku tshab ngo las bcas la gsol ston zhig bshams te phran la yang mgron 'bod gnang ba ltar bcar nas khong rnam lhan du gsol ston la dgyes rgur rol/nyin zhig tho rengs tsam la phran gyi rmi lam du byang rwa sgreng dgon par slebs te rwa sgreng rin po che chibs pa sngon po zhig chibs nas rwa sgreng dgon pa'i rtser btsun dgon zhig tu phebs te khyed tsho 'dir khyug tsam sgug rogs zhes gsungs nas rwa sgreng rin po che sku rkyang dgon pa'i nang du phebs nas rgyun ring phyir phebs ma gnang bar 250

tshang mas dngangs 'tshab kyi ngang nas gnyid sad byung / skabs der yud tsam ring la rang nyid ha cang skyo snang byung ste zhogs ja'i skabs phran gyi rmi lam de'i skor zhib phra rwa bla'i gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan lags su zhus te khong gis rmi lam de ya mtshan po red ces gsung pa las gzhan gang yang gsung ma byung /de'i sang nyin sgang thog 'bras spyi blon chen yig tshang nas rwa bla'i gzim dpon mkhan po lam seng khyug tsam phebs rogs zhes bka' lan 'byor ma thag khong dang rogs pa gnyis khrid de sgang thog tu phebs/ de nyin dgong dro phyi tsam la tshur 'byor nas khong gi zhal ras rnam kun dang mi 'dra ba skyo snang dang / sdug bsngal gyis mnan pa'i thog yang yang dbugs ring kho na btang ste su zhig la bka' mol ma gnang ba ma zad/ de'i sang nyin khong gis kha sa 'bras spyi blon chen las khungs nas ched 'bod byas pa ltar bskyod par/ rang cag gi bla brang dpe bsags song / sde pa gzhung gis nga tsho'i rin po che btsan dbang thog nas gdan zhus kyis rtse shar chen lcog btson khang du bcug yod pa dang / lha sa dang / byang rwa sgreng bla brang gnyis dang /yab gzhis phun khang / sa 'du tshang bcas par sgo thel brgyab yod pa ma zad/rwa bla'i dza sag las zur rnam gnyis kyang btson du bcug 'dug zer/ da nga tsho'i rin po che ha cang sku ngal chen po myong rgyu'i thog sku phyur nyen kha chen po 'phrad kyi red/da yag po ma red/ sde pa gzhung gis lha sdod rgya gar tshong don sku tshab brgyud dbyin ji gzhung la rgya gar khul du yod pa'i rwa sgreng bla brang gi mi rgyu rnams bod gzhung la 'phral du rtsis sprod dgos lugs zhes re skul gyi bka' mol byung yod kyang / rgya gar gzhung gi khrims thog nas bod gzhung gi re 'dun bton pa de khas len zhu thabs med/khyed rang tsho blo bde po byas nas bzhugs rogs zhes 'bras spyi blon chen gyis bka' 25

gnang byung zhes li 'bring mda' dpon bsod nams stobs ldan gyis gsungs byung zhes gsungs /gnas tshul de rnams thos skabs phran gyi snying dbus nas brjod du mi langs pa'i skyo khro mnyam skyed kyis gdung sems drag pos rang dbang med par mchi ma lhung lhung du babs kyang / khong la thugs gso tshig gcig kyang zhu thub ma song /de'i sang nyin khong dang las rogs ngag dbang blo gros/ skad bsgyur gcig bcas khrid de ka ta khul du rgya gar gyi khrims rtsod pa drag gras shig 'tshol thabs su phebs/de ni gal srid dbyin ji'i gzhung gis rgya gar khul du yod pa'i rwa bla'i mi rgyu rnams bod gzhung la rtsis sprod kyi gnas tshul byung ba'i dbang du btang na/ khrims thog nas zhu brgyud bya rgyu'i gra sgrig gnang ba zhig red/de rjes gnas tshul thos gsal du/ skabs der bod gzhung gis lha sdod rgya gar tshong don sku tshab ri car san brgyud dbyin ji gzhung gis rgya gar du yod pa'i rwa bla'i mi rgyu rnams bod gzhung la rtsis sprod dgos lugs kyi re 'dun bton yod pa ma zad/ skabs der bka' shag gis bka' sgug khul du rgya nag dang / ldi li e shi ya'i tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan sku tshab kyi tshogs gtso thun mong la gsang tar gnang 'byor du bka' sbug khul du rwa bla'i mi rgyu yod pa rnams rang gzhung nas do dam gnang bde yod med sogs phyi rgyal gyi khrims lugs zhib rtsad thog rwa bla'i las byed dang / sa 'du'i mi ngo rnams kyi bya spyod nyams zhib dgos rgyu bcas bka' tar phebs don ltar tha'i ji bsam pho dang / mkhan chung blo bzang dbang rgyal gnyis skad sgyur ka shod sras bcas ka tar phebs te khrims dpon che khag la rtsad gcod byas par khrims dpon rnams kyi brjod bab tshig tho dang / rwa bla'i las byed rnams dang /252

sa 'du'i mi ngo rnams kyi bya spyod dogs 'char 'byung gzhi gang yang med lugs kyi bka' shag tu snyan zhu phul ba red ces thos byung /gong gsal gnas tshul ngan pa de bka' sbug khul du khyab yod pa ma zad/lha sa sa khul du zang zing yod lugs kyi bden rdzun mnyam bsres kyi 'chal gtam nyin re bzhin je mang du khyab stabs 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang /rgyal yum chen mo skya 'khor bcas kyi gnas tshul ji chags la sems khral chen po byung ste slar yang sgang thog tu khyug tsam bskyod nas skud med kha par zhig phul bar lha sar rgyal yum chen mos dbus tshang ma bde thang yin lugs dang / sems khral byed mi dgos/ gnas skabs ring bka' sgug du lhod lhod bzhugs rogs/ ring min bsu len btang chog ces bka' lan gnang ba las de min gnas tshul gang yang gsungs ma byung /de nas dus yun de tsam ma song ba'i nyin zhig sgang thog nas rwa bla'i gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan lags su rwa sgreng rgyal zur rin po che btson khang nang du dgongs pa rdzogs yod lugs kyi yid shin tu skyo ba'i gsar gnas shig 'byor te nga tsho tshang mar yid mug sems sdug gi mya ngan tshad las 'das pa byung /skabs der rwa bla'i gzim dpon lags kyis phran la rang re'i bla brang gi mi re zung gis bla ma bzhugs sar ma bzhag pas mtha' ma 'bras bu ngan pa rang gzhan gnyis ka dmigs med gtong ba zhig red gsungs te rgyun ring spyan chab sil/ de nas nyin 'ga' shas ring zhabs mjug gang las med pa sgrub gnang mdzad/nye lam rgya nag nas sku tshab ngo las rnams kyis de sngon gru gzings thog btang ba'i sku chas rnams ka la ka tar 'byor yod lugs kyi lan gsal 'byor te/253

phran la dngos zog gzhan gang yang khye/ ra med na'ang sngon du btang ba'i dkar yol rnying ma rnams de mnyam du btang yod pa rtsis len du khong tsho mnyam du khyug tsam ka tar bskyod nas rtsis len byas te bka' sbug tu phyir log skabs lha sa nas rgyal yum chen mo mchog gis g.yog po zhig gtong gnang mdzad pa de'i mdun phyag bris nang du khyod gnas skabs ring bka' sbug tu sdod rgyu las lam seng lha sar yong rtsis ma byed/da lta bsu len gyi mi rta khom gyi mi 'dug ring min bsu len gtong gi yin/ nga tsho tshang ma bde po yin/ sems khral mi dgos zhes bka' yig tshog don nyung shas de las mi 'dug kyang / g.yog po des brjod gsal/ gzhung gis sras sku zhabs khyed rang rwa sgreng rgyal zur rin po ches rgya nag tu ched mngags btang ba red ces dogs pa gnang gi yod pa ma zad/ lha sa'i khrom gzhung la rwa bla'i skor rtsa chig bkrams pa'i nang du sras sku zhabs khyed rang rwa bla'i phyogs gtogs yin lugs 'khod 'dug zer/skabs der bka' sbug nas lha sar thon khar glo bur dza drag gdub rtsub can gyi gong gsal gnas tshul byung rkyen re zhig bka' sbug tu mi sdod ka med byung ba'i dus yun de ni dngos 'brel nyi ma lo las ring ba lta bu'i tshor snang byung /lo de'i rla ba 8 tsam la nan cing nas ka tar go min tang gi don gcod 'i/sa khungs su sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma dang / sku 'khor brgyad dgu tsam ring min nan cing nas ka la ka tar gnam thog phebs kyi yod lugs dang / gal srid phun tshogs bkris bka' sbug khul du bzhugs yod na dus thog tu ka tar bsu len du phebs rogs zhes spom mda' tshang brgyud de tar 'phrin 'byor ma thag phran lam seng ka la ka tar khong tsho'i phebs bsur bcar/ skabs der sku'i gcen mo che 254

ring sgrol ma'i lhan du 7rgyal yum mchog gi yum dang / a zhang rab rgyas/ sru mo lags/ sru mo'i sras gnyis dang sras mo gcig 7rgyal yab dam pa'i gcen mo bza' mi bcas gdan zhu gnang 'dug da lam sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol ma lags kyis dbyin ji'i gsung ma mkhyen kyang thugs stobs chen pos sku nye sku 'khor mang po de tsam pha yul nas gdan zhu gnang bar phran ha las pa zhig byung / khong gi phebs lam la sku ngal de tsam ma byung zhes blo bde khyad du gsungs 'dug kyang gang ci'i thog sku ngal chen po byung bar gdon mi za/khong tsho ka la ka tar nyin gsum tsam sku ngal gsos nas bka' sbug tu phebs te re zhig lha sa nas chibs bsu ma 'byor bar bzhugs rgyun ring —/bzhugs khang zhig glas nas rla ba gcig lhag tsam bzhugs/ lo de'i phyi rla dgu pa'i ches shar tsam la lha sa nas chibs bsu 'byor te phran yang khong rnams dang lhan du yong na 'gal rkyen gang yang med lugs bka' phebs pa ltar/ khong tsho lhan du bka' sbug nas sgang thog brgyud lha sar phyir log byas/ 7rgyal yum mchog gi yum sku na smin par brten lha sa bar dal bu'i ngang nas 'grul bzhud kyis nyin nyi shu tsam la 'byor byung / nga tsho lha sar 'byor nyin 7rgyal yum chen mo dang khong gi yum chen lo mang ring ma mjal ba de de ring lhan 'dzoms byung bar thugs dgyes mnyes chen po byung song / de ni sku'i gcen mo che ring sgrol mas sku ngal mang po khyad du bsad nas mo'i lags dang sku 'khor mang po gdan zhu thob pa de 7rgyal yum mchog la thugs gsos phul ba lta bu zhig tu gyur/lha sar 'byor nas dus yun gang 'tshams ring dga' nye dang ngo shes rnams rim 'phrad kyis tshang mas bar lam rwa sgreng gi don rkyen ji byung skor bden 255

rdzun sna tshogs kyi gleng mol mang po byung / de 'brel bod gzhung nas bar lam phran rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs yin pa dang / sku gcen rgya lo don grub mchog rgya nag tu gdan 'dren zhus te rwa sgreng rgyal zur rin po che'i phyag bris shig cang ce hrer phul ba red ces pa la sogs pa'i rdugs pa rnam rtog mang po byung yod par brten de dag sel thabs ched bka' blon zur khang dang / stag brag phyag mdzod chen mo sogs kyi sku mdun du 'bul rten khyer te bcar nas thugs yid dang ba zhus pa bcas so//256

le tshan bcu bzhi pa/rwa stag srid skyong rnam gnyis dbar gyi don rkyen/༄mobe/ /phyi lo 1940 lo zla 12 nang rwa sgreng srid skyong rin po ches bod kyi srid skyong dang / 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i yongs 'dzin bgres pa'i mtshan khur gnang mus kyi skabs der rnam kun thugs blos 'gel yul 'phan po seṅge sgang bla ma zhes pa lha sar ched 'bod kyis srid skyong rin po che'i sku phyur ngan rdugs yod med skor pra phabs snga phyi gnang bar 7rgyal ba'i sku phyu shin tu 'tshub pa dang / de bzhin rwa sgreng rang gi sku phyur yang 'tshub ngo che bas 7rgyal tshab dgongs zhu gnang ste rkyen sel bsnyen sgrub gnang na bzang ba 'dug pas gnas skabs srid skyong dgongs zhu mdzad gal che lugs zhes pra lung la phebs par brten rwa sgreng rin po ches srid skyong dgongs zhu gnang rgyu thugs thag bcad nas srid skyong tshab gsar bsko bzhag gnang rgyu'i skor gang 'gab ji legs kyis rwa sgreng bla brang gi gnad yod las byed rnams dang / rnam kun thugs blos 'grel yul bla ma dang mkhan po/ bod gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs khag rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang /dza zur 'jam dbyangs bde legs/ gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan/smyung gnas bla ma thub bstan 'jam dpal skal bzang / mkhar rdo sprul sku skal 257

bzang thub bstan bcas la nang ma'i gros sdur gnang skabs snyung gnas bla ma thub bstan 'jam dpal skal bzang dang / mkhar rdo sprul sku gnyis kyis sku'i rkyen sel ched gnas skabs srid skyong dgongs zhu gnang ste rjes su lo gnyis gsum mtshams srid skyong mdzad 'khur rang 'jags gnang rgyu yod pa zhig byung na legs po yong rgyur srid skyong tshab gsar thad rgyal sprul kun bde gling dang / yongs 'dzin phur lcog sprul sku sogs la bsko bzhag gnang na phyin chad srid dbang phyir 'bul zhu dka' zhing /stag brag rin po che ni rin po che khyed kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa ma zad/ rnam kun thugs snang dkar ba/ de bzhin dgung lo mtho ba bcas gang thad nas thugs blos ling 'gel chog pa yin pa ltar stag brag rang la srid skyong gi 'gan 'khur gnang na /phyin chad sku'i 'gal rkyen sel mtshams srid dbang rang 'jags 'bul bzhes bde lugs bcas kyi bsam tshul zhus pa ltar dza sag las zur gnyis kyis bsam tshul de la mos mthun zhus/ 'on kyang gzim dpon mkhan po ngag dbang blo ldan nas srid skyong dgongs zhu gnang na bod ljongs tshogs chen nas dgongs pa 'brul mdog kha po ma red/ sku phyur 'tshub lhongs yod na rkyen sel zhabs rim bsgrub pas mi zlog pa mi srid cing / nga'i bsam par srid skyong dgongs zhu ma gnang bar da mus rang 'jags gnang na legs gnas dang / gal srid dgongs zhu ma gnang mthu med yin na/ srid skyong tshab gsar su bsko'i thad rang res the tshogs ma gnang na yag shos red ces zhus pa bcas gong du 'khod pa ltar srid skyong rin po ches nang gros gnang rjes rnam kun gzhung zhabs gras nas thugs blo 'gel yul bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / bka' blon bon shod che brtan rdo rje/ bka' blon phun khang bkris rdo rje bcas re re byas nas srid skyong rin po che'i gzim chung du ched 258

'bod kyis mjal 'phrad thog bla lha'i lung brtag dgongs don da mus bzhin srid skyong mu mthud byas na che gegs bar chad shin tu che nges phebs kyi 'dug pas /gnas skabs srid skyong dgongs zhus kyis rwa sgreng dgon du phebs nas rkyen sel bsnyen sgrub gnang rgyur srid skyong dang yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan 'khur gnas skabs ring dgongs zhu mi byed mthu med la srid skyong tshab gsar thad yongs 'dzin sku gzhon stag brag rin po cher bsko bzhag zhu rtsis skor ji legs bka' gros gnang bar bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / bon shod gnyis kyis stag brag rin po che ni rgyal ba rin po che'i yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mdzad khur bzhes mus thog rwa sgreng rin po che'i dbu blar song bas/ bla slob nang ma yin khar/ dgung lo yang mtho po yin stabs srid skyong gsar par bsko gzhag gnang rgyu 'os 'gab che tshul gyi bsam 'char phyogs mthun zhus 'dug pa dang / bka' blon phun khang nas srid skyong dgongs zhu ma gnang na legs tshul zhus shing / de bzhin rwa sgreng bla brang gi dga' nye ltos phyogs bod gzhung gi dpon rigs gnad yod re zung gis srid skyong dgongs zhu rtsa ba nas ma gnang na legs gnas dang / gal srid dgongs zhu ma gnang mthu med yin che rjes su slar yang srid skyong gi mdzad khur bzhes rgyu'i dgongs bzhes gnang rgyu med lugs bcas zhus 'dugaskabs der rtsis dpon ka shod pas dbang dang bral na thams cad shor zhes pa ltar rtsa dgongs zhu gnang ma mdzad na legs shing / gal srid sku phyur 'tshub lhong chen po yod che gnas skabs phyag las mtshams 'jog gis rwa sgreng du bsnyen sgrub gnang rgyu dang / de'i ring stag brag la srid skyong las tshab bsko bzhag gnang ste 7gong sa mchog gi rab bzhes mdzad sgo dang / rgyun du chos srid kyi gnang sgo rnams srid 259

tshab nas gnang rgyu dang / srid don gal che'i rigs rwa sgreng du dgongs skor zhu rgyu mdzad na legs gnas kyi bsam tshul bcas zhus 'dug kyang / de rjes srid skyong las tshab bsko rgyu'i thad kyi bsam tshul de 'ja' yal ba lta bur gyur/skabs der rwa sgreng rin po che nas gnas skabs lo gnyis gsum ring 7rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po che dang / nang don bka' mol gyis lo gsum mtshams nas slar yang rwa sgreng rin po cher srid dbang rang 'jags 'bul bzhes gnang rgyu'i phan tshun bka' mol byung yod lugs kyi gleng lhags byung 'dugartsa ba'i stag brag rin po che ni rwa sgreng rin po che'i dbu bla yin 'dug pas bshes gnyen bsten tshul thog nas bla ma dang slob ma'i dbar gyi 'brel ba dam zab brtsi bkur gzab nan zhu dgos pa'i gnas la brten rwa sgreng srid skyong gis stag brag rin po che mtshan zhabs dkyus khongs su zhugs rgyu ma 'gab pas rtse skor sku bcar mkhan che dar tan gyi mtshan gnas bsko bzhag mdzad pa dang / de bzhin stag brag bla brang gi ri khrod la chos gzhis rten gnas gang yang med stabs rtse mkhan mgron che ba 'das po tog pan rtse'i rjes shul mdzod sbug tu phul ba'i stod lung ram pa mda' grong gzhis ka zhes pa de stag brag bla brang la bstsal ba/ 7rgyal ba'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che gser khrir mnga' gsol zhus nas mtshan zhabs dar han stag brag rin po cher yongs 'dzin sku gzhon gyi mtshan gnas sko bzhag gnang ba/1940 lo'i lo mjug la srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches bka' blon rnams dang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas rwa sgreng bla brang spro khang du ched 'bod gnang nas bka' phebs don du/ nga rang gis da bar chab srid kyi 'khur 'gan blangs te gtso chen spyi nor 7gong sa chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che lha mi kun yid 260

ches pa thag ring nas gdan zhu gegs med thog gser khrir mnga' gsol sogs mdzad sgo rim pa gra rten legs 'grogs byung ba dang / sa mtshams yas mas sogs la chab srid kyi mtshan shas 'thus shor med tsam gyi bstan srid dkar 'jam yug cig tu gnas mus kyang / bla lha'i lung brtag dgongs don phyi lo ngos rang gi che srog la 'tshub lhongs che nges phebs pa ltar/ da cha srid skyong yongs 'dzin gyi mdzad khur dgongs zhu mi byed mthu med la brten 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog la yang lugs mthun dgongs snyan zhus zin pa ltar/ de don dgongs 'khrol yong ba dang / 7gong sa mchog sku na phra gshis bstan srid kyi 'khur bzhes srid skyong tshab gsar thad yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po che nas 7gong sa chung srid rin po che'i yongs 'dzin chung ba'i mtshan khur skyong mus la chung srid rin po che mchog nas kyang bshes gnyen bsten tshul ji bzhin brtsi bkur bla lhag tu che ba gnang mus dang / 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku gong mas kyang stag brag rin po cher thugs rje brtse bas bskyangs pa mkhyen gsal gyis mtshon chos srid mkhyen yon gang ci'i sgo nas 'os babs de las che ba med nges thog mo brtag nan tan rim gyis la skabs bab thugs skal shin tu bzang phebs ltar/ bstan srid dkar 'jam yun gnas rgyun 'khyongs yong res spyi don kho na las rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa til 'bru tsam med pas srid skyong gsar pa'i thad de don 'gab min tshogs 'dur go bsdur dgos rgyu zhes gsungs pa ma zad/ skabs der srid skyong rwa sgreng gi thugs blos 'khel ba'i nang ma'i 'brel ba dam zab yod pa rnams la'ang yongs 'dzin sku gzhon stag brag rin po che mchog la srid skyong dang / yongs 'dzin che ba gnang rgyu'i skor bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i nang sogs la bskul slong dgos pa'i bka' slob zhib 261
