par gnang zhing / nang don rdog gra lam 'grigs byung rjes gong gsal skor bka' shag tu rwa sgreng rin po ches bka' mngags gnang don ltar/ bka' shag nas tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa bskong tshogs gnang rgyu'i skor drung rtsis lhan rgyas la bka' phebs skor rwa sgreng rin po ches srid skyong mjad 'khur dgongs zhu gnang yang /bka' shag nas maṇ+ḍal rten gsum dang sbrags srid skyong dgongs zhu mi gnang bar mdzad 'khur rang 'jags skyong gnang yod pa zhes snga rjes gsol 'debs nan tan zhus rung zhal bzhes ma thob/ de skor ji legs tshogs 'dus mol bsdur bya dgos zhes bka' mngags gnang don bzhin/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du hrag bsdus rgyas pa'i thog bka' shag gi phebs sgo rnams khyab bsgrags byas te tshogs 'thus rnams kyis srid skyong rin po che dgongs 'khrol 'bul rgyu dang / tshab gsar yang yongs 'dzin sku gzhon stag brag rin po che 'os pa sogs gsal po shod par byed pa la khyung ram la ji byung blo mngags la brten tshang mas dgongs zhu de drang don dang nges don ji yin ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis kha ma sangs bar blo pham tshul gyis ngo gdong nag po bstan te kha khu sim po'i ngang yud tsam gnas rjes rwa sgreng bla brang gi phyogs gtogs g.yo can drang rdzus khag cig gis srid skyong rin po che dgongs zhu gnang ma 'os pa'i rgyu mtshan drangs te mtha' ma rgyal tshab rin po che rang nyid kyi sku phyur ngan dogs yod lugs dang / gnas skabs ring sku che che sgrub bsags sbyang gnang 'os sogs dngos 'brel yin gshis thugs bzhed ltar dgongs pa 'bul rgyu dang / srid skyong tshab gsar yang rwa sgreng rin po che'i bka' phebs ltar gnang na legs gnas zhes bshad stabs tshang mas sngon shing rlung gis bskyod pa bzhin phar 'khyogs tshur 'khyogs kyis de la mos mthun byas/262

de nas srid skyong gsar pa stag brag rin po che bsko bzhag zhu rgyu gtan 'khel ltar gyi bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i tshogs 'thus bka' shag la phul te bka' shag dang / spyi khyab mkhan po/ bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i 'thus mi bcas yongs 'dzin skya gzhon stag brag rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar te bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis maṇ+ḍal rten gsum mjal dar bcas phul nas don gnad skor snyan seng zhus par stag brag rin po ches/ nga rang lo na mtho bas srid skyong las 'khur lo gnyis gsum ring gang 'khyol zhus chog pa dang / de mtshams srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che rang gi phyag tu 'bul rgyu yin gshis rwa sgreng rin po che nas mdzad 'khur mtha' 'khyol gnang dgos gsungs te gnas skabs ring srid skyong gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes thob cing / skabs der bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas rwa sgreng rgyal tshab rin po che'i mdzad rjes zhib phra bkod thog da lam sku'i rkyen sel du srid skyong mdzad 'khur gnas skabs ring dgongs zhu gnang ste rwa sgreng gdan sar bsnyen sgrub gnang ched phebs bzhugs gnang rgyu dang / srid skyong gsar pa stag brag rin po che nas mdzad 'khur lo gnyis gsum ring gang 'khyol gnang rgyu/ de mtshams rwa sgreng gis srid skyong rang 'jags gnang rgyu'i thog 7gong sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gis rgyal srid chos srid ma bzhes bar du mdzad khur bzhes cha yong ba zhu rgyu bcas yig thog nas 'god 'bul zhus/srid skyong gsar pa stag brag rin po che phyi lo 1941 bod zla 1 ches 1 la srid skyong khri gsol gnang rgyu'i thugs gtan 'khel ba ltar/ srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che nas phyi lo 1940 che 12 bla mjug bar sngar bzhin srid skyong mdzad 'gan mu mthud gnang rgyu gtan 'khel mdzad/263

rwa stag bla slob gnyis kyi dam tshig nyams chag gi 'byung rtsa ni skabs der phyi rgyar yongs grags kyi gleng phyogs su/ rwa stag gnyis dbar bla slob kyi 'brel ba dam zab yod stabs stag brag dgung lo mtho rkyen srid skyong slar yang rwa sgreng gis tshur bzhes bde yong ba'i ched du srid skyong bskos lugs dang / lo gsum nas rwa sgreng gis rang 'jags gnang gi yod tshod bcas zer grags byung bar brten bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs dang / bka' blon bon shod gnyis kyi bsam par/srid skyong brje len yang yang byas na bka' blon rnams kyi gnas stangs g.yo 'gul thebs mi yong ngam snyam pa'i rdugs 'char byung ste/ khong gnyis kyi ngan gros byas nas rwa sgreng gi mdzad rjes skor rnam grangs mang po bkod pa'i yig 'dzob che ba'i 'char gzhi bzos pa'i nang 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon mchog sprul rin po ches chos srid lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan skyed bzhes ma grub par bod ljongs chab srid 'phrin las kyi mdzad pa srid skyong stag brag rin po che nas thugs 'gan skyed bzhes gnang dgos zhes pa'i 'char gzhi'i nang tshig gnad bkod de gza' 'khor gcig nas srid skyong gsar par phyag las rtsis sprod ran pa'i thugs brel che sgang zhig la srid skyong rwa sgreng mchog la chog mchan phyag rtags zhus 'dugade ni lo gsum tsam gyi rjes rtsod gleng byung na 'gog rkyen bzo rtsis byas pa'i lkog g.yo ngan byus lag bstar byas pa zhig yin tshod/ stag brag rin po che nas rgyal tshab kyi khrir ma rkyebs sngon gyi gsol dpon bstan pa mthar phyin / /de rjesasku sger dza sag bla ma bsko gzhag gnang ba / zhes pa de srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che'i sku mdun du gtong gnang gis stag brag rin po che rgyal tshab khri 'don skabs phebs byam la zhugs ma dgos pa dang / phyag mdzod la yang dza sag bla ma'i gnas rim ltar 264

bzhag mkhan chung tsam yang zhu ma dgos pa/ lo gnyis gsum tsam nas rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhu rgyu yin zhes zhus par skabs der rwa sgreng rin po ches thugs brtse'i ngang nas stag brag rin po che mchog sku na mtho bas phebs byam la nges par ma phebs che khri phebs mdzad sgor yar mar chibs skyod skabs chibs pa 'grogs na mi legs pa dang / phyag mdzod kyang dza sag bla ma ma gnang rung / mkhan chung tsam nges par dgos zhes gsungs kyang skabs der stag brag gsol dpon bstan pa mthar phyin gyis gong don rnams mthar bskyel zhu gnang mdzad bab la gzhigs na stag brag rin po che rang gi dgongs bzhes yin par gsal por mngon/ 'on kyang phyag mdzod bstan pa mthar phyin sogs ngan gros kyis stag brag rin po che khri phebs gsar mjal skabs thog ma'i bka' mol gsungs bab dang ma mthun par phebs byam thog phebs pa dang / gsar mjal gyi dgos mkho rnams rwa sgreng bla brang nas g.yar po ma bzhes pa sogs kyi rgyu rkyen gyis dam sel gyi rtsa ba gcig de nas byung /phyi lo 1941 bod zla 1 ches 1 nyin lo gsar gyi mdzad sgo dang chabs cig bod rgyal khab kyi srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che mdzad 'gan dgongs zhu gnang ba dang / srid skyong gsar pa stag brag rin po che khri phebs bcas kyi mdzad sgo rtse po tā la'i tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel gnang /sngar srol ltar na/ srid skyong zur pa'i bzhugs khri srid skyong las thog gi gsham du bsgron dgos kyang da lam srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i bzhugs khri de las thog gi gong du bsgron pa de ni rwa sgreng lo gsum nas srid skyong mdzad 'khur rang 'jags gnang rgyu'i mtshon rtags yin 'dug de'i skor bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i tshig tho'i nang gsal yod cing tshig tho de'i 'dra shus re rwa sgreng bla brang dang /265

bka' shag tshogs 'du bcas so sor phul yod/ de rjes stag brag bla brang lha sar bzhugs yul kun bzang pho brang du rwa sgreng bla brang gi sku 'khor rnams ched du gdan zhus kyis gsol chig gzab rgyas shig phul thog thugs rje legs 'bul mtshon byed 'bul dngos rgya che tsam phul 'dugasrid zur rwa sgreng rin po che lha sa nas byang rwa sgreng dgon du phyir phebs skabs kyang srid skyong stag brag gi bka' don ltar phebs bskyel du bka' shag gis gtsos pa'i gzhung zhabs ser skya dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po/ dmag sgar khag gi ru sgrigs bcas gzab rgyas kyis srid skyong las thog dang 'dra ba'i phebs bskyel zhus/rwa sgreng ho thog thu thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog phyi lo 1934 bod che 1 ches 10 gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i rgyal tshab kyi khri la phebs pa nas phyi lo 1941bod che 1 ches 3 nyin srid skyong gi thugs 'gan dgongs zhu gnang ba'i bar lo bdun ring bod rgyal khab kyi rgyal bstan chab srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes skabs khong gis dgongs zhu gnang khar bka' shag dang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas lhan rgyas la rji ltar bka' gnang ba bzhin/ spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i yang srid mchog sprul rin po che 'khrul bral gdan zhu gegs med thog gser khrir mnga' gsol gra rten lebs 'grogs byung ba dang / bod rgyal khab kyi sa mtshams khag dus bde zhi 'jags / chab srid dkar 'jam yug cig tu gnas pa bcas la brten skabs der mang tshogs nas kyang rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po che mchog la dad pa dang bstod bsngags gus bkur tshad med zhu gi yod stabs/ khong dgongs zhu gnang 266

ba'i gnas tshul mang tshogs tshos thos skabs yid la gdung ba zad mi shes pa byung zhing / rgyal ba don gyi bdag po lugs gnyis 'phrin las kyi mdzad khur skyed bzhes ma grub bar da mus bzhin srid skyong mdzad khur bzhes rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam yang dngos su zhu ba'i go skabs bral/ 'on kyang bod gzhung gi sku drag nang du rwa sgreng srid skyong rin po che dgongs pa zhus 'khrol byung bar mi re zung nam langs pa lta bu'i dga' tshor byung ba dang / chabs cig slar yang srid skyong kyi mdzad khur bzhes rgyur sems khral langs nas 'gog rkyen bzo ba'i ngan thabs lag len bstar 'go tshugs pa dper na/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng rin po ches thugs blos ling 'grel gyi thog nas chab srid kyi las don gal che'i rigs sngon du bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs la nang gros kyis khong gi bsam tshul bton pa ltar thag gcod mdzad kyi yod pa'i mi des mtha' ma rgyal tshab rwa sgreng dgongs zhu gnang skor kho par bsam tshul gros 'dre gnang bar dgag cha med thog ngo dga' sbrel lad kyis dga' mos yod pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po zhus shing / phyogs gcig nas gong 'khod ltar bka' blon bon shod dang ngan gros bshams te mdzad rjes 'char gzhir tshig gnad bkod nas rwa sgreng slar yang rgyal tshab gnang rgyur 'gog rkyen bzos/ de min srid skyong rwa sgreng nas mdzad khur bzhes ring dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi phyag las phran bu byung yod pa ma zad/ lhag par khyung ram la de tsam gyi le khag med rung thad ku'i bden gtam tshig re zung brjod pa'i rgyu chung rkyen che ched bzos kyi byus nyes phog pa des khyung ram gyi nye ltos sku drag tsho rwa sgreng la blo log pa'i gnas tshul 'byung yod pa'i nang bka' blon bon shod che brtan rdo rje gtso bo zhig yin/de mtshungs sku drag mi sger kha shas kyis 'dod par mi babs pa dang /267

rgyal srid skyong ba'i zhib phra'i mdzad rim nang phran bu'i ma 'os ma 'tshams pa'i gnas tshul 'ga' shas yong rgyu ni g.yol thabs med pa'i chos nyid yin pa dper na/dpon rigs las tshan bsko bzhag dang / gyod don kha mchu thag gcod sogs la gsham 'og las byed rim pas 'bul rten dang / ngo shes mgo 'dren gyi dbang du shor te 'os bab dang ma mthun pa 'ga' zhig byung yod pa dang / rwa sgreng bla brang gi zhabs 'bring 'ga' shas kyis rwa sgreng srid skyong rin po cher mtshan shas yong rgyur ma bsam par rang 'dod chen pos gzhung gi sku chas spras nyo zhu ba dang / dza sag 'jam dbyangs bde legs la dza sag bgres song dar han gyi go ming yod pa de zur bzhugs gnang du bcug nas tsha bo 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan la dza sag gsar pa bskos skabs lo chung nyams myong de tsam med rkyen smyung gnas bla ma can grogs ngan gyis rim pas bslus te lha sa dang / gdan sa rwa sgreng bcas su spro khang sogs mang po gsar rgyag gis 'dod chung chog shes bral ba'i rgyas spros mchis pa dang / ar las grub mtshams ar ston zhes sku drag mang pos ngo dga' sbrel lad byas pa/rgyal tshab kyi mtshan bzhes gnang bzhin pa'i skabs tshong thabs rgya che byas pa/ tha na lha sa bar skor nang du yang tshong khang btsugs pa der rgyal po'i tshong khang zer ba sogs 0/ brten mi gzhan gyi blo la ma bab pa'i gnas tshul byung /gang ltar 1941 lor yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po ches srid dbang bzung rjes sku drag mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa 'ga' shas kyis stag brag bla brang gi phyag mdzod bstan pa mthar phyin la ngo dga' sbrel lad byas pa dang / srid zur rwa sgreng la sdang zug dgrar 'dzin byas te rwa stag bla brang gnyis dbar dkrugs shing gang thub brgyab yod pa de'i dmigs yul ni/ rwa sgreng rin po ches srid skyong rang 'jags 268

gnang rgyur 'gog rkyen bzo rgyu de yin/rwa sgreng rin po che srid skyong dgongs zhu gnang ste byang rwa sgreng dgon du phyir phebs rjes lo gnyis tsam gyi ring la srid skyong stag brag rin po che nas thog ma'i zhal bzhes gnang don ltar chab srid kyi gnad che'i las don dang las tshan bsko gzhag sogs don gnad che rigs rwa sgreng rin po che mchog la bka' 'dre dgongs bskor zhu rgyu'i nang ma'i phyag bris dus thog tu 'bul gnang mdzad pa'i bka' lan du rwa sgreng rin po che nas kyang dge skyon g.yo bsrang gi dgongs tshul phyag bris kyang 'bul gnang mdzad kyi yod 'dug kyang / lo gnyis song rjes dus bsrings yun gnas ma thub pa dang / de mtshungs mtho rim dbang 'dzin sku drag re zung gis srid dbang blos gtong 'dod med par brten ma 'ongs sngon rtsis brgyab ste de sngon rwa sgreng srid skyong khri bzhugs skabs bsko bzhag gnang ba'i gnas yod dpon rigs gnas dbyung dang yang na gnon shugs sprad de dgongs pa zhu ru bcug pa bcas lag len bstar thog rnam kun rwa sgreng la ma dga' ba dang / stag brag bla brang gi nye ltos sku drag 'ga' shas rim bzhin gnas yod du bsko bzhag bya rgyu'i ngan gshom zhig brtsams pa dper na/mdo smad spyi khyab bka' blon gnang byung ba'i las 'khur lo dus rdzogs lugs kyis rang mtshams rgyal khab tu phyir phebs gnang bar stag brag bla brang gi phyag mdzod dza sag bla ma bstan pa mthar phyin gyi bsam par zhabs pad gnang byung ba mdo smad nas sku rgyu phyag rdzas ji snyed khyer yod stabs sku sger bla brang la mjal bcar phebs kyi yod shag gi re sems bcangs rung / khong gis mjal bcar ma zhus par brten rgyu rkyen de rang gi thog nas gnang byung ba'i mdo spyi zhabs pad kyi go gnas gnas dbyung btang ste/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs la bsko bzhag gnang ba de ni bka' blon bla ma 269

bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis mgo 'dren shugs chen byas pa zhig yin 'dugabaka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis zur khang dbang chen dge legs la khyed rang gis bka' blon zhus na 'os khongs su tshud thabs bya rgyu yin/yin na'ang ka shod pas dngul ṭam rdo 8000 phul yod stabs khyed rang gis de'i thog ṭam rdo stong phrag gnyis spar nas 'bul thub na legs gnas kyi slob ston gnang ba ltar zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis gser leb lcug mang po stag brag bla brang du phul bar brten de 'phral bka' blon gyi go gnas thob pa dang / bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis zur khang la slob ston ma byas gong zur khang ni rim bzhi'i gnas rim thog mdo smad las bya bsko stsal ltar thon rtsis kyis rim bzhi gsum mdo rgyal mtshan yon tan gyi khal drel spus nyo'i tshong thag lam tsam chod kyang gnas tshul glo bur 'gyur te/ zhabs pad gsar pa zur khang dbang chen dge legs la bsko bzhag thugs gtan 'khel ba'i gsang brda byung ba ltar/ sang nyin bka' sgyur yig chung stsal gtan 'khel don bzhin zur khang dbang chen dge legs nas rim bzhi gsum mdo'i sa nas rta drel nyo rgyu gnas skabs ring mi dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig btang bar gsum mdo lam seng zur khang du bskyod de rta drel spras gzigs tshong thag chod zin gshis/ da cha tshong slog bzhi zur gnang dgos zhus par/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis tshong slog dgos na nges par phul chog rta drel tshong slog zhus don ni nga rang sang nyin bka' blon kyi bka' sgyur mjal dar 'bul rgyu yin zhing / de nas khri 'don sogs kyi rogs byed du phebs rogs zhes gsungs pas gsum mdo pa tang sangs te/ kha sa ka shod pas bka' blon gsar mjal gyi gra sgrig rogs byed du yong dgos gsung byung ba dang / de ring zur khang 270

nas bka' blon gsar mjal gyi rogs byed du yong dgos phebs skor don dam drang nges ji yin ma nges pas brtag dpyad nan tan gyis bka' mol zhu skabs zur khang rang la bka' blon gsar bsko'i thugs gtan gtsang 'khel byung ba shes 'phral rta drel gyi tshong slog zhu rgyu phar bzhag zur khang gi skyabs khongs zhabs zhur tshud thabs dang gsar mjal zhabs zhu gang ci dam don zhu chog pa'i khas len zhu dgos byung thogaka shod pas ji byas mngon chung gis nyams zhib skabs bka' sgyur yig chung zur khang la phebs pa las ka shod la ma phebs par phru log byung ba gzhi nas shes/skabs der gnas tshul gzhan zhig la/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis khong gi yab zur zur dza sag dang / khu bo khe smad dza sag bsod nams dbang 'dud gnyis so so'i sar bcar te zhabs pad gnang byung ba'i tshab tu pā lags dang /a khu lags nas zhu ba gnang na dus la bab pa yin lugs dang / 'gro song thad ji 'gro nga tsho zur khang rang nas btang chog pa zhes mi re'i sar skad cha gcig mtshungs re bshad/ zur zur dza sag gis 'gro song thad gzim shag zur khang nas btang na ma gtogs nga rang la gtong yas rtsa ba nas med ces brjod/ de rjes khe smad dza sag bsod nams dbang 'dud zur zur dza sag bzhugs sar phebs te/ da zhogs o'o lags dbang chen dge legs nga'i sar phebs te da res zhabs pad gnang byung ba'i tshab tu a khu lags khyed nas zhus na/ gang ci'i thad 'os babs 'dug lhag par du a khu lags nas rgyal ba'i yang srid gdan zhu'i byas rjes la brten nas nges par du bka' blon bsko gzhag yong gi red/ 'gro song thad gal srid zur khang nas rogs ram zhu dgos kyang zhu gi yin/ zhes gsung gi 'dug pas gcen po'i dgongs tshul ji yin ngas bka' slob zhu bar bcar ba yin zhes zhus par/ zur 27ga

zur dza sag gis/ bu dbang chen dge legs nga'i sar phebs byung bar/ da lam zhabs pad gnang byung ba'i tshab tu pā lags rang zhu ba gnang na 'os babs 'duga'agro song thad zur khang nas btang chog ces gsungs kyi 'dug pas nga la 'gro song gtong yas med ces bshad pa yin/ lar nas gcung po khyed kyis mkhyen gsal ltar ngas bu dbang chen dge legs kyi bka' mol la yid ches med/ zhabs pad nga gnyis zhu dgos gsung pa tsam las don ngo ma bu dbang chen dge legs khong rang la zhus tshar yod pa red bsam gyi 'dug ces gsungs pa'i gnas tshul de rjes su zur zur dza sag nas sku ngo sne'u shar thub bstan thar par gsungs ste sku ngo sne'u shar nas phran la gong gi gnas tshul dang / zur khang gi mdzad phyogs skor gsung gleng byung /bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs ni/ gzugs bong chen po med kyang 'jon thang chen po yod pa ma zad/ g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi mi sna zhig yin pa'i thog kha shugs ha cang chen po yod pa dang / 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po zhal bzhugs skabs khong la rtse phyag mkhan chung gi las 'gan stsal/ rtse pho brang shar brgyud gzim chung nyams gso'i ar las kyi 'gan 'khur zhu sgo 'thus tshang ma byung bar brten mkhan chung go ming gnas dbyung btang ste rtse drung dkyus mar phab/zer skad du/ pho brang gzim chung nyams gso byed ring ar las kyi mthun rkyen du ma lkog zos byas pa'i dogs gnad kyis khong pa'i mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes btang ste skyid sdug ha cang tha zhan gyi 'tsho ba skyel dgos byung 'dugade sngon rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dbyangs bde legs dang 'brel 'dris chen po yod pa ltar/ rwa sgreng rin po che srid skyong gi thugs 'khur bzhes rjes rwa sgreng bla brang la phan thogs yong ched khong la thugs re gzigs skyong bla med thog rtse drung dkyus ma 272

nas dmigs bsal gnas spar gyis bod rgyal khab kyi lo rgyus thog ser mo ba thengs dang po yin pa'i bod gzhung dmag spyi mkhan chung gi go gnas gnang / de'i rjes tsam la drung yig chen mo bsko bzhag gis mkhan drung dmag spyi zhes grags/ de nas bka' blon bla ma dang / dmag spyi che ba gcig lcogs bsko bzhag gnang ba sogs dus yun thung ngu'i nang go gnas mtho po dang dbang cha chen po gnang bas rim bzhin dpal 'byor gyi stobs kyang dbyar gyi chu gter rgyas pa ltar je rgyas je 'phel du gyur pa bcas ni rwa sgreng rin po ches rogs mgon gnang ba nyag cig las byung ba zhig yin/srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po ches chab srid kyi dbang cha brtan por gnas thabs ched khong la dmag spyi dang / rtse yig tshang gi drung che bsko bzhag dang / de rjes stag brag skabs bka' blon dmag spyi bcas ches mtho'i gnas rim gnang /de ni blos 'gel mi sna drag gas shig tu brtsis nas bsko gzhag gnang ba zhig yin/gong 'khod ltar/ de sngon khyung ram gyi don rkyen skabs bon shod la le thogs yong nye'i skabs bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis rwa sgreng la mgo 'dren btang nas bzung bka' blon bon shod de bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyi bka' gsung dang len byed mkhan zhig tu bsgyur thub pa red/rtsis dpon 'bri yul bas zhib khang las khungs kyi las tho nor 'khrul byung skor la bsnyad 'dogs kyi las 'khur gnas dbyung btang ste/ de'i tshab tu rtsis dpon gsar pa zhu sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan la bsko bzhag gnang ba bcas la brten lha sa'i mang tshogs khrod du/ gnang byung rlung rta dma' bas/ me skyogs 'thor mdel phog song / gser gyi rtsig pa brtsigs nas/ zur la dar lcog btsugs song / 'bri yi rwa co bud pa/ hon nad phog pa'i 'khrul red/ zhwa la 273

gnyis brtsegs gsum brtsegs/ len po rang yang ma byung / zhes dang / stag mo grod khog ltogs nas/ gnang gi rwa co bkog song / gser gyi rtsig pa brgyab nas/ zur la nyi ma shar song / 'bri la 'gram lcag bzhus nas/ zhwa la nyis brtsegs brgyab song / zhes pa'i gzhas btang ba red/de rjes srid zur rwa sgreng gis thugs blo gtsang ma 'gel yul bka' blon phun khang bkris rdo rje nyes med le btags kyi bka' blon gyi las 'khur nas phyir 'then byas tshab tu bka' blon gsar pa ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma dang / bka' blon bon shod 'das tshab tu lha klu che dbang rdo rje bcas la rim bzhin bka' blon gsar pa bsko bzhag byas/ bka' blon 'pho 'gyur snga phyi rim byung gi skabs so sor skyabs rten phul ba'i rgyu 'gro sngar las ldab 'ga' shas 'phar bar brten lha sa'i mang tshogs kyi gzhas tshigs tu/ nyis khri 'dred brdar shor song / sum khri dpyi 'go brdabs song / lnga khri tham pa med par/ zhabs pad yong sa ma red/ lha klur zhabs pad bskos na/ 'a dzi 'a ma yog red/ bsam phor zhabs pad bskos na/spom mdas hrag hrag yog red/ ces pa'i gzhas kyang yongs grags su btang ngo /de bzhin gdan sa'i mkhan po dang / gzhung zhabs gnas yod las 'khur bsko 'then phyogs rigs kyi gnas stangs mngon gsal je dod du song bar brten srid zur rwa sgreng gi phyogs gtogs tshang mas nad mi theg pa'i 'gal ba zhig chags pa sogs rwa stag bla brang gnyis kyi 'brel ba je zhan je sdug tu song ba ma zad/sngon du srid skyong stag brag gis lo gsum gyi rjes srid skyong las 'khur rwa sgreng la phyir sprod bya rgyu'i bka' mol nan tan byung ba'i dus tshod slebs zin rung / stag brag bla brang nas srid skyong phyir sprod bya rtsis kyi bzo gang yang ma thon par brten srid zur rwa 274

sgreng gi dgongs par da cha lo gsum song yod stabs lha sar khyug tsam phebs te srid skyong stag brag rin po che dang ngo mjal zhus na de sngon bzhag pa'i tshig don ltar/srid dbang phyir 'bul gnang shag gi thugs re gnang ste lha sar phebs rtsis kyang phyi rgyar gdan zhu byed mkhan zhig ma byung bar rang bzhin phebs bde po med cing /bod shing spro rla 1 ches 3 phyi lo 1944 lo rtse po ta lar 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzim chung du ches gsum zan brtags su 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i sku phyur 'tshub lhongs nyen rdugs yod lugs phebs par brten bod gzhung gis rkyen sel du gdan sa bzhis gtsos pa'i bod ljongs yongs kyi dgon sde ris med khag tu zhabs rim ched sgrub zhu rgyu dang / gdan sa gsum dang gzhung zhabs ser skya spyi mgrin nas 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen por brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu gtan 'khel pa'i gnas tshul de srid zur rwa sgreng rin po ches gsan thos byung 'phral de snga rwa sgreng gi ltos phyogs bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis gtsos pa'i gzhung gi gnad yod dbang 'dzin dpon rigs khag dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po bcas so sor phyag bris ched gnang don bzhin gdan sa'i mkhan po rnams nas 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen par brtan bzhugs 'bul bar rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu dgos lugs bka' shag la zhus kyang bsam yul las 'das pa zhig la/ srid zur rwa sgreng nas gzigs skyong dang thugs blo ling 'gel gnang yul gtso bo bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis khong khro chen po'i rnam 'gyur bstan te lan 'debs su/ 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu'i thad 'di gar srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku zil pa khrum mer bzhugs yod pa ma red dam/ de 'dra yin bzhin du srid zur 275

rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu ni/ la cha'i sgang lo spags thel rgyag dgos don yog ma red/ lar nas gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po tshos chos 'chad nyan dang / bslab pa slob gnyer gnang nas bzhugs tshugs na dga' gi ma red dam zhes yog tshom byil byil gtong bzhin par ngo gdong yang dmar por gyur te bshad stabs gong gsal rwa sgreng rin po ches 7gong sa mchog la brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu de tsha 'thor/de rjes rwa sgreng ltos bcas sku drag dang / gdan sa'i mkhan po las sne bcas kyis rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu nges par dgos gal gyi 'char gzhi gnyis pa bsam gzhigs byed skabs srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che nas thabs lam gzhan zhig bton gnang mdzad pa ste/ lha sar khyug tsam phebs nas srid skyong stag brag rin po che mjal tsam byung na/ sngar gyi zhal dan tshig gnad kyis srid dbang rtsis 'bul zhu rgyu'i thugs re chen po gnang bzhin yod par brten ser byes gra tshang gi 'du khang nyams gso legs grub kyi rab gnas mdzad par rwa sgreng srid zur rin po che gdan zhu bya rgyu'i snyan seng zhus par zhal bzhes kyis lha sar phebs rgyu ches cha gtan 'khel ltar phyi lo 1944 lo nang srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar phebs skabs bod gzhung gis phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus 'dugaskabs der lha sa'i mi dmangs rnams kyis srid zur rwa sgreng rin po ches srid dbang rang 'jags bzhes kyi red snyam pa'i re ba byung ste rwa sgreng rin po che'i sku mdun du sku drag dang / gdan sa'i bla sprul/ mkhan po las sne/ tshong rigs che khag dang / mi dmangs bcas 'tshang ka shig shig gis bcar mkhan byung 'duganyin shas rjes srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che rtse pho brang du 7gong sa mchog dang / srid 276

skyong stag brag rin po che rnam gnyis lhan 'dzoms sar mjal bcar zhu gnang gi mdzad sgo grub rjes stag brag rin po che'i gzim chung du mjal 'phrad du phebs nas srid zur rwa sgreng rin po ches rkyen sel bsnyen sgrub zin lugs dang / srid skyong rin po che sku na mtho bas mu mthud chab srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu sku ngal chen po yong rgyur bsam nas da lam ched bcar gnang ba'i gnas lugs sogs gsungs par/ srid skyong stag brag rin po ches bka' mol de rnams la gsung lan ma phul pa'i gnas tshul byung rkyen rwa sgreng rin po che'i thugs pham ngang nas thabs sdug 'di 'dra 'phrad pas skabs der lha sar phebs par der thugs 'gyod chen po byung / de'i sngon tsam la dza sag tsha rong gis rwa sgreng rin po cher dang thog srid skyong mdzad khur bzhes skabs dgongs zhu gnang rgyu mi 'dug ces dang / gal srid dgongs zhu mi gnang mthu med yin na rjes su rang 'jags gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes ma gnang na legs lugs bcas zhus pa yin/ da cha slar yang tshur lha sar phebs na bzo lta yag po mi 'dug pas ma phebs na legs gnas zhes phyag bris phul ba yin zhes de sngon phran la gsungs byung /srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che nas bla slob bshes gnyen bstan tshul gyi dam chig 'du shes kho nar brtsi bkur de lta bu gnang ste khong gi thugs su sngar bzhin bla brang khag gnyis kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams gtsang sel gyis dam chig nyams chag tu ma gyur pa bya dgos gsungs pa de ni rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i bla na med pa'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad pa'i cha shas shig yin par gor ma chagasrid zur rwa sgreng rin po che lha sa nas rwa sgreng dgon du phyir phebs rjes ston dus lha sa'i nye 'khor 'phan po lhan grub rdzong khul du ser byes gra tshang dang /277

sngags pa gra tshang gnyis kyi 'bru 'ded gra pa 'ga' shas kyis dpyod ka 'bru bun btang ba rnams ston dus bsdu bar phyin te dza drag thog bsdu 'ded byed skabs mi ser rnams kyis lhun grub rdzong dpon la rgyu rkyen gnas tshul zhus par rdzong dpon gyi mi ser tshor 'bru bun tsha 'ded btang na sprod mi dgos zhes bshad par brten 'bru bun 'ded mkhan gra pa rnams rdzong dpon sar bcar te rgyu rkyen zhu skabs phan tshun nga che nga btsan gyi shod res thug mthar gra pa khros te rdzong dpon gyi ngo tshab la nyes rdung drag po btang rkyen che las 'das shing / rdzong tshab de ni rtse mkhan drung chos 'phel thub bstan gyi spyan rgan pa yin 'dug pa dang / chos 'phel thub bstan ni srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i thugs blo 'gol yul gyi gras shig yin/ khong gis bka' shag la snyan zhu phul ba ltar bka' shag nas se ra byes sngags gnyis la byed gte rtsis sprod dgos lugs gsungs par rtsis sprod mi dgos pa zhus pa sogs la brten bod gzhung gis ser byes mkhan po ngag dbang rgya mtsho 'dzin bzung bya rtsis skabs ngag dbang rgya mtsho khams phyogs su bros par rjes 'ded pas ngag rgya'i spyan mched ngag rgyar 'khrul nas bsad te mgo lag lha sar khyer yong ba sogs kyis rkyen pas rwa sgreng phyogs gtogs mkhar rdo dang / snyung gnas bla ma can ha cang nad mi theg pa byung stabs phyi lo 1947 bod rla 1 nang mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal gyi shag tu lag 'bam 'bar gas byung ba'i gnas tshul de lha sar yongs su sbir grags chen po byung ba'i brjod rigs la/ khams pa tshong pa 'dra ba'i mi zhig gis mdo spyi g.yu thog nas srid skyong stag brag rin po che mchog la 'bul rgyu'i sgam chung ras dkar bsgril 'thum rtags 'byar zhig phul yod pa zla gcig tsam song rjes mkhan drung gi spyan mched dge 'dun bstan dar gyi sgam chung de kha 'byed skabs de'i nang nas tshor 278

sgra grags nas lag 'bom 'bar gas byung 'dug kyang / khong pa'i nang gi dngos chas phran bu gtor skyon byung ba las mi la skyon gang yang byung mi 'dug zer/dus de nas bzung rwa stag gnyis dbar chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod yang rtser slebs skabs nus stobs zhan pa'i phyogs de 'u thug thabs zad kyi nyen kha'i lam nas bde ba 'tshol thabs byed pa ni ldog tu med pa'i rang bzhin gyi chos nyid cig yin pa ltar/ srid zur rwa sgreng rin po ches rgya nag go min tang gzhung la rogs ram gyi re bcol ma gnang mthu med byung nas tre hor brgya dpon bu don grub rnam rgyal dang / la dkar bu mthu stobs gnyis gsang ba'i thog nas btang ste 'brel gtugs kyi mngags cha gnang ba'i gnas tshul de lha sdod rgya gar tshong don sku tshab ri car san gyis bod gzhung phyi rgyal las khungs su bcar te rwa sgreng rin po che rgya gar khul gnas gzigs la phebs rgyur rogs ram byed rogs gsung 'dug kyang nang don rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu phebs rtsis med dam snyam pa'i gnas tshul zhus nas me 'bar ba'i thog shing gshag pa'i dpe ltar/ rwa stag gnyis kyi dbang cha'i 'thab rtsod rno ngar che zhing rnyog zing can gyi gnas stangs sngar bas dza drag tu song /gong gsal gyi gsang gnas bden rdzun gang yin la ma ltos par bod gzhung mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa'i gas nas srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che dang rnam kun 'khon 'dzin yod pa rnams kyis 'khon lan bslogs pa'i dus skabs rnyed dka' ba thog tu babs nas gzhung don kha khyer gyis sger gyi 'khon lan slog ched dang / stag brag bla brang la ngo srung sbrel lad zhu ched ngan byus ji snyed bton te lag len du bstar gyis srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku na mtho zhing / sku che hril po'i ring chos phyogs kyi nyams bzhes kho na mdzad dang mdzad bzhin pa de sku drag 'ga' shas kyis byang chub 279

pa'i lkog g.yo ngan byus kyi rnyog zing kyag gyog gi lam du dbu bskor zhus pa der rdugs zon ma byung ba dang / lhag par du phyag mdzod bstan pa mthar phyin chung dus nas bla ma'i zhabs phyi kho na zhus pa las/ chos srid kyi khe nyen rtogs pa'i shes yon med thog chags sdang mongs gsum gyi bag chags zab cing / gzhan gyi ngo bstod la dga' ba/ phra mar yid ches sla zhing 'dod yon gyi thog chog shes dang ngoms dus med pa/ de'i lag rogs mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang / sne mgron thub bstan legs smon sogs kyis rgyal kha blon sgyur gyi bya rim je snyed cig byung 'dugade rjes phyi lo 1947 zla 2 ches 23 nyin bka' shag tu nan cing don gcod mkhan mgron lo gsum nas rwa sgreng gi ngo tshab tre hor brgya dpon bu don rnam dang / la dkar bu mthu stobs gnyis kyis go min tang gzhung la bod du drag dpung dang drag chas kyi rogs bskyor gnam gru sogs dgos lugs zhus 'dug par rgya gzhung nas de'i skor nyin shas rjes lan gsal sprad 'thus bshad lugs 'khod pa'i gsang tar zhig phul 'byor byung 'dug pa'i skor bka' blon bla ma ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / zur khang dbang chen dge legs / ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma/lha klu che dbang rdo rje/ spyi khyab mkhan po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bcas lhan tshogs kyis gsang tar de bltas rjes tshang ma hang sangs te khungs so sos gang dga' ci drag gi bsam tshul mang tsam bton mthar bka' blon zur khang gis nye char dbyin ji'i sku tshab ri car san nas gsang gnas gsal po gsungs pa ma gtogs nga tsho mgo rul rna bas mi 'tshor ba lta bu'i las ka gang min yong gtan 'khel zhing / da res kyi gnas tshul 'di ni lag pa 'gyogs snga rting lta rgyu las thabs gzhan med pa red/ sngon la rwa sgreng lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu de red ces bshad pa de la bka' blon 280

gzhan rnams dang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas nas mos mthun byas thog gdan zhu'i 'go 'doms bka' blon gcig 'gro rgyu yang thag bcad de bka' shag lhan rgyas dang / spyi khyab mkhan po bcas srid skyong stag brag rin po che sku mdun du snyan zhur bcar te gong gsal nan cing don gcod kyi gsang tar 'byor ba'i skor dang /bka' shag lhan rgyas kyi gros bsdur ji byung gi skor zhib cha snyan seng zhus te 'grigs min dgongs skor zhus par skabs der srid skyong stag brag rin po che nas gnas phrul rnams gsan ma thag thugs pham byung bar brten spyan chab bsil shing /bka' shag gi srid zur rwa sgreng gdan zhu'i 'go 'doms bka' blon gcig 'gro dgos la bka' blon su 'os bsko gzhag gnang dgos zhus par/ zur khang 'gro dgos gsung 'phral zur khang gis lam seng rogs pa bka' blon gcig gtong rogs zhes zhus pa ltar/ bka' blon lha klu che dbang rdo rje zur khang gi rogs par bsko brdzong gnang 'dugade nyin srid bka' lhan tshogs kyis thag gcod byas rjes lha sa rwa sgreng bla brang dang / de min rwa bla'i phyogs gtogs mkhar snyung bla ma gnyis dang / phun khang /sa 'du tshang bcas la sgo thel brgyab pa dang sbrags rwa sgreng dza sag las zur gnyis dang / phun khang gung bkris rdo rje dang sras mgon po tsho ring bcas 'dzin bzung gis las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung thog rtse shar chen lcog tu do dam btson 'jug byas/ de bzhin sa 'du tshang gi tshong dpon rgan pa 'gyur med dang / snyung gnas bla ma/ mkhar rdo bla ma bcas 'dzin bzung gis shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug bya rtsis kyi khongs nas snyung gnas bla ma skabs der bros shor te lam seng 'dzin bzung ma thub/281

bod gzhung gis rwa bla'i yig rigs la zhib 'jug skabs snyung gnas bla ma dang / rwa sgreng dza sag bcas kyis srid zur rwa sgreng rin po cher gsang yig phul ba'i zin bris dang / tshur stsal ba'i bka' lan phyag bris ngo ma khag mang po thon 'dugarwa sgreng rin po cher phul ba'i gsang yig nang du stag brag gi bya spyod ha cang ngan sdug de bzod sgom bya thabs bral bas srid skyong stag brag dgun dus 'char can stag brag ri khrod du phebs skabs lam bar sgyag ra sprad de yas mas gnyis nas 'gag btsir gyis me mda' brgyab te gsod rgyu'i thag bcad lugs zhus par/ srid zur rwa sgreng gi bka' lan du/ da lta rwa sgreng bla brang gi thad mchod rten mgo mjug log kyang bang rim sked par gnas yod/ mi byed dgu byed byas na da lta'i gnas tshad la yang mi gnas pa zhig yong gi red ces gsungs pa de ni/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi gsung las/ khams gsum skye rgu ma lus khros gyur te/ gshe zhing mtshang 'bru bsdigs shing srog gcod kyang / mi 'khrugs gnod lan phan pa sgrub byed pa'i/bzod pa'i phar phyin rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar don dam nyams bzhes phyag bstar gyi gnod lan phan 'jal gyi bka' lan de lta bu gnang bar gzur gnas blo ldan zhig yin phyin dad pa'i spu long dbang med du g.yo zhing / skyes bu dam pa de'i rlabs chen mdzad par rjes su yi rang mi zhu ba ci la srid/skabs der gnas tshul gyi 'phel phyogs de shin tu nas kha lo sgyur dka' ba'i gnas su gyar zin pas rwa sgreng rin po ches bka' lan de ltar gnang ba yang cung zad phyis pa lta bur snang yang don dngos thog rwa stag bla brang gnyis kyi 'gal ba dza drag tu gyur pa'i gnas bab kha lo sgyur ba'i dbang cha ngo ma de stag brag gi phyag tu yod nges kyang bka' shag gis dza drag gnas tshul skor dgongs bskor nan zhus la rwa sgreng 282

rin po che 'phral du gdan zhu bya rgyur bka' 'khrol ma gnang mthu med byung / gdan zhu byed thub pa de ni rwa sgreng rin po ches da lta'i gnas tshad la'ang mi gnas pa zhig yong gi red gsungs pa de ma 'ongs lung bstan mngon sum du gsungs pa zhig yin pa'i dngos ra 'phrod pa zhig red/srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che lha sar gdan zhu bya rgyu dang / rwa bla'i gnad yod las byed dang ltos phyogs bcas 'dzin bzung bya rgyu/ sgo thel rgyag rgyu bcas kyi gnas tshul sngon tshud nas snyung gnas bla ma can la gsang brda zhig 'byor yod kyang /rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan gyis lam seng snyung gnas bla ma'i bsam tshul ltar lag len ma bstar ba'i gnod skyon chen po byung zhing / skabs der snyung gnas bla ma'i bsam tshul la bod gzhung gi sgo thel rgyag mkhan ma yong gong sngon tshud nas phar rgol bya rgyu'i gra sgrig yod pa byas nas kho tsho yong ma thag rtsa med bzo dgos/gal srid rwa sgreng bla brang bzung ma thub pa byung na bla brang la me brgyab nas nga tsho se rar rla sgril nas kha gtad gcog dgos/ gzhan gyi lam bu gang yang med/ de'i sngon tshud nas rwa sgreng rin po che bzhugs rgyu mi 'dug pas phebs dgos zhes bka' lan 'bul dgos pa bcas kyi bsam tshul de lag len ma bstar bar dngos 'brel yin min brtsad zhib byed pa'i dbar kho tsho tshang ma 'dzin bzung du tshud pa red//bka' blon lhan tshogs kyis thag gcod byas pa de'i dgong mo bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / lha klu che dbang rdo rje gnyis kyis dmag spyi skal tshul dang / dbus mda' shud khud pa/ byang spyi rim bzhi zhwa skab bcas dang /bod dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam khrid de lha sa nas mtshan mo gsang thon gyis nyin mtshan gnyis tsam shar bskyod kyis rwa sgreng du 'byor mas srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che 283

lha sar bde blag ngang btsan khrid zhus te / rtse pho brang shar chen lcog gi gsol thab pa'i las shag cig tu do dam byas te/ do dam srung 'doms lta zhib byed sgo gang ci shod 'gag nas thad kur 'gan 'khur byas te/ srung dmag gi 'go 'doms shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang dang / de 'og shod drung lung shar o rgyan rnam grol dang /rtse drung rme ru ba thub bstan nyi ma bcas bsko bzhag byas yod kyang / rtse drung thub bstan nyi mas rwa sgreng rin po cher gas brtsi che ba'i zhabs 'degs gang thub zhus rkyen glo bur brje len gyis tshab gsar rtse drung ye shes thub bstan ming 'dogs la rtse drung bal po zer ba de bzhag gong gsal mi gsum de stag brag bla brang gi blos 'gel thub pa'i mi sna gsum la nang don 'gan 'khur bsko gzhag byas/srid zur rwa sgreng rtse shar chen lcog tu bcug rjes se ra'i gra dmangs rnams kyis dgong mo lha sar gsang 'dzul gyis stag brag bla brang dang / zur khang bcas me bsregs gtong rgyu dang / rwa sgreng rin po che rtse shar chen lcog nas 'don rgyu yin lugs kyi dkrog gtam khyab bdal byung yod par brten stag brag phyag mdzod dza sag bstan pa mthar phyin gyis rtse shar chen lcog tu srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che'i srung cha'i 'go 'doms skal bzang ngag dbang la se ra'i gra dmangs kyis rwa sgreng btson nas 'don par yong rtsis yod 'dug stabs de lugs gzab gzab gnang dgos zhes mngags cha byas nas bka' shag dang drung rtsis (rtse yig tshang gi dbu 'dzin mkhan drung ngam/drung yig chen mo bzhi dang / rtsis dpon bzhi bcas kyi bsdus tshig ) lhan tshogs kyis se ra dgon par dmag 'thab bya rgyu'i gros thag chod de bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma dmag spyi spyi 'doms rang mos khas len zhus thog gsham 'og gzhung zhabs dpon rigs sum cu lhag tsam dang / bod dmag bcas khrid de se ra dgon pa'i 284

mdun gra bzhi dmag sgar de dmag sa chags nas bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi ma ngo las dpung dmag bcas gra bzhi dmag sgar du 'byor nas se ra dgon par dmag 'thab bya rtsis skabs dga' ldan khri rin po che dang / kun gling hu thog thu/phur lcog byams mgon rin po ches dbus bla sprul khag dang / se 'bras kyi las sne sbyin bdag tshong rigs sogs kyis ser byes grwa pa rnams kyis gzhung sar ya bzung tshod med zhu thal rtsa 'gal sngar na ma grags pa byung rung / da lo 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i dgung geg dang bcas skyabs mgon mchod yon gyi sku che che thar du byed gte rnams rtsis 'bul zhu ma dgos par bka' nyes ji stsal nga tshos sgrub 'bul zhu rgyu yin zhes pa'i yi ge btang yang / grwa dmangs rnams kyis yid ches mos mthun ma byung bar ya 'gal du phyin stabs se ra'i zing cha lhing 'jags su gtong ched du bod gzhung gi kha dang / nga dang sogs dmag sgar bzhi yis se ra dgon par dpung 'jug gis grwa dmangs byings rnams mgo btags zhus kyang / rtse nya sprul sku sogs gra pa nyen mchongs pa khyu gcig gis ser byes grwa tshang gi 'du khang nang 'dzul te sgo mnan nas mgo btags ma zhus par brten dmag mi rnams kyis ser byes gra tshang la me ma rgyag thabs med yin lugs kyi gnas tshul dmag don spyi khyab khang la bka' 'khrol zhu bar 'byor zhing / dmag don spyi khyab ngo las rnams kyis dza drag gi gnas tshul de'i skor gros sdur byas mthar dmag don spyi khyab bka' blon ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas ser byes gra tshang la me brgyab pa yin na/ 'dabs sbrel ser sngags grwa tshang dang / ser smad gra tshang sogs la yang me mched de nyes skyon ji yong nges med kyis nyen kha chen po yong nyen yod stabs dmag don spyi khyab khang nas gnas tshul de dag thugs 'gan bzod bral la brten dgon pa dang / lha khang 285

bcas la gtor bsheg mi byung ba'i srung skyob bkod 'do mas mtha' gcig tu lag len bstar rgyu zhes gsung par mang mos byung yang / dmag don spyi khyab gzhon pa mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal nas nye sngon nga tshos gra bzhi dmag sgar du phebs skabs lam seng se ra dgon par dmag 'thab bya rgyu yin pa ltar/ ser byes gra tshang la me brgyag dgos na rgyag rgyu las thabs gzhan med lugs kyi lam tsam thugs gtan 'khel yod pa red ces bsam tshul bshad/ de'i lan du rtsis dpon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med nas/ da lta dmag don spyi khyab bka' blon ka shod mchog dang / las rogs gzhan rnams kyi dgongs 'char gsungs pa de yag po 'dugaser byes gra tshang gi 'du khang la me rgyag rgyu gtan nas 'grigs kyi ma red/ nga tsho tshang ma lam seng se ra dgon par bskyod de me rgyag thal mi 'byung ba sogs bkod 'doms nan tan byas na legs gnas las/ me brgyab na dpe bsags kyi red/dgon pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / sku gsung thugs rten rnams kyis ngo log byas yod pa ma red/ me brgyab pa'i rkyen gyis gtor bshig byung na bod mi dmangs kyis gang zer gyi red dam/ de dag blos 'gan mi bzod pa ma zad/ gdan sa gsum gyi nang nas se ra dgon pa cha mi tshang ba zhig bzos te 'jog thabs ga la yod/phyin chad dgon pa gsar rgyag nyams gso byed dgos byung na/ mi ser la khral sku la te ar po rgyag rgyu red/ de ni rgya khyab mi ser rnams khral bun brdabs gsig dka' sdug chen po yong rgyu nga tshos shes gsal yin lugs sogs kyis bsam tshul bshad pa ltar/ tshang mas rgyab bskyor gyis me mi rgyag rgyur gtan gtsang ma 'khel te dmag don spyi khyab ngo las tshang ma 'brel tshab chen po'i sgo nas se ra dgon du ngo bskyod skabs dmag mi rnams me rgyag rtsis kyi gra sgrig ang bsar thog se ra byes gra 286

tshang gi 'du khang sgo mchor gyi ka ring la yang sa snum byug nas me spar chog chog gis bka' sgug nas bsdad yod tshod 'dugaskabs der dmag don spyi khyab ngo las rnams der phebs 'byor rjes dza drag gi gnas tshul de gzigs nas tshang ma tang sangs thog dgon pa gtor bshig mi 'byung ba dgos rgyu'i skor kha sa khyab 'doms nan tan byed bzhin du de ring 'di lta bu'i thal cha gang 'dra byas pa red dam/ zhes zhib brtsad skabs dmag mi 'go byed tsho nas brjod don ltar na/ da zhogs snga dro ser byes 'du khang la me rgyag rgyu'i bgro gleng byung skabs dmag don spyi khyab gzhon pa mkhan drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal dang /dmag spyi dza sag skal bzang tshul khrims rnam gnyis kyis gra bzhi las khungs nas sa snum lcags krin brgya yas mas shig bton te ser byes gra tshang mtha' khor du bskor srung 'go dmag rnams la skyel 'dren byas pa'i gnas tshul yong rkyen rnams dmag don spyi khyab ngo las tshang ma yod sar bshad de ra 'phrod thub pa byung ces ka shod chos rgyal nyi mas bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi 'dems sgrig 'don thengs drug pa'i nang bkod 'dug pa ltar/ se ra'i dge 'dun rnams nas se ra dgon par gtor skyon ma byung bar thugs rje che zhus pa dang / mi sngon chad kyi 'gal 'dzol la sdig bsags rang khur zhu rgyu zhus/phyi lo 1947 zla 3 ches 28 nyin srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che glo bur du btson khang nang sku che'i 'phen pa rdzogs pa red ces grags/de'i skor gshegs rkyen ngo ma ji yin gleng phyogs mang po byung yang gang ltar gnad don de ni bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus thog ha cang ngo gnong dgos pa'i bya ba zhig byung 'dug sku gshegs rjes bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas btang ba'i zhib dpyod 287

tshogs chung zhig gis brtsad zhib byas kyang / phyi tshul mtshon byed tsam las zhib phra brtsad zhib byed pa'i nus pa bral rkyen 'di yin 'di min gsal po byung mi 'dug zer/ 'on kyang srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che do dam khongs bzhugs skabs bod ljongs tshogs 'du nas dri ba thengs 'ga' shas len skabs srid zur rwa sgreng rin po ches/ngas bstan srid rlung la bskur ba'i las ka gang yang byas med pa dang / gsham 'og las byed pa rnams la yang ma byed ma lta kho na brjod kyi yod ces gsungs tshul de yongs grags yin/rwa sgreng sku ma gshegs gong tsam nyin cig bod ljongs tshogs 'du'i drung rtsis rnams bka' shag tu bcar te srid zur rwa sgreng rin po cher bka' nyes 'char gzhi bzo phyogs skor bka' shag gi dgongs 'char ji yod bka' slob zhus par bka' blon lhan gros kyis thag ba/cod bkod dpyad khrims mthun drang 'brel gyi 'char gzhi tshogs 'du rang nas bzo gnang mdzad 'thus zhes gsungs 'dug par brten tshogs 'dur gros bsdur skabs sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis khrims yig gi deb gcig khyer yod pa de kha phye ste/ nag can khrag sbyor gyi zhal lce'i nang / 'bangs kyi gyen ldog byas na zhes pa'i don tshan lung drangs te srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che spyan 'bras gnyis 'don rgyu'i gros 'go bton pa dang / de la tshogs 'thus re zung gis rgyab skyor gyis rwa sgreng la khrims gcod nan po gtong dgos zhes shod skabs/ dza sag tsha rong rla bzang dgra 'dul nas ga re/ mig ril 'don rgyu yis/ a tsha tsha/ a tsha tsha zhes/ rang gi mig gnyis la sbar mo 'gebs bzhin mi bzod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan cing / gzhan yang tshogs 'thus gzhung zhabs ser skya dang / gdan sa gsum gyi mkhan po las zur 'thus mi bcas nas kyang / de 'dra e 'gab kyi 288

mi 'dod pa'i ngo rgol lta bus mos mthun mi byed pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan thog 'thus mi mang che bas de skor gros sdur ma byas par gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis tshogs 'dur ma bsdad par phyi rol du bskyod de tshang 'dzoms ma thub par lus/drung rtsis lhan rgyas kyis dngos gzhi'i nyes pa ji gcod yig zin 'god ma shes par sdod pa'i skabs su rla 3 ches 37 nyin snga dro tshogs 'du mjug skyong gi gros sdur byed skabs srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che sku gzugs bde min yod tshul shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang gis rtse phyag mkhan chung thub bstan rgyal po brgyud tshogs 'dur snyan seng zhus pa ltar/ tshogs 'du nas bka' shag la snyan seng zhus pa dang 'brel sman rtsis khang gi 'go 'dzin mkhan chung mkhyen rab nor bus phyag rtsa lta zhib zhus par rlung mkhris kyi snyun gzhi dge skyon che ba mi 'dug ces tshogs 'du dang /bka' shag bcas la snyan seng zhus yod par grags/de'i sang nyin tshogs 'du tshogs skabs mdang dgong rwa sgreng rin po che snyun gzugs drag po'i gsung skad dang bcas sku gshegs song zhes tshogs 'dur snyan seng 'byor/rwa sgreng rin po che sku gshegs pa'i rkyen rtsa'i skor skabs der bod mi dmangs kyi khrod du gleng mol 'dra min khag gnyis byung ba ste/ gcig ni/ btson khang nang du stag brag bla brang gi phyogs gtogs mi sna nyung shas shig gis dug phul nas bkrongs pa red zer ba dang / cig shos ni/ sgong 'bras btsir nas bkrongs pa red zer ba tsam las sku gshegs rjes brtag dpyad zhib 'jug mthar phyin ma byung bar brten dpang rtags ra 'phrod 'di yin med pa lta bur gyur/ 'on kyang / lo shas rjes dza sag tsha rong dang / rtse phyag mkhan chung thub bstan rgyal po gnyis kyis 289

de'i skor phran la gsung gleng byung / skabs der bod ljongs tshogs 'dus rwa sgreng gi sku phung la brtag dpyad byed par tsha rong dang / rtse phyag thub bstan rgyal po sogs btang bar/ khong rnam pa mnyam du yod pa'i gdan sa'i mkhan 'thus bcas nas sku gdung thog smug thig yod pa de ji yin zhu skabs tsha rong gis/ rin po che'i sku chung srid skabs ha cang sku spyod 'tshub po yod tsang dge rgan gyis rta lcag btang ba'i sha rtags red ces gsungs te/ brel 'tshub kyi thog nas lta zhib reb tsam byas mthar tshogs 'du'i sar snyan seng mdor bsdus shig zhus pa red/ ces dang / gal srid zhib 'jug nan po byas na rnyog dra mang po zhig chags rgyu dang / zhib 'jug byed mkhan tshor yang gnas tshul gang 'dra yong rgyu de shod ma dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig red ces gsungs byung pa dang / rtse phyag thub bstan rgyal pos phran la / skabs der tsha rong khong gnyis log 'gro skabs lam bar smug thig de gang yin nam zhes 'dre skabs/ tsha rong gis da kha khar bzhugs gsung byung zhes gsungs byung /bka' blon shan kha 'gyur med bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis gus la gsung par/ srid zur rwa sgreng rin po cher bka' dpyad bzo stangs drung rtsis na sa bka' shag tu dgongs skor zhus par lha klus khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum gyi don bzhin 'char 'bul zhu dgos gsungs 'dug par bsher khang gi khrims yig zhal lce bcu gsum bzhes te zhib 'jug skabs khag gcig nas/ pha ma bsad par gcod pa'i bka' dpyad de gnang dgos zhes khrims deb nang g.yang skyur dang / nyu bzhur ba sogs kyi brjod bya'i steng mdzub mo btsugs par/ rtsis dpon bde mkhar bas/nga ni mi sdig pa chen po zhig yin/ de sngon rtsis dpon lung shar gyi mig 'don rgyu'i skor la tshogs dgos byung zhing / da cha khrims gcod de 'dra nam yang phod pa mi 290

'dug da cha shar chen lcog tu rwa sgreng rin po cher rten gsum dang sbrags dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs rogs gnang zhes gsol 'debs zhus na/ zhes zhal shob kyi tshul du gsungs pa tshang ma gad mo dgod bzhin sam ṭa'i /yi ge zin bris rgyag sa'i shing leb rtsi ldan zhig/ steng du yig mjug ma bris pa'i bar der rwa sgreng gi btson srung 'go 'doms shod mgron skal bzang ngag dbang tshogs 'dur bcar te da lta nyin dgung tsam nas srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che snyun mnar byung tshul zhus song bar/de 'phral sman rtsis mkhan chung mkhyen rab nor bu mchog ched 'bod kyis phyag rtsa brtag dpyad zhus nas gsol sman 'bul bzhes dang / snyun gzhi de tsam che ba mi 'dug pa sku mkhris rlung lta bu yod lugs zhus song bar rtsis dpon bde mkhar bas/snga 'phros gsol sman 'phrod bsten 'bul dgos/ gzab gzab gnang dgos zhes bka' mngags gnang ba dang / snyun gzhi dwangs skyed ma byung bar bka' dpyad la thugs brel mi 'dug de ring tshogs 'du snga tsam grol ba gnang na zhes gsungs par tshogs yun ring stabs tshang mas de rang legs gnas dgongs mthun gyis tshogs 'du grol/ de'i sang nyin 'tshogs 'du 'tshog skabs mdang dgong srid zur rin po che snyun zug drag po'i gsung skad dang bcas sku gshegs song zhes snyan seng 'byor song bar gnas skabs sku gdung la zhabs zhu dang / rwa blar gdan zhu mchod 'bul do dam bcas shan kha ba rang la bskos byung zhes gsung /skabs der rgya che'i bod mi dmangs nas rwa sgreng rin po che btson khang du gshegs pa'i gnas tshul thos skabs bzod par dka' ba'i mya ngan sems gdung gi mchi mas sa gzhi yang brlan pa ltar byas shing / ngu 'bod kyi sgras ri klung g.yo ba lta bu byung yod pa de ni gtso bor bdag cag gangs can pa rnams kyi lta ba'i mig dang /294

khog pa'i snying lta bu 7gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po 'di nyid skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyi bgo skal du thob pa ni/ mtshan brjod pa tsam gyis dad pa'i spu long g.yo ba'i srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che gang de'i thugs rje nyag cig la brten nas byung ba zhig yin pas de'i bkrin ni bskal pa stong du 'jal yang 'jal mi tshar ba zhig yin/de lta bu'i skyes chen dam pa zhig nyams nyes byas pa der khong khro'i me lce rab tu 'bar yang / skabs der khog nang me 'bar yang kha nas du ba ma thon pa'i dpe ltar/ stag brag bla brang gi srid dbang gnon shuṭa 'og sems kyi khong khro phyir 'don ma thub cing /de rjes 1959 lor rgya mis btson srung ba rtse drung ye shes thub bstan dang /lung shar o rnam gnyis gra bzhir btson 'jug byas pa ltar kho pa gnyis kyi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi shod stangs gzhi rtsa'i thog gcig gyur byung ba rnams bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi rgyu cha 'dems sgrig nang gsal por bkod 'dug pa ltar mi rnams ha las hon 'thor dgos pa'i gnas tshul mang dag de rnams la dre ngan snom skyor dang / ltas ngan la lta skyor gyi dpe ltar lo rgyus 'di'i nang 'god 'os su ma mthong zhing / gang ltar nga rang la cha bzhag na/ skabs de'i thad ku'i myong tshor gang yang med pas bden rdzun gyi mtha' dpyod byed pa'i spobs pa dang bral ba'o//292

le tshan bco lnga pa/bod gzhung gi gang ci'i legs bcos mdzad phyogs la 'gal rkyen phrad pa/༄༅༅/ /rwa stag srid skyong rnam gnyis kyi khri rabs lo ngo bcu bdun gyi dus yun de ni bod bstan pa chab srid kyi phan bde nyag cig rang dbang rang btsan sra brtan bzo rgyu'i dus tshod yag shos ha cang rtsa ba chen po gser gyi dus rabs lta bu de chus zos su btang ba de ni mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyis ha cang blo 'gyod chen po skye ba'i rang bzhin red/bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs kyis rtsom bris gnang ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus zin bris las/ snga mo'i bod mi tsho gsar brje ma byas par sgo brgyab ste bsdad pa des dus skabs de dag la skyid po'i snang ba zhig gi ngang la mi che 'khyol thub kyang / de'i nyes skyon tshang ma rjes su lus te deng sang gzhan dag dang bsdur skabs chab srid dang dpal 'byor tshang ma nyams rlung nus med gcig tu gyur nas da cha rgya dmar gyi 'og las sla por bcug pa de mi rabs gong ma tsho'i nor 'khrul blo pham pa'i rang bzhin red ces gsal/de'i 'byung gzhi'i rtsa ba gang la thug min dpyad pa bya ched bod kyi nye rabs 293

lo rgyus nas drangs te phran bu gleng bar bya ste/ de yang dus rabs bco brgyad pa nas bzung lo ngo brgya phrag gcig tsam ring man ju gzhung gis bod dbang ba'i thabs shes kyi srid byus ngan pa la thug yod/srid byus de khag gsum gyi thog lag len bstar ba zhig yin par mngon/dang po ni/ bod dang phyi rgyal su 'dra zhig 'brel ba byed mi chog pa'i thabs byus su bod kyi sa mtshams gi sgo bkag nas bod mi rnams kyis phyi rgyal gyi mi dang phar 'gro tshur 'ong gi 'brel ba byed mi chog pa'i bkag sdom byas pa dang / phyi rgyal dang 'brel ba byas na bod chos ldan zhing gi mi rnams la btsog grib kyi shugs rkyen yong gi red ces bod mi'i khrod du 'chal gtam spel te bod mi rnams kyi mgo bo skongs su bcug thabs byas/ gnyis pa ni/ man ju gzhung gis bod thog zhi drag zung sbrel gyi sgo nas man ju gong ma de gnam gyi lha dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul sku yin zhes bod mi dmangs la mgo skor 'jigs skul bslu brid byas te/ bod mi dmangs rnams 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po yin par ngos 'dzin yid ches gyis gus bkur zhu ru bcug pa dang / de'i grib bsil zer ba'i 'og rang smad kyi 'du shes bzung nas sdod dgos pa zhig byung / gsum pa ni/ bod kyi bla dpon rnams la go gnas chen po'i ming dang / cho lo sprad pa dper na/ bla chen khag la ho thog thu zhes pa'i go gnas gtan 'jags dang / mnga' 'bangs mi ser mang po sprad de che btsan khag mang po bzos pa dang / de dang 'dra bar bod kyi mi drag dpon rigs gzhung zhabs rnams la yang / gung dang / pe se/ jun wang / tha'i ji sogs kyi go ming dang sbrags/ mnga' khongs mi ser rgya chen po sprad de don dngos bod me'i khrod kyi nus shugs can rnams thabs mkhas kyi gso skyong byas te/ bod mi rang 294

nyid kyis man ju sbyin bdag tu bsten nas rgya che'i bod mi dmangs kyi khrod du bod mis bod mi 'dul ba'i srid byus thabs sdug lag len bstar bar brten bod mi mang tshogs rnams man ju'i gser thag gis bcings pa'i 'og gnas pa las 'grol thabs kyi bsam blo gtan nas 'khor ma thub pa dang / 'dzam gling gi 'pho 'gyur gnas stangs ji yin ma shes pas mun nag lta bu'i nang du gnas pa'i skyon cha chen po byung / de 'dra'i gnas tshul gyis rkyen pas bod mi rnams kyis lo ngo mang po'i ring phyi rgyal dang phar 'gro tshur 'ong gi 'brel ba ma byas pa dang / phyi rgyal gyi dngos zog nyo tshong mi chog pa'i bkag 'doms kyang byas/ gal srid bod mi su rung zhig gis phyi rgyal gyi mi dang 'brel ba byed mkhan byung rigs srog thog tu btang ba dang / gzhung gi dpon rigs gas kyis de 'dra'i 'brel ba byas rigs la gnas dbyung dang mkhar dbang gzhung bzhes bcas btang 'dug gnas tshul de ni man ju gzhung gis bsam ngan gyi srid byus de dag lo mang ring lag bstar byas pa lam du rgyugs pa'i rkyen gyis 'dzam gling mi dmangs gzhan dag rnams nyin re bzhin tshan rig dang rig gzhung / chab srid kyi lam lugs bcas yar rgyas kyi lam du gom pa mdun du spo bzhin pa'i dus tshod der bod mi tsho sngar bzhin sgo brgyab nas 'jam thing nger bsdad pa red/bod kyi spyi tshogs rjes lus thebs pa'i gnas babs ji bzhin ma rtogs par rang cag bod mi rnams kyis rang yul de bde ba can gyi zhing khams lta bur brtsis nas yul gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i rang bstod khengs rlom gyi ngang nas rtsa che'i dus tshod stong zad du gyur nas don du bod kyi chab srid gnas babs dang /dpal 'byor/ rig gzhung bcas yar rgyas mdun phyogs su gom pa ma spos par bsdad/295

man ju'i dus skabs su bod la lag len bstar ba'i srid byus kyi rtsa ba gnam bskos gong ma 'jam dbyangs bdag po chen po zhes pa'i tshig gnad des bod mi rnams mongs su bcug tshig don de'i 'byung khungs ni/ man ju rgyal khab des rgya nag la dbang bsgyur ma byas pa'i sngon phyi lo 1542 bod chu rta lo/ 7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos man ju rgyal por gnas lan zhig gnang ba'i 'go brjod du/mañdzu shri zhes pa'i bstod tshig 'khod pa'i phyag bris stsal ba ltar rjes su bod dang /man ju phyogs gnyis kyis tshig de dngos su bed spyod byas 'dugaphyi lo 1895 lor 7gong sa skyabs mgon skya phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos bod kyi srid dbang bzhes rjes khong gi mdzad 'phrin rim bskyangs kyis bstan pa chab srid kyi dus rabs gsar pa zhig tu bsgyur bar mdzad/phyi lo 1897 lo bod rgyal khab tu bca' sdod man ju'i sku tshab am ban gyis sngar lam bzhin bod kyi mtho rim dpon rigs bsko gzhag gi ming 'don pa'i bsam tshul la 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gis cha 'jog ma gnang bar khong gis thad kur bsko gzhag gnang rgyu byung 'dug de ni lo ngo brgya phrag lhag tsam gyi ring la bod mi dbang 'dzin rim brgyud tshos byed ma thub pa'i stobs shugs phyir bton pa der man ju gzhung gis blo ma babs pa yin na'ang / mgon po gang des rngam brjid ldan zhing dus skabs dang bsnun pa'i mdzad byus tshar du dngar ba phyag len mdzad stabs man ja gzhung gis gang yang byed ma thub/de mtshungs skabs der bod kyi srid skyong rnying pa de mo sprul sku'i mdzad byus ngan pa lam lhongs ma byung skabs / man ju'i sku tshab kyis de mo sprul sku'i skor gyi gnad don de bzhin man ju dang bod lhan 'dzoms thog nas gyod gzhi brtsad gcod 296

byed dgos kyi red ces bshad kyang gsan 'jog gang yang ma gnang bar rang phyogs nas thag gcod gnang yod pa dang / mi lo brgya phrag gcig tsam ring man ju gzhung gi bod la g.yo 'khrul byed pa'i srid byus de 7gong sa sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gi dus de tsam nas gsal por mkhyen te sngar mus bzhin bod man ju'i grib bsil zer ba'i 'og sdod thabs med par brten 'dzam gling thog stobs shugs can gyi rgyal khab u ru su dang grogs po gsar du sgrig rgyu'i dgongs pa bzhes te mtshan zhabs sog rigs blo bzang rdo rje 'am/ /rdorje yib / zhes pa u ru su rgyal khab tu 'brel gtugs byed par ched brdzong gis phyis 'byung bod la rgyab bskyor yong ched kyi 'brel lam gsar pa gtod/phyi lo 1909 lo smad la 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po mchog rgya sog rgyal khab gnyis nas rang gi rgyal sa lha sar zhabs sor 'khod 'phral rgya dmag lu'u cun lha sar slobs nas lo de'i lo gsar ches gnyis nyin phun khang tha'i ji rgya'i dmag sgar du btsan khrid byas pa sogs kyi don rkyen yo langs che ba'i 'jigs skrag 'og da mus bzhugs blos ma bzod par ches gsum nyin 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor rnams rgya gar du chibs zhal bsgyur/de rjes 1913 lo man ju'i dbang shugs yongs rdzogs bod nas mthar skrod btang zhing / 1913 lo bod rgyal khab tu slar yang phyir phebs rjes dga' ston rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i thog bod mi ser skya yongs rdzogs nas 7gong sa chen po mchog la gser gyi phyag dam zhig phul ba de'i kha ris la/ 'phags pa'i yul nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung 7rgyal dbang 'jig rten gsum mgon dus kun sa steng kun khyab rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs la mnga' dbang sgyur ba thams cad mkhyen pa 297

'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma lha mi yongs kyi spyi bos mchod pa'i yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i phyag rgya/ zhes 'khod yod/ de nas bzung / bod 'di ming don mtshungs pa'i rang btsan rgyal khab cig tu gyur pa dang / rgyal khab brtan srung ched bod rang du drag po'i stobs shugs kyi drag po'i sgrig 'dzugs go sgrig dang /go lag bzo bskrun/ dpal 'byor yar rgyas gtong ched gser dngul zangs shog bcas kyi dngul par btab nas bed spyod byas yod/ de bzhin rgyal yongs rdzong khag tshang mar slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis mi dmangs rnams kyi shes tshad gong 'phel gtong rgyu dang / bod phyi nang gnyis kyi srid byus la bsgyur bkod gnang gal che ba zhig la dgon sde khag nang du chos dang 'gal ba'i bya spyod yod med rigs la dag ther mdzad pa dang / sa bdag dbang shugs can 'ga' zhig gis gyis dbul phongs mi dmangs rnams la btsan dbang gis mgo gnon byed pa'i rigs las grol thabs/bod rang dbang rang btsan gyi chab srid ji srid bar gnas thabs ched bod kyi sa mtshams khag tu sa srung drag po'i dmag dpung gsar 'dzugs gnang /rgyal khab kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas yong thabs su sger chos sa bdag chen pos dbang ba'i sa zhing thog 'os shing 'tsham pa'i gzhung khral gsar du bkal te/bod gzhung gi yong 'bab la phan thogs chen po byung /phyi phyogs kyi mdzad phyogs srid byus ni khyim mches rgyal khab dbyin ji dang /u ru su/ phyi sog rgya nag bal yul bcas la mthun lam gyi 'brel ba bskyangs/phyi lo 1914 lo bod dbyin rgya gsum gyis rgya gar sem lar bod kyi gnas stangs thog lhan tshogs shig tshogs nas bka' gros zhib cha byung ba'i bod rgya gnyis kyi chings yig zin bris la phan tshun mos mthun byung ste gnyis mas ming rtags bkod 298

kyang / chings yig ngo ma'i thog rgya phyogs nas ming rtags ma bkod/ 'on kyang bod dang dbyin ji rgyal khab gnyis nas rgyal spyi'i khrims lugs dang mthun pa'i bod dang rgya gar gyi sa mtshams mekha ma hon sa thig ces pa'i chings yig gcig bzhag par brten bod rgyal khab de bzhin rang btsan rgyal khab cig yin pa'i thob thang de rgyal khab phan tshun gnyis kyi sa mtshams dbye 'byed kyi thig rtags 'khod pa'i chings yig gcig bzhag pa de thog nas mtshon thub pa ma zad/ bod rgyal khab 'di bzhin rgyal spyi'i gar stegs thog 'dra mnyam gyi thob thang longs su spyod thub pa byung yod/de mtshungs phyi lo 1913 lo rla 1 nang bod dang phyi sog rgyal khab gnyis kyis phan tshun gyi rang btsan ngos len byas pa'i chings yig cig phyi sog rgyal khab kyi rgyal sa rda khu ral la bzhag ste khyab bsgrags kyang byas/ rgya nag mi se ra rgyal khab gzhung gsar pa dang 'brel ba mdzad de rgyal khab phan tshun gnyis kyi 'brel ba'i gnas stangs ji srid yun gnas ched du bod kyi sku tshab don gcod khang zhig rgya nag gi rgyal sa nan cing du btsugs thog rim bzhin mdza' grogs kyi lam nas bod rgya gnyis kyi lo rgyus dus yun ring po nas phan tshun sa mtshams kyi skor rnyog zing 'phro lus de dag rim bzhin phyogs gnyis nas 'dzam gling mi rigs sger langs kyi 'gro phyogs lugs mthun drang bzhag thog nas thag gcod gtsang ma zhig gnang rgyu'i dgongs bzhes mdzad/7gong sa mchog nas bod rang dbang rang btsan dang / rgyal bstan yun gnas kyi ched du dgongs pa rlabs chen bzhes nas rgya che'i mi dmangs rnams kyi shes yon 'phel rgyas yong thabs su bod rgya khyab yongs su slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyi dgongs bzhes mdzad pa ltar de phyag len du yang bkal zhing / lhag par 7gong sa 299

mchog nas bod rgyal khab 'di 'dzam gling rgyal khab gzhan dang 'brel ba mi byed thabs med la brten phyi rgyal gyi skad yig gnad cher gzigs te/ phyi lo 1913 lo gzhung zhabs kyi bu phrug bzhi eng lan du slob sbyong du gtong gnang mdzad pa de ni bod mi'i slob phrug phyi rgyal nub gling du slob sbyong byed par 'gro mkhan thengs dang po de yin/1923 lor 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i bka' 'brel ltar/ dbyin ji dge rgan che ba eng lan nas ched 'bod kyis slob grwa'i tshugs yul dang / dge rgan bzhugs khang bcas myang chu'i nye 'gram gsar rgyag mdzad pa/ dge rgan gzhon pa rgya gar ba gcig dang / bod yig dge rgan skabs der rgyal rtse dpal chos mkhan po sku ngo rtse drung mkhyen rab dbang phyug yin zhing / slob phrug grangs 'bor bzhi cu skor yod/ slob sbyong ni snga dro dbyin ji'i skad yig dang / ang rtsis/dgong dro bod yig dang / sum rtags bcas yin/rgyal rtse khul du dbyin bod slob grwa zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang ste lo bzhi'i ring slob sbyong gang legs byung 'dug kyang / chos phyogs mi sna rnams kyis dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong byas na nang chos la 'gal rkyen 'phrad tshul shugs chen zhus rkyen slob grwa de phyir 'then gnang dgos byung / bar chad de rigs kyi rkyen pas de rjes bod du gzhung gi slob grwa de gas 'dzugs rgyur yang 'gog rkyen rim pa 'phrad/de bzhin 7gong sa mchog nas legs bcos mdzad phyogs kyi dgongs bzhes rnams kyang chos phyogs kyi dbang shugs can dang / sa bdag chen po rnams kyi blo dang mi 'tshams par brten ltog tu 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i mdzad 'phrin la mi ltos pa'i 'gal rkyen sna tshogs bzos yod pa red/7gong sa mchog nas phyi lo 1933 lo bar lo ngo nyi shu tsam ring bod kyi 300

bstan pa chab srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes ring bod rang dbang rang btsan gyi rgyal khab gtsang ma zhig tu 'dzin skyong gnang thog phyin chad kyang de ltar yun gnas yong thabs kyi 'bad brtson gnang yang / bod kyi dpon rigs khag dang dgon sde khag gi gnad yod mi sna dang / bod mi dmangs bcas kyis 'dzam gling gi 'gyur ba ji cher 'gro bzhin yod pa'i shes bya khag go rtogs ji bzhin ma thub pa dang / lhag par du bod gzhung gnad yod dpon rigs khag gis 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs bzhes dang mthun pa'i rang btsan gyi sri zhu byed sgo rnams hur brtson chogs su tshud pa zhig sgrub ma thub par brten 7gong sa mchog nas phyi lo 1931 1 nang / bla ma dang dge 'dun / dpon rigs bcas mi dmangs khri phrag lhag tsam 'dzoms sar bod rgyal khab chen po'i bstan pa chab srid yun gnas yong thabs su bka' slob yun ring zhig gnang ba'i skabs der tshang mas mig nas mchi ma gtong ba las bka' slob zab mo gnang ba rnams lag len thog dang bas khur len ma thub par sngar bzhin chab srid nyi ma gang 'khyol lta bu las/ lhag bsam hur brtson zhig ma byung bar brten/ phyi lo 1933 lo 7gong sa mchog nas bod ser skya mchog dman yongs la zhal gdams bka' slob don snying chil rul gso ba'i sman mchog sgrib med gcer mthong lha zhibadud rtsi gsar pa'am/ yongs grags chu spre zhal gdams zhes pa'i phyag dpe khri khrag mang po dpar skrun gyis bod rgyal khab yongs su 'grems spel gnang yod pa de'i nang /ngos rang lo 58 la slebs nye bas yun ring chab srid kyi khur skyed mi thub pa'i skor dang / phyi sog tu dmar po'i lam lugs dar ba'i gnas tshul go thos byung dang 'byung mus ltar/ 'byung 'gyur dbus ljongs chos srid gnyis ldan gyi 301

zhing 'dir yang phyi nang gang sa nas lhag par nges pas de skabs rang sa srung ma nus na chos byed dge 'dun gyi sde'i 'dzin dbang mchod rgyun dang bcas pa rtsa brlagachos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi bzhed rgyun chab srid kyang ming tsam du nyams dmas thog 'di ga'i zhabs 'bring kun kyang pha gzhis rgyu nor rtsa 'phrog dgra ya'i bran du dbang med 'khyams shing / yid can kun kyang mnar gcod 'jigs skrag gi sdug bsngal nyin mtshan mi 'khyol ba'i dus shig 'byung nges zhes gsungs 'dug pa ma zad/ 1933 lo'i zla 1 pa'i nang srid bka' lhan rgyas nas bstan srid dang /7gong sa mchog gi sku phyu'i skor thugs dam zhig phul ba'i nang bka' lan nan ljid che ba zhig phebs 'dug pa bcas 7gong sa mchog gi bka' slob nang ma 'ongs mngon gzigs kyi dran skul nan po mdzad kyang / skabs der bod mi ser skya mi dmangs rnams kyis de tsam gyi do snang ma thub pa'i mur 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim zhing / skabs der mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa 'ga' shas kyis de snga'i gnas tshul la sems kyi gting nas 'gyod gdung drag po skyes pa'i sgo nas spyi don 'bad sgrub ma byas par nang khul srid dbang 'phrog res kyi las 'gul 'khrug cha dod po zhig spel ba ni/ zhu sgab pa'i rgyal rabs las/7rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen gzigs don gyi bdag po mya ngan las 'das te dgongs pa zab mo yongs su rdzogs thabs rnam dkar mchod sprin dang / bka' dgongs zab mo rjes su mthun pa'i chab srid brtan brling gi thabs tshul mdzad 'khur 'bad brtson mdzad rgyu'i tshab tu/ skya mya ngan las 'das nas bdun phrag 'ga' shas las ma song gong grong drag dmag sgar gtor bshig dang / sku bcar zhabs 'bring rnams la zhu bzhes bka' dpyad gnang ba sogs chab srid nyams rgud dang /302

nang khul bkra ma shis pa'i las ka dang po de dus nas 'go tshugs pa min nam snyam pa shar 'dug go zhes gsal ba de dngos 'brel gyi dpyad tshig cig tu mthong /dus de'i yas mas lo ngo bcu bdun tsam ring 'dzam gling 'di 'khrug cha dod pa'i dus yin zhing / sngar rang btsan gyi khe dbang spyod myong gtan nas med pa'i mi rigs mang pos btsan dbang rgyal khab gi 'og nas mi rigs rang btsan yong thabs kyi ched du rang srog sha khrag rngul gsum gyi 'gro gron btang nas rang btsan rtsod len byas pa'i 'bras bur rang btsan gsar du thob pa'i rgyal khab ji snyed cig dpyid ku'i char shul gyi smyug drwa rgyas pa lta bur thon yod/ 'on kyang rang cag bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams ni 'dzam gling gi 'pho 'gyur ma rtogs par gnas/skabs der khyim mches rgyal khab rgya dkar nag gnyis la yang chab srid kyi 'pho 'gyur chen po byung / rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab la phyi phyogs nas nyi tong gi btsan 'dzul byas pa dang / nang khul zhing chen khag gi dbang 'dzin pa rnams rang btsan rang bdag lta bur gnas te dbus gzhung gi bka' bkod la brtsi 'jog med pa/ lhag par phyi lo 1917 lo u ru su'i rgyal khab der dmar po'i ring lugs la srid dbang thob rjes dmar po'i ring lugs de bzhin 'dzam gleng thog rjes lus thebs pa'i yul gru khag la khyab nas rgya nag tu yang dmar po'i ring lugs de dar khyab byung /rgya nag dmar po'i ring lugs pas dus skabs de rnyed nas rgya nag nang khul du dmar po'i ring lugs sngar las dar khyab che ru btang bar brten rgya nag mi ser rgyal khab kyi gzhung de phyi nang gnyis kyi thog dka' ngal chen po 'phrad pa'i dus shig byung stabs bod la the byus byed pa'i stobs shugs mi 'dang ba'i dus skabs shig yin/de bzhin khyim mches rgya gar yang mi lo nyis brgya lhag tsam ring dbyin ji btsan 303

dbang rgyal khab 'og tu gnas yod pa des lo ngo mang po'i ring nas rgya gar gyi mi snyan grags can maha ta ma lhan lhas gtsos shes yon can rnams kyis gcig mjug gnyis mthud kyis sne khrid byas nas dbyin ji'i btsan dbang 'og nas thar thabs kyi las 'gul de rgya gar sa gnas yongs su khyab/lhag par bdag nyid chen po snyan dhis rgya gar mi dmangs rnams zhi ba'i lam du khrid de rgya gar mi rigs rang btsan mgyogs myur thob thabs kyi 'bad brtson gnang nas / phyi lo 1947 lor rgya gar yul gru chen po'i mi dmangs yongs rdzogs dbyin ji btsan dbang rgyal khab 'og nas rang btsan gtsang mar thob ste/rgya gar yul gru chen po de bzhin rgya gar dang pā ki si than zhes rgyal khab gnyis su gyes/rgya dkar nag rgyal khab chen po gnyis kyi dkyil du gnas pa'i bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khab de gdod ma'i dus rabs ltar de mur gnas thabs med pa zhig yin yang / mtho rim dbang 'dzin mi sna'i gas 'ga' zhig nas rang cag bod kha ba can ni chos ldan rgyal khab yin pas dkon mchog gi byin mthu dang / chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rjes yul gzhan ltar gyi 'pho 'gyur yong gi ma red ces mongs tshod klad rnying mkhregs bzung kho na'i ngang nas rin thang bral ba'i dus tshod de chud zos su btang /dmag chen gnyis pa mjug 'gril ma thag rgya nag nang khul la go min tang dang / gung khran tang shog khag gnyis kyi nang 'khrug shugs chen yod mus mur/1948 lo nang 'khrug de rtse mor son te rgya nag byang phyogs kyi sa sde yongs rdzogs gung khran gyis dbang bsgyur byas gshis go min tang rgya nag lho phyogs su phyir 'then 304

byed dgos byung /skabs der bod gzhung shod 'gag nas phran la nyin re rgya nag gi dmag 'khrug gnas tshul ji byung skor rgyang bsgrags rlung 'phrin nyan te yig thog bkod nas shod 'gag tu 'bul dgos lugs bka' phebs bzhin nyin re 'thus shor med pa 'bul gyi yod/ nyin gcig shod 'gag nas da res kyi gnas tshul ji byung rnams sku ngo sne mgron gyi lha sa'i shag tu phyi dro chu tshod gsum pa'i thog khyed rang ngo bcar thog 'bul dgos/ zhes bka' phebs pa ltar dus thog ngo bcar gyis kha sa rgya nag dang / ldi li'i rgya skad bcas kyi rgyang bsgrags rlung 'phrin thog nas gnas tshul ji thos rnams sne mgron la phul ba'i gnas tshul de'i nang rgya nag byang rgyud sa khul rnams gung khran gyi lag tu shor ba'i skor dang / gung khran tang gi dpung dmag rnams nas rgya nag lho phyogs sa khul rnams bcings 'grol gtong rgyu yin zhes gra sgrig byed bzhin yod lugs dang / go min tang gis dmag rnams rgya nag byang phyogs nas phyir 'then gyis yang rtse cang ('drichu) lho phyogs su gung khran dmag la ngo rgol gyi dmag sa gra sgrig byed kyi yod lugs bcas kyi gnas tshul sku ngo sne mgron thub bstan legs smon gyis gzigs rjes khong gis/ da rgya nag la ga re yong gi red dam zhes dres byung ba'i lan du/ gung khran gyis mgyogs po rgya nag yongs su dbang bsgyur byed kyi red/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni da bar go min tang gi dmag rnams dgra ya gung khyan tang la dmag 'thab ma byas par dmag sgar hrol pos mgo btags zhus pa'i gnas tshul mang po byung lugs zhus par/ yang khong gis/ de nas gang 'dra chags kyi red dam ces dres byung bar/ phran gyis gung khran gyis rgya nag yongs rdzogs dbang bsgyur na bod ljongs sa khul du slebs mi yong ngam bsam gyi 'dug des na rang 305

gzhung gis bod rang btsan yin pa'i skor khyim mtshos rgyal khab rgya gar dang / a dbyin rnams nas rogs ram yong thabs zhu gnang mdzad na/ legs pa'i bsam tshul zhus pa gsan ma thag zhal ras nag por gyur nas rlung 'tshub 'tshub lta bus/sras sku zhabs/ bod rang dbang rang btsan yin yin pa red/ bod rang btsan ma red sus zer gyi 'dug rgya mi bod du nam yang yong thub kyi ma red/ dus snga rabs nas da bar bod la yong gi red yong gi red ces shod mkhan byung yod kyang yong ma thub pa red/ da dung nam yang yong thub kyi ma red/ gang yin zer na/bod kha ba can chos ldan rgyal khab 'dir lha chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs kyi mthu la brten nas nam yang yong thub kyi ma red/ de la yid ches blos 'gel byed dgos/ da res sras sku zhabs khyed rang gis nga la dgongs tshul gsungs pa de phyi mi su la'ang gsungs na yag po yod pa ma red/ gal srid skad cha de gur na dkrog gtam du 'gro gi red lta/ zhes gsungs te rnam 'gyur nan po bstan par brten phran gyis zhus pa'i gnas tshul rnams tshig tho 'dra brgyab yong ngam snyam nas zhed snang chen po skyes byung ba dang / lam seng dgongs dag zhus shing /phyis su su la'ang shod kyi min zhes khas len lta bu zhu dgos byung /de nas dus yun ring po ma song rjes 1951 zla 4 zla smad du khong dang bsam pho rim bzhi bstan 'dzin don grub gnyis lha ldan rgyal khab nas mdo smad spyi khyab bka' blon nga phod lhan du rgya nag pe cing du zhi mol du phebs pa dang / phran gro mo byes gzhung dza drung rnam gnyis kyi las byar bcar skabs pe cing du 'byor ba'i dgong mo mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon nga'i sdod khang du phebs te/ da res gzhung gis gnas dus tshod rtsis kyis nga rgas 'khogs sa cha 'dir btang ba'i skor 306

mang dag cig gsungs pa dang / spyan chab sil bzhin par de sngon sras sku zhabs khyed rang gis nga la gsungs pa'i dgongs tshul de mngon sum du byung song / nga ni khron pa'i nang gi sbal pa lta bu zhig red/ 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul ma shes thag chod red ces gsungs byung /de sngon khong ni bod rgyal khab kyi rgyal tshab 'og dbang shugs chen po yod pa'i mi sna zhig yin zhing / khong dang 'dra ba'i lta ba 'dzin mkhan dbang 'dzin pa mi nyung ba zhig yod pa de tshos lo mang po'i ring bod kyi sgo bkag rang srung gi srid byus bzung ba'i rkyen gyis chab srid thog rjes lus 'thus shor phyin pa'i yong rkyen mang po zhig 'phrad yod pa red/ 'on kyang skabs de nas bzungs mtho rim dbang 'dzin pa'i nang nas phyi rgyal gyi gnas stangs phran bu shes mkhan re zung gis bod kyi spyi tshogs rjes lus de bzhin legs bcos gtong dgos bsam yang / dka' ngal 'phrad rgyur 'jigs nas legs bcos gyi las 'gul lag len bstar rgyu phar bzhagabasam 'char tsam yang 'don nus kyi med pa de ni lo rgyus kyi nyams myong gis rkyen pas byung ba zhig red/ dper na/ rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa zhal bzhugs skabs bod rgyal khab kyi chab srid gnas stangs dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba /rig gzhung / dpal 'byor/ 'grim 'grul bcas legs bcos gtong thabs kyi dgongs gzhi ji ltar byung yang phyag len bstar skabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'gal rkyen mang po 'phrad par brten mtha' 'khyol ba zhig gnang thub med/bar lam yang rgya gar phyogs dang srid don gyi 'brel ba lo re bzhin ji rgyas la brten las byed khongs dbyin yig shes pa ma byung mthu med stabs shing bya 1945 lor rgya gar gzhung nas dge rgan 'os pa zhig gtong rogs zhus ltar/307

dbyin ji'i dge rgan rgan gzhon gnyis gtong gnang byung bar gzhung zhabs dang / mi dmangs khongs nas slob phrug 70 skor 'dems sgrug gis lha ldan drung spyi gling khar slob grwa gsar 'dzugs kyis snga dro chos kyi dge rgan nas chos phyogs sogs slob sto na dang / de nas nyin dgung bar dbyin dge nas dbyin ji'i skad yig nyin gung rgyab tu bod dge nas bod yig 'bri klog bcas slob sbyong byed mus kyang / rla ba 'ga' shas kyi rjes su gdan sa'i dbu chos rnams nas sngar ltar lta spyod la 'gal rkyen byung tshul ngo rgol mtha' bkag byas rkyen/ slob grwa phyir bsdu gnang ste slad dbyin yig shes tshad ldan pa'i dmigs sgo gzhung zhabs skya bo'i bu phrug dang / ser mo ba'i shag tshang bcas slob phrug bcu bod gzhung gis 'gro song dang bcas rdor gling sen 'jo seb slob grwar gtong gnang mdzad dgos byung ba sogs de dang de 'dra'i yul lung yar rgyas la chos phyogs nas dgag bya yang yang byung ba de dag ni chab srid la gnod pa'i 'gal rkyen bsam bzhin ched bzos byas pa zhig min yang / phyi rgyal gyi gnas lugs ji bzhin ma rtogs pa dang / nang pa'i chos kho nar srung brtsi ha cang che drags pa'i dbang gis shugs ma thub kyis byung ba yin tshod 'dugalhag par phyi nas yong ba'i lkog g.yo ngan gshoms ci rigs rang dgar sem 'dzul byed bde byung ba'i skyon yin zhing / de yang rgya mis snga sa nas bod mi shes mongs khyer rkyang du bzhag na dbang sgyur bya bde yong rgyu dang bod za rgyu'i srid byus gzhi bzhag thog gdan sa'i gra rgyun nang rgya mi'i gsang nyul mang dag yod mus rnams nas bod phrug la dbyin ji'i skad yig bslab na phyi rgyal lam lugs bod du dar rgyu/deng sang 'dzam gling nang slob phrug tshos srid gzhung la ngo rgol byas te dka' ngal bzo mus la brten bod kyi chab srid lhag par chos lugs la gnod 'gal chen po yong 308

tshul sogs skad cha 'dra chags po shin tu sha tsha chen po'i rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas gra sa'i slob gnyer ba dang / dge bshes khag mkhan po dang las sne tsho'i nang du bkrams pa des 'dzam gling gi gnas tshul nam yang mi shes pa'i mkhan po las sne dang / grwa dmangs bcas pa'i sems nang shugs rkyen shin tu chen po thebs pa de yin/ rgya nag chen pos khyim mtshos bod mir 'di lta bur gnag sems gting zab bcangs pa rang rigs rnams nas gsal por rtogs dgos pa shin tu gal che snyam/skabs der lha sar bca' sdod go min tang don gcod sku tshab las khungs kyis las byed mi sna dang / go min tang gi gsang nyul khag gis kyang go skabs de dam 'dzin gyis gdan sa gsum gyi las sne'i khog par 'dzul te dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas pa sogs phyi'i shugs rkyen yang tshabs chen 'thebs yod pa gdon mi za/gnas tshul de tsho byung ba'i skabs der sku'i gcen po rgya lo don grub dang /phran gnyis nyin ltar lha sa rwa sgreng bla brang du rgya yig slob sbyong du 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs yin/ skabs der lha sa'i khul du gra pa rdob rdob dgon pa nas lha sar phar 'gro tshur 'ong sngar las mang du phyin par brten yab gzhis zhabs gas rnams kyis phran gnyis la/ rnam kun g.yog po gcig 'khrid pa de'i thog da cha 'phar ma zhig khrid dgos zhes bsam tshul bton pa ltar g.yog po gnyis khrid rgyu byas/ khong tshos zer skad la/gra pa de tsho glen rtaṭa tsha po yod pas gzab gzab gnang dgos zhes bslab bya byed kyi yod/ skabs der 'chal gtam mang po gleng gros byung ba de lhang lhang dran bzhin 'dugaganas tshul de lta bu'i 'og bod kyi spyi tshogs legs bcos kyi lam du 'gro mi thub pa'i 'gag rdo gtso bo ni/ de dang de 'dra'i rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad par brten gang ci'i thad la legs bcos gtong ma thub pa'i dbang gis de mur lus//309

le tshan bcu drug pa/phran dang 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal gnyis ngo shes byung stangs dang khong gi dmar lugs kyi las 'gul/༄༅sku/ /de dus lha sdod go min tang gi don gcod khru'u yi las byed mi sna dang /rgya'i tshong rigs/ de bzhin go min tang gi so nyul mi sna phal cher phran gyis ngo shes shing / lhag par du bod shar phyogs nas yong ba'i rgya'i dmag dpon mtho slob thon pa'i bod mi na gzhon 'ba' pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ rgya ming la cang shing shi zhes pa dang 'brel 'dres chen po byung / gong min tang rgyal srung las khungs kyi sde tshan gnyis pas khong bod du gsang nyul du mngags gtong byas pa'i nang gi gtso che shos shigayin/'on kyang khong gis rgya mi gong rim 'go khrid tshor rgyun du mi 'dod pa'i 'khang ra byed kyi yod pa de'i rgyu mtshan rgya mi de tshos bod mi rnams la mthong chung byed lugs phran la shod kyi yod/phran khong sar yang yang bskyod de rgya nag gi chab srid 'pho 'gyur skor dang /dmag chen gnyis pa'i skabs go min tang gi dmag 'thab kyi snyan grags/ gung khran tang gi 'khrug slong bcas kyi skor skad cha mang po zhig go thos byung ba dang / lhag par du khong gis rang re bod mi yongs kyi dmigs yul mngon du 'gyur ched lag bstar cig
