byed phyogs thabs byus skor rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi 'grel bshad thengs mang brgyab byung / khong gi dmigs yul gtso bo de bod gzhung gis bod rigs yongs rdzogs la gcig gyur gyi 'go khrid gnang thub pa'i thog da yod bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi lam lugs de rim bzhin dmangs gtso'i lam lugs su bsgyur bkod gtong thub na/ bod kha ba can gyi mi dmangs rnams kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas yong thabs dang / de bzhin rgya nag nang khul gyi gnas tshul mi nyung ba zhig yang yang bshad byung /nyin zhig phran khong gi sar bskyod skabs khong gi tsha bo khams 'bras legs pa'i na gzhon zhig phran la ngo sprod gnang byung ba de'i ming la phun tshogs dbang rgyal zer/ khong ni 1931 lo mdo khams smad phyogs 'ba' mthil sgo ra nang pa zhes pa'i khyim du 'khrungs/ khong gi yab kyi mtshan la sgo ra a she dang / yum gyi mtshan la dbyangs can zer/ khong gnyis la bu rgan pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / de 'og chos 'phel/ thub bstan dbang phyug bu mo skal bzang lha mo/ bu skal bzang rnam rgyal/ bu mo skal bzang dbyangs 'dzoms bcas yin/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal chung dus khong gi spo bo sgo ra dge bshes kyi mdun du rab byung sdom pa blangs/ dgung 'tshe dgu la khong gi zhang po cang an shes rgya nag slob grar khrid nas lo dgu ring rgya yig slob sbyong byas/ slob sbyong bya yul de go min tang gi dbus chab srid slob grwa/ (krung dbyang greng kre tu zho'o / yi bod sog sde tshan gyi 'dzin grwa'i nang du slob sbyong byas/dus skabs der khong gis rgya nag go min tang gi rgyal sa drung ching du bca' bzhugs u ru su'i gzhung tshab las khungs kyi chab srid sde tshan gyi spyi khyab phe te ling 342

dang 'brel ba byung nas des phun tshogs dbang rgyal rgyal spyi gsum pa'i gung khran tang gi sgrig 'dzugs nang du ngo sprod byas te bod ljongs gung khran tang yan lag gcig 'dzugs dgos lugs bkod mngags byas pa bzhin khong gis bod ljongs rgyal spyi gsum pa'i gung khran tshogs pa zhig gsar gtod byed rgyu byas/ skabs der khong gi slob grogs 'ba' pa ngag dbang skal bzang dang / ho bstan 'dzin gnyis tshogs mi'i gas su zhugs yod/ go min tang gzhung gos phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi bya spyod dang / gtam brjod la dogs pa byung nas slob grwa nas phyir 'bud byas/ phe te ling gis phun tshogs dbang rgyal re zhig ru sur slob sbyong la gtong rgyu thabs shes byas yod kyang / 'gro bskyod ma bde bas de mur lus nas phyi lo 1943 lo yas mas su rang yul 'ba' la phyir log gis khong gi gcung po thub bstan dbang phyug dang /chos 'phel sogs tshogs pa'i nang du ngo sprod kyis tshogs mi'i khongs su zhugs/khong 'ba' nas sde dge dgon chen du gung khran gyi lam lugs spel thabs ched der yod go min tang gis btsugs pa'i rgya yig slob grwa'i dge rgan gyi las 'gan re zhig blangs pa'i skabs der mdo stod smad phyogs sa khul yul gru khag la dbang bsgyur byed mkhan go min tang gi dmag dpon le'u lhun hus dmag shed can gyis khong 'dzin bzung bya rtsis kyi gnas tshul zhang po cang an shi yis gsang brda btang 'byor ltar/ rang yul du bzhugs bzod bde min gyis gcung po thub bstan dbang phyug mnyam khrid kyis sde dge nas chab mdor 'byor/ chab mdor bod gzhung bca' bzhugs mdo spyi g.yu thog bkris don grub kyi sku mdun la bcar nas phan tshun ngo shes kyi 'brel ba legs po byung ba'i thog mdo spyi g.yu thog gis phun tshogs dbang rgyal lha sar bskyod thabs kyi rogs ram gnang ba ma zad/ bka' 313

blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs mchog la ngo sprod dang sbrags khong la rogs ram yong ba'i phyag bris kyang 'bul skur gnang /de nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal chab mdo nas lha sa bar lam bar bde bgrod kyis lha sa la 'byor nas re zhig khong gi zhang po blo bzang chos 'phel/ (dga' ldan pha ra khang tshan gyi gra log) sar bzhugs/phyi lo 1944yas mas tsam la rgya gar du khyug tsam phebs te bka' sbug khul du mthar phyin 'ba' pu ngo shes nas de brgyud rgya gar gyi gung khran tang mi 'jo ti lha su 050'i 6255) ngo shes nas 'brel ba byung ste khong gnyis ka ma le ring lugs la dga' zhen chen po'i thog nas ma 'ongs pa'i rang rang so so'i yul de gung khran ring lugs kyi lha yul lta bur bsgyur bkod gtong rgyu'i phugs re shar ba zhig yin/khong gnyis kyi 'brel ba de ni/ rgya gar dang bod khyim mches rgyal khab gnyis kyi gung khran tang mi thug 'phrad kyi lo rgyus 'brel ba thengs dang po yin zhing /phun tshogs dbang rgyal ka ta khul 'jo ti lha su'i nang du lhan bzhugs gnang rjes lha sar phyir phebs kyis khong gi zhang po cang shing shi yis khong la go min tang gi lha sar bca' sdod don gcod khru'u yis rgya mi'i rig gzhung spel rgyu'i ched du lha khul gyi kha che hu'i rigs dang / rgya rigs bcas kyi bu phrug tshor slob sbyong bya rgyu'i slob grwa chung ba zhig btsugs yod pa de'i dge rgan gyi las 'gan zhig ngo sprod byas nas 1949 lo bar dge rgan gyi las ka gnang /de sngon 1945 lo'i dgun dus tsam la rgya gar ka la ka tar gung khran rgyal spyi gsum pa'i na gzhon sde tshogs tshogs 'du tshogs skabs phun tshogs dbang rgyal la bod kyi gung khran rgyal spyi gsum pa'i na gzhon sde tshogs kyi 'thus mi zhig 314

gtong rgyu'i brda lan 'byor ba ltar/ khong gi gcung po thub bstan dbang phyug tshogs 'du der bod kyi gung khran rgyal spyi gsum pa'i na gzhon sde tshogs kyi 'thus mir btang ste/ tshogs 'dur phebs mkhan yongs rdzogs kyis bod kyi gzhon nu sde tshogs kyi 'thus mi thub bstan dbang phyug mthon por bteg nas dga' bsu chen po zhus yod pa red/phran dang phun tshogs dbang rgyal ngo shes byung nas khong gi zhang po cang shing shi bzhugs sar yang yang 'dzoms pa ma zad/ da lta dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'dzam gling gi chab srid 'pho gyur dang / lhag par du bod kyi chab srid kyi gnas stangs dang /ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam bcas kyi skor gleng mol yang yang yong gi yod/ nyin zhig cang shing shi bzhugs sar bskyod de phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / sog po rla ba bzang po/ 'ba' pa gzhon nu blo bzang don yod/ cang shing shi yi gcung po blo bzang chos 'phel/ shod drung nor rgyas bcas lhan du 'dzoms yod sar cang shing shi yis de rnams phran la ngo sprod byas te/ khong gis phran la khong rnam pas bod kyi chab srid mdun lam gyi bsam tshul nga tsho dang gcig gyur yin 'dug par brten thun mong gi bsam tshul dang / dmigs yul de dngos su yong thabs su sgrig 'dzugs zhig 'dzugs thub pa byung na legs po yong gi red/ khyed rang sgrig 'dzugs 'di'i nang zhugs 'dod yod na nga tsho tshang mas dga' bsu zhu gi yin ces zer byung /de sngon khong gis de skor phran la thengs 'ga' shas brjod myong ba da lam de'i skor slar yang 'grel bshad byas pa ltar/ phran gyis som nyi med par sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang du zhugs 'dod yod ces khas len byas/ de nas nyin shas rjes cang shing shi yis gsol tshig la mgron 'bod gnang ste nga tsho tshang ma dus thog tu 'dzoms nas 345

phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis sgrig 'dzugs de'i sgrig gzhi zin bris shig rob tsam bkod nas khong gis tshang mar sgrog sbyangs gnang ba'i thog tshig 'bru re re bzhin khong gis 'grel brjod kyang gnang ste/ chig don re zung la legs bcos kyis bsam 'char 'don mkhan byung ba ltar legs bcos byas/da bar lo rgyun ring po song stabs sgrig gzhi'i don tshan rnams kyi tshig don re re bzhin ma nges kyang sgrig 'dzugs de'i ming la bod ljongs gsar brje mna' 'brel tshogs pa zhes btags yod snyam/ de'i don gnad gtso bo che ba'i gas su 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i skya dbang bla na med pa'i dbu khrid 'og gangs can pa yod do cog gcig sgril thog bod mi dmangs rnams kyi spyi tshogs la legs bcos bya rgyu zhes 'khod yod pa rob tsam dran gyi 'dug tshogs 'du tshogs yul lha sa gnam bde legs yin/ de nas tshang mas sgrig gzhi'i gsham du ming rtags re bkod pa nas bzung nga tsho rla re bzhin mnyam 'dzoms bya rgyu byas/de sngon phun tshogs dbang rgyal chab mdo khul la shod drung nor rgyas dang ngo shes nas grogs po chags te rjes su khong gnyis lha sar 'dzoms nas khong gnyis 'brel ba sngar bas dam zab tu gyur pa ma zad/ bod ljongs gung khran tshogs pa'i khongs su zhugs/ shod drung nor rgyas dang / lcang lo can sras dbang phyug rgyal po gnyis spyan mched 'brel ba thugs snang dge yul yin stabs khong gis phun tshogs dbang rgyal la sku drag na gzhon deng rabs kyi shes yon la mos mthun yod pa 'ga' shas ngo sprod byas pa'i nang lcang lo can sras dbang phyug rgyul po dang / bkras mthong sras bsod nams stobs 'byor bcas ngo shes grogs po nye po chags nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis khong rnams la/ gung khran rgyal spyi gsum pa'i las 'gul nang 316

ma le ring lugs kyi lta ba bcas 'grel bshad byas pa dang / slad khong gi chab srid kyi phugs re'i 'grel bshad byas pa bcas khong rnams rim bzhin thun mong ma yin pa'i blo mthun gyi 'brel ba byung /bkras mthong sras bsod nams stobs 'byor chos dang / rig gzhung la ha cang brtson pa'i thog rgya yig dang dbyin yig bcas legs po mkhyen gyi yod/ khong gi thugs rgyud 'jam zhing / mi tshang mas khong la mi drag gi sras kyi nang nas phul byung zhig yin par dpe mtshon lta bur bsngags brjod byed kyiyod/phun tshogs dbang rgyal chab mdo nas lha sar 'byor rjes mdo spyi g.yu thog gis bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs la ngo sprod zhus pa nas bzung phun tshogs dbang rgyal zur khang gi gzim shag tu yang yang bcar ba'i mgron po zhig tu gyur te/ khong gnyis kyis bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho bar legs bcos bya dgos pa'i skor yang yang gros gleng byung yod lugs phun tshogs dbang rgyal nas bshad pa go thos byung /1947 lo cang shing shi yis rgyun du khong gi nan cing du yod pa'i gong rim 'go khrid tshor 'khang ra byed pa'i rkyen gyis khong gi rgyun gron dang / phogs dngul bcas ma btang bar yun ring song bar brten 'tsho ba'i gnas stangs zhan po chags te 'gro gron la dka' ngal 'phrad rkyen 'tsho ba 'khyol thabs ched lha sa bar skor dga' ldan shar du ja mngar mo'i tshong khang zhig btsugs nas 'tsho ba bskyal/lo de'i zu 13 tsam la/ cang shing shi yis ja mngar mo'i tshong khang sgo phye bas sngon gyi nyin zhig gi dgong dro cang shing shi nang du khong gi spyan mched rnams dang /pha yul gcig pa'i 'ba' pa thugs snang dge yul rnam rgyal la gsol ston zhig 3 7

bshams te/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal yang skabs der bcar 'dug de'i dgong dro dus tshod phyi po byas nas phun tshogs dbang rgyal zhang po'i nang du bzhugs pa dang /rogs pa 'ba' pa blo bzang don yod gcig pu rang gi sdod sar phyir log bskyod de kun bzang rtse gzim shag gi rgyab kyi srang lam du slebs skabs mi gzhan zhig gis blo bzang don yod kyi ltag khung la me mda' thung mda' brgyab ste rkyen lam du btang /de ni de sngon nan cing go min tang gi dmag don sdom rtsis sde tshan (gsang ba'i las khungs ) gyis sha'o khrung ching la 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal lkog gsod gtong dgos pa'i bka' btang 'byor ltar sha'o khrung ching gis phun tshogs dbang rgyal lkog gsod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig thengs mang byas kyang gra ma 'grig par lus/ de nyin phun tshogs dbang rgyal zhang po'i sar sku mgron du bskyod de phyir log byed pa'i lam bar lkog gsod bya rgyu'i gra sgrig byas kyang / phun tshogs dbang rgyal de'i dgong mo zhang po'i sar bsdad stabs blo bzang don yod phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi tshab tu lkog gsod btang / skabs der mi tshang mas sha'o khrung ching gis bsad pa red ces ngos 'dzin gyi gleng mol ji mang byung ste 'ba' pa cang shing shis gtsos pa'i lha sdod 'ba' pa rnams kyis lha sdod go min tang gi don gcod khru'u brgyud nan cing go min tang la snyan seng zhus pas/ go min tang gis lha sdod don gcod khru'u krang khyen zhi'i krang la thag gcod gyi bka' phab ste khyen zhi'i krang gis sha'o khrung ching nas blo bzang don yod kyi gcung por 'das mchod kyi 'gro gron bod dngul srang nyis khri lnga stong sprod rgyu'i bar 'dum thag gcod byed dgos byung /de nas bzung bod gzhung dmangs rnams kyis rgya mi'i bya spyod la zhen pa log nas ma dga' ba'i gnas shig chags/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis slob gra'i 348

dge rgan gyi las zhor du ja mngar mo'i tshong khang de'i 'dzin skyong gi rogs ram yang gnang gi 'dug sog po rla ba bzang po ni/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyi grogs po nye po zhig yin pa ma zad/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang lo mnyam yin pa'i na gzhon phul du byung ba zhig yin/ nga tsho thengs 'ga' shas mnyam 'dzoms byung nas ngo shes yag po chags/ khong bod skad ha cang bde po'i thog lha sa'i sgra gdangs gtsang ma rgyag mkhan zhig yin zhing / bod mi tshos khong sog po'i mi rigs shig yin par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod kyang / dngos 'brel nyi hong gi mi rigs yin 'dug ming ngo mar hi sa'o khe mu ra (51520517577) zhes zer/ de sngon dmag chen gnyis pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i stod tsam nyi hong dmag don so nyul sde tshan gyis khong nang sog khul du btang ste sog skad dang / bod skad sbyong brdar byed du bcug nas mdo smad khul brgyud dbyar dus zi ling tshong 'grul mnyam du lha sa khul chos kyi slob gnyer du bskyod pa yin tshul gyis lha sar 'byor/ de rjes khams phyogs khul dang / rgya gar bcas la snga rjes thengs 'ga' shas tshong 'grul yin tshul gyis yul gyi gnas babs sogs la nyams zhib tu bskyod 'dug1945 lo khong bka' sbug tu sdod skabs nyi hong rgyal khab de dmag pham nyes byung ste/ a dbyin ru rgya mthun phyogs rgyal khab bzhi la gleng med du mgo btags byas pa'i gnas tshul thos ma thag blo pham chen po skyes te bka' sbyag khul gyi nye 'gram dur khrod du rang shi rgyag rgyur blo thag bcad nas lag pa gnyis kyis gri zhig bzung ste rang nyid kyi grod par 'dzugs grabs byed skabs rgyab nas khong gi sog po grogs po zhig gis glo bur gri 'phrog nas khong la thabs sdug gi las ka de 'dra ma byed 319

ces kha rdung dang / bslab bya mang po brgyab nas de mnyam slar yang lha sar phyir log byas/de rjes bka' sbug khul gyi hom si slob gar dbyin ji'i skad yig slob sbyong du yong ba red/ lo gcig tsam gyi rjes la ka la ka tar bskyod de rgya gar gzhung gi nyen rtog las khungs su rang nyid nyi hong pa zhig yin ces dang / rang nyes rang 'khur byas te nyen rtog las khungs kyis khong lo gcig min tsam btson 'jug gis rgya gar gzhung gis nyi hong gzhung la 'dri brtsad byas mthar rang nyid kyi gces pa'i rgyal khab tu phyir log thub pa byung zhes phyi lo 1955 lo phran nyi hong du spro 'cham la bskyod skabs phran gnyis slar yang ngo 'phrad skabs khong gis gong gsal lo rgyus zhib gsal gsungs byung ba ma zad/ de sngon nga tsho mnyam du btsugs pa'i tshogs pa de'i skor gleng mol yang byung / tshogs pa'i sgrig gzhi'i zin bris bkod pa'i nang du tu la'i bla ma'i sku dbang de dmag chen gnyis pa'i gong gi nyi tong gong ma'i dbang cha bla na med pa de'i dpe mtshon blangs pa'i bsam tshul de 'don mkhan khong yin zhes gsungs byung /phyi lo 1949 lo rgya nag skam sa chen po yongs su rgya dmar gung khran tang gis dbang sgyur byas pa'i skabs der bod gzhung gis slad dmar po'i ring lugs de bod ljongs su khyab mi yong ngam snyam pa'i dngangs skrag dang / dogs pa skyes te gnas skabs kyi nyen kha sel thabs su lo de'i rla bdun pa'i nang go min tang gi bod sdod don gcod khru'u yi ngo las dang / go min tang gi so myul/ de bzhin bod mi 'ba' pa phun tshogs dbang rgyal sogs gung khran tang mi yin par dogs pa yod rigs bcas kyang de rnams mnyam du rgya gar brgyud rgya nag tu 'phral thon dgos pa'i bka' btang 320

ba ltar/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal dang / zhang po cang shing shi bcas mnyam du lha sa nas rgya gar dang / hong kong brgyud rang yul 'ba' thang du phyir log byas/gong smos ltar dang thog phun tshogs dbang rgyal gyis krung go gung khran tang gi khongs gtogs ma yin par rgyal spyi gung khran gsum pa'i 'go khrid 'og bod ljongs gung khran tang zhig logs su btsugs nas ma khe si le nyin ring lugs de 'dzam gling gi yang steng bod ljongs su dar sprel btang nas 'byor med gral rim gyi las 'gul spel thabs kyi thugs re 'bad brtson gnang yang / dus skabs der mi rnams kyi blo yul las 'das pa'i dus yun thung ngu'i nang rgya dmar gung khran tang gis rgya nag skam sa chen po yongs su dbang sgyur byas pa'i thog rgyal spyi'i gnas bab la 'pho 'gyur chen po byung ste/ ru su gzhung gis rgyal spyi gung khran gsum pa'i sgrig 'dzugs de phyir bsdu byas pa'i gnas tshul des khong gi snying stobs ma zhum par rang yul du phyir log byas ma thag de sngon gsang ba'i thog nas btsugs pa'i sgrig 'dzugs de slar gso gong 'phel du btang nas bod shar dmangs gtso na gzhon rang skyong mna' 'brel tshogs par ming sgyur byas nas rgya dmar gung khran tang gi dpung sde'i nang du rla sgril gyis zhugs dgos byung ba red/ 'on kyang khong gis blo gcig sems gcig gis ma khe si le nyin gyi rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi lta ba gzhir bzung ste/ rgya dmar gung khran tang gi 'go khrid 'og rang yul bod mi rigs rnams kyi thob thang de thog mtha' bar gsum du brtson len byed ched rgya'i gtam dpe phyug po'i nor gyis bslu mi thub/'jigs zil bstan kyang mgo mi sgur/ zhes pa ltar dus yun de'i ring rang gi lta ba rgyun 'khyongs lhod med du bzung ba red//32
